### [1] [GoldiBench: Right Tools, Wrong Amount -- Benchmarking Agents on Effect Judgement in Professional Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31590)
*Wang Yang,Xinpeng Li,Yanyan Zhang,Chaoda Song,Shouren Wang,Debargha Ganguly,Vikash Singh,Chuang Ma,Xiaoran Cai,Kai Ye,Xiaotian Han,Vipin Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 GoldiBench——500 个跨五种专业软件（darktable、RawTherapee、GIMP、Inkscape、Blender）的编辑任务基准，通过 START/TARGET 配对与重渲染比对，将"操作能力"与"效果判断（量的大小）"分离测量，揭示现有智能体在决定工具用量这一核心能力上存在断崖式缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实编辑需求只描述"想要的效果"而非达成步骤，因此智能体必须自行判断各工具所需的"量"。但现有基准要么直接给出工具与数值，要么用量开放却依赖 VLM 评审，而后者会把半数甚至三倍强度的结果判为通过，无法测量这一能力。

Method: 构建 GoldiBench：五种应用中的 500 个任务，既可通过写程序也可通过 GUI 操作完成；每个任务由 START 图与隐藏程序渲染的 TARGET 图配对，使"量"由已知目标固定；将智能体编辑结果重新渲染后与 TARGET 比对评分；同一任务分别以"工具+数值""仅工具""仅目标"三种提示形式给出，以解耦操作与效果判断。评测覆盖 25 个开源、GUI 与闭源模型。

Result: 告知数值时智能体操作几乎无误（4B 以上模型用程序达 99–100%）；但仅给工具时最佳模型程序通过率仅 19%、GUI 通过率 33%，且规模扩大无法弥合差距；手册帮助甚微；以文本形式给出实测 TARGET−START 差异可使通过率翻倍以上，而以图像形式呈现对开源模型无效；允许四次渲染时智能体几乎总在首次后停止，强制比较后强模型通过率翻倍。

Conclusion: 智能体掌握工具知识，却既不"读取"也不"校验"所需的量；核心瓶颈在于效果的定量判断而非操作技能，规模扩展亦不能解决。

Abstract: Real editing requests describe a look, not the steps to reach it, so an agent that serves them must judge how much of each tool the look takes. Existing benchmarks do not measure this: their tasks either state the tools and values, or leave the amount open and are scored by VLM judges that pass more than half of half- and triple-strength results. We introduce GoldiBench, a benchmark of 500 editing tasks in five professional applications (darktable, RawTherapee, GIMP, Inkscape, Blender), solvable by writing a program or by operating the GUI. Each task pairs a START image with a TARGET rendered from a hidden program, so the amount is fixed by a known target; the agent's edit is re-rendered and compared with TARGET, and the same task is posed with the tools and values, the tools only, or the goal only, separating operation from effect judgement. Across 25 open, GUI and closed models, agents operate well (99-100% with programs from 4B up when told the values) but fall off a cliff when they must judge the amount: given only the tools, the best model passes 19% of the tasks with programs and 33% through the GUI, and scale does not close the gap. Manuals barely help; the measured TARGET-START difference more than doubles the pass rate, but the same difference shown as an image does not for open models. Allowed four renders, agents almost always stop after the first; forced to compare, the strong models double their pass rate. Agents know the tools, but neither read nor check the amount.

</details>


### [2] [CoRe: Jointly Learning Contextual Representations for Understanding and Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31397)
*Hangke Sui,Chang Li,Yuyan Li,Mohammad Haris Baig,Daniel Ulbricht*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CoRe 用一套共享的上下文表示统一理解与生成：图像与文本各有一个表示，该表示既被读取用于理解、又条件化另一模态、还是该模态连续流生成的所在空间；无需预训练语言模型、文本编码器或 VAE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解（对比学习式表示）与生成（潜空间扩散/流模型）通常依赖分离的表示与大量预训练组件（LM、文本编码器、VAE），规模大且信息冗余。作者试图验证：单一表示是否足以同时支撑双向理解与生成，以及生成是否为理解带来增益。

Method: CoRe 从零训练（383M 参数，CC12M）两个模态各一个连续表示；每个表示可被读出用于理解、条件化另一模态、并由高斯噪声出发的连续流在其中生成该模态。控制实验包括：(1) 等数据等架构下与"仅理解塑形后冻结"的表示对比；(2) 与"理解不参与塑形"的生成空间对比；(3) 强读出探针（注意力分割探针、单目深度、冻结语言模型读取）。

Result: 全局理解上与同数据仅对比学习基线持平；COCO-30K FID 10.10，可媲美依赖预训练组件的大模型生成器；等数据等架构下双向生成（文生图、图生文）均优于冻结表示方案，且提示词跟随更好；在分割探针、单目深度、冻结 LM 读出上超过对比基线；因生成位于理解表示内，冻结的真实图像探针可直接读取并操控中间状态，模型无需额外训练即可对自身样本排序；双向连续流均可蒸馏至少步采样。

Conclusion: 单一表示足以同时支撑理解与生成：理解使表示在语义上更有组织，生成使表示保留更多信息，二者互补；生成带来的额外信息可被更强的读出方式利用。

Abstract: We introduce CoRe, in which understanding and generation jointly shape one contextual representation for images and one for text, trained from scratch. Each representation is read for understanding, conditions the other modality, and is the space in which that modality is generated by a continuous flow from Gaussian noise. With 383M parameters trained on CC12M and no pretrained language model, text encoder, or VAE at inference, CoRe matches a same-data contrastive-only baseline in global understanding and reaches COCO-30K FID 10.10, comparable to much larger generators built on pretrained components. In controlled comparisons at equal data and architecture, CoRe generates better in both directions (text to image and image to text) than a representation shaped by understanding alone and then frozen, and follows prompts better than generating in a space that understanding does not shape. In the other direction, with an attentive segmentation probe, on monocular depth, and when read by a frozen language model, CoRe surpasses the contrastive-only baseline: generation adds information that stronger readouts reach. Because generation runs inside the understanding representation, frozen real-image probes read and steer intermediate states and the model ranks its own samples without extra training. Because both modalities use continuous flows, both also distill to a few steps. Our controls indicate why one representation suffices: understanding organizes the representation semantically, while generation makes it retain more information.

</details>


### [3] [BEARING: Who Is Talking to Whom? Grounding Acoustic Direction in Vision for Online Multi-Party Conversation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31735)
*Nader Lobandi,Lombe Chileshe,Mohammad Mehdi Hosseini,Mohammad H. Mahoor*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BEARING：以麦克风阵列测得的声源方向为核心几何信号，构建在线、免校准标注的多人对话“谁在对谁说”系统，方向既作视觉提示、又作融合输入与可验证奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有领先系统在单通道片段上离线处理说话人/受话人判定，并用自评估奖励对齐模型，缺乏几何约束与在线能力。

Method: 用相机旁麦克风阵列的声源方向作为唯一测量信号：(1) 从数据流中学习免标签校准，将该方向配准到图像；(2) 在线人脸-声音-方向注册表，无需注册录入；(3) 方向分别用作VLM视觉提示（说话人标记或屏外来向箭头）、与视觉主动说话人检测进行可靠性加权融合的输入、以及对齐的可验证奖励（命名说话人须位于声源方向、置信度须与校验一致、"group"恒答不得分）；全部在线决策，前瞻窗口为显式参数。

Result: 在AMI三个站点与自我中心EasyCom共9,498条带受话人标注的语句上，方向提示使说话人准确率由54%升至74%；受话人准确率仅变动约2点。AVDIAR共位说话人场景中视觉主动说话人检测保持95%，而单靠方向降至59%。可验证奖励在GRPO、reward-ranked微调与DPO下均优于自评估；前瞻由5s缩至0.5s在AMI上损失4.5 DER点；在线学习配准在前两分钟有性能下降，随后超过纯视觉方案。

Conclusion: 声源方向是可测量、可验证的强几何先验，显著提升说话人定位与在线对齐效果；受话人判定更依赖语言内容而非空间位置，方向与视觉主动说话人检测互补。

Abstract: Understanding a group conversation means deciding, from video and audio, who is speaking and to whom. Leading systems treat these tasks offline on single-channel clips and align models with a self-evaluation reward. We propose BEARING, a geometry-first alternative built on one measured signal: the direction from which a microphone array beside the camera hears a sound. A label-free calibration learned from the stream registers this direction into the camera image, and an online registry of faces, voices and directions needs no enrollment. The registered direction serves as (i) a visual prompt for a vision-language model, a marker on the speaker or an arrow toward an off-screen source; (ii) one input of a reliability-weighted fusion with visual active-speaker detection, for speakers in the same direction from the array; and (iii) a verifiable reward for alignment: the named speaker must sit where the sound comes from, the confidence must match that check, and always answering "group" earns nothing. Every decision is online, with the lookahead as an explicit parameter. On 9,498 addressee-labelled utterances from three AMI sites and egocentric EasyCom, the direction prompt raises speaker accuracy from 54% to 74%; addressee accuracy moves by about two points, because telling one addressee from the group depends on the words more than on where people are. For co-located speakers on AVDIAR, visual active-speaker detection holds 95% where direction alone falls to 59%. The verifiable reward beats self-evaluation under GRPO, reward-ranked fine-tuning and DPO; shrinking the lookahead from 5 s to 0.5 s costs 4.5 DER points on AMI, and learning the registration online costs a dip in the first two minutes before the system overtakes vision alone. Code and evaluation protocols will be released.

</details>


### [4] [ARS-VLM: Visually Aligned Augmented Random Search for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32147)
*Xiangwei Wang,Jianyuan Lin,Peng Wang,Saman Halgamuge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出前向零阶优化框架 ARS-VLM，无需反向传播与参考模型即可对 VLM 进行多模态推理后训练，在 7.5 倍更少步数下达到 GRPO 级性能并避免 OOD 崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一阶 RL（如 GRPO）虽广泛用于 VLM 多模态推理后训练，但反向传播、优化器状态与参考模型带来沉重显存与系统开销；前向零阶方法（ES/ARS）可规避这些开销，却尚未用于 VLM 推理。直接套用标准 ES/ARS 存在两大失效模式：(i) patch 网格过拟合，拟合脆弱的网格特定视觉 token 伪影而忽略空间不变性；(ii) 灾难性遗忘，无界的高秩参数与策略漂移损害通用感知与 OOD 任务。

Method: ARS-VLM 包含三项设计：1) 从双线性配对的跨网格视图提取对比视觉基，将扰动集中于共享视觉信号并抑制 patch 位移伪影；2) 用软子空间先验锚定浅层视觉融合层、放开深层推理层，无需参考模型即约束策略漂移；3) 在配对视图上对扰动打分，于 top-k 选择中剔除视图脆弱方向。

Result: 在 Qwen3-VL-4B 与 Qwen3-VL-8B 上评测。8B 模型 20 步即达 61.0% 验证准确率，GRPO 需 150 步（优化步数少 7.5 倍），且避免 vanilla ARS/ES 的后期 OOD 崩溃；在七个 OOD 视觉推理基准上单视图微准确率 75.41%，与全参数 GRPO 的 75.31% 相当。

Conclusion: 前向零阶后训练可在显著降低内存与系统开销、减少优化步数的同时，达到与全参数 GRPO 可比的推理与 OOD 泛化性能，为 VLM 后训练提供了轻量替代方案。

Abstract: First-order reinforcement learning, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is widely used to post-train Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for multimodal reasoning. However, it incurs heavy memory and system overhead from backpropagation, optimizer states, and a reference model. Forward-only zeroth-order (ZO) methods, such as Evolution Strategies (ES) and its top-k variant Augmented Random Search (ARS), avoid these overheads via reward-guided weight perturbations, yet remain unexplored for VLM reasoning. We find that directly applying standard ES or vanilla ARS to VLMs suffers from two fundamental failure modes: (i) patch-grid overfitting, fitting fragile grid-specific visual token artifacts while ignoring spatial invariants, and (ii) catastrophic forgetting, degrading general perception and out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks due to unbounded high-rank parameter and policy drift. We propose ARS-VLM, a visually aligned Augmented Random Search framework for forward-only VLM post-training. First, ARS-VLM extracts a contrastive visual basis from bilinearly paired cross-grid views, concentrating perturbations on shared visual signals while suppressing patch-shift artifacts. Second, ARS-VLM anchors shallow visual-fusion layers with a soft subspace prior while freeing deep reasoning layers, restraining policy drift without a reference model. Third, ARS-VLM scores perturbations on paired views to discard view-fragile directions during top-k selection. We evaluate ARS-VLM on Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B on multimodal reasoning tasks. On 8B, ARS-VLM reaches 61.0% validation accuracy in 20 steps versus 150 for GRPO (7.5x fewer optimization steps) and avoids the late OOD collapse of vanilla ARS and ES. Moreover, ARS-VLM achieves 75.41% single-view micro accuracy across seven OOD vision reasoning benchmarks, compared with 75.31% for full-parameter GRPO, using forward-only post-training.

</details>


### [5] [DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33153)
*Binfei Ji,Zhiwen Cao,Anqi Yang,Prem Seetharaman,Shuo Yang,Ratheesh Kalarot,Yingyan Celine Lin,Mingze Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiaCap 是一个用于综合对话字幕生成的音视频 LLM，为视频中每句话输出转写文本、时间戳和说话人视觉描述，通过两阶段训练统一了语音时间定位与音视频说话人日志任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对话字幕生成中，话语时间定位（utterance timing）与音视频说话人日志（audiovisual diarization）高度耦合，但通常被分开处理；同时缺乏同时对时间戳、说话人分组与说话人绑定的细粒度监督信号。

Method: 两阶段训练：（1）在 225K 精选片段上用合成字幕（对每句话密集标注细节）进行训练；（2）在 2.9K 人工校正片段上用强化学习微调，采用直接评估话语时间、说话人分组和说话人绑定的细粒度反馈，将各任务统一于单一模型。评测使用扩展后的 DiaDemBench（新增话语级时间戳与字幕脱敏）。

Result: 在 DiaDemBench 上，DiaCap（使用现成语义转写）与端到端变体 DiaCap-E2E 均取得强结果；DiaCap 的音视频说话人日志性能与 Gemini 4 Argon 相当，而时间戳准确率显著领先（76.59 vs. 42.76 TIME）。模型在多语言及分钟级长视频上保持较强日志性能，并可迁移至音视频问答任务。

Conclusion: 将话语时间定位与音视频说话人日志统一建模、并以细粒度强化学习反馈进行精调，可有效提升对话字幕的整体质量，尤其在时间戳精度上带来显著增益，并具备多语言、长视频与下游任务的泛化能力。

Abstract: We present DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning, which produces the transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of the speaker for every utterance in a video. Considering that utterance timing and audiovisual diarization are tightly coupled, DiaCap unifies the tasks in a single model, trained in two complementary stages. First, we train DiaCap on 225K curated clips, using synthetic captions that densely label every utterance in detail. Second, we further refine the model via reinforcement learning on 2.9K human-corrected clips, using fine-grained feedback that directly evaluates utterance timing, speaker grouping, and speaker binding. On DiaDemBench, which we extend with utterance-level timestamps and subtitle redaction, both DiaCap with off-the-shelf transcripts and its end-to-end variant DiaCap-E2E achieve strong results. Specifically, DiaCap performs on par with Gemini 4 Argon in audiovisual diarization while clearly outperforming it in timestamp accuracy (76.59 vs. 42.76 TIME). It also maintains strong diarization on multilingual and minute-long videos, and transfers to audiovisual question answering.

</details>


### [6] [HuluOPD: Unifying Heterogeneous Medical Specialists into One Lightweight Model with Unlabeled Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32021)
*Yuncheng Zhang,Songtao Jiang,Yitian Tang,Zijie Meng,Zihan Xu,Xuxiang Ren,Jian Wu,Hualiang Wang,Zuozhu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HuluOPD在线策略蒸馏方法，仅用无标注提示即可将五个异构医学专科视觉语言模型统一为单一轻量模型，10%参数保留94%性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专科VLM各自专精但难以统一：训练数据多为私有、架构不保证一致、分别部署成本高，且现有整合方式依赖参考答案或专家训练数据。

Method: 提出HuluOPD在线策略蒸馏配方：轻量学生模型对每个无标注提示生成回答，由该提示模态对应的专科教师进行监督；设计continuation-aligned跨分词器损失，使其在架构与分词器均不一致时仍可蒸馏。同时构建HuluOPDCorpus（914k无标注提示）与HuluOPDBench（47k留出测试项），覆盖90余个公开数据集。

Result: 在五个专科（超声、病理、OCT、眼底照相、牙科影像）上验证：合并参数10%的单模型保留94%问答性能，2%参数版本保留89%；并在132k测试项（含第三方基准）上以统一协议评测。

Conclusion: 首次实现无需专科训练数据、也无需共享架构即可统一异构医学专科VLM，为低成本部署多专科能力提供可行路径。

Abstract: Specialist medical vision-language models (VLMs) are strong within their specialties but hard to unify: their training data are often private, and independently developed specialists cannot be assumed to share an architecture. Deploying these large models separately is costly. We present HuluOPD, an on-policy distillation recipe that unifies heterogeneous specialists into one lightweight VLM using only unlabeled prompts, without requiring reference answers or the specialists' training data. The lightweight model answers each prompt, and the specialist of the prompt's modality supervises its response; a continuation-aligned cross-tokenizer loss makes this possible even when they differ in architecture and tokenizer. We apply HuluOPD to five specialists, for ultrasound, pathology, optical coherence tomography, fundus photography, and dental imaging. To distill and evaluate them, we build HuluOPDCorpus, 914k unlabeled prompts, and HuluOPDBench, 47k held-out test items, from over 90 public datasets, and score all models under one protocol on 132k test items, including third-party benchmarks. A single model with 10% of the five specialists' combined parameters retains 94% of their question-answering performance, and one with 2% retains 89%. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of unifying heterogeneous medical specialist VLMs without requiring their training data or a shared architecture.

</details>


### [7] [Factorized Context Attention: From Emulated to Native Grid Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32423)
*Mohamed Eltahir,Manar Eyad,Yara Alzahrani,Fatimah Albesher,Duaa M. Tahir,Tanveer Hussain,Naeemullah Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的分块稀疏注意力 FCA，把 grid probing 的"模拟注意力"原生实现为模型自身注意力，一次编码、批量前向并配合阶梯位置调度，在长视频、长文本与图像定位上以极小成本复现甚至超越其精度与覆盖范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着上下文变长，单次前向推理变慢、精度下降，且受限于上下文窗口；稀疏注意力虽高效但仍存在后两个限制；近期免训练的 grid probing 通过让冻结模型对短局部/跨步子片段重复提问可恢复精度并扩展覆盖，但每个片段都要重新编码，计算被整体重复，成本高昂。

Method: 核心洞察是 grid probing 本质是一种"模拟注意力"——通过 prompt 从模型外部复现的注意力模式，因为每次探测仅限制问题可见的输入范围。据此提出 Factorized Context Attention (FCA)：一种免训练的分块稀疏注意力，将该模式作为模型自身注意力原生运行；输入仅编码一次为 KV cache，所有片段以掩码序列在一次批量前向中读取，并采用阶梯位置调度（stair position schedule）使每个片段都落在训练时的位置范围内。

Result: 在长视频理解、长上下文文本推理与图像定位任务上，FCA 以极小的成本达到与 grid probing 相当的精度与覆盖范围：长视频上较单次前向提升约 10 分，长篇小说上提升 9–14 分；可在超过一千帧的视频及四倍于窗口长度的文本中检索到目标；对同一输入的后续提问，耗时低至 grid probing 的十分之一。

Conclusion: 原生注意力可以保留模拟注意力带来的收益而不承担其成本，且完全基于现有的冻结语言模型与视觉-语言模型实现，无需额外训练。

Abstract: Models read a book, an hour of video, or an image in one forward pass. As the context grows, this pass slows down, loses accuracy, and stops at the context window. We introduce Factorized Context Attention (FCA), a training-free block-sparse attention that runs the same pattern natively, as the attention of the model itself. FCA encodes the input once into a KV cache, reads all spans as masked sequences in one batched forward, and uses a stair position schedule to keep every span inside the trained position range. Across long video understanding, long-context text inference and image grounding, FCA matches the accuracy and the reach of grid probing at a fraction of its cost. </details>


### [8] [BriConstrain: Geometrically Constrained Decoding for Autoregressive Brick Assembly Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33135)
*Nadav Magar,Amir Hertz,Ariel Shamir,Or Patashnik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 BriConstrain 约束解码方法，通过动态约束零件连接方式而非零件选择，将语言模型生成的 LEGO 装配的无碰撞率显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型虽能从文本生成 LEGO 装配，但生成结果常含相互碰撞或悬空未连接的零件。常用的"拒绝并重采样"策略会丢弃已解码 token，且无法保证最终构建有效。

Method: 采用约束解码：在采样前限制预训练模型的下一个 token 概率分布。由于砖块放置的有效性依赖非预先确定的构建状态，无法编译为固定文法，需动态检查。核心思路是约束"零件如何连接"而非"哪些零件相连"，以缩小组合爆炸的搜索空间。具体地，给定模型当前零件的预测及其想连接的父零件，用预计算的几何 oracle 枚举各种连接方式并过滤碰撞选项，再将模型的下一个 token 分布偏向剩余的有效候选。

Result: 在 BrickNet（显式标注连通性）上无碰撞构建率由 31% 提升至 91%；在作者提出的 ICLF（隐式连通性 LDraw 格式）上由 15% 提升至 65%；两种格式下均优于拒绝采样，且解码成本约为其 60%。

Conclusion: 动态约束连接方式是一种高效且通用的合法装配解码策略，可在降低解码开销的同时显著提高生成装配的几何与连通有效性。

Abstract: Language models can generate LEGO$^\circledR$ assemblies from text, but their builds often contain parts that collide or attach to nothing. The usual approach of rejecting and resampling invalid placements discards decoded tokens without guaranteeing a valid build. We present BriConstrain, a constrained decoding method that restricts a pretrained language model's next-token probabilities before sampling, steering it towards valid placements. Because the validity of a brick placement depends on the non-predetermined build state, it cannot be compiled into a fixed grammar and must be checked dynamically. However, checking the validity of a brick before sampling is challenging as the space of valid placements is combinatorially large and cannot be enumerated exhaustively. Our key idea is to narrow the search space by constraining how parts attach rather than which parts attach to each other. Concretely, given the model's predictions of the currently placed part, and the previously placed parent it wants to connect to, we constrain the model's choice of how they attach. This allows us to span the space of part attachments, using a precomputed geometric oracle, and to effectively filter out colliding options. With valid attachment candidates in hand, we bias the model's next-token distribution towards the remaining valid candidates. We evaluate our method on two LEGO$^\circledR$ formats and models: BrickNet, which annotates connectivity explicitly, and our proposed Implicit Connectivity LDraw Format (ICLF), which uses numeric values for placements and leaves connectivity implicit. </details>


### [9] [STAR: Counterfactual Dual-World Rollouts and Spatial Target Adaptive Reconstruction for Visual On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32472)
*Yi Zou,Zhuang Yan,Yudong Zhang,Xu Wang,Yang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STAR：融合反事实双世界 rollout 与空间注意力引导目标重构的视觉在线策略自蒸馏框架，提升细粒度视觉依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型依赖全局上下文与语言先验，忽略决定答案的局部细节；仅用高分辨率局部裁片的特权教师做在线自蒸馏时，模型在局部证据完全被遮挡时仍保留一半以上全图准确率，说明单图正确性不足以保证依赖局部证据，且各 token 对视觉纠正的需求随其空间注意力状态而异。

Method: 局部图像编辑构造成对“双世界”：同一问题与背景但答案决定性事实不同；共享学生独立采样轨迹，在图像一致前缀下暴露上下文捷径。每个世界内，教师对比真实裁片与均值色裁片确定视觉纠正方向；学生图像注意力与教师质心空间参考的散度自适应控制 token 级目标对数概率重构。无需辅助注意力损失或测试时工具开销。

Abstract: Vision-language models often rely on global context and language priors while overlooking answer-determining local details. Privileged visual on-policy self-distillation supervises full-image student rollouts using a frozen teacher that views high-resolution evidence crops. Yet our cross-scale diagnostics show that models retain over half of their full-image accuracy when local evidence is completely masked, indicating that single-image correctness does not guarantee reliance on local evidence, while the need for visual correction also varies across tokens with their spatial attention states. We propose STAR, a visual on-policy self-distillation framework combining independent counterfactual dual-world rollouts with spatial-attention-guided target reconstruction. Local image editing constructs paired worlds with identical questions and backgrounds but distinct answer-determining facts, where a shared student samples trajectories independently to expose contextual shortcuts under image-consistent prefixes. Within each world, the teacher contrasts real and mean-color crops to determine the visual correction direction, while the divergence between student image attention and a teacher-centroid spatial reference adaptively controls token-wise target log-probability reconstruction. Without auxiliary attention losses or test-time tool overhead, STAR improves Qwen3.5 across scales by up to 8.04 percentage points in average accuracy over initialization across six fine-grained benchmarks, reaches OPSD's final accuracy $4.7\times$ faster, and generalizes to out-of-domain reasoning tasks.

</details>

*Ang Qi,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出VFR（经验证的失败驱动修复）框架，指出"留出失败集准确率"是误导性指标，并揭示失败挖掘中的标签噪声与措辞捷径两大陷阱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接在模型自身失败样本上微调是修复视觉语言模型的直接手段，但以留出失败集准确率衡量成功存在系统性误导：人工审计100个Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct失败样本发现37个为标签错误；且挖掘出的失败共享措辞规律，仅用问题的分类器在73.2%的留出失败对上可答对两选项。

Method: VFR包含四个环节：类型化最小对失败挖掘；由三个LLM裁判在不看存储标签的条件下作答进行验证；答案优先的纠正性目标构造；带回放数据的LoRA微调。

Conclusion: 留出失败集准确率不足以作为修复成功判据，需引入独立标注、去条件化评估；验证环节与失败选择不可省略，同时需警惕否定捷径与多图能力退化等副作用。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a vision-language model on its own failures is a direct way to repair it, but accuracy on held-out failures, the obvious measure of success, misleads. Many mined failures are not model errors: a human audit of 100 failures of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on questions generated from COCO and GQA found label errors in 37. And mined failures share wording regularities: question-only classifiers get both answers right on 73.2% of held-out failure pairs. We study both traps with verified failure-driven repair (VFR): typed minimal-pair failure mining, verification by three LLM judges that answer without seeing the stored labels, answer-first corrective targets, and LoRA fine-tuning with replay. Paraphrasing the spatial questions keeps most of the gain (87.3% vs. the base model's 62.0%), though rewording lowers spatial repair on held-out failures from 92.9% to 76.8%. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多参考生成方法虽提供构图引导，但其规划的主体关系未被显式实例化，难以在合成前进行检查与修正，导致主体难以按指令可靠地组织进目标场景。

Conclusion: 将构图显式实例化为可检查、可修订的3D程序化视觉规划，能有效增强多参考图像生成对主体外观保持与空间关系组织的可靠性。

Abstract: Multi-reference image generation requires a model to preserve the appearance of selected subjects while arranging them according to an instruction. Despite recent progress in reference-based generation and compositional control, reliably organizing selected subjects into the intended scene remains challenging. Although existing methods provide various forms of compositional guidance, the planned relationships are not always explicitly instantiated for inspection and refinement before image synthesis. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGPIE, which represents the intended composition as a simplified 3D scene defined by an executable Blender program. A coding agent links each scene instance to its reference, checks the geometry and rendered view against the instruction, and revises the program to correct discrepancies. The final proxy rendering serves as a visual plan for the image generator. Using MAGPIE-Instruct-3K, we train the generator to follow this plan while drawing each subject's appearance from its reference. MAGPIE improves both Qwen and FLUX on DreamOmni2 and SconeEval. </details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Retrieving images of patients clinically similar to a given patient can support diagnosis, teaching and research. Training and evaluating retrieval systems requires knowing which images of different patients show the same finding, and existing datasets are small or narrow in scope. We construct PMC-PaIR, a dataset of 86,144 pairs of clinically similar images from 56,013 open-access PubMed Central case reports, which often document rare or challenging presentations. We develop an approach that follows citations, which often link case reports of similar patients. To determine what two linked cases share clinically, it prompts large language models to generate and answer hierarchical questions, from modality to diagnosis and findings, and to match images by caption using the answers. Experts find the pairs highly accurate, and this question-guided approach finds twice as many correct pairs as direct matching. Fine-tuning BiomedCLIP on PMC-PaIR improves retrieval in all modality, anatomy and diagnosis categories tested, for image-only queries and image queries with a short text naming the finding. </details>


### [13] [ASTERISM: Do Multimodal LLMs Actually Look at All the Images?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32316)
*Chanseul Cho,Dongwoo Kim,Noori Bae,Seungjae Moon,Seongsu Lee,Youngmin Ro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 现有19个多图基准约33k题项中，24.2%仅凭单图或问题即可作答，模型据此走"单图捷径"；作者构建经审计的ASTERISM基准（18.7k题）并指出RLVR同样奖励该捷径，提出跨图像信用分配CICA，使3个开源MLLM分数提升2.6–6.0分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多图基准本意考察模型跨图像整合证据的能力，但大量题项存在单图可解的漏洞。这种"单图捷径"会虚高评测分数，且现行RLVR对单图读出与跨图整合给予同等奖励，进一步强化捷径，导致评测与训练均无法真实衡量多图推理。

Method: （1）审计19个公开多图基准约33k题项，采用两阶段单图过滤，逐项判定是否仅凭一张图或问题本身即可定答案；（2）在捷径题上量化MLLM从单图恢复的准确率，并统计其在"单图不足"题项上重复单图答案的错误率；（3）筛选需多图的题项构建ASTERISM（18.7k，含2.0k修正/重写），统一格式、评分器与七类任务，并发布ASTERISM-Train（49k）与人工逐题核验的ASTERISM-Lite；（4）提出CICA，作为RLVR扩展，将信用重新分配到真正需要多图信息的token上。

Result: 24.2%的题项可由单图或问题单独决定；在这些题项上，MLLM从单图恢复的准确率达"全图相对纯文本增益"的中位数78%；即便单图不足，模型仍取捷径，错误答案重复此前单图答案的比例显著高于随机。ASTERISM-Lite上最强闭源MLLM仅得68%。现有RLVR目标对ASTERISM分数提升甚微；CICA在三个开源MLLM上提升2.6–6.0分，超过同数据下通用与视觉专用RL目标增益的两倍。

Abstract: Multi-image benchmarks aim to test whether a multimodal large language model (MLLM) combines evidence across images, but many of their items can be answered from a single image. Across about 33k items from 19 public benchmarks, our audit and a two-stage single-image filter find that one image or the question alone settles 24.2% of them. On these items, MLLMs recover from one image a median 78% of the accuracy that all images add over the text alone, so these items reward answering from one image, which we call the single-image shortcut. MLLMs take this shortcut even on items where one image is not enough. On such items, most of their wrong answers repeat an answer they give from one image, at a rate well above chance. We build ASTERISM, to our knowledge the largest audited multi-image benchmark, from these 19 benchmarks by keeping their items that need more than one image. Its 18.7k items, 2.0k of them corrected or rewritten, share one format, one scorer and seven task categories. We also release ASTERISM-Train with 49k training items and ASTERISM-Lite, a hard subset whose items we manually verify one by one. On ASTERISM-Lite, the strongest proprietary MLLM scores 68%. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), now common in MLLM post-training, rewards the shortcut as well, because a correct answer read off one image earns as much reward as one that combines images. In line with this, existing RLVR objectives add little to the ASTERISM score. To stop rewarding the shortcut in training as ASTERISM does in evaluation, we propose cross-image credit assignment (CICA), an extension of RLVR that moves the credit toward the tokens that need more than one image. On three open-source MLLMs, CICA raises the ASTERISM score by 2.6 to 6.0 points, more than twice the gain of each general and vision-specific RL objective trained on the same data.

</details>

Motivation: 人类会用图像与文字共同推理；让模型生成中间图像并据此继续推理（交错多模态推理）通常依赖任务特定的示范数据，而这类数据难以收集。

The second stage uses automatically constructed demonstrations for question-driven instruction tuning. At the same instruction-tuning budget, models trained with pretext reasoning outperform those trained with instruction tuning alone. *Phuc Linh Ngo,Thang Nguyen Duc,Truong Thanh Hung Nguyen,Hung Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 概念模型声称通过本体解码概念来为决策提供依据，但概念预测会泄漏标签、忽视局部性，并在新属性组合上缺乏可靠依据；本文因此追问：概念解码的决策何时可作为"证书"。作者将本体视为纠错码，提出证书所需的三项条件，并给出最小参考实现OCVE（每个部件在独立前向传播中从局部裁剪读出）。在FunnyBirds未见过类别上，OCVE在约0.4%风险下认证52%的图像，而掩码池化特征为14%、整图部件读取器为33%，且零样本准确率相当。CUB与真实交通标志实验验证了隔离读取降低认证风险；但在已见类别上本体较公平训练的黑箱无增益，隔离也带来准确率损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念瓶颈/概念嵌入模型常被视作可解释且可审计的决策依据，但已知其概念预测会泄漏标签信息、忽略局部性、并在新属性组合上依据不牢，导致"本体正确但决策错误"的情形。本文旨在厘清概念解码的决策在何种条件下能真正充当正确性证书，并定位失败机理（如跨概念捷径）。

Result: 在FunnyBirds未见组合上，MJCB与概念嵌入模型在正确本体下93–94%的认证为错误类别（仅用可见部件并加定位器门控的联合模型为60%）；OCVE在0.4%风险下认证52%图像，掩码池化为14%、整图读取器为33%（同等训练与门控下5.6%），零样本准确率相近；最佳基线（含校准版或仅限未见类）及仅统计一致部件的解码器风险仍高约3–8倍。CUB上隔离区域读取器准确率63.1% vs. 属性原型模型55.3%，未见物种认证风险低约6个百分点，较同关键点框内池化特征低约10个百分点。真实交通标志上隔离读取器将认证风险由99.8%降至67%，仍偏高，余下错误多为图标误读。

Conclusion: 概念解码的决策并非天然证书；其可认证性需满足可见证据排他、缺失部件如实报告、误读不依赖共享捷径三项条件，独立读取局部部件是实现该条件的关键。隔离读取显著降低认证风险且保持零样本准确率，但在已见类别上本体相对公平训练黑箱无增益，隔离本身亦牺牲部分准确率，真实场景（如交通标志）认证风险仍不可接受。

Abstract: Concept-based models justify a decision by concepts they claim to see, decoded through an explicit ontology. Yet concept predictions are known to leak label information, ignore locality, and be poorly grounded on new attribute combinations. A decision decoded from such concepts can satisfy the ontology and still be wrong, so we ask when it can serve as a certificate. On unseen combinations of familiar parts, a joint concept bottleneck model and a concept embedding model, trained as is standard, certify wrong classes 93-94% of the time despite a correct ontology (60% for a joint model trained only on visible parts and gated by a localizer). The joint model's part errors copy co-occurring values more often than chance (cross-concept shortcutting). Treating the ontology as an error-detecting code, we show that a certificate needs visible evidence excluding every rival, unseen parts reported as such, and rare misreads not driven by a shared shortcut. A minimal reference design, OCVE, reads each part from a local crop in its own forward pass. On unseen FunnyBirds classes, it certifies 52% of images at 0.4% risk, against 14% for mask-pooled features and 33% for full-image part readers (5.6% when trained and gated alike), at similar zero-shot accuracy. The best baselines, even calibrated or restricted to unseen classes, and a decoder counting only agreeing parts remain about 3-8 times riskier. On CUB, isolated region readers are more accurate than an attribute-prototype model (63.1% vs. 55.3%) and certify unseen species at about 6 points less risk than it and about 10 points less than features pooled in the same keypoint boxes. On real traffic signs, isolated readers lower certified risk from 99.8% to 67%, which is still far too high; most remaining errors are misread pictograms. On seen classes the ontology brings no gain over a fairly trained black box, and isolation costs accuracy.

</details>

*Zhengye Yang,Anthony Wang,Yuyang Li,Mehmet Kerem Turkcan,Beizhan Yan,Zoran Kostic*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"适应标签-蒸馏"(adapt-label-distill)流程：用少量目标域标注微调SAM3教师，为无标注图像生成伪标签，并以置信度引导的监督训练紧凑的YOLOv11学生模型，在多个目标域实现显著增益并在Jetson上达到188 FPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标检测器在专业域迁移效果差，且这些域中框标注稀缺、部署要求模型紧凑实时。视觉基础模型可提供离线监督，但零样本预测与目标域对齐不佳，需用有限标注将其特化后再蒸馏给小模型。

Method: 两阶段pipeline：①在标注子集上适配SAM3教师，对剩余无标注图像生成伪标签；②以置信度引导的监督训练YOLOv11学生（多容量）。机制上，教师置信度对伪标签损失加权；zero-gating在分配阶段保留不确定假设但不施加其训练损失。对比实验包括统一硬标签训练配方下的多种教师，以及与EfficientTeacher在线SSOD基线的比较。

Result: 覆盖6个目标域、3种学生容量：部分域显著提升，部分域迁移有限或为负。YOLOv11m下较STAC式自训练最高提升15.3 AP；Garbage域达51.6 AP（全监督为54.1 AP）。Jetson AGX Orin上学生188 FPS，SAM3仅2.9 FPS。

Conclusion: 基础模型监督可通过离线"先适配、再蒸馏"有效转移给紧凑检测器，兼顾精度与实时性，且不承担教师的部署成本；但跨域收益不均衡，负迁移仍存在，选域与教师适配是关键。

Abstract: Object detectors often transfer poorly to specialized domains, where box annotations are scarce and deployment requires compact, real-time models. Large vision foundation models can provide offline supervision, but their zero-shot predictions may be poorly aligned with the target domain. We present an adapt-label-distill pipeline that uses limited target annotations to specialize a foundation teacher and transfer its supervision to compact detectors. We adapt SAM3 on the labeled subset, generate pseudo-labels for the remaining unlabeled images, and train YOLOv11 students with confidence-guided supervision. Teacher confidence weights pseudo-label losses, while zero-gating retains uncertain hypotheses during assignment without applying their associated training losses. Experiments across six target domains and three student capacities show substantial gains in several domains, while revealing limited or negative transfer in others. Teacher comparisons under a common hard-label training recipe support the choice of SAM3, and comparisons with an EfficientTeacher adaptation provide additional evidence against an online SSOD baseline. With YOLOv11m, our pipeline improves over STAC-style self-training by up to 15.3 AP and reaches 51.6 AP on Garbage, compared with 54.1 under full supervision. On NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, the deployed student achieves 188 FPS versus 2.9 FPS for SAM3, benefiting from foundation-model supervision without incurring the teacher's deployment cost. Code is available at https://github.com/zk2172-columbia/ProjectAdaptLabelDistill_ObjectDetection.

</details>

*João Félix,Atabak Dehban,Rodrigo Ventura*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人感知任务（非合作轨道目标捕捉、变工业产品检测）常缺乏标注图像，需在计算成本约束下利用合成数据增强，但生成规划与筛选的作用及质量指标的有效性不清楚。

Method: 模块化合成增强流水线，将生成规划与生成后筛选作为独立干预分别评估；使用 FLUX.1-Fill 结合类别特定 LoRA 适配生成样本；以验证集选择增强剂量；在六个目标检测数据集上以 mAP@50:95 评估，并对比 FID、KID、precision、recall、LPIPS 与检测性能的关系。

Abstract: Robotic perception for capturing uncooperative orbital objects and inspecting variable industrial products must often operate with limited labelled imagery. We examine a modular synthetic-augmentation pipeline, evaluating generation planning and post-generation filtering as separate interventions, with computational cost as a design constraint. Across six object-detection datasets, FLUX.1-Fill with class-specific LoRA adaptation produced dataset-dependent dose effects; the validation-selected augmentation improved mAP@50:95 on four datasets and reduced it on two. Filtering did not yield consistent gains, and FID, KID, precision, recall, and LPIPS did not consistently track detector changes. The results do not establish that image quality alone identifies useful samples. They motivate standardised evaluation and inexpensive candidate-utility measures that could identify useful samples before detector retraining, reducing repeated training cost.

</details>


### [18] [AdProducer: Towards Agentic Advertising Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31466)
*Kunyang Li,Chaoyang Wang,Mubarak Shah,Yuzhang Shang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AdProducer 是首个端到端广告视频创作智能体，通过自主产品调研生成卖点驱动分镜来引导冻结视频生成器，并以 SFT+RL（分镜/视频联合奖励）训练，配 AdCreation-Bench 评测，显著提升产品正确性与广告效果且可跨模型泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型只能完成视觉合成，无法真正理解产品并做出"如何传达产品卖点"的策略性创意决策；而广告的可信呈现要求产品调研与创意设计深度耦合，因此需要超越单纯视觉合成的端到端智能体框架。

Method: 提出 AdProducer——首个端到端广告视频创作智能体框架：多模态智能体通过网页与图像搜索自主调研产品，将调研结果转化为卖点驱动的分镜（storyboard）以引导冻结的视频生成器；构建专用数据流水线产出 AdProducer-SFT 与 AdProducer-RL 两个训练集，采用监督微调后接强化学习，并对分镜级与视频级奖励联合优化；同时提出 AdCreation-Bench（305 条广告简报、跨 8 个领域）及 PG-Score、Ad-Score 两项互补指标。

Result: AdProducer 将 MiniMax H3 的 PG-Score 从 17.3 提升至 51.3；在无额外训练的情况下泛化至 Veo 3.1，将其得分从 28.0 提升至 35.9；在 Ad-Score、VideoScore2 及人工评测上均获得一致增益。

Conclusion: 将产品调研与创意设计耦合进智能体框架可显著提升广告视频的产品忠实度与创意表现，且该能力可跨视频生成器迁移；代码、模型与数据均已开源。

Abstract: Recent advances in video generation have made automated advertising production increasingly feasible. However, an effective advertisement must faithfully represent the product and communicate its selling points through compelling visual storytelling, which requires more than visual synthesis: it calls for deeper product understanding and strategic decisions about how to present product value. Crucially, product research and creative design are closely intertwined, as the information gathered about a product determines which features can be faithfully demonstrated and how they should be presented. In this paper, we introduce AdProducer, the first end-to-end agentic framework for advertising video creation, transforming concise creative briefs into finished advertisements. Our multimodal agent autonomously researches products through web and image search and translates its findings into selling-point-driven storyboards that guide a frozen video generator. To achieve this, we develop a dedicated data construction pipeline that yields two training datasets, AdProducer-SFT and AdProducer-RL, and train the agent through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with joint optimization of storyboard- and video-level rewards. We further introduce AdCreation-Bench, comprising 305 advertising briefs across eight domains, with two complementary metrics: PG-Score for product correctness and creative execution, and Ad-Score for overall advertising effectiveness assessed by an independent judge. Experiments demonstrate that AdProducer improves the PG-Score of MiniMax H3 from 17.3 to 51.3 and generalizes to Veo 3.1 without additional training, improving its score from 28.0 to 35.9, with consistent gains in Ad-Score, VideoScore2, and human evaluations. Code, models, and data are released.

</details>


### [19] [Which Ellipses Are Outlines of a Given Ellipsoid? A Ratio Test with Unknown Focal Length](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31437)
*Michael Werman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文给出图像椭圆是否为给定椭球（半轴 a≤b≤c）轮廓的判定准则：在方像元、零偏斜、主点已知的相机下，仅由两个特征值构造的圆锥比 κ(f) ≤ a/c 即可，中轴 b 无关；f 未知时可容许焦距构成区间，由最小圆锥比（显式四次方程给出）判定是否为空，并给出区间有上界的几何条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单幅图像椭圆反推椭球的可行性（哪类椭球能被排除）此前缺乏严格的充要判据；作者希望建立可计算的判别准则，明确相机内参（焦距、主点）如何影响可容许椭球集合。

Method: 对主轴对齐的椭球，用图像椭圆的两特征值构造与焦距相关的圆锥比 κ(f)（椭圆周长与椭圆参数的最大比值），以 κ(f) ≤ a/c 为轮廓充要条件；对未知 f，在焦距上最小化 κ(f)，极值点由显式四次方程求得，据此判断可容许焦距区间是否为空及其有界性。

Result: κ(f) ≤ a/c 是图像椭圆成为该椭球轮廓的充要条件，且与中轴 b 无关；f 未知时可容许焦距构成区间，空与非空由 κ 的最小值决定；仅当主点更靠近椭圆长轴而非短轴时区间才有上界。仿真与 45 幅土星卫星 Cassini 图像验证了该判据。

Conclusion: 单个椭圆只能排除"过圆"（a/c 偏大）的椭球，无法排除过扁长的椭球；主点未知时无任何椭球可被排除。该结论为单视图椭球形状约束与相机标定提供了闭式、可验证的检验。

Abstract: When is an image ellipse the outline of a given ellipsoid with semi-axes $a <= b <= c? For a camera with square pixels, zero skew and known principal point, we show that it is an outline at focal length $f$ exactly when a cone ratio kappa(f), computed from two eigenvalues, is at most a/c; the middle semi-axis b plays no role. With f unknown, the admissible focal lengths form an interval; whether it is empty is decided by the smallest cone ratio over $f$, which, when attained, is obtained from an explicit quartic. The interval is bounded above only when the principal point is closer to the long axis of the ellipse than to its short axis. Thus one ellipse can rule out ellipsoids that are too round, never ones that are too elongated, and none if the principal point is unknown. Simulations and 45 Cassini images of Saturn's moons support the test.

</details>


### [20] [Tornado4D: Physics-Guided 4D Gaussian Reconstruction of a Laboratory Tornado from Sparse One-Sided Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31435)
*Yucheng Zhu,Maria J. Molina,Christopher Metzler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Tornado4D，一个物理引导的 4D 高斯框架，可从稀疏单侧视频重建实验室龙卷风的时序 3D 结构，通过引入旋转气流场先验约束 3D 结构随时间演化，在新视角合成任务上显著优于逐帧 3DGS 与视频式 4DGS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解并防范高破坏性龙卷风需要刻画其时空演化，但即便是受控实验环境，从稀疏单侧视频重建也严重欠约束：外观依赖视角、运动非刚性、未观测体积存在多种可能几何。

Method: 利用封闭空间几何知识引入旋转气流场先验，约束 3D 结构随时间演化，构建物理引导的 4D 高斯表示框架，从而重建原本不可观测的结构。采用留出相机视角上的新视角合成精度评估重建准确性。

Conclusion: 融入物理先验（旋转气流场）可有效缓解稀疏单侧视频下的严重欠约束问题，实现实验室龙卷风的高质量时序 3D 重建，为龙卷风时空演化分析提供可行手段。

Abstract: Characterizing how tornadoes evolve over space and time is critically important for understanding and preparing for these highly destructive weather events. Towards this end, we develop algorithms capable of forming time-resolved 3D reconstructions of laboratory smoke tornadoes from sparse one-sided videos. Even in a controlled environment, reconstruction is severely underconstrained: appearance is view dependent, motion is non-rigid, and the unobserved volume admits many geometries. We present Tornado4D, a physics-guided 4D Gaussian framework capable of reconstructing laboratory tornadoes from sparse, one-sided videos. Tornado4D uses knowledge of the enclosure geometry to introduce rotational airflow field priors that constrain how the 3D structure evolves over time. These rotational priors allow us to reconstruct otherwise unobserved structure. We evaluate reconstruction accuracy by computing novel-view synthesis accuracy on a held out camera view: Tornado4D outperforms frame-by-frame 3DGS and video-based 4DGS by a considerable margin.

</details>


### [21] [JECT: Addressing the Context Shortcut in Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for Chest CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31849)
*Hanbin Ko,Hong-Jun Choi,Jihun Kim,Young-Gon Kim,Dongheon Lee,Chang Min Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出JECT，针对胸部CT中JEPA式掩码预测的"上下文捷径"问题，将放射报告同时用作预测器的条件与编码器的预测目标（掩码章节文本预测），配合分层三维编码器，实现从零训练的强CT基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JEPA从可见上下文预测掩码区域特征，但胸部CT中决定诊断的关键发现（如小结节）往往无法由周围解剖推断，导致模型倾向于将其预测为正常解剖，预测损失不再激励编码器表征该发现，作者称之为"上下文捷径"。仅以报告作为预测器条件虽可修复预测，但编码器几乎无所得——报告提供了编码器本应自己学到的信息。

Method: 让报告承担双重角色：(1) 作为预测器的条件；(2) 通过掩码章节文本预测作为编码器的目标，即编码器需从未掩码扫描中预测报告的各解剖章节。采用分层三维编码器，在每个层级都进行预测，使临床信息在各尺度上得以保留。

Result: 消融表明，文本目标的加入提升了分类与定位性能，而条件化对编码器的增益很小。基于173k体积从零训练，该配方在分类、检索与结节恶性预测上达到当前CT基础模型水平，微调后在肺癌风险预测上达到任务专用模型水平。条件化仍有价值：其预测器可零额外训练复用于定位——展示报告句子在何处起作用，且变化最大处正是该句子所描述的发现。

Conclusion: 报告作为编码目标而非仅作条件，是缓解上下文捷径的关键；分层多尺度预测保持了临床语义；条件化预测器可零样本用于句子级定位，兼具可解释性。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn by predicting features of masked regions from visible context. In chest computed tomography, the findings that decide a diagnosis, such as a small nodule, are often not predictable from the surrounding anatomy. A hidden finding is then best predicted toward normal anatomy, and the prediction loss stops rewarding the encoder for representing it. We call this the context shortcut. Conditioning the predictor on the radiology report repairs the prediction, but in our setup the encoder gains little over image-only pretraining: the report supplies what the encoder never had to learn. JECT therefore gives the report two roles: a condition for the predictor and, through masked section-text prediction, a target for the encoder, which must predict the report's anatomical sections from the unmasked scan. A hierarchical three-dimensional encoder that predicts at every stage keeps this clinical content at every scale. In ablations, the text target improves classification and localization, while conditioning adds little to the encoder. Trained from scratch on 173k volumes, the recipe reaches the level of current computed tomography foundation models in classification, retrieval and nodule malignancy, and of task-specific models in lung-cancer risk prediction after fine-tuning. Conditioning still matters: its predictor can be reused, with no extra training, to show where a report sentence acts, changing most at the finding the sentence describes. Code and pretrained weights are available.

</details>


### [22] [BODYBENCH: Evaluating Adversarial Image Defenses Against AI Nudification Inpainting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31774)
*Li Qiwei,Salma Abdel Magid,Olga Russakovsky,Eric Gilbert,Sarita Schoenebeck*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出对抗扰动类图像保护方法从未针对"脱衣化"（nudification）编辑进行评估，而后者是生成式AI最典型的危害之一；作者将问题诊断为"问题表述失败"，提出BODYBENCH基准与三项危害对齐指标，审计四种方法后发现现有防御几乎全面失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对抗扰动防御（用于阻止未经授权的图像编辑）在设计时并不匹配脱衣化编辑这一真实威胁模型：掩码形状、训练/测试提示分布、成功判定标准均存在结构性错位，导致评估系统性高估防御效果。尽管AIG-NCII是记录最充分的生成式AI危害之一，且其编辑恰通过inpainting实现，却无人评估防护方法对该危害的有效性。

Method: 构建BODYBENCH基准：648个完全合成的着衣成人受试者，每人配11种掩码变体，覆盖身体、面部与上下文区域。提出三项与危害对齐的指标——性化程度（sexualization）、自然度（naturalness）、可识别度（recognizability），联合判定inpainted输出是否构成成功的nudification攻击。在此基准上审计PhotoGuard、DiffusionGuard、AdvPaint、DiffVax四种近期防护方法，并检验PSNR等常规指标与防护效果的相关性。

Result: 四种方法中仅一种方法在一种配置下防护成功，且仅当防守方与攻击方掩码完全对齐时成立——该条件任何真实防守方都无法保证，且易于被始终绕过。此外，PSNR等标准评估指标与nudification防护效果基本不相关，说明既有评测体系失真。

Conclusion: 现有图像保护方法在真实脱衣化威胁下基本无效，根源在于问题表述而非方法本身强弱。BODYBENCH使这种错位可测量，为以"实证危害"为基础的新型防御研究提供基准与评价框架。

Abstract: Adversarial perturbation defenses protect images from unauthorized edits by adding imperceptible noise. Yet none of these methods have been evaluated against nudification, despite AI-generated non-consensual intimate imagery (AIG-NCII) being among the most documented harms of generative AI. Moreover, nudification edits are readily carried out through inpainting, the primary setting these protection methods are designed to defend against. We argue this is a problem-formulation failure since prior threat models do not correspond to nudification edits (also called attacks). The misalignment of existing approaches is structural, spanning mask shape, training and testing prompt distributions, and success criterion which causes existing evaluations to systematically overestimate protection effectiveness. We reformulate image protection against unauthorized editing around this documented harm. We introduce BODYBENCH, a benchmark of 648 fully synthetic clothed adult subjects, each paired with 11 mask variants spanning body, face, and context regions. We propose three harm-aligned metrics: sexualization, naturalness, and recognizability that jointly determine whether an inpainted output constitutes a successful nudification attack. Auditing four recent protection methods (PhotoGuard, DiffusionGuard, AdvPaint, DiffVax) on BODYBENCH, we find that protection succeeds in only one configuration of one method, and only under exact mask alignment between defender and attacker---a condition no real defender can guarantee and one that we show is easily always bypassed. We also show that standard evaluation metrics such as peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) are essentially uncorrelated with nudification protection. BODYBENCH makes this misalignment measurable and provides a foundation for defenses grounded in documented harm.

</details>


### [23] [GRUN: Generalized Retinex Unfolding Network for Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31690)
*Rihan Zhang,Fengyang Xiao,Yuhan Chen,Chunming He,Sina Farsiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出广义Retinex分解先验与MAP引导深度展开网络GRUN，统一处理七类图像复原任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像复原需在多样退化下保持场景结构与细节。经典Retinex的照明-反射率分解可推广为"内容-环境"因子分解先验，以统一刻画退化变化与场景固有属性。

Method: 构建广义Retinex公式化：内容主导响应（广义反射率）与环境侧响应（广义照明）。据此设计GRUN——MAP引导的深度展开框架，在K个阶段交替执行反射率复原、照明估计与渐进退化推断，并采用退化条件近端算子；同时提出退化感知耦合正则器DCR，结合互信息最小化、梯度去相关与尺度锚定，促使两因子表示互补。

Result: 去噪、去雾、去雨、低光增强、去模糊、水下增强、逆光增强共七项任务上，以同一架构配任务专属权重在多个基准取得有竞争力结果；该设计可嵌入现有复原方法，具跨架构适用性。

Conclusion: 广义Retinex为图像复原提供了统一、可解释的因子分解先验，配合展开网络与解耦正则实现多任务有效复原，并具良好迁移性。

Abstract: Image restoration remains a fundamental challenge in low-level vision, requiring methods that handle diverse degradations while preserving scene structures and details. We revisit classical Retinex theory and propose a Generalized Retinex formulation that extends the illumination-reflectance decomposition into a Retinex-inspired content-environment factorization prior for image restoration. The key idea is to restore images using two learned factors: a content-dominant response (generalized reflectance) capturing scene properties and an environment-side response (generalized illumination) encoding task-dependent variations associated with the observed degradations. Based on this formulation, we develop GRUN (Generalized Retinex Unfolding Network), a MAP-guided deep unfolding framework that alternates reflectance restoration, illumination estimation, and progressive degradation inference across K stages with degradation-conditioned proximal operators. We further introduce a Degradation-aware Coupling Regularizer (DCR) that combines mutual information minimization, gradient decorrelation, and scale anchoring to promote complementary content-environment factor representations. Experiments on seven image restoration tasks, including denoising, dehazing, deraining, low-light enhancement, deblurring, underwater enhancement, and backlit enhancement, demonstrate competitive results on multiple benchmarks using the same architecture with task-specific weights. Moreover, the proposed Generalized Retinex design can be integrated into existing restoration methods, demonstrating its cross-architecture applicability. Code will be released.

</details>


### [24] [LineEX: Data Extraction from Scientific Line Charts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31664)
*VP Shivasankaran,Muhammad Yusuf Hassan,Mayank Singh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LineEX，用于从科学折线图中提取数据，通过改进视觉 Transformer 与姿态检测方法并结合新损失函数，在最大规模折线图数据集（43 万张）上显著超越现有 SOTA。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学折线图蕴含大量数据，但缺乏高效、自动化的数据提取手段；现有方法在精度与数据规模上存在不足。

Method: 适配（adapt）现有视觉 Transformer 与姿态检测（pose detection）方法；提出一种新的损失函数；合成构建包含 430K 图像的目前最大折线图数据集。

Result: 相较现有 SOTA 基线取得显著性能提升；新损失函数在实验中相较既有损失函数表现出有效性。

Conclusion: LineEX 在折线图数据提取任务上验证了视觉 Transformer 与姿态检测框架的适用性，并贡献了大规模合成数据集，为后续研究提供基准；代码已开源。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce LINEEX that extracts data from scientific line charts. We adapt existing vision transformers and pose detection methods and showcase significant performance gains over existing SOTA baselines. We also propose a new loss function and present its effectiveness against existing loss functions. In addition, we synthetically created the largest line chart dataset comprising 430K images. The code is available at https://github.com/Shiva-sankaran/LineEX.

</details>


### [25] [Anchoring VAE Fine-Tuning to Its Latent Diffusion Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31651)
*Rafael Bischof,Dominik Narnhofer,Julius Erbach,Michael Kraus,Konrad Schindler,Bernd Bickel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Diffusion Prior Anchoring (DPA)：在 VAE 微调时引入基于 score-distillation 的正则项，把潜变量拉回预训练扩散模型可准确去噪的高密度流形，从而在冻结/仅解码器/无锚定微调之上进一步降低预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于预训练隐扩散模型的迁移学习通常只微调扩散主干、冻结 VAE 编码器以保持潜分布，但冻结编码器难以捕捉非 RGB 输入中的显著细节，且受限于三通道；而直接微调 VAE 又会偏离预训练扩散模型所适配的潜分布。因此需要一种在允许 VAE 微调的同时维持潜空间与扩散先验一致性的正则化手段。

Method: DPA 是一个在 VAE 微调过程中施加的正则器，采用 score-distillation 形式的更新，将编码得到的潜变量引导向预训练扩散模型能够准确去噪的高密度流形区域。该方法与扩散主干解耦，可即插即用，并适用于剪枝、多通道等改造后的 VAE。实验覆盖三个图像/视频模型（FLUX 3、LTX-Video、Wan2.2）与四项任务：单目深度估计、MRI 重建、风场模拟、表面法向估计。

Result: DPA 相对冻结 VAE 降低预测误差 7.5%，相对仅解码器微调降低 4.9%，相对无锚定的 VAE 微调降低 4.0%。增益随目标数据偏离 RGB 训练分布的程度增大而提升：单目深度估计为 3.3%，复值 MRI 达 7.2%。在同时编码深度与表面法向的四通道 VAE 上，深度估计误差降低 9.3%。

Conclusion: DPA 表明"冻结编码器"并非必要约束：通过 score-distillation 锚定潜空间，可在释放 VAE 表达能力的同时保持扩散先验有效性，且分布偏移越大收益越明显，对多通道及剪枝 VAE 亦具通用性。

Abstract: Pretrained latent diffusion models are effective priors for transfer learning, from geometry estimation to physics simulation. Existing approaches fine-tune the diffusion backbone but freeze the encoder of the VAE to preserve the latent distribution. However, a frozen encoder may miss salient details in non-RGB inputs and is limited to three channels. We introduce Diffusion Prior Anchoring (DPA), a regularizer applied during VAE fine-tuning that uses a score-distillation update to steer latents toward the high-density manifold on which the pretrained diffusion model denoises accurately. We validate DPA across three image and video models (FLUX 3, LTX-Video, Wan2.2) and four tasks: monocular depth estimation, MRI reconstruction, wind-flow simulation, and surface normal estimation, where DPA lowers the prediction error by 7.5% relative to the frozen VAE, 4.9% to decoder-only fine-tuning, and 4.0% to unanchored VAE fine-tuning. Its gain grows the further the target data lies from the RGB training distribution, from 3.3% on monocular depth estimation to 7.2% on complex-valued MRI. DPA also applies to modified VAEs, including pruned and multi-channel variants. With a four-channel VAE that encodes depth and surface normals, it lowers depth estimation error by 9.3%.

</details>


### [26] [PreferenceScene: Personalized Indoor Scene Synthesis from Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32099)
*Seongrae Noh,RyunHa Lee,HyeongYeop Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PreferenceScene：在多轮交互中，仅依据用户对渲染图的简短自由反馈与满意度分数，用 LLM 维护并整体更新每项设计属性的偏好估计，再由场景实例化模块将各属性逐一落地，实现隐藏偏好下的个性化室内场景合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到场景方法虽能将短指令生成带家具的 3D 房间，但用户偏好难以完全用语言表达，往往需要看到具体房间后指出喜好与厌恶；且偏好不仅涉及单个物体，还涉及表面、光照、织物、家具及其布局共同营造的外观与氛围。因此需要在隐藏偏好、部分反馈条件下进行多轮个性化场景合成。

Method: 1）多轮设定：系统展示 3D 场景（用户仅见渲染图），用户给出简短自由文本反馈与满意度分数；2）LLM 为房间每个设计属性维护显式偏好估计，每轮从反馈中推断其背后的品味，并修订整个估计，包括反馈未提及的部分；3）场景实例化模块将每个估计值构建为房间中对应的独立部件，使各部分均可随偏好调整；4）评测采用含 320 个实例、10 种房间类型的基准测试集，并使用模拟用户与基于渲染的评价器。

Result: 在基准测试集上，PreferenceScene 对隐藏偏好的匹配度优于五个经相同交互适配的已发表文本到场景基线，且随轮次增加持续提升；即使直接向基线提供偏好信息，本方法仍更优；视觉语言模型评价其场景在真实感与功能性上最佳。

Conclusion: 结果表明，显式的全属性偏好估计加整体修订、并将估计值直接对应到可独立控制的场景部件，是应对隐藏偏好与部分反馈的有效范式，可在多轮交互中逐步逼近用户真实偏好。

Abstract: Text-to-scene methods turn a short instruction into a furnished 3D room, but the room that a particular person wants rarely comes across fully in words: many preferences surface only when the person sees a concrete room and can point to what they like and dislike in it. We therefore study personalized indoor scene synthesis under hidden user preferences: over several turns, a system shows a 3D scene, and the user, who sees only rendered images of the scene, replies with brief free-form feedback and a satisfaction score. The system must therefore bring the whole room toward the user's preferences from feedback that comments on only part of it at a time. It must also be able to change every part of the room, because a preference concerns not only single objects but the look and atmosphere that surfaces, lighting, textiles, furniture and their arrangement create together. We present PreferenceScene, in which a large language model keeps an explicit estimate of the user's preferences for every design attribute of the room and, after each turn, infers the taste behind the feedback and revises the whole estimate, including the parts that the feedback does not mention. A scene instantiation module builds every estimated value as its own part of the room, so that each of these parts can follow the user's preferences. We evaluate on the test set of a benchmark with 320 instances in ten room types, with a simulated user and a render-based evaluator. PreferenceScene matches the hidden preferences better than five published text-to-scene baselines adapted to the same interaction, and its match rises with every turn. It even surpasses them when they are given the preferences directly, and a vision-language model rates its scenes as the most realistic and functional.

</details>


### [27] [GUI-PRISM: Efficient Action Decoding for GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32097)
*Enqi Liu,Zhi Gao,Liu Liu,Lifeng Fan,Liyuan Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 GUI-PRISM 混合动作解码器，直接预测动作类型与结构化参数，兼顾开放式文本生成，在保证高精度的同时显著降低 GUI 智能体推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GUI 智能体多依赖视觉语言模型以自回归方式将动作生成为文本，推理延迟高；已有空间解码方法仅聚焦目标定位，无法覆盖完整动作预测。

Method: 混合动作解码：直接预测动作类型与结构化参数，仅对开放式文本保留语言生成。使用字段专用查询从共享多模态特征库中抽取动作相关的语义与空间信息；通过条件查询建模动作各组件间依赖；用门控残差交叉注意力结合细粒度多模态信息精化预测。

Result: ScreenSpot-v2 上达 95.1% 准确率，较最强 head-based 空间解码方法高 2.0 个百分点，推理较基线加速 3.8×；AndroidControl-v2 与 MM-Mind2Web-v2 上完整动作准确率分别提升 4.8 与 0.7 个百分点，推理加速 2.7× 与 3.9×。

Conclusion: 将直接预测从空间定位扩展到动作类型与参数，可实现完整 GUI 动作预测，同时兼顾精度与推理效率，验证了混合解码范式的有效性。

Abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents translate screenshots and user instructions into executable actions. Most existing approaches rely on vision-language models to generate actions as text, often leading to substantial inference latency due to autoregressive decoding. To address this inefficiency, we propose GUI-PRISM, a hybrid action decoder that directly predicts action types and structured arguments while retaining language generation for open-ended text. Unlike existing spatial decoding methods that primarily focus on target localization, GUI-PRISM extends direct prediction to action types and their associated arguments, enabling complete GUI action prediction. Specifically, GUI-PRISM employs field-specific queries to extract action-relevant semantic and spatial information from a shared multimodal feature bank. It further models dependencies among action components through conditional queries. Gated residual cross-attention refines these predictions using fine-grained multimodal information. GUI-PRISM achieves 95.1\% accuracy on ScreenSpot-v2, outperforming the strongest head-based spatial decoding method by 2.0 percentage points while delivering a 3.8$\times$ inference speedup over the baseline. On AndroidControl-v2 and MM-Mind2Web-v2, it improves complete-action accuracy by 4.8 and 0.7 percentage points while achieving 2.7$\times$ and 3.9$\times$ inference speedups over the baseline, respectively. Our code is available on our project page.

</details>


### [28] [Rethinking Post-Training Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32096)
*Minchan Kang,Kyeonghye Park,Seoyoung Cho,Junhee Lee,Daeshik Kim,Yucheol Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对大视觉语言模型(LVLMs)训练后量化(PTQ)在低位权值-激活量化下的严重性能退化，指出误差源于离群值主导PC权重与PT激活的共享量化范围，提出局部Hadamard变换+分组量化+分组感知执行的Rotate-and-Refine Quantization (RRQ)基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PTQ方法虽不断精化校准策略，但在低比特权值-激活量化下仍显著退化。作者通过定位量化误差集中位置并分析对应权重与激活分布，发现少数离群值主导了逐通道(PC)权重与逐令牌(PT)激活的共享量化范围，导致大多数数值分辨率不足并被映射为零。这一发现促使研究重点从"校准精化"转向"量化表示"本身。

Method: RRQ将局部Hadamard变换、分组量化与高效的分组感知执行相结合，作为一种简单有效的LVLM PTQ基线；核心是通过旋转(变换)缓解离群值对共享量化范围的支配，并以分组方式提升有效比特分辨率。

Result: 在8个多模态任务及多种量化配置下，RRQ显著优于基线，同时降低推理时间与显存占用。W4A4设置下，8B模型保留超过96%的全精度性能，32B模型超过99%，而基线不足8%。

Conclusion: 量化表示的改进(旋转+分组)比单纯精化校准更关键；RRQ作为简单基线在低位LVLM PTQ中实现接近无损的性能，并具备效率优势，代码已开源。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses large vision-language models (LVLMs) by calibrating quantization parameters on a small dataset without retraining. However, despite increasingly sophisticated calibration strategies, prior methods suffer substantial performance degradation under low-bit weight--activation quantization. To understand this degradation, we locate where quantization error is concentrated and examine the corresponding weight and activation distributions. We observe that a few outliers dominate the ranges shared by per-channel (PC) weights and per-token (PT) activations, leaving insufficient resolution for most values and mapping many of them to zero. These findings motivate a shift in focus from calibration refinement to the underlying quantization representation. We therefore present Rotate-and-Refine Quantization (RRQ) as a simple, effective baseline for LVLM PTQ, combining local Hadamard transforms with group quantization and efficient group-aware execution. Across 8 multimodal tasks and diverse quantization settings, RRQ substantially outperforms baselines while reducing inference time and memory usage. At W4A4, it retains over 96\% of full-precision performance on 8B models and over 99\% on a 32B model, compared with less than 8\% for these baselines. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/kmc3661/RRQ

</details>


### [29] [Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32094)
*Yang Bai,Yingzhi Xia,Ling Lin,Jun Cheng,Lin Fu,Huazhu Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Clinical3D-Bench（3,368 题、8 类、373 个医院病房布局、配对场景状态）评估 MLLM 空间推理；35 个模型最佳仅 53.6%，医生 79.0%；用 Clinical3D-45K 微调可提升 16–20 点，但 3D 地图被"视而不见"；GeoJeV 以显式 3D 操作注入证据，取得全场最高准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医院场景的空间推理（相似设备追踪、患者相对方位判断、通道宽度判断）是真实需求，但现有基准覆盖不足，缺乏可控、可配对验证的场景与量化诊断。

Method: 构建模拟基准 Clinical3D-Bench：按医院设计规范生成 373 个病房布局，第一视角漫游录像（照片级真实），答案由 3D 场景计算得到，且设计成对场景状态以检验证据变化时的答案一致性；10 名医生审核布局。评测 35 个 MLLM，并提供 44,750 题训练集 Clinical3D-45K 用于微调；提出 GeoJeV：从视频重建场景记忆，基于问题状态选择 3D 操作及其参数，将其证据并入选项打分。

Result: 最佳开源/闭源模型宏平均准确率 45.7%/53.6%，答案先验基线 40.8%，医生子集达 79.0%；32 个开源模型中 27 个在二分类患者相对方向上低于 40%。微调后两个 MLLM 超出最佳闭源模型 16–20 点；但输入 3D 地图几乎未被利用——替换为其他视频的地图（即便为真值）准确率几乎不变。GeoJeV 在所有评测模型中准确率最高，缩小了与医生的差距。

Conclusion: 现有 MLLM 的 3D 空间推理显著不足，且"给 3D 输入"不等于"会用 3D"；显式引入可计算 3D 操作的 GeoJeV 更有效，为后续工作提供基准、训练数据与新范式。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning in hospitals requires tracking look-alike equipment, interpreting patient-relative directions, and judging passage widths, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of these abilities. We introduce Clinical3D-Bench, a simulated benchmark with 3,368 questions of eight types on egocentric walkthroughs of 373 hospital-room layouts. Layouts follow hospital design guidelines, answers are computed from the 3D scenes, and paired scene states test whether models change their answers when relevant evidence changes. Videos are photorealistic, and ten physicians screened the layouts. Among 35 multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the best open and proprietary models reach 45.7% and 53.6% macro accuracy, against 40.8% for an answer prior and 79.0% for physicians on a subset, and 27 of 32 open models score below 40% on two-way patient-relative directions. Fine-tuning on Clinical3D-45K, our 44,750-question training set, lifts two MLLMs 16-20 points above the best proprietary model. 3D maps given to the fine-tuned MLLM as input go largely unused: replacing them with another video's, even when they are ground truth, barely changes its accuracy. The proposed GeoJeV instead lets the MLLM compute with 3D: it reconstructs a scene memory from each video, selects 3D operations and their arguments from the MLLM's question state, and adds their evidence to its option scores. It achieves the highest accuracy of all evaluated models, narrowing the gap to physicians.

</details>


### [30] [LoopDVR: Looped Transformer for Efficient Dense Visual Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32067)
*Sirui Liang,Xuanlong Yu,Longfei Liu,Xiaodong Cun,Xi Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LoopDVR 通过在 ViT 骨干与 Transformer 解码器中跨层复用模块，将预训练稠密视觉识别模型转化为参数高效的循环网络，在保持精度竞争性的同时减少约 28% 参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稠密识别模型（检测、分割等）参数冗余大，直接减宽度或深度会破坏原有计算结构与精度；因此希望在不改变计算结构的前提下压缩参数。

Method: 1) 跨层复用 ViT 骨干与解码器中的 Transformer 块以共享参数；2) 基于层间表征差异度划分共享组，并保留最后一个骨干块独立以构建多尺度特征；3) 用组内末层预训练权重初始化各共享块以保留已学表征；4) 每层引入独立 Loop Adapter 维持深度特异的变换；5) 将视觉表征蒸馏到循环骨干，并与循环解码器联合进行任务训练。

Result: 在多种稠密识别任务上取得最优的精度—参数权衡；相比参考模型参数减少约 28% 且精度具竞争力；LoopDet-S 仅 7.0M 参数即达 50.9 box AP。

Conclusion: 层级循环复用结合差异度分组、末层权重初始化与轻量 Loop Adapter，可在不改变计算结构的情况下有效压缩稠密识别模型参数，并在紧凑模型上表现突出。

Abstract: We propose LoopDVR, a framework for converting pretrained Transformer-based dense visual recognition models into parameter-efficient looped networks. Rather than reducing the network width or depth directly, LoopDVR reuses Transformer blocks across layers in both the ViT backbone and Transformer decoder, reducing the number of parameters while retaining the original computational structure. However, naively sharing parameters can disrupt the distinct transformations learned at different depths. To address this challenge, we identify suitable sharing groups based on inter-layer representation dissimilarity and keep the final backbone block independent for multi-scale feature construction. We then initialize each shared backbone block with the pretrained weights of its group's terminal layer to better preserve the learned representations. An independent Loop Adapter at each layer further helps retain depth-specific transformations within shared blocks. Subsequently, we distill visual representations into the looped backbone and integrate it with a looped decoder for task-specific training. Experiments demonstrate that LoopDVR achieves the best accuracy--parameter trade-offs across dense recognition tasks. Compared with the reference models, it reduces parameters by approximately 28% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Notably, LoopDet-S achieves 50.9 box AP with only 7.0M parameters, highlighting its effectiveness in compact models.

</details>


### [31] [DynaCue: Comparing Motion and Timing Between Groups of Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32014)
*Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DynaCue——一种结合光流局部变化、帧差/冻结计数与运动外观评分的双样本置换检验，用于比较视频组的运动质量差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频评分指标（如VideoScore的时间一致性分数）只能区分一致性评级不同的视频，却无法检测"运动偏好"相关的差异：在41对VideoGen-RewardBench的200次比较中一次也没能区分偏好视频与同提示替代视频，说明单一线索的评分不足以刻画运动质量。

Method: DynaCue采用双样本置换检验框架，融合多组互补度量：(1) 在扣除每个片段自身常规活动水平前后分别度量光流的局部变化；(2) 通过帧间差异与冻结帧计数捕捉播放中断；(3) 纳入运动与外观质量评分。无需预先选定单一线索，直接比较两组视频的整体分布差异。

Result: 在涵盖播放连续性、位移和节奏的五种受控干预实验中均成功检出组间差异；在三个真实生成视频数据集上、较小样本量下，重采样比较的检出率均不低于80%；而其他所有在三个数据集上评估的方法至少在一个数据集上检出率不超过60%。

Conclusion: 多线索融合的双样本检验比单一线索评分更灵敏、更稳健，能可靠捕捉与人类运动偏好相关的视频差异。

Abstract: A score that distinguishes videos with different temporal-consistency ratings can miss differences associated with motion preference. VideoScore's temporal consistency score distinguished higher- from lower-rated Pika videos in 95% of comparisons with 15 videos per group, yet could not detect the difference between preferred videos and their same-prompt alternatives in any of the 200 comparisons of 41 VideoGen-RewardBench pairs. We introduce DynaCue, a two-sample permutation test that combines complementary measurements of motion, frame continuity, and appearance to compare groups of videos without choosing a single cue in advance. DynaCue measures local changes in optical flow both before and after accounting for each clip's usual activity, captures interruptions through frame differences and freeze counts, and incorporates scores for motion and appearance. In controlled experiments, DynaCue detected group differences across five interventions affecting playback continuity, displacement, or rhythm. In real-world evaluations of generated videos where viewers rated temporal consistency or chose which of two videos they preferred for its motion, DynaCue detected group differences in at least 80% of resampled comparisons on each of the three datasets at the smaller sample sizes studied. Every other method evaluated on all three had a detection rate of 60% or less on at least one dataset.

</details>


### [32] [Change the Base, Change the Game: Rethinking Pan-sharpening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32002)
*Jeonghyeok Do,Geunhyuk Youk,Munchurl Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PanBase：一种基于物理传感器特性的更清晰的多光谱起点，用于替代模糊的上采样基座，提升残差学习的效率与效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全色锐化（PS）网络普遍以4倍插值的低分辨率多光谱（LRMS）作为残差学习的基座，仅通过残差修正引入全色（PAN）细节，导致起点本身模糊、训练收敛慢。作者质疑：既然已有清晰的空间细节，为何还要从模糊基座出发。

Method: 提出PanBase，利用PAN空间细节与LRMS光谱信息构造更清晰的多光谱起点，并在传感器特定模糊下强制与LRMS观测一致。该基座无需神经网络训练，仅通过闭式标定估计每个光谱带的9个系数。集成方式简单：将全局残差跳连的基座替换为PanBase，并将其作为额外输入拼接。

Result: 在WorldView-3、QuickBird、GaoFen-2上使用各骨干网络原始训练配方与匹配预算，PanBase提升了多数降分辨率与全分辨率指标，并平均实现4.4倍更快的训练收敛。在WorldView-2零样本评估中，独立PanBase无需目标传感器拟合或神经细化即可获得有竞争力的重建效果。

Conclusion: 以物理驱动的清晰基座替代模糊上采样基座，是一种无需额外训练、易集成且高效的残差学习改进方案，兼具精度提升与收敛加速优势，并展现良好的跨传感器泛化能力。

Abstract: Many pan-sharpening (PS) networks reconstruct high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) images by adding learned residuals to 4$\times$-interpolated low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) inputs, incorporating panchromatic (PAN) detail only through these residual corrections. This raises a simple question: Why start with a blurry base when sharp spatial detail is already available? We propose PanBase, a sharper multispectral starting point designed for more effective residual learning. Guided by physical sensor characteristics, PanBase combines PAN spatial detail with LRMS spectral information while enforcing consistency with the LRMS observations under sensor-specific blur. We construct this base without neural network training, estimating only nine coefficients per spectral band through closed-form calibration. Our PanBase can be easily integrated into existing backbones with a global residual skip through two simple changes: (i) replacing the skip base with PanBase and (ii) concatenating it as an additional input. Using each backbone's original training recipe and matched training budgets, PanBase improves most reduced- and full-resolution metrics on WorldView-3, QuickBird, and GaoFen-2, while achieving 4.4$\times$ faster training convergence on average. In zero-shot evaluation on WorldView-2, standalone PanBase achieves competitive reconstruction without target-sensor fitting or neural refinement.

</details>


### [33] [SPAR: Self-Referenced World-Model Rewards for Physical Alignment in Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31958)
*Junyi Zhang,Qichao Wang,Wenzhe Qian,Yuanchuan Wang,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPAR：用自参考（重复自身帧构造静态片段）作为内容匹配基线，将世界模型预测误差转化为推理时物理对齐奖励，并结合时空奖励精化，提升文生视频与图生视频续写的物理合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成视觉质量提升，但物理合理动力学仍难保证。潜世界模型的预测误差常被用作物理性评估信号，然而"预测-观测特征一致"可能只反映场景内容更易预测，而非动力学更合理，存在内容偏差的混淆问题。

Method: 提出SPAR（自参考物理对齐奖励）：对每个生成视频，构造由其自身帧重复而成的静态片段作为内容匹配参考，比较两者的世界模型预测误差，以相对误差衡量动力学合理性。并设计统一的时空奖励精化：空间精化聚焦局部预测差异；时间精化抑制短暂误差峰值，并将预测与实际特征变化量之间的一致性补充进预测误差。作为推理时奖励用于引导生成。

Result: 在多个基准上评测，SPAR在文生视频生成与图生视频续写两类任务上均提升物理合理性，使生成动力学更接近真实世界事件的物理规律。

Conclusion: 以内容自参考的相对预测误差替代绝对误差，可缓解场景难度混淆，配合时空精化作为推理时奖励，是提升视频生成物理对齐的有效、无需训练式方案。

Abstract: Generating videos with physically plausible dynamics remains challenging despite advances in visual quality. Latent world models offer predictive signals for evaluating physical plausibility, but higher agreement between predicted and observed features may reflect easier-to-predict scene content rather than more plausible dynamics. We propose \textbf{S}elf-Referenced \textbf{P}hysical \textbf{A}lignment \textbf{R}ewards (\textbf{SPAR}), a framework that uses world-model predictions for inference-time physical alignment. SPAR compares each video's prediction error with that of static clips constructed by repeating its own frames, providing a content-matched reference for evaluating generated dynamics. To account for the uneven spatial and temporal distribution of physical interactions, we introduce a unified \textbf{spatiotemporal reward refinement} strategy. \textbf{Spatial refinement} emphasizes localized prediction discrepancies, while \textbf{temporal refinement} moderates brief error peaks and supplements prediction errors with agreement between predicted and observed feature changes. Evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SPAR improves the physical plausibility of both \textbf{text-to-video generation} and \textbf{image-to-video continuation}, bringing generated dynamics into closer alignment with the physical regularities governing real-world events. Additional results and resources are available at https://gavin-jy.github.io/spar-page/

</details>


### [34] [The Old Scene Lives in the Cache: Diagnosing and Shedding Stale History in Streaming Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32116)
*Hao Zhou,Ziyang Xu,Chenhan Jin,Hao Qin,Shengze Xu,Tieyong Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练方法 Molt Forcing，通过在冷启动目标场景上重建场景历史、同时从原始缓存中**选择性保留主体 token**，解决流式视频生成中"换场景但保持主体"的冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频生成中切换场景并保持原主体存在矛盾：缓存历史既帮助维持主体一致性，也会残留应消失的旧场景物体。作者通过干预实验定位了残留机制，并需要一个既能清除旧场景物体又不损害主体身份的方案。

Method: 先做受控干预分析（文本条件、去噪步、局部窗口、attention sink），发现只要原始帧仍在缓存中，KV flush 与 sink 重算仍会残留旧场景物体；用目标场景历史替换则主体会改变（人脸相似度下降）。据此提出 Molt Forcing：以冷启动目标场景重建场景历史，并从原始缓存中**选择性保留主体 token**，全程免训练。

Result: 在 16 个场景族上，Molt Forcing 清除旧场景物体的可靠性至少与 Echo-Forcing 硬切相当，同时主体外观与切换前更接近（保持更高人脸相似度）。

Conclusion: 旧场景残留源于缓存中的原始帧历史而非 KV 或 sink 状态；旧的"全切"与"全留"都不理想。将"场景历史"与"主体 token"解耦重建是有效方向，Molt Forcing 提供了无需训练的实用解。

Abstract: Switching scenes while preserving the original subject in streaming video generation exposes a conflict: cached history helps maintain the subject but also sustains old-scene objects that should disappear. Through controlled interventions on text conditioning, denoising steps, the local window, and the attention sink, we identify how cached visual history keeps this obsolete content. When the original frames remain in the cache, KV flush and sink recomputation still leave old-scene objects in the generated videos. Replacing this history with target-scene history largely removes those objects, but also changes the subject, reducing face similarity to the pre-switch subject. We then propose Molt Forcing, a training-free method that rebuilds scene history from a cold-start target scene while selectively retaining subject tokens from the original cache. Across 16 scene families, Molt Forcing removes old-scene objects at least as reliably as an Echo-Forcing hard cut while keeping the subject much closer to its pre-switch appearance.

</details>


### [35] [Rethinking Video Agents: When and Why Video Harnesses Work](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31883)
*Luoyuan Zhang,Xuanyu Zheng,Yancheng Long,Haoyang Xu,Bin Wen,Tingting Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Video-Relook 实验框架，系统研究视频理解中"主动观察"（agentic harness）何时、为何有效，发现其效益取决于任务对细粒度信息的需要与模型将交互转化为可靠答案修正的能力之间的匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频理解不仅依赖模型如何推理视觉证据，还依赖模型"看到哪些证据"。以往固定观察策略在推理前就预设了证据范围；而允许模型随理解加深主动请求额外观察的智能体框架，有望释放固定输入无法触及的能力。然而，"能请求观察"并不等于"能有效利用观察"，因此需要厘清这类交互式框架在何种条件、因何机制带来收益。

Method: 构建 Video-Relook 作为实验框架：让模型从统一的默认观察配置出发，在时间与空间维度上自适应地调整观察（按需重看/放大）；跨多个模型与多类任务，分析性能变化与交互轨迹（evidence seeking 行为、答案修正的可靠性）。

Result: 自适应观察在细粒度动作理解任务上带来显著提升，收益也延伸到 Video-MME-v2；但即便观察接口相同，不同模型间收益差异明显，交互轨迹显示其在证据搜寻与答案修订可靠性上存在对应差异；同一模型在不同任务上的收益也从大幅提升到有限增益甚至性能回退不等。

Conclusion: 框架有效性取决于"存在可获取信息性观察的机会"与"模型能把交互转化为可靠答案修正的能力"二者之间的对齐。据此倡导协调感知与推理的视频框架，使观察自主度与任务需求及模型能力相匹配。

Abstract: Video understanding depends not only on how models reason about visual evidence, but also on which evidence they observe. Fixed observation policies determine this evidence in advance; agentic harnesses allow models to seek further observations as their understanding develops. This shift creates an opportunity to realize capabilities that fixed inputs leave untapped, yet the ability to request observations does not ensure their effective use. We investigate when and why video harnesses improve understanding, examining how task demands and models' capacity for interaction jointly shape their benefits. Using Video-Relook as an experimental framework, we let models adapt their temporal and spatial observations from a common default configuration, and analyze performance and interaction trajectories across models and tasks. Adaptive observation yields substantial gains on fine-grained action understanding, with benefits also extending to Video-MME-v2. Even under the same observation interface, gains differ substantially across models; interaction traces reveal corresponding differences in evidence seeking and the reliability of answer revision. The benefits also vary across tasks for the same model, ranging from substantial improvements to limited gains and regressions. Together, these findings support an account in which harness effectiveness depends on the alignment between opportunities for informative observation and the model's ability to turn interaction into reliable revisions. They motivate video harnesses that coordinate perception and reasoning, matching observational autonomy to task demands and model capabilities.

</details>


### [36] [PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL: Polarization-Keyed Examination Papers and Mandatory Issued Eyewear that Displace AI Glasses and Extend Universal Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31299)
*Dohyeon Kwon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"和平测试协议"：考场统一发放并回收内置圆偏振检偏器的"权限眼镜"，试卷以圆偏振手性编码文字（肉眼与无滤光相机下呈均匀灰色），从而把AI眼镜形态反制为受控读取通道；并给出亮度/对比度预算、倾斜容忍性分析与模拟结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带摄像头的AI眼镜可将试卷内容远程送给视觉语言模型，构成新型作弊通道。已有对策分两类：设备检测针对"持有行为"，companion工作SEOYUN针对模型侧。本文改换思路——改变"眼镜归谁所有"，把智能眼镜形态本身变成受控于考试机构的读取工具。

Method: 1）体制设计：全体考生全程佩戴机构发放并回收的眼镜；试卷采用图案化层压结构，如影院立体显示那样以圆偏振手性而非亮度编码文字，裸眼及未加滤光相机下呈均匀灰色，仅凭发放的圆偏振检偏器可读。2）可及性分层：近视者配处方插入镜片，低视力者可用离线辅助MR层级，盲人保留盲文、音频与读屏格式。3）理论分析：推导亮度与对比度预算，论证圆偏振键控对头部倾斜的容忍性。4）验证：Mueller矩阵光谱模型检验倾斜不变性与对线偏振相机不可见性；对英文/韩文文本做拍摄-OCR实验；151名观察者与28台相机的可见性数据；全部为仿真。

Result: Mueller模型确认倾斜不变性与线偏振相机不可见性，但1°轴失配会泄漏数个百分点对比度；拍摄-OCR实验显示视频帧平均可恢复单帧不可读的微弱泄漏，故泄漏须按对手总光子预算设界；151名观察者与28台相机数据显示光谱（同色异谱）键对全部被试可见；仿真支持前述分析。

Conclusion: "发放式眼镜+偏振手性编码试卷"可作为把AI眼镜形态反制为受控通道的协议框架，但并非秘密密钥——不提供保密性，滤光隐蔽相机仍可行，且1°失配泄漏与多帧平均攻击必须严格设界。所有结果均为仿真，尚无原型、实物测量或人体实验结果，实证有效性未验证。

Abstract: Camera-equipped AI glasses turn an examination page into a query for a remote vision-language model. Device detection targets possession, and our companion work SEOYUN targets the model. PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL instead changes who owns the eyewear. Every candidate wears authority-issued glasses for the whole session, and the question paper is printed so that it can be read only through them. As in cinema stereoscopy, a patterned laminate encodes the text in the handedness of circular polarization rather than in brightness. The page looks uniformly grey to the naked eye and to unfiltered cameras, and the issued circular analyzer reveals the text. Compulsory issued eyewear turns the smart-glasses form factor against itself. The face position is occupied by a device the authority supplies and collects, and a camera anywhere else needs its own analyzer. Spectacle wearers receive prescription inserts in the issued frame, low-vision candidates may use an offline assistive mixed-reality tier, and blind candidates keep braille, audio, and screen-reader formats. We derive the luminance and contrast budget and show why circular keying tolerates head tilt. A simulation study supports the analysis. A spectral Mueller model confirms tilt invariance and invisibility to linear-polarization cameras, but a 1 degree axis misregistration leaks a few percent of contrast. A capture-and-OCR experiment on English and Korean text shows that video averaging can recover leakage too weak to read in a single frame, so leakage must be bounded against the adversary's total photon budget. Data from 151 observers and 28 cameras show that spectral (metameric) keys are visible to all of them. The key carries no secrecy, and filtered covert cameras remain possible. All results are simulations; no prototypes, physical measurements, or human-subject results are reported.

</details>

*Ming Ma,Wenhao Hu,Qichao Wang,Yuhao Wang,Junpeng Zhao,Qiyi Wang,Fangrui Zhang,Zhiqian Lai,Shanxin Guan,Haoyi Pei,Hongan Chen,Rui Gong*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 影视素材导入与初调色中，Log曲线仅存于易在转码和团队交接中丢失的元数据里；调色师须逐一试曲线并借波形示波器判断，选错会使整段画面色调偏移。厂商曲线在码值上高度聚集且与未知曝光耦合，仅凭图像恢复极难，故需一个标准化基准衡量多模态模型的真实能力。
