Result: 实拍素材准确率仅略高于"总猜最常见曲线"的基线；去除正确选项后模型几乎从不弃答，表明严重依赖场景与品牌先验。提供厂商规范后在标定色卡上识别显著提升，但在无光度参照的自然图像上几乎无改善。

Conclusion: 现有模型并未真正"测量像素"来识别Log曲线，而是依赖先验；"读懂规范"与"测量像素"之间存在明显鸿沟。CameraLogBench为多模态模型在真实影视流程中的光度推断能力提供了可诊断的评测工具。

Abstract: MediaStormBench is a multimodal benchmark for real-world film and television production, with each subset drawn from MediaStorm's day-to-day work. We release its first subset, MediaStormBench-CameraLog (CameraLogBench), on a common foundational task in footage ingest and initial color grading: identifying the Log curve of a clip without metadata. Cameras record Log footage by compressing a wide range of scene light into code values with a vendor-defined logarithmic curve, and color can be restored correctly only once that curve is known. The curve, however, is recorded only in file metadata, easily lost in transcoding and team hand-offs. A colorist then has to try candidate curves one by one against a waveform scope, and a wrong choice shifts the tones and colors of the whole clip. Recovering the curve from the image alone is challenging, because vendor curves cluster tightly in code value and are coupled with unknown exposure. CameraLogBench is built on professionally shot footage and tests whether multimodal models can identify the curve, with a probe that removes the correct option to expose guessing from priors. Because every candidate curve is strictly defined by a published vendor formula, we derive four controls from one implementation of these formulas: graded negatives, synthetic frames of identical scenes, in-context specification digests, and a training-free formula baseline, which together decouple semantic priors from photometric measurement. Across 11 models, real-footage accuracy barely exceeds always guessing the most frequent curve; when the correct option is removed, models almost never abstain, revealing heavy reliance on scene and brand priors. Supplying the vendor specification sharply improves recognition on calibrated charts but hardly helps on natural images without a photometric reference, exposing a gap between reading a specification and measuring pixels.

</details>


### [38] [EditText: Structure-Aware Generation and Selective Visual Transport for Fine-Grained Text Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32134)
*Zhaobin Chu,Guandong Li,Xin Lv,Zhiwei Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EditText 是一个统一的细粒度文本编辑框架，将目标字符生成与源图像视觉搬运相结合，通过 attention transport 机制实现字符替换、外观保持与未编辑区域一致性。同时提出 TBench 基准，取得 SOTA 的非编辑区 SSIM（0.9769）与全图 LPIPS（0.0460）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度文本编辑需在指定区域准确替换文本，同时保持源文本的字体、颜色、纹理以及未编辑区域的视觉一致性。现有方法难以兼顾精确字符生成与源图像细节的准确搬运。

Method: 采用双条件 Fill 输入：掩码图像（遮蔽原文本、保留未编辑内容作为源画布）与源文本风格参考，二者与目标图像共享空间参照。提出 Attention Transport 框架，以 Source Weight（条件被分配的注意力）与 Spatial Aggregation Kernel（内部空间注意力分布）描述条件利用；对选定的非编辑 query，在保持掩码图像总注意力权重不变的前提下，将其注意力重新分配到空间对应的邻域，实现选择性视觉搬运。训练采用多阶段策略并引入针对局部目标字符结构的 Glyph-aware Structural Loss。

Result: 在自建的 TBench（覆盖字母、表意文字与阿拉伯数字）上，非编辑区 SSIM 达 0.9769，全图 LPIPS 达 0.0460，均为 SOTA。

Conclusion: 通过 attention transport 的选择性视觉搬运与结构感知损失，EditText 统一实现准确字符生成、源文本外观保持与未编辑细节保留；TBench 为细粒度文本编辑提供多书写体系评估基准。

Abstract: Fine-grained text editing aims to accurately replace text in a specified region while preserving the source text's font, color, and texture, as well as visual consistency in unedited regions. We present EditText, a unified framework for fine-grained text editing that combines target character generation with visual transport from the source image. The model uses dual-condition Fill inputs: a masked image and a source text style reference, both sharing a spatial reference with the target image. The masked image hides the original text and retains unedited content as a source canvas; the style reference supplies appearance cues that guide new character generation together with the target text. We introduce an Attention Transport framework in which Source Weight describes the attention allocated to a condition and the Spatial Aggregation Kernel describes its internal spatial attention distribution. Accurate transfer of source details depends on attention strength, the retention of details in condition features, and spatially accurate aggregation. For selected non-edit queries, we therefore preserve the total attention weight assigned to the masked image while redistributing its attention toward spatially corresponding neighborhoods, enabling selective visual transport. Multi-stage training, combined with a Glyph-aware Structural Loss on local target character structure, teaches the model to generate accurate text, preserve source text appearance, and retain unedited details. We also introduce TBench, a fine-grained text editing benchmark covering Alphabetic, Logographic, and Arabic numerals, to evaluate character updates, appearance preservation, and the preservation of unedited details. On TBench, EditText achieves state-of-the-art non-edit-region SSIM (0.9769) and full-image LPIPS (0.0460).

</details>


### [39] [RISE: Reasoning with Implicit State Embeddings for GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32102)
*Enqi Liu,Zhi Gao,Liu Liu,Lifeng Fan,Liyuan Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出隐式框架RISE，将动作相关推理融入隐式状态表示以提升GUI动作预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GUI智能体依赖显式推理训练，易过度拟合特定推理模式，而非学习可泛化的动作相关信息。

Method: 将动作相关推理整合进隐式状态表示，并以三种互补监督目标捕获推理信息：全CoT状态对齐（保留推理过程信息）、动作分布对齐（编码动作偏好）、推理到动作边界对齐（捕获动作生成前的即时表示）。

Abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents translate user instructions and screenshots into executable actions. To learn executable actions, existing approaches often rely on explicit reasoning during training, which encourage over-reliance on specific reasoning patterns rather than generalizable action-relevant information. In this paper, we propose an implicit framework, RISE, which integrates action-relevant reasoning into implicit state representations to guide GUI action prediction. To this end, action-relevant reasoning is captured through three complementary supervision objectives: full-CoT state alignment preserves information across the reasoning process, action-distribution alignment encodes action preferences, and reasoning-to-action boundary alignment captures the representation immediately before action generation. In this case, our RISE effectively learns informative implicit representations, thereby improving the accuracy of next-action token prediction. RISE achieves 70.6\% accuracy on OSWorld-G, establishing state-of-the-art performance among compared 8B models with a 4.3-point gain over its backbone. Results across two distinct backbones and six diverse benchmarks further demonstrate its effectiveness in GUI grounding and action prediction. Our code is available on our project page.

</details>

*Shubh Garg,Pratham Arora,Debabrata Ghosh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文对InternVL3-2B在DisasterM3上进行受控诊断，发现真实时相对比"后影像重复两次"控制仅提升0.5个百分点（置信区间跨零），说明模型几乎不利用真实前时影像内容、对时序顺序也不敏感，但对第一张影像并非完全无视。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双时相遥感影像的灾害评估本质需要对比灾前灾后影像，但VLM可能主要依赖灾后影像或提示中的时序措辞而"看似"回答了变化问题，缺乏对时序证据依赖性的诊断，现有基准只报告准确率而不检验答案是否真正依赖预期证据。

Method: 构建受控诊断协议，在DisasterM3数据集（41个事件的1,659对光学与SAR影像、九类灾害、事件不相交划分、9,031个推理问题）上比较五种输入配置：仅后影像、真实前后配对、后影像重复两次、影像顺序反转、以及来自其他事件的无关前影像，并使用配对bootstrap置信区间评估。

Result: 真实配对较重复后影像控制仅高0.5个百分点，95%配对bootstrap CI为[-0.2, +1.2]；顺序反转带来-0.2个百分点变化，CI为[-0.8, +0.5]；但真实配对比无关事件前影像配对高2.5个百分点，CI为[+1.6, +3.4]。状态转移与多跳问题依然困难，光学与SAR输入呈现不同表现特征。

Conclusion: 在该协议下未发现真实前时影像内容带来可测量收益，模型对时序顺序敏感度很低，但确实读取了第一张影像（存在某种图像级依赖而非时序语义理解）。作者提出时序场景图作为可检验的下一步方向而非已验证方案，并主张遥感时序基准应报告答案是否依赖预期证据，而不只报告准确率。

Abstract: Bi-temporal satellite imagery is central to disaster assessment: deciding what was damaged requires comparing a pre-event scene with its post-event counterpart. A vision-language model (VLM) can nonetheless appear to answer change questions while relying mainly on the post-event image or on the prompt's temporal framing. We present a controlled diagnostic of temporal grounding and apply it to one lightweight VLM, InternVL3-2B, on DisasterM3: 1,659 optical and SAR image pairs from 41 events and nine disaster types, in event-disjoint partitions, with 9,031 reasoning questions. We compare post-only input, the true pre/post pair, the post image repeated twice, reversed image order, and an unrelated pre-event image. The true pair scores $+0.5$ accuracy points above the repeated-post control (95\% paired bootstrap CI $[-0.2, +1.2]$), and reversing the order changes accuracy by $-0.2$ points ($[-0.8, +0.5]$). Under this protocol we therefore find no measurable benefit from the content of the true pre-event image and little sensitivity to temporal order. The model is not blind to the first image, however: the true pair scores $2.5$ points above a pair whose pre-event image comes from another event ($[+1.6, +3.4]$). State-transition and multi-hop questions remain hard, and optical and SAR inputs show different profiles. We outline temporal scene graphs as a testable next step, not a validated solution, and argue that temporal benchmarks for Earth observation should report whether answers depend on the intended evidence, not only how often they are right.

</details>

*Adonay Demewez Gebremedhin,Mohamad Alansari,Wessam Shehieb,Muzammal Naseer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DistractAttack：首个利用背景干扰物（distractor）对 SAM2 类可提示视频跟踪器实施持续扰动攻击的白盒方法，核心为反事实干扰物搜索（CDS），在视频级与单次扰动下显著提升攻击效果并具黑盒迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM2 等可提示视频跟踪器凭借强时序一致性成为下游视频理解与跟踪的重要基座，其对抗鲁棒性问题日益重要。现有针对 SAM2 的攻击多聚焦局部掩码退化与短期时序特征破坏，忽视长期动态与竞争性干扰物（distractor）的作用。同时观察到 SAM2 在跟踪不确定时自身会暴露有用的干扰物线索，可被反向利用。

Method: 提出 DistractAttack 白盒攻击，借助背景干扰物持续破坏目标跟踪。核心过程为反事实干扰物搜索（CDS）：并行传播干净轨迹与被攻击轨迹，发现合理的竞争区域，并甄别在扰动下愈发有效的区域；将发现证据随时间累积，削弱目标支持度，推动模型产生反复出现的替代预测或目标消失预测。

Conclusion: 利用背景干扰物并挖掘 SAM2 自身的不确定性线索，可实现对可提示视频跟踪器长期、持续的跟踪破坏；CDS 的证据累积机制带来强攻击性与良好迁移性，揭示了该类模型在长时序动态与干扰物竞争层面的鲁棒性缺口。

Abstract: Promptable video trackers such as SAM2 achieve accurate and robust performance through strong temporal consistency, making them important foundations for downstream video understanding and tracking applications. As their use continues to expand, understanding their robustness to adversarial perturbations becomes increasingly important. Existing attacks on SAM2 largely focus on local mask degradation and short-term temporal feature disruption, leaving its longer-term dynamics and competing object interferences (Distractors) insufficiently explored. We observe that SAM2 itself exposes useful distractor cues when tracking becomes uncertain. Based on these observations, we propose DistractAttack, a white-box attack that uses background distractors to disrupt target tracking persistently. Its core procedure, Counterfactual Distractor Search (CDS), propagates clean and attacked trajectories in parallel to discover plausible competing regions and identify those that become increasingly effective under perturbation. The discovered evidence is accumulated over time to weaken target support and promote recurrent alternatives or disappearance predictions. Extensive experiments under video-level and one-shot perturbations across Visual Object Tracking and Video Object Segmentation demonstrate strong attack effectiveness, raising DRE to $4.4\times$ and NRE to $7.3\times$ their nearest baselines under video perturbation, while transferring effectively across model scales and tracker variants in black-box settings. Project page: https://adonaydem.github.io/sam2-da-page/

</details>


### [42] [VLG-Drive: Unifying Vision-Language and Geometric Priors for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31952)
*Junge Zhang,Jie Zhu,Yanqi Jia,Xiangyu Xu,Zixun Huang,Wenbin He,Xin Li,Jiachen Li,Liu Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶规划器同时需要场景语义（VLM 提供）与空间结构（几何基础模型从视觉历史恢复），但分别适配两类模型代价高，缺乏轻量的统一利用方案。

Method: 保持 VLM 与几何模型全部冻结，仅用轨迹标签训练融合接口与规划器；在相机网格的每个单元上，通过几何锚定的残差将配对的 VLM 特征与几何特征融合为联合 token；再由命令条件规划器读取这些 token 预测自车轨迹。

Abstract: A driving planner needs both scene semantics, which vision-language models (VLMs) provide, and spatial structure, which geometric foundation models recover from visual history. We present VLG-Drive, which keeps both models frozen and trains only a fusion interface and a planner from trajectory labels. At each camera-grid cell, the interface fuses the paired VLM and geometry features into one joint token through a geometry-anchored residual, and a command-conditioned planner reads these tokens to predict the ego trajectory. VLG-Drive achieves 31.78 EPDMS on NavHard under perturbed initial states, the highest among the compared methods, and 88.27 PDMS on NavTest from cameras alone. Pointwise fusion outperforms independent VLM and geometry streams on both benchmarks. In closed-loop driving on 420 HUGSIM scenarios, VLG-Drive outperforms all compared planners. These results indicate that a lightweight planner trained on fused features of frozen vision-language and geometric foundation models is an effective alternative to adapting either model for planning.

</details>

*Xiaoling Zhou,Haopeng Li,Yufa Zhou,Rui Ding,Yu Li,Jun Lin,Enze Xie,Chunhua Shen,Xuan Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DraftKV：免训练框架，通过几何锚定的粗粒度草稿相关性检索历史KV缓存，并用tile级流式注意力重叠CPU-GPU传输以隐藏延迟，实现一致性保持下的高效交互式视频世界模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式视频世界模型在重访已探索区域时难以保持空间几何与外观一致性。历史KV缓存可提升长时一致性，但随历史增长，其检索与注意力计算带来显著延迟与显存开销。

Method: 提出训练无关的DraftKV：(1) 先以几何锚定(相机位姿)做粗筛，再用查询条件化的draft相关性精化，检索历史KV；(2) CPU offloading结合tile-wise流式注意力，降低显存占用与延迟；(3) 提出流式CG-Attention，将CPU-to-GPU的KV传输与注意力计算重叠，隐藏传输延迟并保持显存有界。理论分析给出：draft相关性与全分辨率块相关性的均值分支精确一致，偏差仅限β加权max分支；以Top-K选择重叠度界定检索效用损失；并证明仅凭池化描述子无法区分相似块，须先做几何锚定。

Result: 多模型族实验显示DraftKV在生成质量与一致性上更优，端到端加速3.27×，峰值显存较其他CPU-offloaded KV缓存检索方法降低42.2%；可在单张H100上用SolarWM-33B实现高质量交互式世界生成与历史KV检索。

Conclusion: 几何锚定+草稿精化的分层检索与流式CG-Attention结合，可在免训练条件下兼顾长时一致性与推理效率，使大模型交互式世界生成在单卡上可行。

Abstract: Interactive video world models enable action- and camera-controlled exploration, yet struggle to maintain consistent spatial geometry and appearance when revisiting previously explored locations. Historical KV caches help auto-regressive video diffusion models maintain long-term consistency, but their retrieval and attention computation introduce substantial latency as history grows. We propose DraftKV, a training-free framework that retrieves historical KV caches based on geometric grounding and query-conditioned relevance, while combining CPU offloading with tile-wise streaming attention to reduce GPU memory usage and inference latency. Theoretically, we show that draft relevance reproduces the mean branch of full-resolution block relevance exactly, so its deviation is confined to the $β$-weighted max branch, and we bound retrieval utility loss in terms of the measured Top-K selection overlap. We further show that draft relevance cannot distinguish blocks with similar pooled descriptors regardless of camera pose, motivating geometric grounding before refinement. Then, we introduce streaming CG-Attention, which overlaps CPU-to-GPU KV transfers with attention computation through tile-wise streaming, hiding transfer latency while maintaining bounded GPU memory usage. Experiments across diverse model families show that DraftKV achieves superior generation quality and consistency while achieving $3.27\times$ end-to-end speedup and 42.2% peak GPU memory reduction over other CPU-offloaded KV cache retrieval methods. Notably, DraftKV enables high-quality interactive world generation with historical KV retrieval on a single H100 GPU using SolarWM-33B.

</details>

*Tianyuan Yuan,Baijun Ye,Shicheng Cao,Xing Nie,Xiaopeng Yu,Ke Dong,Zijie Zhao,Shenling Qiu,Yizhao Xu,Feiyang Xue,Haonan Liu,Haoyu Zhang,Haobo Jia,Zheng Liu,Anqi Yang,Jiahui Niu,Yue Sun,Tailai Cheng,Jianpeng Yu,Yang Wen,Longhao Wei,Zibin Dong,Shiduo Zhang,Yicheng Liu,Hang Zhao*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) adapt pretrained video generators for robot control by jointly predicting future camera frames and actions, transferring physical priors learned from video into manipulation policies. However, generating future frames before every action makes test-time inference too slow for closed-loop control, while most existing policies remain restricted to short observation histories. Across public simulation suites and real-robot deployments, direct action decoding (Fast mode) matches imagine-then-act (IDM) inference from the same checkpoint while running in 60 ms per 16-step action chunk on a single RTX 5090 (7.6x faster than IDM) and supporting pause-free real-time chunking. *Shahd Hekal,Joram Kim,Jeova Farias Sales Rocha Neto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出有界分段线性激活族 JaSIN，在避免超越函数的前提下插值 ReLU 与分段线性正弦，系统厘清 ReLU 在 INR 任务中失效的关键因素，并给出基于"可证明不活跃单元"的无损剪枝方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReLU 坐标网络在隐式神经表示（INR）任务中表现差，而能改善的正弦、Gabor 等激活均离开了分段线性函数类，导致难以判断 ReLU 究竟哪一性质是问题根源；需要一种仍属分段线性、可控制变量地逼近正弦行为的激活。

Method: 设计 JaSIN 系列激活：由有界性、单峰、峰居中、振荡数等可调属性组成的分段线性有界激活，无需任何超越运算即可在 ReLU 与分段线性正弦之间插值；配合消融式对比（每增加一种属性看增益）。同时利用 INR 在评估网格上拟合的特性，判定预激活从未进入激活支撑集的单元在整个域上可证明不活跃，从而直接删除，无需微调。

Result: 有界范围使图像重建 PSNR 平均提升 0.06 dB；单一鼓包提升 3.29 dB；鼓包居中再提升 3.64 dB；振荡数进一步带来 6.30 dB，使 ReLU 在 Kodak 上从 24.0 dB 升至 37.3 dB，在 11 种激活中排名第三，距 SOTA 差 1.3 dB；但超过四次振荡后重建崩溃。剪枝可去除最多 84% 参数且性能无损（dB 指标），解码提速 3.2 倍。

Conclusion: ReLU 的缺陷可通过保持分段线性前提下的有界性、单峰居中与有限振荡来逐步弥补，说明并非必须离开分段线性类；振荡数存在明显上限（约四次），可能源于分段线性近似的表达与频率权衡。此外，网格拟合特性使可证明不活跃单元的识别与无损参数删除成为可能，兼顾精度与效率。

Abstract: Coordinate networks with ReLU activations perform poorly on implicit neural representation tasks, and the activations that address this, such as sinusoids and Gabor wavelets, all leave the piecewise-linear function class, so it remains unclear which property of ReLU is at fault. We introduce JaSIN, a family of bounded piecewise-linear activations that interpolates between ReLU and a piecewise-linear sinusoid without any the use of transcendental operation. Our results show that a bounded range improves image reconstruction PSNR on average by 0.06 dB, a single bump 3.29 dB, and centering that bump a further 3.64 dB. The oscillation count improves 6.30 dB more, raising ReLU from 24.0 to 37.3 dB on Kodak images, placing third over eleven activations, within 1.3 dB of the state-of-the-art, though beyond four oscillations the reconstruction collapses. Because an INR is fit on the grid on which it is evaluated, a unit whose pre-activations never reach the support of its activation is certifiably inactive over the entire domain; deleting such units is lossless without fine-tuning, removing up to 84% of parameters at zero loss in performance (dB) and decoding 3.2 times faster. Reference code and demos are available at https://github.com/jeovafarias/jasin.

</details>


### [46] [MSW: a Multi-Scale Sliced Wasserstein Distance Between Image Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31647)
*Youssef Haouchat,Stanislas Ducotterd,Bassam El Rawas,Michael Unser*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多尺度切片Wasserstein（MSW）距离：在像素空间用固定DCT滤波器组卷积图像、全局池化后比较一维分布的Wasserstein距离，无需训练网络，并配以精确两样本检验给出校准p值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像分布度量多在预训练网络潜空间中比较，而潜空间对简单扰动近乎不变，导致度量对这类扰动不敏感，且需要大量样本。

Method: MSW在多个尺度上用固定离散余弦滤波器组对图像卷积，对所有位置响应做池化，得到一维分布并用Wasserstein距离比较；配套精确两样本检验提供校准p值；不使用任何学习特征。

Result: 相比潜空间度量，MSW能检测更小的扰动且所需图像数远少；虽无学习特征，仍能检测图像分布的语义变化；实验中匹配或优于现有基于Wasserstein的度量。

Conclusion: 像素空间的多尺度滤波加一维Wasserstein比较是一种无需训练、样本高效且敏感的图像分布度量方案。

Abstract: We propose the multi-scale sliced Wasserstein (MSW) distance between image distributions, which operates in pixel space and requires no trained network. MSW convolves images with a fixed bank of discrete cosine filters at several scales, pools the responses over all positions, and compares the resulting one-dimensional distributions using the Wasserstein distance. We pair MSW with an exact two-sample test that gives calibrated p-values. Most metrics compare two image sets in the latent space of a pretrained network. We show that these metrics are insensitive to simple perturbations of the images, because the latent space is nearly invariant to them. In contrast, MSW detects smaller perturbations than latent-space metrics and needs far fewer images to do so. Although it uses no learned features, it still detects semantic changes of the image distribution. Finally, MSW matches or outperforms existing Wasserstein-based metrics in our experiments.

</details>

*Yukun Shi,Minglun Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文系统考察了照片旋转（EXIF方向标签被忽略、丢失或错误）对五个多视图3D基础模型的相机位姿与3D点估计精度的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机常以横向方式存储竖拍照片，依赖方向标签告知观看方向，而该标签可被忽略、丢失或错误；现有3D基础模型与官方图像加载器普遍未处理该问题，却无人系统评估其后果。

Method: 在三个数据集上对五种多视图3D基础模型进行受控实验：人为旋转部分输入照片，比较相机位姿精度；同时检验标准基准中已存在的横向照片的影响，评估模型置信度信号是否能揭示失败，核查官方图像加载器对方向标签的处理，并测试若干修复方案。

Result: 少数旋转照片即降低所有模型的相机位姿精度；标准基准中已有的横向照片同样造成精度损失；即便最鲁棒的模型也会掉点。失败是"静默"的——模型置信度无法可靠指示该问题，且多数官方加载器忽略方向标签；所测试的每种修复方案仅能纠正部分问题。

Conclusion: 照片方向是3D重建流程中被忽视的脆弱点，呼吁在重建管线与基准评测中引入方向检查机制。

Abstract: Multi-view 3D foundation models estimate camera poses and 3D points from a set of photos in one forward pass. Many cameras store a portrait shot sideways, with an orientation tag telling viewers how to turn it, and this tag can be ignored, lost or wrong. We measure how rotated photos affect five such models on three datasets. A few rotated photos lower camera pose accuracy for every model, and the sideways photos already in a standard benchmark do the same. Even the most robust model still loses accuracy. The failure is also silent: the models' confidence does not reliably flag it, and most official image loaders ignore the tag. The fixes we test each correct only part of the problem. These findings call for orientation checks in reconstruction pipelines and benchmarks.

</details>


### [48] [Look Where Camouflage Breaks: Concealment-Guided Observation for Camouflaged Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31392)
*Dingming Zhang,Fengyang Xiao,Jingjia Feng,Chunming He,Sina Farsiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CamoBreak是一个以“ Concealment Spectrum（隐蔽谱）”为引导的主动式伪装目标检测框架：在多尺度上量化区域相似性与边界模糊度，区分“持续隐蔽”与“在更细/更粗尺度上可分辨”，并据此选择裁剪区域、与全局前景/背景参考比对识别、以目标条件空间偏好更新预测与特征记忆，由预测增益决定是否再次观测。跨编码器与相关分割任务上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伪装目标在某一尺度可与背景融合、在另一尺度则可分辨，因此“某区域看起来有歧义”这一信息不足以指示应采集何种观测来消解歧义。核心挑战在于：如何把隐蔽的形态与尺度属性，与“新视角/新观测能提供何种判别证据”建立联系。

Method: 1) 由图像与当前预测构造 Concealment Spectrum，在多个比较尺度上度量区域相似度与边界模糊度，区分持续隐蔽与在更细或更粗尺度上新出现的可分性；2) 依据谱测量从已捕获图像中选择裁剪区域（crop selection），并对照全局前景/背景参考进行识别；3) 采用目标条件（object-conditioned）的空间偏好，决定局部证据在何处更新预测与特征记忆，保留目标修正、抑制背景干扰；4) 已接受的修正重新塑造下一次测量，由预测的分割增益决定是否继续观测（主动式闭环）。

Result: 在多种编码器家族及相近分割任务上取得一致提升；针对性分析显示在小目标恢复、多目标覆盖和选择性证据整合方面均有改善。

Conclusion: 将隐蔽性以多尺度“谱”形式显式建模，并将其作为主动观测的决策依据，可有效把尺度相关的可分性证据转化为对伪装目标的判别性修正；该框架与主流编码器即插即用、可扩展至相关分割任务。代码将开源。

Abstract: A camouflaged object can blend into its surroundings at one scale and become distinguishable at another. Yet a region's apparent ambiguity gives limited guidance on which observation would resolve it. The challenge is to connect the form and scale of concealment to the evidence that a new view can reveal. We introduce CamoBreak, an active framework for camouflaged object detection guided by a Concealment Spectrum. From the image and current predictions, the spectrum measures regional resemblance and boundary ambiguity across comparison scales, distinguishing persistent concealment from separation emerging at finer or broader scales. These measurements guide crop selection from the already-captured image and recognition against global foreground and background references. An object-conditioned spatial preference then selects where local evidence should update the prediction and feature memory, retaining target corrections while suppressing background distractions. Accepted corrections reshape the next measurement, while predicted segmentation benefit determines whether to observe again. Experiments across encoder families and related segmentation tasks show consistent improvements. Targeted analyses support improved small-target recovery, multiple-object coverage, and selective evidence integration. Code will be released.

</details>


### [49] [Lit Up but Not Needed: Scoped Lesions Show Where Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts Depend on Their Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31576)
*Zhixuan Ge,Anqi Li,Kexin Geng,Wei Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在Qwen3-VL、Kimi-VL与Gemma-4等MoE视觉语言模型中，3–12%的专家为"视觉专属"，但消融（lesion）实验表明它们对感知任务几乎不可或缺性为零，真正的任务依赖位于"双用途"专家上；应以消融而非路由激活图作为专家选择、剪枝与跳过的依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经科学表明，任务激活图并不等价于必要性地图——任务中"亮起"的脑区未必是任务所需，只有损伤（lesion）才能揭示哪些区域真正必要。MoE视觉语言模型天然自带"激活图"（路由器记录哪些专家响应图像/文本token），近期工作据此识别"模态专属专家"，但这一推论缺乏因果验证。

Method: 在Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B、Kimi-VL-A3B与Gemma-4-26B-A4B上开展消融研究：(1) 依据路由统计识别视觉专属专家（图像token路由率最高达均匀分布的5倍，文本token几乎不路由）；(2) 对这些专家做整体消融，并与同等规模的随机专家集合消融作对照；(3) 进一步做"范围化消融"（scoped lesion），仅在图像位置或仅在文本位置移除专家集合；(4) 辅以专家输入patch信息量、输出幅值、纯文本训练下的激活行为及负载均衡偏置的分析。

Result: 在Qwen3-VL中，视觉专属专家占据全部图像token路由的四分之一；但消融全部此类专家，在8个感知基准与自由形式OCR上平均损失不足1个百分点，且不高于消融同等规模随机专家集合的损失；Kimi-VL与Gemma-4中亦然。范围化消融显示：Qwen3-VL在所有图像位置静默全部专家仅损失3点，而在文本位置损失45点，依赖集中在双用途专家上。图像侧依赖在Qwen3-VL与Kimi-VL约为2–3点，Gemma-4为26点。"读取图像中的文字"是所有模型中唯一必须依赖图像位置专家的能力。视觉专属专家接收信息量丰富的patch、输出幅值正常，但在感官剥夺（纯文本训练）下保持惰性，仅当负载均衡强制时才被招募；Kimi-VL中多数此类专家由均衡偏置本身制造。

Conclusion: 路由激活图不能作为专家必要性的判据：视觉专属专家虽被图像token高频选中，却对感知能力近乎无关紧要；模型真正依赖的是双用途专家，且依赖集中在文本位置。负载均衡在模型依赖最弱的计算部分塑造了模态地图。因此专家选择、剪枝与跳过策略应遵循消融（lesion）结果，而非路由激活图。

Abstract: Cognitive neuroscience learned that an activation map is not a map of necessity. Regions that light up during a task are not always needed for it, and only lesions reveal which ones are. Mixture-of-experts (MoE) vision-language models come with an activation map for free, since the router records which experts respond to image and text tokens, and recent work reads modality-specialized experts off this map. We bring the lesion. In Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, Kimi-VL-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B, 3 to 12% of the experts are vision-exclusive: image tokens route to them at up to five times the uniform rate and text tokens almost never. In Qwen3-VL they receive a quarter of all image-token routing, and lesioning all of them costs less than one percentage point on average over eight perception benchmarks and free-form OCR, no more than lesioning a random set of the same size. In Kimi-VL and Gemma-4 the lesion also costs no more than a random set. Scoped lesions, which remove an expert set only at image positions or only at text positions, then show where the models do depend on their experts. In Qwen3-VL, silencing every expert at every image position costs 3 points, against 45 at text positions, where the dependence sits in dual-use experts that text-only tasks need as well. Across models the image-side dependence is 2 to 3 points in Qwen3-VL and Kimi-VL and 26 in Gemma-4. Reading text in images is the one ability that needs image-position experts in every model. The exclusive experts receive informative patches, produce outputs of ordinary size, and stay inert under sensory deprivation: text-only training recruits them only when load balancing forces it. In Kimi-VL the balancing bias itself manufactures most of them. Load balancing draws the modality map in the part of the computation the models depend on least. Expert selection, pruning and skipping should follow the lesion, not the map.

</details>

Abstract: Surgical scene understanding is constrained by data scarcity and long-tail class imbalance, as annotating surgical videos demands scarce clinical expertise while rare procedural events remain underrepresented. We tackle this through data generation and propose SurgGenesis, a generative surgical world model that learns future surgical state transitions in a latent space from visual observations and textual procedural descriptions, serving as a scalable surgical data engine. To adapt a large-scale video diffusion model to the data-scarce surgical domain without catastrophic forgetting, we introduce a three-stage progressive LoRA strategy that incrementally injects endoscopic visual priors, procedural semantics, and spatial motion cues. Rather than judging generation by visual fidelity alone, we validate SurgGenesis along two axes that separate a world model from a generic generator: (i) future-awareness, by comparing predicted futures against the real future through a GT-latent prediction gap and temporal-horizon analysis, and (ii) action-faithful usefulness, by checking that generated clips contain the commanded surgical triplet and that using them to rebalance long-tail events and drive downstream understanding (segmentation, triplet recognition, 3D reconstruction) yields action-specific gains. Conditioned futures therefore complement conventional long-tail sampling. Code: https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis

</details>


### [51] [Your VLM Knows What to Inspect: Semantic Probe-Guided Adaptive Focusing for GUI Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31909)
*Ruixiao Shi,Fu Feng,Yucheng Xie,Jing Wang,Xin Geng*

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的SPARK框架，利用VLM的语义描述能力引导多视图定位，在ScreenSpot-Pro上显著提升GUI grounding精度。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI grounding需在语义上下文中解析细微视觉细节；额外视图虽能改善定位，但其价值取决于所暴露的证据与保留的上下文。作者观察到VLM即便坐标预测错误，仍能描述值得检查的视觉证据，故希望将这种语义引导转化为有针对性的视觉观察。

Method: SPARK（Semantic Probe-guided Adaptive Region seeing），training-free框架：探索探针描述相关上下文与区分性目标细节，验证探针识别评估新兴假设所需证据；利用空间注意力指导视图放置，上下文响应决定裁剪范围，观察历史鼓励互补检查；最终通过不确定性加权投票融合预测。

Abstract: GUI grounding requires resolving fine visual details within the context that gives them meaning. Additional views can improve localization, but their value depends on what evidence they expose and how much context they preserve. We explore a capability of vision-language models (VLMs): even when their coordinate predictions are incorrect, they can describe visual evidence worth inspecting. We introduce \textbf{SPARK}, \textit{\textbf{S}emantic \textbf{P}robe-guided \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{R}egion see\textbf{K}ing}, a training-free framework that turns this semantic guidance into targeted visual observations. Exploration probes describe relevant context and distinguishing target details, while verification probes identify evidence needed to assess emerging hypotheses. Their spatial attention guides view placement, contextual responses determine crop extent, and observation history encourages complementary inspection. The resulting predictions are combined through uncertainty-weighted voting. On ScreenSpot-Pro, SPARK improves grounding accuracy over single-view inference by 13.9, 25.2, and 16.1 percentage points with Qwen3-VL, Qwen2.5-VL, and UI-TARS, outperforming all compared test-time methods for each backbone. Consistent gains across four additional benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness across diverse interfaces and grounding tasks. These results establish semantic probing as an effective mechanism for turning a frozen VLM's understanding of what to inspect into more accurate GUI grounding.

</details>

*Emil Kielar,Pratik Chaudhari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的 Visual Thinking 框架，用迭代式主动感知回路结合 VLM 与 SAM 3，解决视觉基础模型对小目标、遮挡目标及文本描述不佳目标的恢复难题，在计数与定位任务上显著优于 SAM 3 且效率远超 Claude。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉基础模型（如 SAM 类）依赖单一文本提示，难以恢复小目标、被遮挡目标或文本描述不准确的目标；视觉语言模型虽能结合图像上下文给出更丰富的描述，但缺乏精确分割与定位能力。二者能力互补，亟需一种无需训练即可协同的方法。

Result: 在 CARPK、FSCD-147、PixMo-Count、OmniCount(Fruits) 上评估计数与定位：相比 SAM 3，FSC-147 上计数 MAE 降低约 18，CARPK 约降低 8；FSCD-147 与 CARPK 的框 AP 提升超过 12。固定分块或不分块时性能与极高推理强度的 Claude Opus 5.5 相当，单张桌面 GPU 每图约 5.91 秒，而 Claude API 每图约 46.53 秒。

Conclusion: VLM 的语义理解与 SAM 3 的精确分割通过主动感知循环互补协作，可在无需训练的情况下显著提升计数与定位性能，并以约 8 倍的推理速度优势达到与大型专有模型相当的精度。

Abstract: Vision foundation models can precisely segment objects based solely on a text prompt. However, they struggle to recover objects that are small, occluded or whose appearance is poorly captured by the original textual description. Vision language models can examine the image and its context, they can propose richer descriptions of the objects to be detected. But these models struggle with precise segmentation and localization. We introduce Visual Thinking, a training-free framework that combines a vision-language model with Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) through an iterative active perception loop. At each iteration, the VLM proposes short noun phrases using the image, candidate crops and history from past iterations. A controller ranks these phrases using embedding similarity between the original prompt and the proposal, an entropy-based verification priority and the novelty of the prompt. Next, SAM 3 uses prompts to detect objects in the image. We associate detections across iterations and update each object's confidence score using a weighted mean of scores obtained from SAM 3 with a larger weight for detections using narrower prompts. We supply confident detections as positive visual exemplars for SAM 3, and incorporate image tiling to recover small objects in cluttered images. We evaluate counting and localization on CARPK, FSCD-147, PixMo-Count, and OmniCount (Fruits). Compared with SAM 3, Visual Thinking reduces the counting mean absolute error (MAE) by about 18 on FSC-147 and about 8 on CARPK. It improves box average precision (AP) by more than 12 on FSCD-147 and CARPK. Visual Thinking, with fixed or no tiling, performs on par with Claude Opus 5.5 at extra-high reasoning effort, while running on single desktop GPU in about 5.91 seconds per image, compared to about 46.53 seconds per image for Claude through its API.

</details>


### [53] [PromptSMC: Enabling Particle Exploration in Flow Matching via LLM-Based Prompt Rejuvenation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31471)
*Wenyi Lian,Zheng Zhao,Thomas B. Schön*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PromptSMC，在推理阶段结合序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）与基于 LLM 的提示词"焕新"机制，实现无梯度、无需训练的文本到图像提示-图像对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散/流匹配模型在推理时存在提示-图像对齐不足的问题，现有奖励引导方法往往依赖额外噪声注入、模型微调或奖励梯度，代价高且不够通用，因此需要一个无需梯度、无需训练的原理性推理期对齐框架。

Method: 以序贯蒙特卡洛为框架，沿流匹配模型的扩散时间进行粒子探索与奖励引导的轨迹选择；核心是 LLM 驱动的提示词焕新：保留选中的隐状态，对复制出的粒子在语义保持约束下用预训练 LLM 动态改写提示词，产生新的条件速度场，使粒子从共享中间状态探索不同延续路径；再用奖励模型评估各粒子与原提示的对齐度，并通过重采样引导粒子；全程无额外噪声注入、无模型训练、无奖励梯度。

Result: 在多个基准与多种骨干模型上的实验和消融验证了该方法对文本到图像流匹配任务的有效性。

Conclusion: PromptSMC 将基于提示的探索与奖励引导采样相结合，作为即插即用的推理期方案可有效提升提示-图像对齐，且不增加训练与梯度开销。

Abstract: This paper is concerned with prompt-image alignment at inference time through exploration of generative trajectories and dynamical prompt rejuvenation. We leverage sequential Monte Carlo (SMC), to offer a gradient-free and principled framework for this purpose through reward-guided trajectory selection. More specifically, we introduce LLM-based prompt rejuvenation, allowing for efficient particle exploration in SMC samplers along the diffusion time in flow matching models. The proposed method, PromptSMC, retains the selected latent states and uses a pretrained LLM to dynamically revise the prompts of duplicated particles under semantic-preservation constraints. These revised prompts induce alternative conditional velocity fields, allowing particles to explore different continuations from a shared intermediate state. The method further uses a reward model to evaluate each particle's alignment with the original prompt, and the resulting scores guide particles through resampling. PromptSMC thus integrates prompt-based exploration with reward-guided sampling, achieving faithful prompt-image alignment without additional noise injection, model training, or reward gradients. Our experiments and ablation studies across multiple benchmarks and backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of the method for text-to-image flow matching. Code is available at https://github.com/shermanlian/PromptSMC.

</details>


### [54] [Open-OmniCoach: Evidence-Enhanced Trajectory Learning for Omni Video Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31891)
*Weisong Liu,Xiangtai Li,Haochen Wang,Haiquan Wen,Zhaoxiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全模态视频智能体需要学会可靠地定位、关联并纠正任务相关证据，但现有数据管线对"任务相关证据"的控制力有限、对上述能力的监督较弱。

Method: 1) 构建 OmniCoach-240K 数据集：248.2K 交互轨迹，含 230.7K 多跨度轨迹与 17.4K 反思轨迹，采用利用细粒度全模态证据与智能体自身错误的三阶段数据管线；2) 提出 Step-Level Evidence-Guided Policy Optimization (SEPO)，基于证据覆盖率提升与时间定位改进提供轮级（turn-level）信用分配。

Abstract: Training capable omni video agents requires more than diverse question-answer pairs: agents must learn to reliably find, connect, and correct task-relevant evidence in omni-setting. However, we argue that existing data pipelines provide limited control over task-relevant evidence and weak supervision for these capabilities. In this work, we present Open OmniCoach, a new framework for evidence-seeking omni video agents. It contains a high-quality dataset, OmniCoach-240K, and a new agentic reinforcement learning (RL) method, Step-Level Evidence-Guided Policy Optimization (SEPO). For the former, OmniCoach-240K comprises 248.2K interaction trajectories, including 230.7K multi-span trajectories and 17.4K reflection trajectories. We design a three-stage data pipeline by leveraging both fine-grained omni-evidence and the agent's own errors. Meanwhile, compared with other RL baselines, SEPO provides turn-level credit based on improvements in evidence coverage and temporal localization. Applying both trajectory data and the SEPO method, we obtain Open OmniAgent models. The resulting models outperform the baselines across multiple video and audio-visual understanding tasks by significant margins, demonstrating the effectiveness of the Open OmniCoach framework. In particular, Open OmniAgent-30B improves average accuracy over Qwen3-Omni by 6.3 percentage points across nine benchmarks, with gains of 12.2 and 13.3 points on LVOmniBench and LVBench, respectively.

</details>


### [55] [RePT: 3D Geometry Emerges from 2D Relational Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31601)
*Xize Duan,Binke Hou,Xingqiao Huang,Xinyuan Guan,Jiaxin Huang,Kaiyuan Hu,Zipeng Sun,Hong Kang,Meng Bi,Xue Liu,Yili Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 无需3D预测目标，仅通过跨视角2D点预测学习不同物理点之间的关系，即可使表征自发形成反映真实3D位移的几何组织。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间表征学习多依赖显式预测几何量，但学习到的表征内部物理几何如何组织仍不清楚；作者试图检验3D结构能否从2D观测间的关系学习中涌现。

Method: 提出RePT：通过跨视角2D点预测学习不同物理点之间的紧凑关系，构建"关系空间"，并分析其幅值、夹角与邻域结构是否对应物理3D位移；用线性读出、跨数据集迁移与对照实验（同点对应学习、加性关系、自适应场景上下文、点迁移精度）进行验证。

Result: 在16个场景上拟合的单一线性读出可零重拟合地预测39个留出场景的位移长度与角度（Pearson r=0.72与0.78）；ARKitScenes训练的模型在ScanNet++上保持强几何组织；异点关系预测显著优于匹配的同点对应学习；该组织依赖加性关系与自适应场景上下文，且更高的点迁移精度本身并不带来更强组织。

Conclusion: 3D几何不必作为显式预测目标，而可作为"关系化预测2D观测"训练所得表征的结构性质涌现，关系预测是通向空间智能所需表征的补充路径。

Abstract: Learning spatial representations often relies on explicitly predicting geometric quantities, but how physical geometry is organized within learned representations remains less understood. We ask whether 3D structure can emerge from learning relations across 2D observations, without 3D prediction targets. We introduce RePT, which learns compact relations between distinct physical points through cross-view 2D point prediction. The learned relation space develops a geometric organization in which magnitudes, angles, and neighborhoods reflect physical 3D displacement. A single linear readout fitted on 16 scenes recovers displacement length and angle on 39 held-out scenes without refitting (Pearson r = 0.72 and 0.78). The ARKitScenes-trained checkpoint also retains strong geometric organization on ScanNet++, showcasing generalizability. In controlled comparisons, distinct-point relational prediction consistently yields stronger geometric organization than matched same-point correspondence learning. This organization depends on additive relations and adaptive scene context, and higher point-transfer accuracy does not by itself produce stronger organization. More broadly, our results suggest that 3D geometry need not be an explicit prediction target and can instead emerge as a structural property of representations trained to relate 2D observations, pointing to relational prediction as a complementary route to learning the representations that spatial intelligence builds on.

</details>


### [56] [Spec$^2$R: Recovering Emergent Properties in Supervised Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31589)
*Adam Wróbel,Jacek Tabor,Bartosz Zieliński,Marcin Przewięźlikowski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过谱分析揭示监督式ViT与自监督式ViT表示质量差异的根源在于MLP层引入高频扰动，并提出轻量谱正则化方法Spec$^2$R以恢复物体对齐的patch表示与注意力图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督ViT常表现出涌现特性（物体对齐的patch表示与注意力图），而监督式ViT即便使用强数据增强也缺乏这些特性。理解这一差异的来源，对于解释并控制物体级结构至关重要。

Method: 对监督式与自监督式模型进行谱分析，定位关键差异：监督式ViT的MLP层向patch表示引入高频变化，破坏其空间组织。基于此，提出Spec$^2$R——一种对预训练监督式ViT的MLP层进行微调的轻量谱正则化方法。

Result: Spec$^2$R恢复了物体对齐的patch表示与注意力图，同时提升对抗鲁棒性，并保持有竞争力的分类精度。

Conclusion: 监督式ViT缺乏物体级结构的根源可归因于MLP层的高频扰动；通过在谱域对MLP层施加轻量正则化即可有效恢复该结构，并带来鲁棒性收益，为解释与控制ViT的物体级表示提供了可行途径。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved strong performance across computer vision tasks, but the quality of their learned representations differs drastically depending on the training paradigm. While self-supervised ViTs often demonstrate emergent properties, such as object-aligned patch representations and attention maps, supervised ViTs typically lack these properties, even when trained with strong data augmentations. Understanding the origin of this difference is important for explaining and controlling the object-level structure. To investigate it, we perform a spectral analysis of supervised and self-supervised models, and identify a key distinction: MLP layers in supervised ViTs introduce high-frequency variations into patch representations, disrupting their spatial organization. Motivated by this finding, we propose Spec$^2$R, a lightweight spectral regularization method that fine-tunes the MLP layers of pretrained supervised ViTs. Spec$^2$R recovers object-aligned patch representations and attention maps, while improving adversarial robustness and preserving competitive classification accuracy.

</details>


### [57] [Fast Anatomy-Aware Diffeomorphic Augmentation for Brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31524)
*Tonmoy Hossain,Alexandra G. Roberts,Mark Olchanyi,Jonathan Williams Ramirez,Stefan Brandstätter,Juan Eugenio Iglesias*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BrainAug 是一种无需群体影像数据的解剖感知数据增强框架：通过构建编码脑区空间邻近性与左右对称对应关系的解剖图，将其融入概率模型以采样相关区域体积变化，再转化为微分同胚形变，并结合对比度无关图像合成，生成解剖与外观独立变化、拓扑保持的训练图像，在八个脑 MRI 数据集上提升分割泛化与配准对齐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑 MRI 训练数据有限，尤其针对特定分辨率或对比度的监督任务难以获得大队列。传统随机非线性形变场虽简单，但无法刻画不同脑区形态变化之间的空间依赖关系，生成的变化缺乏解剖学合理性。

Method: 1）构建解剖图，编码脑区之间的空间邻近性与双侧（左右半球）对应关系；2）将该图结构关系嵌入概率模型，采样具有相关性的区域体积变化；3）把采样得到的体积变化转化为微分同胚变换，在大幅改变结构的同时保持解剖拓扑；4）结合对比度无关（contrast-agnostic）图像合成，使解剖形态与图像外观独立变化。

Result: 在八个脑 MRI 数据集上的评估显示：面对多样人群时分割泛化能力更强；配准实验中在存在显著形态差异的情况下对齐效果改善。

Conclusion: 将解剖先验（区域间空间与对称关系）引入增强过程的概率建模，可在不依赖群体影像数据的前提下生成解剖协调、拓扑保持的多样化样本，是提升脑 MRI 分割与配准模型跨人群泛化性的有效途径。

Abstract: Data augmentation is essential for training deep learning models that are generalizable, particularly when training data are limited. In brain MRI, augmentation methods that synthesize anatomically diverse images without relying on large cohorts are particularly attractive, especially when training supervised models for scans with a specific resolution or MRI contrast. While conventional random nonlinear fields offer a simple means of achieving such diversity, they fail to capture the underlying spatial dependencies among morphological changes across brain regions. To address this limitation, we introduce BrainAug, an anatomy-aware augmentation framework that generates diverse, anatomically coordinated deformations without relying on population imaging data. BrainAug constructs an anatomical graph encoding spatial proximity and bilateral correspondence between brain regions, then incorporates these relationships into a probabilistic model designed to sample correlated regional volume changes. These sampled variations are translated into diffeomorphic transformations, enabling substantial structural changes while preserving anatomical topology. Combined with contrast-agnostic image synthesis, BrainAug generates training images with independently varying anatomy and appearance. Evaluations across eight brain MRI datasets demonstrate stronger segmentation generalization across diverse populations, while registration experiments show improved alignment under substantial morphological differences.

</details>


### [58] [Your Codec, Your Generator: Idempotent Generative Compression without Retraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31520)
*Raz Haim,Assaf Shocher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需重训的伪可逆图像压缩框架，通过非线性右逆与接收端潜变量搜索实现循环一致重压缩，并允许解码端独立选择生成先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预训练编解码器难以在已编码图像上反复重压缩并保持一致性，且解码端先验与编解码器耦合，无法在不解码重编的前提下更换更强的生成模型。

Result: 首次解码质量变化小；在50次重压缩中保持质量优于训练式一致性编解码器，8比特存储条件下亦然；解码端可控制感知-失真权衡。

Conclusion: 将编解码器与其先验解耦，使接收端无需重训或重编码即可采用未来生成器，实现可适配、循环一致且先验可替换的图像压缩。

Abstract: We introduce an image compression framework with three properties: (i) adaptation of pretrained codecs without retraining or fine-tuning, (ii) cycle-consistent recompression, even of already-encoded images, and (iii) decoding with independently chosen generative priors. We wrap the frozen encoder with non-learned operations so that every continuous latent has a preimage, yielding a surjective pseudo-invertible neural network. A nonlinear right inverse built from the pretrained decoder satisfies $E'(D'(E'(x)))=E'(x)$. To extend consistency to quantized bitstreams, the receiver searches for a continuous latent that reproduces both the transmitted main symbols and entropy side information. A successful search and an exact correction preserve both streams under deterministic coding; the final reconstruction is checked through the actual coding path. The encoder's pseudo-inverse enables a nonlinear counterpart of back-projection. In the linear case, back-projection has the closed-form solution $x'=x+A^\dagger(y-Ax)$, giving the closest reconstruction to $x$ satisfying $Ax'=y$. Our nonlinear formulation enforces the transmitted code on proposals from an independently chosen generative model. Adjusting the starting noise controls the prior's influence without changing that code. Experiments show small first-pass quality changes, higher retained quality than trained consistency codecs over 50 recompressions, also under 8-bit storage, and decoder-side control of the perception-distortion trade-off. Decoupling the codec from its prior lets the receiver adopt future generators without retraining or re-encoding.

</details>


### [59] [InitFree-SfM: When Initialization-Free Bundle Adjustment meets Learned Structure-from-Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31516)
*Simon Weber,Mateo de Mayo,Je Hyeong Hong,Carl Olsson,Daniel Cremers,Ronald Clark*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 InitFree-SfM 流水线，将学习到的对应、度量深度、深度一致轨迹构建与联合度量优化结合，并提出深度增强的 dOSE 目标，显著提升无初始化 BA 的实际三维重建精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无初始化 BA（InitFree BA）需在无全局初始估计下联合恢复位姿与结构，难度大。现有方法优化代理的 OSE 目标，但低目标值不等于准确重建，存在"优化—重建"鸿沟，且在现代 SfM 基准上重建精度差。

Method: 构建完整流水线 InitFree-SfM：学习对应 + 度量深度 + 深度一致轨迹构建 + 联合度量精化；并提出 dOSE（深度增强 OSE），在 OSE 方向约束基础上沿视射线约束路标位置。

Result: 显著优于现有 InitFree BA 方法，与成熟 SfM 流水线精度相当，在低重叠图像集上亦有效；实验显示几何约束是准确重建的核心，OSE 优化带来进一步增益。

Conclusion: 研究挑战了以往 InitFree BA 对代理目标的过度强调，指出度量深度与几何约束在实际可行性中的关键作用，为无初始化 SfM 提供了新的有效范式。

Abstract: Initialization-free bundle adjustment (InitFree BA) aims to jointly recover camera poses and scene structure without requiring an initial global estimate. It is a very challenging problem, especially compared to traditional BA where a good estimation is assumed. While recent methods optimize surrogate Object Space Error (OSE) objectives from random initialization, a low objective value does not necessarily yield an accurate reconstruction, revealing a gap between optimization and reconstruction. We show that existing InitFree BA pipelines struggle to produce accurate 3D reconstructions on modern SfM benchmarks, and demonstrate that incorporating learned metric depth substantially improves their practical feasibility. We introduce InitFree-SfM, a complete initialization-free SfM pipeline combining learned correspondences, metric depth, depth-consistent track construction, and joint metric refinement. Within this framework, we propose a simple depth-augmented OSE (dOSE), which complements the directional constraints of OSE by constraining landmark positions along their viewing rays. Our approach substantially outperforms existing InitFree BA methods and achieves competitive accuracy with established SfM pipelines, including on challenging low-overlap image collections. Importantly, our analysis challenges the prevailing emphasis on surrogate objectives in previous InitFree BA research, revealing that geometric constraints play a central role in accurate reconstruction, while OSE-based optimization provides further improvements.

</details>


### [60] [GDD: A Remote Sensing Image Deepfake Detection and Manipulation Localization Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31487)
*Jacob Arndt,Philipe Dias,Debvrat Varshney,Sudarshan Srinivasan,Dalton Lunga*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出地理空间深度伪造数据集GDD，用于遥感领域深度伪造检测与篡改定位，并建立OOD评测协议，说明高质量小规模数据集优于高体量未筛选基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感图像真实性验证需求迫切，但生成式AI使合成遥感数据愈发逼真；现有RS深度伪造基准追求数据体量而忽视视觉真实性与多样性，且缺乏严格的OOD测试协议，难以评估真实场景鲁棒性。

Method: 构建GDD基准，覆盖多种现代生成模型与真实图像源，包含扩散修复、拼接与复制-移动三类篡改；建立由未见真实图像源与未见生成模型组成的OOD评测协议；在数据集内与跨数据集两种设定下评测5个深度伪造检测器和2个定位模型。

Result: 在高体量未筛选基准上训练的检测器过拟合数据集特定伪影；在GDD上训练虽规模紧凑，却获得更优的跨数据集泛化能力；同时揭示当前SOTA方法的关键失效模式。

Conclusion: GDD及其评测协议为该安全关键领域的检测与定位模型开发及压力测试建立了高质量标准，数据集已公开。

Abstract: Verifying image authenticity is a critical need for a variety of applications and decision-making in the remote sensing (RS) domain, yet it is becoming more challenging as advancements in generative AI enable producing increasingly realistic synthetic overhead data. However, existing RS deepfake benchmarks prioritize sheer volume at the expense of visual realism and diversity, while also lacking rigorous out-of-distribution (OOD) testing protocols to evaluate real-world robustness. To address this, we introduce the Geospatial Deepfakes Dataset (GDD), a benchmark for RS deepfake detection and manipulation localization. Rather than relying on uncurated, redundant synthetic generation, GDD comprises images across diverse modern generative models and real image sources, alongside manipulations from diffusion inpainting, splicing, and copy-move operations. Crucially, GDD establishes an OOD evaluation protocol for deepfake detection comprising unseen real image sources and generative models. We benchmark five deepfake detectors and two localization models across intra- and cross-dataset regimes and reveal that detectors trained on high-volume, uncurated benchmarks overfit to dataset-specific artifacts, whereas training on GDD yields superior cross-dataset generalization despite its compact scale. This benchmarking also exposes critical failure modes in current state-of-the-art methods. Combined, GDD and its evaluation protocol establish a high-quality standard for developing and stress-testing detection and localization models in this safety-critical RS domain. The dataset is publicly available.

</details>


### [61] [Enhancing Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting with Feed-Forward Priors via Spectral Fusion and Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31428)
*Weikai Lin,Jun Dai,Sheng Zhao,Junjie Zhao,Yuhao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出即插即用的谱域融合方法：利用预训练前馈NVS先验增强稀疏视角高斯模型，按频率互补融合后蒸馏回高斯，在不牺牲渲染速度的前提下提升重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏训练视角下的高斯泼溅在近视角渲染质量高，但在训练集欠采样的远区域重建质量下降；前馈NVS模型虽能凭强先验从差异大的视角重采样，却渲染耗时十倍以上且对域外场景产生高频伪影。二者需要互补利用。

Method: 观察到二者在频域互补：先验在低频更准确，高斯在高频更准确；先验相对高斯的可靠性与图像频率成反比，故最优融合权重是一阶低通滤波器（仅一个可拟合参数）。据此智能融合两者各自可靠的部分，生成融合图像作为教师，蒸馏回高斯，并与输入视角监督平衡；渲染时去除慢速前馈模型。

Result: 提升多种稀疏视角高斯方法的质量且不牺牲渲染速度；分析结论在不同先验模型上均成立。

Conclusion: 频域互补视角为稀疏视角高斯与前馈NVS先验的融合提供了一参数化的最优权重方案，通过教师蒸馏实现即插即用的质量增强，兼具速度与泛化性。

Abstract: Gaussian splatting from sparse training views renders high-quality images near training views, but reconstruction quality degrades at distant regions, which are undersampled by the training set. Feed-forward novel view synthesis (NVS) models use strong learned priors to resample the scene from substantially different viewpoints, but they take more than ten times as long to render and produce high-frequency artifacts on out-of-domain scenes. We propose a plug-and-play method that enhances an existing sparse-view Gaussian model with a pretrained feed-forward NVS model. We observe that the two are complementary in the frequency domain: the prior is more accurate at low frequencies, and the Gaussians at high frequencies. The reliability of the prior relative to the Gaussians is inversely proportional to the image frequency, so the optimal fusion weight is a first-order low-pass filter with one parameter that can be fitted. Our key idea is then to intelligently fuse the reliable part of each of the two methods. To remove the slow feed-forward model at render time, we use these fused images as teachers and distill them back into Gaussians, balanced with supervision from input views. Our method improves the quality of various sparse-view Gaussian methods without sacrificing rendering speed, and our analysis works on different prior models. Project page: https://linwk20.github.io/spectral-fusion-gs/

</details>


### [62] [Don't Miss the Forest for the Trees: Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition with Hyperbolic Hierarchical Semantic Prototypes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31877)
*Zixiao Jin,Siyu Zhu,Feng Ding,Haisheng Fu,Xin Dong,Shankai Chen,Jie Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出双曲层级语义原型框架H²SP，在Lorentz模型中为动作分类学每个节点合成层级感知原型，将叶节点运动对齐传播至祖先概念，实现层级概念预测与跨分类学迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本骨架动作识别几乎只在平坦叶标签上评估，无法判断表示是否真正接地于包含该动作的上位概念；实验发现强叶对齐并不迁移到祖先概念（8种平坦方法叶Top-1达57.86–73.29%，而全路径准确率仅6.15–31.21%）。

Method: 1) 在双曲空间Lorentz模型中表示动作分类学所有节点，通过单一树级门控下的递归父子测地线插值合成层级感知原型，而非每节点学习自由向量；2) 在已见类别上做切空间语义与分布对齐，将叶原型锚定于骨架运动；3) 采用软蕴含锥正则项，鼓励有向父子包含关系，把运动接地传播到祖先概念。

Result: 在四个NTU RGB+D划分上，独立解码与级联解码的平均全路径准确率均为最优，叶Top-1为72.40%（可比水平）；迁移到替代分类学后，每种划分与解码模式下均优于平坦基线和同树欧氏对照。

Conclusion: 叶级对齐不能代表层级概念理解；显式双曲层级原型加蕴含锥正则可将运动接地传播至上位概念，且概念级对应关系可泛化到训练分类学之外的替代分类学。

Abstract: Zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition is evaluated almost exclusively on flat leaf labels, which leaves open whether a representation also grounds the broader concepts that contain an action in skeleton motion. We find that strong leaf alignment does not carry over to them: when ancestor concepts are scored directly under independent decoding, eight flat methods with 57.86-73.29% mean leaf Top-1 reach only 6.15-31.21% mean full-path accuracy across four NTU RGB+D splits. We propose the Hyperbolic Hierarchical Semantic Prototype ($H^2SP$) framework, which represents every node of an action taxonomy in the Lorentz model of hyperbolic space. First, instead of learning a free vector per node, $H^2SP$ synthesizes hierarchy-aware prototypes by recursive parent-child geodesic interpolation under a single tree-wide gate. Second, tangent-space semantic and distributional alignment on seen classes anchor the leaf prototypes in skeleton motion. Third, a soft entailment-cone regularizer encourages directional parent-child inclusion, propagating this motion grounding to ancestor concepts. We evaluate hierarchical concept prediction under independent and cascade decoding, and transfer to an alternative taxonomy without retraining. Across the four splits, $H^2SP$ attains the best mean independent and cascade full-path accuracy among the evaluated methods, at a comparable leaf Top-1 of 72.40%. Transferred to the alternative taxonomy, it outperforms both flat baselines and the same-tree Euclidean control across every split and decoding mode, indicating that its concept-level correspondence extends beyond the training taxonomy.

</details>


### [63] [VISOR: A Vision-Language Selector for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31780)
*Seunghan Lee,Jun Seo,Junhyeok Kang,Jaehoon Lee,Sangjun Han,Sungdong Yoo,Minjae Kim,Tae Yoon Lim,Dongwan Kang,Hwanil Choi,Soonyoung Lee,Wonbin Ahn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VISOR框架：用无文本随机预测器采样多条候选未来，再由视觉-语言模型（VLM）将候选绘成一张图表图像并结合文本选出单一最合适轨迹，避免均值化导致"平缓线"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型（TSFM）输出分布却只用中位数/均值作点预测，把多样未来压平成"calm line"；多模态TS预测依赖TS-语言对齐，弱于视觉-语言对齐。故需保留候选多样性并以更强对齐能力做选择。

Method: VISOR含两部分：1) text-free随机预测器采样多样候选未来；2) VLM选择器将全部候选渲染为单张图表图像，依文本指令选出其一。为防过平滑，选择器用shape-aware目标训练，同时评估逐点误差与路径形状。

Result: 在覆盖10个数据集的3个基准上，VISOR在点误差与波动率误差上均取得最佳平均排名，优于TSFM与多模态TS预测模型。

Conclusion: 以"选择而非平均"的多模态范式，借助视觉-语言对齐可有效缓解分布塌缩并提升点与波动率预测；代码已开源。

Abstract: Recent time-series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast a distribution over futures, and multimodal time-series (TS) forecasting further exploits other modalities to improve forecasting accuracy. However, existing works have two limitations: 1) TSFMs reduce the predictive distribution to its median or mean, flattening diverse futures into a calm line, and 2) multimodal TS forecasting models incorporate text into the forecaster through TS-language alignment, which is substantially weaker than vision-language alignment. To address these limitations, we propose the VIsion-language SelectOR (VISOR), a multimodal TS forecasting framework that selects one plausible future instead of averaging across candidates, leveraging the alignment capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) to select the most suitable candidate based on textual information. VISOR consists of two components: 1) a text-free stochastic predictor that samples diverse candidate futures, and 2) a VLM selector that reads the candidates as a single chart image and selects one based on the text. To avoid overly calm forecasting paths, we train the selector with a shape-aware target that evaluates each candidate based on both point-wise error and path shape. Across three benchmarks covering ten datasets, VISOR achieves the best average ranking in both point and volatility errors compared with TSFMs and multimodal TS forecasting models. Code: https://github.com/seunghan96/VISOR.

</details>


### [64] [ReCAP: Sequential Concept Acquisition with Guarantees under Imperfect Concept Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31776)
*Md Nahiduzzaman,Steven Korevaar,Alireza Bab-Hadiashar,Ruwan Tennakoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReCAP 提出一种以“可靠概念获取”为核心的序贯诊断框架，把概念预测器的错误与弃答显式纳入推理，用标签判别目标替代条件信息增益，并配合弃答感知获取与诊断保持剪枝，从而用更少概念获得更可信、更准确的诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于概念的序贯诊断方法默认预测概念是正确的，导致“正确诊断可能建立在错误证据之上”，解释虽人类可读却不可信；同时需要在有限预算下用尽可能少的概念支撑诊断。

Method: 提出 ReCAP：在概念预测器所报告的结果（含错误与弃答）之上进行推理；以“标签判别目标”替代条件信息增益，用于区分需要不同诊断的病例；证明该目标具自适应单调性与自适应子模性，从而为固定预算下的贪心获取给出 (1-1/e) 近似保证，并在学习估计下保证有界退化；结合弃答感知获取与诊断保持剪枝以缩短并保障解释。

Result: 在五个医学影像数据集上，相对最强基线，ReCAP 将“至少由一个错误预测概念支撑的正确诊断”占比从 27.1% 降至 9.6%，同时所用概念数不足其一半，且诊断准确率更高。

Conclusion: 将概念预测的不确定性（错误与弃答）纳入序贯获取，并用具子模性保证的标签判别目标替代信息增益，可在更短解释下显著提升诊断的证据可靠性，兼顾可解释性与准确性。

Abstract: Sequential concept acquisition enables interpretable diagnosis from a compact set of human-understandable findings. Such explanations are useful only if clinicians can trust them, yet most existing methods treat predicted concepts as correct, so a correct diagnosis can rest on incorrectly predicted evidence. We propose Reliable Concept Acquisition with Pruning (ReCAP), which reasons over what the concept predictor reports, including errors and abstentions, and replaces conditional information gain with a label-discriminating objective that separates cases requiring different diagnoses. We prove this objective adaptively monotone and adaptively submodular, yielding a (1-1/e) guarantee for greedy fixed-budget acquisition that degrades boundedly under learned estimates, and combine it with abstention-aware acquisition and diagnosis-preserving pruning to keep explanations short and reliable. Across five medical imaging datasets, ReCAP reduces the share of correct diagnoses supported by at least one incorrectly predicted concept from 27.1% to 9.6% relative to the strongest baseline, while using fewer than half as many concepts and achieving higher diagnostic accuracy.

</details>


### [65] [Dreamcatcher: Remembering What Surprises a World Model in Video Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31765)
*Jinxi He,Ce Zhang,Wenhe Liu,Jianshu Zhang,Katia P. Sycara,Yaqi Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Dreamcatcher：训练免调、利用冻结的视频世界模型预测误差（surprisal）驱动流式视频问答的在线视觉记忆构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直播/流式视频越来越长，重复编码与处理完整历史代价高昂；未来问题未知，需在一次前向中构建视觉记忆。现有方法仅保留与早期帧差异大的 token 或匹配预先固定的代理查询，因缺乏对世界动态建模，难以区分"细微的意外细节"与"预期内的变化"。

Method: 基于独立预训练、参数冻结的视频世界模型：以近期历史为条件预测后续特征，将归一化预测误差转化为时间与空间surprisal信号，指导在线分段与冻结 Video-LLM 原生视觉 token 的保留；预算随段龄衰减，在"意外细节"与"全局覆盖"间平衡。查询时设证据门控（evidence gate）：从相似度候选段中，仅当 Video-LLM 判断该段相对当前视野能增加证据时才纳入。

Result: 在 3 个流式与 3 个离线长视频基准上评估。OVO-Bench 上，对四种冻结 Video-LLM 均取得所比较训练免调方法中最高总体准确率，Qwen3.8-27B 达 78.9%；三个 Qwen Video-LLM 下，答案生成的平均输入 token 较各自基座模型（1 fps）减少逾 80%。

Conclusion: 预测性 surprisal 可作为无需训练的通用在线记忆信号，兼顾细节敏感性与覆盖度，在提升流式长视频问答准确率的同时显著压缩 token 开销。

Abstract: As live video streams grow longer, repeatedly encoding and processing their full histories becomes increasingly costly. Answering questions as they arrive therefore calls for visual memory built in one pass before future questions are known. Existing methods mainly keep tokens that differ from earlier ones or match surrogate queries fixed in advance. Without modeling world dynamics, these criteria struggle to tell subtle surprising details from expected change. We introduce Dreamcatcher, a training-free framework and, to our knowledge, the first to use predictive signals from an independently pretrained, frozen video world model for online memory formation in streaming video question answering. Conditioned on recent history, the world model predicts incoming features using learned world priors. Its normalized prediction errors yield temporal and spatial surprisal signals that guide online segmentation and the retention of a frozen Video-LLM's native visual tokens, balancing surprising details with broad visual coverage under budgets that decay with segment age. At query time, an evidence gate admits a segment from a similarity-based shortlist only when the Video-LLM judges that it adds evidence for the question beyond the current view. We evaluate Dreamcatcher on three streaming and three offline long-video benchmarks. On OVO-Bench, Dreamcatcher achieves the highest overall accuracy among the compared training-free methods for each of four frozen Video-LLMs, reaching 78.9% with Qwen3.8-27B. With the three Qwen Video-LLMs, it also reduces average input tokens for answer generation by more than 80% relative to their base models at 1 fps.

</details>


### [66] [NOBODY Was There: Bridging the Human-VLM Gap in Unwarranted Person Attribution Bias](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31714)
*Parsa Madinei,Ziqi Wen,Miguel Eckstein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发现视觉语言模型（VLM）存在"无依据人物归因偏差"——在没有人物的图像中过度推断出人物，并提出NOBODY偏好数据集，通过DPO对齐显著缓解该偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像描述不仅需要识别可见内容，还需决定哪些内容应当被推断。人类与VLM在此推断倾向上存在系统性差距：VLM倾向于将可见的动作或事件归因于图像中并不存在的人物，导致幻觉式人物描述。

Method: 将上述现象定义为"无依据人物归因偏差"（unwarranted person attribution bias）；在25个SOTA VLM上量化该偏差；通过偏好研究验证人类与VLM均偏好不进行此类归因的描述；构建偏好数据集NOBODY，并采用直接偏好优化（DPO）对开源VLM进行对齐；同时提出NOBODY-Bench评测基准。并与9个现有公开偏好数据集作对比。

Result: 在无人场景中，25个SOTA VLM生成的描述提及人物的频率是人类撰写描述的4倍；偏好研究表明人类与VLM均更偏好避免此类归因的描述；经NOBODY对齐后，模型在人物归因上与人类描述的一致率达到或超过人际一致率，而9个现有公开偏好数据集几乎未改变该行为；人类评审对被对齐模型描述有显著更高偏好。

Conclusion: 无依据人物归因偏差是VLM中普遍且可量化的系统性问题，现有通用偏好数据集难以纠正；针对性的偏好数据（NOBODY）配合DPO可有效对齐模型行为至人类水平，并发布NOBODY-Bench以支持后续评测。

Abstract: Describing an image requires not only recognizing what is visible but deciding what should be inferred. We investigate a systematic gap between humans and VLMs in their tendency to attribute visible actions or events to people who are not present in an image. We term this behavior unwarranted person attribution bias and find that, across 25 SOTA VLMs, captions of person-absent scenes mention a person four times as often as human-written captions of the same images. Through a preference study, we further show that both humans and VLMs prefer captions that avoid such attributions. Motivated by this, we introduce NOBODY, a preference dataset designed to bridge the gap between humans and VLMs in unwarranted person attribution. Through direct preference optimization (DPO), we align open VLMs on NOBODY and show that their agreement with human captions on person attribution reaches or exceeds inter-human agreement, whereas nine existing public preference datasets leave this behavior largely unchanged. Furthermore, we show that human judges preferred the aligned VLM captions significantly more than those of the baseline model. Alongside NOBODY, we release NOBODY-Bench, which evaluates VLMs for unwarranted person attribution bias and their alignment against human captions and preference. Project page: https://pmadinei.github.io/NOBODY/

</details>


### [67] [E-Waste-Bench: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Visual Triage of Data-Center Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31703)
*Nader Lobandi,Mohammad Mehdi Hosseini,Lombe Chileshe,Mohammad Mahoor*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 E-Waste-Bench：328K 张电子废弃物照片基准（24 类，标注类别、粒度、成色与印刷文字），并揭示公开数据集缺陷与近重复泄漏问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 退役数据中心硬件的分拣需区分外观相似部件、判断损伤/遮挡下的成色并读取印刷件号，但现有九个公开电子废弃物数据集以消费设备为主（仅10%标注为数据中心部件）、不标注成色与文字，且含42%精确或增强重复。

Method: 构建 328K 图像数据集（源自762K去重图像），来自既有集合与网络；采用基于配方的爬虫与基于开放权重视觉语言模型的智能体协同采集，智能体审核新来源、解析难解析站点，二者均向欠代表类别倾斜；训练标签由模型生成，按近重复分组划分数据集；近万张测试集由人工标注。

Result: 在基准上评测分类、成色、检测、文字感知与跨数据集迁移；ConvNeXt-T 在该测试集达 64.3% top-1，仅用公开集合为 31.5%；近重复泄漏在模型标签下虚增 3.0 点，人工标签下不足 0.1 点；市场/拍卖照片上准确率降至 42.1%。

Conclusion: 模型标注基准必须采用分组划分以避免近重复泄漏；E-Waste-Bench 显著提升性能并暴露真实部署场景（退役硬件流出）的域差距，数据与代码将公开。

Abstract: Retired data-center hardware can often be refurbished or resold, but triage demands more than object categories. A model must tell visually similar parts apart, judge condition under damage and occlusion, and read the printed part number. We audit nine public e-waste collections. They cover mostly consumer devices (only 10% of images are labeled as a data-center part), label neither condition nor printed text, and contain 42% exact or augmented duplicates. We introduce E-Waste-Bench, 328K photographs drawn from 762K deduplicated images and labeled for class (24 classes), granularity, condition and printed text. Images come from those collections and the web, where a recipe-based crawler works beside an agent built on an open-weight vision-language model. The agent vets new sources and reads sites the crawler cannot parse, and both are steered toward under-represented classes. Training labels are model-made, splits follow near-duplicate groups, and human annotators label a test set of nearly 10,000 images. We benchmark classification, condition, detection, text perception and cross-dataset transfer. On this test set, a ConvNeXt-T trained on E-Waste-Bench reaches 64.3% top-1, against 31.5% with the public collections alone. Near-duplicate leakage inflates top-1 by 3.0 points under model-made test labels but by less than 0.1 under human labels, so model-labeled benchmarks need group splits. Accuracy falls to 42.1% on marketplace and auction photographs, the closest proxy for hardware leaving service. Data and code will be released.

</details>


### [68] [GeoMVGen: Joint Appearance-Geometry Modeling for Multi-View Video Generation in Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31689)
*Qiaoqiao Jia,Guile Wu,Dongfeng Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GeoMVGen，基于视频扩散Transformer联合生成多视角RGB与点图视频，实现机器人操作下的外观-几何一致多视角生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作需预测交互的时序演化，涵盖外观与几何；多相机下需跨视角一致的3D场景且支持动作/相机可控生成。现有视频模型缺乏显式几何建模，几何感知与多视角生成方法在多视角下难以同时保证时序一致的外观与几何。

Method: 以视频扩散Transformer为骨干，采用模态专属适配模块分别建模外观与几何，并通过跨模态残差连接交换信息；引入跨视角投影机制与互补几何监督（点图一致性+几何基础模型引导的特征对齐）。

Result: 在包含仿真与真实机器人操作场景的4D视频生成数据集上，GeoMVGen在视频质量、几何精度和跨视角一致性上优于SOTA方法。

Conclusion: 联合外观-几何建模结合跨视角投影与互补监督，可有效生成时序演化且几何一致的多视角观测，为机器人操作预测提供可行框架。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation requires predicting how robot-object interactions evolve over time, encompassing both visual appearance and scene geometry. In multi-camera settings, such predictions need to capture the evolving 3D scene consistently across viewpoints, while supporting controllable generation under different robot actions and camera configurations. Existing video generation models provide strong priors for visual appearance and motion but typically lack explicit geometric modeling. Meanwhile, recent advances in geometry-aware and multi-view generation have explored joint appearance-geometry modeling and cross-view consistency, yet generating temporally coherent appearance and geometry across multiple viewpoints under robotic manipulation conditions remains challenging. In this work, we propose GeoMVGen, a framework for joint multi-view RGB and pointmap video generation in robotic manipulation. Built on a video diffusion transformer, our framework employs modality-specific adaptation modules to capture the distinct characteristics of appearance and geometry, while using cross-modal residual connections to facilitate information exchange between the two modalities. To establish geometric correspondences across viewpoints, we further introduce a cross-view projection mechanism with complementary geometric supervisions, combining pointmap consistency with geometry foundation model-guided feature alignment. These designs enable controllable generation of temporally evolving multi-view observations with coherent appearance and geometrically consistent scene structures. Extensive experiments on 4D video generation dataset comprising simulated and real-world robotic manipulation scenarios demonstrate that GeoMVGen outperforms state-of-the-art methods in video quality, geometric accuracy, and cross-view consistency.

</details>


### [69] [Medical Image Segmentation Is Now Just Another Coding Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31673)
*Shuheng Cao,Ruiqi Chen,Qizhen Lan,Edward Wang,Xiyun Hu,Yilei Wang,Juqy Chen,Weilin Huang,Anhong Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 仅凭任务描述、标注数据和CPU，四种现成编程智能体在数小时内为4种模态13项任务的医学图像分割自主构建分割器；2D任务上最佳程序达GPU训练nnU-Net Dice的99%，并可通过自检改进，但缺乏无参考质量信号（“质量盲点”）制约进一步提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像分割长期依赖专家、专用架构和nnU-Net等框架，本文探究：在无框架、无预训练权重、无人工介入、仅有CPU的条件下，通用编程智能体能否直接“编码”出可用的分割器，以及它们能在多大程度上自我改进分割结果。

Method: 使用四种现成编程智能体，输入仅为任务描述与标注数据，在CPU上从头构建并迭代修订分割程序，覆盖4种成像模态、13项任务（含9项2D任务）；在不见案例上通过查看自身预测的可视化渲染进行无参考自检；并设置“被告知真实Dice”的对照条件，比较视觉检查、增加迭代轮次、智能体自训练质量估计器等不同反馈来源的效果。

Result: 数小时内完成13项任务；9项2D任务最佳程序Dice达GPU训练nnU-Net的99%；仅凭预测渲染自检即使最差十分之一案例Dice提升0.09、HD95降低近1/4；告知真实Dice后，14对匹配实验中全部提升，失败掩膜挽救率由30%升至85%，平均超过GPU训练nnU-Net（源于生成更优掩膜而非仅做挑选）。视觉检查、更多轮次与自训练质量估计器均未能提供同等增益。

Conclusion: 构建与修复分割器的能力已由通用编程智能体自发涌现，瓶颈在于缺乏可被智能体调用的无参考质量估计信号（“质量盲点”）；未来突破方向不在新的分割模型，而在无参考质量评估。

Abstract: For decades, every new medical image segmentation task has needed an expert, a dedicated architecture, and a framework such as nnU-Net. This is no longer the case: medical image segmentation is now just another coding task. Given only a task description, labeled data, and a CPU (with no segmentation framework, no pretrained weights, and no human in the loop), four off-the-shelf coding agents built segmenters for 13 tasks across four imaging modalities within hours, an ability that has emerged rather than been built. On the nine 2D tasks, their best programs reach 99% of the Dice of a GPU-trained nnU-Net. Like any code, a segmenter improves by being revised and checked, so we ask how far the same agents can improve their own segmentations and what unlocks further gains. On unseen cases there is no reference, so the agents inspect renderings of their own predictions: this alone lifts the worst tenth of cases by 0.09 Dice and cuts boundary error (HD95) by almost a quarter. Far more is within reach. Told the true Dice of each attempt, the same agents improve in all 14 matched pairs, rescue 85% of failed masks instead of 30%, and surpass the GPU-trained nnU-Net on average, by producing better masks rather than by choosing among them. What unlocks these gains is a quality signal, which neither visual inspection, nor more rounds, nor a quality estimator trained by the agents themselves yet supplies: we call this the quality blind spot. The ability to build and to repair is already present; the next advance will come not from another segmentation model, but from reference-free quality estimation that coding agents can call.

</details>


### [70] [Let The Pixels Through: Rethinking Long Skip Connections for Scalable Pixel Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32151)
*Jiachen Lei,Jiahong Wu,XiangXiang Chu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种简洁的像素扩散Transformer（PiT），通过非对称长跳连与adaGLU改进U-Net式跳连，实现从零训练的平滑扩展，在ImageNet-256/512上分别达到1.62/1.70 FID，并原生支持文本到图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素扩散模型训练不够简便，依赖经验式训练配方与架构设计，且对超参数敏感；作者希望从文献中的像素原生设计出发，通过改进跳连机制获得强去噪器。

Method: 作者重新审视U-Net的长跳连：发现其优化收益并非去噪收益的必要来源；且跳连与主干特征的常规线性组合难以适应不同噪声水平。据此提出两点核心修改：(1) 非对称长跳连，将细粒度信息从输入嵌入传递到解码层；(2) 在解码层引入adaGLU（类SwiGLU的MLP模块），在嵌入信息加至主分支前自适应过滤。最终得到简洁的像素扩散Transformer架构。

Result: 从零训练时，模型从小规模基线平滑扩展至1.6B参数，在ImageNet-256和ImageNet-512上分别取得1.62和1.70 FID；原生支持文本、图像等多模态输入，在文本到图像生成上具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过重新审视并改进跳连与特征融合方式，可构建结构简洁、易于训练且可平滑扩展的像素扩散Transformer，兼具高质量生成与多模态原生支持能力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Training pixel diffusion models remains less straightforward, owing to the ad hoc training recipes and architecture designs, along with the sensitivity to hyper-parameter choices. We show that strong denoisers can be built by refining existing pixel-native designs from the literature. Specifically, we revisit the long skip connection in U-Net and find that the optimization benefit commonly attributed to it is not necessary for its denoising benefit. We further find that the conventional linear combination of features from the skip and main backbone is inadequate for regimes of various noise levels. Motivated by these observations, we introduce two core modifications. First, we adopt asymmetric long skips, which propagate fine-grained information from input embeddings to decoder layers. Second, we introduce adaGLU, a SwiGLU-like MLP block, in decoder layers to adaptively filter information from the embeddings before being added to main-branch features. The above designs give a simple pixel diffusion transformer architecture. When trained from scratch, it scales smoothly from small-scale baselines up to 1.6B parameters, achieving 1.62 and 1.70 FID on ImageNet-256 and -512, respectively. Besides, it natively supports multimodal inputs, such as text and images, yielding competitive performance in text-to-image generation. We release our codes at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/PiT

</details>


### [71] [LiteSTAR: Low-Rank Channel Modulation for Temporally Consistent CVD Video Compensation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32140)
*Peiyang Lin,Sichen Lin,Yipeng Liao,Liqun Lin,Xu Wang,Tiesong Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量级时空自适应重着色框架 LiteSTAR，以可插拔的通道自适应解码器 LiCaD 在低秩状态空间做时序滤波，无需空间对齐即可抑制视频重着色闪烁，仅 0.05M 参数，并发布首个自我中心视角 CVD 视频基准 EgoCVDSet。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 色觉缺陷（CVD）人群规模庞大，实际重着色需在设备端持续运行；逐帧处理会产生颜色闪烁，而现有方法依赖像素/特征空间的跨帧对齐，计算开销大，难以满足轻量化与实时性需求。

Method: 观察到颜色闪烁与通道级响应的变化相关，且颜色敏感变化集中于低秩子空间；据此设计 LiCaD——在低秩状态空间中结合学习到的过程与观测不确定性进行时序滤波，再通过通道调制实现时序一致性，避免显式空间对齐；整体框架 LiteSTAR 叠加自适应分块路由（adaptive patch routing）以增强 CVD 用户的颜色区分度并抑制过度增强；同时构建 EgoCVDSet 自我中心视频基准。

Result: 定量与定性实验显示 LiteSTAR 以仅 0.05M 参数取得更优性能；LiCaD 在不同任务与网络架构上表现出较强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通道级低秩状态空间滤波可替代昂贵的跨帧对齐，实现轻量、时序一致的视频重着色；LiCaD 具备良好的即插即用通用性，EgoCVDSet 为该方向提供首个自我中心视频评测基准。

Abstract: Color Vision Deficiency (CVD) affects a large population worldwide, yet practical recoloring must run continuously on-device. Frame-wise video recoloring produces color flickering, while existing methods rely on costly cross-frame alignment in pixel or feature space. We observe that color flickering correlates with variations in channel-wise responses, with color-sensitive variations concentrated in a low-rank subspace. Based on this observation, we propose Lightweight Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Recoloring (LiteSTAR), built around LiCaD, a plug-and-play Lightweight Channel-Adaptive Decoder. LiCaD performs temporal filtering in a low-rank state space with learned process and observation uncertainties. It then modulates feature channels to achieve temporal consistency without explicit spatial alignment. LiteSTAR further employs adaptive patch routing to improve color discrimination for CVD users while avoiding unnecessary over-enhancement. We also introduce EgoCVDSet, the first egocentric video benchmark for CVD recoloring. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that LiteSTAR achieves superior performance with only 0.05M parameters. LiCaD further demonstrates strong generalization across different tasks and network architectures. The code, models, and dataset will be released after review.

</details>


### [72] [Interpretable Orthogonal Latent Diffusion with Scale-Selective Uncertainty for Medical Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32135)
*Onkar Jadhav,Tim French*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Med-PODiff：在POD局部系数空间做patch-wise扩散，实现脑MRI超分辨重建，并将不确定性分解为总/粗/细成分，定义幻觉风险分数H_p定位细尺度误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型用于医学图像重建与超分辨时，样本可能包含看似合理却难以从重建图本身识别的细尺度幻觉；需要在紧凑、可解释的表示空间中生成并给出可分解的不确定性以定位此类幻觉风险。

Method: 基于patch-wise proper orthogonal decomposition（POD）的扩散框架：在POD局部系数空间中进行生成式重建，利用POD结构将低秩解剖变化与细节残差变化分离，从而把预测不确定性分解为总、粗、细三个成分；据此构造像素级幻觉风险分数H_p，突出细细节不确定性主导于粗结构不确定性的区域。另做受控注入实验与回顾性笛卡尔k空间欠采样验证。

Result: 在脑MRI上重建质量优于代表性扩散基线，预测区间校准良好，总不确定性检测高误差区域AUROC 0.954；分解不确定性具有尺度选择性，粗/细不确定性分别优先预测对应尺度误差，H_p定位细误差AUROC 0.906；被丢弃的POD尾部仅占保留细误差幅度的3.8%；提升下游分割一致性，推理时间显著少于像素空间扩散。

Conclusion: POD系数空间扩散为医学图像超分辨提供了可解释、尺度选择性的不确定性分解，能有效量化并定位细尺度幻觉风险，兼顾重建质量、校准性与推理效率。

Abstract: Diffusion models are increasingly used for medical image reconstruction and super-resolution, but their samples may contain plausible fine-scale hallucinations that are difficult to identify from the reconstructed image alone. We propose Med-PODiff, a patch-wise proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) diffusion framework for brain MRI super-resolution that performs generative reconstruction in compact and interpretable local coefficient spaces. Unlike pixel-space or learned-latent diffusion models, Med-PODiff uses the POD structure to separate low-rank anatomical variation from fine-detail residual variation, enabling predictive uncertainty to be decomposed into total, coarse, and fine components. Building on this decomposition, we define a pixel-wise hallucination-risk score, $H_p$, that emphasizes regions where fine-detail uncertainty dominates coarse structural uncertainty. On brain MRI, Med-PODiff outperforms representative diffusion baselines in reconstruction quality while producing well-calibrated predictive intervals, with total uncertainty detecting high-error regions at AUROC 0.954. More importantly, the decomposed uncertainty is scale-selective: coarse and fine uncertainty preferentially predict errors at the corresponding scales, with $H_p$ localizing fine error at AUROC $0.906$. Controlled injections and retrospective Cartesian $k$-space undersampling further support fine-detail localization and degradation robustness. The discarded POD tail is only $3.8\%$ of the retained fine-error magnitude, and Med-PODiff improves downstream segmentation consistency while requiring substantially less inference time than pixel-space diffusion.

</details>


### [73] [An Automated Framework Integrating Deep Learning and Anatomical Reasoning for Cardiac Phenotyping From CCTA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32114)
*Hien Minh Tran,Thi-Thu-Hien Pham,Le Duy Tan,Hieu Xuan Nguyen,Tuong-Anh Mai-Phan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个结合深度学习与解剖推理的自动化框架，实现冠状动脉CT血管造影(CCTA)的定量心脏表型分析，包括管腔分割、冠脉钙化、PCAT与EAT量化。


<details>
