  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CCTA可显示冠脉解剖与心脏脂肪，但单纯分割无法保证测量在解剖上的一致性；同时EAT量化通常依赖专家心包轮廓，成本高。

Method: 解剖测量模块利用图几何、分支身份和周围结构定义血管特异性的PCAT采样区域及EAT替代腔室，并借此自动生成训练目标而无需专家心包标注；配套模块在非增强CT上量化冠脉钙化。在ImageCAS、ImageCAS-X、COCA、Visual Lab、MultiD4CAD五个公开数据集上分组件基准测试。

Result: ImageCAS-X Test-160上管腔分割经验证集选定后处理取得Dice 0.9133、clDice 0.940，超过已发表CAS-Net点估计；四折ImageCAS评估中四模型集成优于单ResEnc-L；800对配对扫描显示全血管与管腔参考下的PCAT衰减测量存在差异；外部EAT评估显示强体积相关与良好空间重叠。

Conclusion: 显式解剖规则使测量可解释、可检查；该框架为处理心脏CT队列及群体水平冠脉钙化、PCAT、EAT量化与跨研究比较提供标准化流程，代码已开源。

Abstract: Coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) depicts coronary anatomy and cardiac fat, but segmentation alone does not ensure anatomically consistent measurements. We propose an automated framework that combines deep learning with anatomical reasoning for quantitative cardiac phenotyping. Its anatomical measurement module uses graph geometry, branch identity, and surrounding structures to define vessel-specific pericoronary adipose tissue (PCAT) sampling and a surrogate epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) compartment. The latter also generates training targets without requiring expert pericardium contours. A companion module quantifies coronary calcium on non-contrast CT. Component-wise benchmarking was conducted on five public datasets: ImageCAS, ImageCAS-X, COCA, Visual Lab, and MultiD4CAD. On ImageCAS-X Test-160, lumen segmentation with validation-selected post-processing achieved a Dice score of 0.9133 and a clDice score of 0.940, exceeding the corresponding published CAS-Net point estimates. In the four-split ImageCAS evaluation, the four-member ensemble outperformed the single ResEnc-L model. Analysis of 800 paired scans showed that PCAT attenuation measurements differed between whole-vessel and lumen references. External EAT evaluation showed strong volume correlation and good spatial overlap. Explicit anatomical rules make the resulting measurements interpretable and inspectable. In practice, the framework provides a standardized pipeline for processing cardiac CT cohorts and quantifying coronary calcium, PCAT, and EAT for population-level analysis and comparison across studies. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/HarryTRAN207/CardiacCT-Research

</details>


### [74] [Not the Scalar, but Its Evolution: Robust Source Attribution for Generated Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32074)
*Chao Wang,Zijin Yang,Yaofei Wang,Yuang Qi,Weiming Zhang,Kejiang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出SpCon框架，利用重建残差能量的频率分辨演化（"谱收缩"现象）进行潜在生成模型生成图像的来源归属，在三种参考设定下均显著优于基线，并在社交平台数据上保持有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于重建的归属方法将图像对重建算子的响应压缩为单一全局标量（重建误差或相邻误差之比），丢弃了通道-频率结构，使图像内容与后处理变化掩盖来源证据，导致图像传播后归属困难。因此需要一种在后处理下更稳定的来源判别线索。

Method: 发现"谱收缩"（Spectral Contraction）现象：重复应用同一重建算子时，残差能量的频率分辨演化具有稳定判别性。据此构建SpCon：仅需目标模型的VAE，通过两次确定性重建获得相邻残差，由其频率分辨的相对能量变化构建谱收缩表示，并对每个来源-条件对在有限拟合参考分量上聚合Student-t响应密度。按非归属参考可得性分三种设定：Target-Only（仅归属参考）、External-Reference（外域参考）、Known-Reference（已知域内竞争者）。

Result: 七个LGM、35种条件下，TO/ER/KR平均AUROC/AP分别为0.8786/0.6344、0.9404/0.7886、0.9652/0.8626，均超过最强基线（0.8154/0.5277）；三个社交平台上分别为0.8581/0.5507、0.9369/0.7549、0.9734/0.8773。

Conclusion: 频率分辨的残差能量演化比单一全局标量更抗后处理干扰，为生成图像来源归属提供了稳定线索；SpCon在无参考、外域参考和已知域内参考三种实际场景下均取得领先性能，且适配社交平台处理。

Abstract: The widespread deployment of latent generative models (LGMs) makes generated image source attribution essential for copyright auditing and data governance, yet practical attribution should remain reliable under common post-processing and platform-induced processing. Existing reconstruction-based attribution methods summarize an image's reconstruction response to a single global scalar, such as the reconstruction error or the ratio of two consecutive errors. These summaries discard channel-frequency structure, allowing image content and post-processing variation to obscure source evidence and making attribution after spreading difficult. We instead uncover a more stable source-discriminative cue under post-processing: the frequency-resolved evolution of residual energy across repeated applications of the same reconstruction operator. Motivated by this insight, we characterize a phenomenon we term Spectral Contraction and use it to build SpCon, a source-attribution framework that accesses only the target model's VAE. SpCon obtains adjacent residuals through two deterministic reconstructions, builds a spectral-contraction representation from their frequency-resolved relative energy change, and aggregates Student-t response densities for each source-condition pair over a finite set of fitted reference components. The same representation supports three settings according to non-belonging reference availability: none (Target-Only, TO; belonging references only), external out-of-domain sources (External-Reference, ER), or known in-domain competitors (Known-Reference, KR). Across seven LGMs, TO, ER, and KR attain average AUROC/AP of 0.8786/0.6344, 0.9404/0.7886, and 0.9652/0.8626 over the 35 conditions, all outperforming the strongest baseline (0.8154/0.5277), and achieve 0.8581/0.5507, 0.9369/0.7549, and 0.9734/0.8773 on the three social platforms.

</details>


### [75] [InCue: Making Better Use of What Multimodal LLMs Already See at Test Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31987)
*Shuwei Wu,Siyue Yu,Longin Jan Latecki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 InCue，一种无需额外视觉输入的测试时框架，利用视觉注意力与预测熵梯度作为"内部线索"定位相关区域，仅优化已有视觉 token 上的偏移来引导注意力，在匹配视觉 token 预算下取得 SOTA，V* 最高提升 8.9%、难题样本提升 23.4%，并泛化到八个通用基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型即使答错，其内部线索往往仍指向相关区域。常见的"放大裁剪重呈现"方法虽有增益，但作者发现该增益大多并非来自新细节：使用已见过的低分辨率裁剪仍能保留大部分收益，甚至仅复制该区域缓存 token 也能部分保留。这说明重呈现的收益部分源于把注意力引向模型已持有的证据，因此应更充分地利用这些内部证据，而非补充视觉输入。

Method: InCue 为测试时框架：将视觉注意力与预测熵梯度作为内部线索，二者耦合为空间目标；随后仅优化现有视觉 token 上的一个偏移量，以将该注意力引导至该目标区域，不引入任何额外视觉输入。

Result: 在匹配视觉 token 预算条件下达到 SOTA，持续优于近期测试时方法；在 V* 上对四个 MLLM 最高提升 8.9%，在其困难样本上最高提升 23.4%；增益亦可迁移至八个通用基准。

Conclusion: 重呈现方法的收益很大程度上来自注意力重定向而非新细节，InCue 通过耦合内部线索并轻量调控已有视觉 token，即可在无额外视觉输入下有效提升 MLLM 表现，且具备良好泛化性。

Abstract: Even when multimodal large language models (MLLMs) answer incorrectly, their internal cues often point to the relevant region. A widely used remedy re-presents the cue-selected region as an enlarged crop to supply finer detail. However, we find that much of its gain requires no new detail: it largely survives when the crop comes from the already-seen low-resolution input, and partly even when the region's cached tokens are merely copied. Part of re-presentation's gain thus comes from drawing attention to evidence the model already holds. We propose InCue, a test-time framework that makes better use of this evidence without additional visual input. InCue treats visual attention and predictive-entropy gradients as Internal Cues, couples them into a spatial target, and optimizes only an offset on the existing visual tokens to steer attention toward it. Under matched visual-token budgets, InCue achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming recent test-time methods and improving four MLLMs by up to 8.9% on V$^*$ and 23.4% on its hard samples. Its gains carry over to eight general benchmarks. Code will be available at https://github.com/paul-swu/InCue.

</details>


### [76] [Distill to Loop: Turning Pretrained Diffusion Transformers into Looped Models with Adjustable Depth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31977)
*Chenru Wang,Shengwei An*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Distill to Loop（Dooop）方法，将预训练的非循环扩散 Transformer 蒸馏为共享权重的循环学生模型，把蒸馏建模为朝向教师的固定点迭代，使单一模型可在测试时运行任意循环数，并可结合高阶 ODE 求解器与 loop guidance 提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有循环扩散 Transformer 需从头训练，重复完整预训练开销，而已有强预训练的非循环扩散 Transformer 未被利用，因此存在参数与计算浪费的问题。

Method: 将教师模型各块权重用于初始化循环学生；把蒸馏表述为固定点迭代，每个循环的输出都朝教师输出对齐，每次循环视为深度方向 ODE 的一步；由此支持测试时任意循环数、在深度维应用扩散采样的高阶 ODE 求解器；并在不同循环数输出之间构造 loop guidance。

Result: 在 SD3-medium 上，约占教师 37% 参数的循环学生用 2–4 次循环即在 GenEval、ImageReward、PickScore、HPSv2.1 平均上匹配教师；2 次循环仅用约 58% 教师算力。四步 SD3-medium 上，loop guidance 将四项指标平均值从 88.2 提升至 99.2。

Conclusion: Dooop 无需从头预训练即可获得高效循环扩散 Transformer，兼顾参数与计算节省，并通过深度维 ODE 求解与 loop guidance 以极小额外开销提升生成质量。

Abstract: Looped transformers reuse one block of shared weights along the depth of the network. Recent looped diffusion transformers are trained from scratch, which repeats the full pretraining cost although strong pretrained non-looped diffusion transformers exist. We propose Distill to Loop (Dooop), which distills a pretrained non-looped diffusion transformer into a looped student whose blocks are initialized from the teacher's. We cast distillation as a fixed-point iteration toward the teacher, in which the output after every loop is trained toward the teacher, and each loop is one step of an ordinary differential equation in depth. As a result, one model runs any number of loops at test time without retraining, and the higher-order ODE solvers of diffusion model sampling can be applied along the depth dimension for better results. Meanwhile, because a looped model produces an output after every loop, we also construct loop guidance between the outputs of different loop counts, which improves the generated samples at little extra compute. On SD3-medium, a looped student with about 37% of the teacher's parameters matches the teacher on average over GenEval, ImageReward, PickScore and HPSv2.1 with two to four loops, and with two loops it uses about 58% of the teacher's compute. And on a four-step SD3-medium, loop guidance raises the average of the four metrics from 88.2 to 99.2.

</details>


### [77] [TACTUS: Unifying Surgical Action Understanding in Time and Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31956)
*Lurui Wang,Hao Ding,Chenhao Yu,Chenyan Jing,Jiru Xu,Ruoqi Zuo,Liwei Mei,Chang Liu,Lalithkumar Seenivasan,Mathias Unberath*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TACTUS数据集与基准，统一标注工具、动作、接触与轨迹，并配套TactusNet网络进行多任务评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手术基准多以任务特定目标定义监督，未充分刻画动作语义、器械运动与组织交互之间的关系，缺乏对完整手术动作的时空理解。

Method: 构建统一标注框架，联合标注工具与动作身份、嵌套的动作/交互时间窗、器械特定关键点轨迹与组织区域轨迹；采用人工标注、点跟踪与模型生成空间提示的两级流水线，重新标注5个公开来源的141段视频，得到22,995个动作片段（290万帧），含15,668个Gold片段与7,327个Silver片段；并提出参考网络TactusNet，基于共享视频特征进行语义、时间与空间预测。

Result: 在TactusNet与13个已发表基线上，工具-动作准确率达95.8%（逐头编码器微调）；最佳时间召回率46.6%（tIoU 0.7），接触Dice为0.351；加入Silver数据使默认TactusNet的配对准确率从93.8%提升至95.5%。

Conclusion: TACTUS为学习和评估器械-组织交互提供了统一基础，支撑未来手术自动化研究。

Abstract: Advancing surgical automation requires a comprehensive spatio-temporal understanding of how instruments act on tissue throughout an action. Existing surgical benchmarks, however, largely define supervision through task-specific targets, leaving the relationships between action semantics, instrument motion, and tissue interaction incompletely specified. To address this limitation, we introduce TACTUS (Tool, Action, Contact and Trajectory Understanding in Surgery), a new dataset and benchmark that establishes a unified annotation framework for complete surgical actions. The framework jointly specifies tool and action identities, nested action and interaction windows, instrument-specific landmark trajectories, and tissue-region tracks. To construct these annotations at scale, we develop a two-tier pipeline combining human annotation, point tracking, and model-generated spatial prompts. Using this pipeline, we re-annotate 141 videos from five public sources, producing 22,995 action clips spanning 2.9 million frames. The dataset comprises 15,668 Gold clips with human spatial prompts followed by review and re-checking, and 7,327 Silver clips combining human semantic and temporal annotations with model-generated spatial prompts. We further introduce TactusNet, the companion reference network, to benchmark semantic, temporal, and spatial prediction from shared video features. Across TactusNet and 13 published baselines, tool-action accuracy reaches 95.8% with per-head encoder fine-tuning, while the best temporal recall and contact Dice reach 46.6% at temporal IoU 0.7 and 0.351, respectively. Moreover, adding Silver improves the default TactusNet's pair accuracy from 93.8% to 95.5%. Together, these contributions establish a foundation for learning and evaluating the instrument-tissue interactions underlying future surgical automation.

</details>


### [78] [Beyond Rigid Hands: Deforming Skin into Contact-Consistent Hand Meshes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31950)
*Seonghwan Park,Min-Gyu Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出“lift”优化方法，将刚性手网格提升为与接触一致的变形手，既贴合物体表面又保持原姿态，并训练轻量头引导估计手的变形方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手-物数据集与估计器将手表示为刚性铰接网格，导致网格悬空于物体之上或穿透物体，与真实软皮肤接触不符；已有refiner只调姿态不调形状，以牺牲姿态精度换取物理合理性。

Method: 三项联合优化：(i) 微调关节与手腕使手指接触物体；(ii) 变形皮肤使穿透区域沉降到表面；(iii) 保持变形的时间一致性；因变形仅作用于近物皮肤，另训练轻量头预测估计手应接触的位置以引导变形。

Result: 对三个已发表估计器，lift使贴附物体表面的皮肤面积翻倍以上，而姿态几乎不变；学习头的引导通过闭合估计遗漏的接触间隙进一步提升抓握稳定性。

Conclusion: 现有手-物数据集与估计器无需更换手模型或重训估计器即可获得接触一致的手表示。

Abstract: Hands grasp objects with soft skin. A fingertip flattens against a mug, and a palm curves around a bottle. Yet hand-object datasets and estimators represent the hand as a rigid articulated mesh, which hovers above or penetrates the object where skin would press against it. Existing refiners keep the mesh rigid and adjust only the pose, trading pose accuracy for physical plausibility. We ask whether a rigid hand can instead touch the object as skin does while staying close to its original pose. We lift annotated or estimated rigid hands to contact-consistent meshes through an optimization that (i) slightly adjusts the joints and wrist to bring the fingers onto the object, (ii) deforms the skin so that penetrating regions settle onto the surface, and (iii) keeps this deformation consistent over time. Since deformation reaches only skin already near the object, we further train a lightweight head on the lifted annotations to predict where an estimated hand should touch and steer the deformation there. Unlike existing refiners, the lift more than doubles the skin lying on the object surface for three published estimators while barely changing the pose. Guidance from the learned head further improves grasp stability by closing contact gaps that the estimate leaves open. Existing hand-object datasets and estimators can thus adopt contact-consistent hands without changing the hand model or retraining the estimators.

</details>


### [79] [Decompose, Verify, Evolve: Physically Grounded Shape Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31924)
*Wenchao Ma,Rui Yu,Fan Zhu,Jiachen Liu,Sharon X. Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysDec 是一个利用预训练视觉语言模型语义与常识推理的智能体框架，可从少量图像预测材料感知的几何基元分解，包含带点云反馈与物理验证器迭代修正的 PhysDec-Loop 以及通过自我进化蒸馏得到的免反馈 PhysDec-Evolved。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有三维形状分解方法主要按几何保真度训练，缺乏物理合理性约束，易产生不连通部件或物理不稳定的重建结果。

Method: 借助预训练 VLM 的语义理解与常识推理预测材料感知基元分解；PhysDec-Loop 作为智能体流水线推理部件结构与材料，利用参考三维点云提供几何反馈并结合物理验证器进行迭代精炼；再通过自我进化从既往修正中学习，得到推理阶段无需点云反馈与修正循环的 PhysDec-Evolved。

Result: PhysDec-Loop 在几何保真度、物理合理性与视觉质量上优于以几何为中心的基线；PhysDec-Evolved 以显著更低的推理成本接近其性能。

Conclusion: 将 VLM 语义推理与物理验证反馈引入形状分解可有效提升物理合理性，且经自我进化可将该能力蒸馏为低成本的一次前向预测，兼顾质量与效率。

Abstract: Shape decomposition represents 3D objects as a compact set of geometric primitives for interpretable modeling and simulation. However, existing decomposition methods are trained primarily for geometric fidelity, without explicit constraints on physical plausibility, and can therefore produce disconnected parts or physically unstable reconstructions. We present PhysDec, an agentic framework that draws on a pretrained vision-language model's semantic understanding and commonsense reasoning to predict material-aware primitive decompositions from a few images. Within this framework, PhysDec-Loop is an agentic pipeline that reasons about part structure and materials, using a reference 3D point cloud for geometric feedback and physical verifiers to guide iterative refinement. Through self-evolution, we further develop another agentic pipeline, PhysDec-Evolved, which learns from prior corrections to predict primitive decompositions from images without point-cloud feedback or a correction loop at inference. Experiments show that PhysDec-Loop improves geometric fidelity, physical plausibility and visual quality over geometry-focused baselines, while PhysDec-Evolved approaches its performance at substantially lower inference cost.

</details>


### [80] [CodeHOI: Code with Agents for Physically Plausible 4D Hand-Object Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31976)
*Seonghwan Park,Inho Chang,Min-Gyu Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CodeHOI 是一个 agentic 框架，能以为程序形式生成物理合理的 4D 手-物体交互（HOI），并配套提出 CodeHOI-Bench 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D 手-物体交互建模对理解操作至关重要，且本质依赖物理（手仅通过接触移动物体、不同材质响应不同）。现有方法要么忽略物理，要么仅模拟少数材质；而程序化方法虽能描述任意材质物理，却由编码智能体忽略了驱动交互的手。

Method: 提出 CodeHOI，由三个智能体协作：Object Agent 先按材质物理构建物体；HOI Agent 通过接触点指定手部并为各类材质调用成熟物理求解器进行仿真；Evaluator Agent 依据物理定律检验结果。同时构建 CodeHOI-Bench，含 100 个覆盖四种材质的重建与生成任务。

Result: 在现成的前沿模型上，CodeHOI 能为每种材质生成合理的交互，且迁移到独立物理引擎后仍保持合理。

Conclusion: CodeHOI 使编码智能体能够在多样材质上以程序形式写出物理合理的手-物体交互，弥合了程序化物理描述与手部驱动交互之间的空白。

Abstract: Modeling 4D hand-object interaction (HOI) is fundamental to understanding manipulation. This requires physics, since hands move objects only by touch and each material responds differently. Yet existing methods ignore this physics or simulate only a narrow range of matter. Programs can instead describe any matter with its physics, but coding agents omit the hand that drives the interaction. We close this gap with CodeHOI, to our knowledge the first agentic framework that writes physically plausible 4D HOI as programs. To write one, an Object Agent first builds each object with the physics of its matter. An HOI Agent then specifies the hands by their contacts and simulates each kind of matter with an established physics solver. Finally, an Evaluator Agent checks each result against physical laws. We also introduce CodeHOI-Bench with 100 reconstruction and generation tasks across four kinds of matter. With off-the-shelf frontier models, CodeHOI writes interactions that are plausible for every kind of matter and remain so when transferred to an independent physics engine. It thereby enables coding agents to write physically plausible HOI across diverse matter.

</details>


### [81] [View Management with Gaussian Placement and Opacity Regularization for Online 3DGS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32025)
*Dong Hwi Kim,Park Sangwon,Chaehyeon Song,Ayoung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对在线3DGS-SLAM地图过拟合稀疏输入的问题，从增加视图监督与控制地图模型复杂度两方面改进：将非关键帧逐步纳入映射更新并按监督贡献分配有限更新，采用边缘引导初始化控制高斯数量，并提出自参考不透明度正则化（SOR）抑制前景冗余高斯的透明度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS与SLAM耦合可提供位姿与初始高斯，但地图仍沿用传统SLAM设计：仅在定位关键帧上训练、用不确定的前端深度做几何正则。这些设计忽视了3DGS地图的高模型复杂度（数百万参数而每区域视图极少），导致对稀疏输入过拟合；而每个新增视图与高斯都要争抢同一实时预算，难以直接解决。

Method: 1) 在关键帧维持地图结构的前提下，随映射更新完成逐步接纳非关键帧图像，并按各组帧提供的监督量在帧组间分配有限更新；2) 边缘引导初始化，在图像细节需要处放置新高斯以控制模型复杂度；3) 自参考不透明度正则化（SOR），利用累积渲染证据（无额外渲染开销）抑制持续出现在地图导出表面参考前方的高斯的不透明度，以弥补前端深度不确定性。

Result: 在实时预算内同时提升了在线地图的外观与几何质量。

Conclusion: 通过"增监督+控复杂度"的双侧设计，可在实时约束下缓解3DGS在线建图的过拟合，获得外观与几何俱佳的在线地图。

Abstract: The realistic rendering of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has drawn interest from real-time applications that require maps to be built online. This led to coupling 3DGS with SLAM, providing camera poses and initial Gaussians for the map. However, the map is still optimized with designs inherited from conventional SLAM, which train only on keyframes selected for localization and regularize geometry with uncertain frontend depth. These designs overlook the model complexity of a 3DGS map: with millions of parameters but few views of each region, the map overfits to sparse inputs. Resolving this is challenging, as every view and Gaussian added to the map competes for the same real-time budget. We close this gap from both sides. To add views while keyframes preserve the structure of the map, we progressively admit non-keyframe images as mapping updates complete and allocate the limited updates across different groups of frames according to the supervision each group provides. To control the model complexity of the map, edge-guided initialization places new Gaussians where image detail requires them. To complement the uncertain frontend depth, Self-Referenced Opacity Regularization (SOR) uses accumulated rendering evidence, at no extra rendering cost, to suppress the opacity of Gaussians that persistently contribute in front of a map-derived surface reference. Together, these designs improve both the appearance and the geometry of online maps within the real-time budget.

</details>


### [82] [DeCo-Attention: Decompose to Compensate for Low-Precision Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32035)
*Yuhang He,Harrison Zhang,Fanrong Li,Chang Liu,RuQing G. Xu,Perkz Zheng,Zhenhua Wang,Rajeev Rao,Mengdi Wang,Sharan Chetlur,Jun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DeCo-Attention：一种免训练的算法-系统协同设计低精度注意力，通过沿主方向的补偿项修正Q/K的4-bit舍入误差，使QK在FP4下正确计算，实现视频扩散Transformer的显著加速且画质不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散Transformer中，数万token的自注意力生成时间占主导，其开销随序列长度二次增长。GPU的FP4矩阵乘可加速，但对Q、K做4-bit舍入会引入大误差，且softmax中的指数项会放大QK乘积误差，导致该误差主导整个注意力误差。

Method: 免训练的DeCo-Attention：对每个head做特征分解找出少数主方向，沿这些方向补偿Q与K的舍入误差；将轻量补偿项作为额外通道附加到Q和K上，使FP4矩阵乘在计算注意力分数的同时自我修正舍入误差；进而优化softmax内核（以softmax界定内核开销），把FP4计算收益转化为实际加速。QK用FP4，其余注意力在GB300/VR200上用FP8、在RTX PRO 6000上全FP4实现。

Result: 在Wan2.2上，内核分别比BF16注意力快2.13x、2.49x、2.82x，整体生成快1.55x、1.68x、1.80x。在四个视频生成模型上，FP8配置的LPIPS与先前8-bit QK方法相当，全FP4配置的LPIPS低于先前全4-bit内核。

Conclusion: 沿主方向补偿Q/K舍入误差可有效抑制softmax对QK误差的放大，使FP4 QK在视频扩散注意力中既保真又高效；配合softmax内核优化可获得实际端到端加速，为低精度注意力提供了免训练的实用方案。

Abstract: Self-attention over tens of thousands of tokens dominates the generation time of video diffusion transformers, because its cost grows quadratically with sequence length. The FP4 matrix products of modern GPUs can speed up attention, but the 4-bit rounding of the queries Q and the keys K introduces large errors. We show that the exponential in softmax amplifies the error of their product QK, which therefore dominates the attention error. We propose DeCo-Attention, a co-design of algorithm and system for low-precision attention. DeCo-Attention is training-free and compensates the rounding error of Q and K along a few principal directions found by a per-head eigendecomposition. The lightweight compensation terms are appended to Q and K as extra channels, so the FP4 matrix product corrects its own rounding error while it computes the attention scores. Once the products run in FP4, the softmax bounds the kernel, and we optimize the softmax so that the gain of FP4 computation translates into realized speedup. With QK in FP4, we implement DeCo-Attention with the rest of attention in FP8 on GB300 and VR200 and in FP4 on RTX PRO 6000. On Wan2.2, these kernels run 2.13x, 2.49x, and 2.82x faster than BF16 attention, and the whole generation runs 1.55x, 1.68x, and 1.80x faster. On four video generation models, the FP8 configuration achieves LPIPS comparable to prior 8-bit QK methods, and the fully FP4 configuration lower LPIPS than prior fully 4-bit kernels.

</details>


### [83] [Gaze World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31836)
*Jiawen Zhang,Houze Yang,Xu Cao,Yifan Shen,Zhongyi Zhou,Steve Wong,Ismini Lourentzou,Inki Kim,James M. Rehg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Gaze World Model (GWM)，在冻结的V-JEPA 2.1编码器上联合训练潜在场景预测与以人物为条件的注视监督，实现注视目标估计、注视转移检测与未来注视预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有注视目标估计方法多逐帧处理，未建模注视在目标间的转移；而注视转移常由场景的动态变化驱动，这正是世界模型擅长编码的信息，但该关联较为细微（远处事件可能仅引起轻微的头部或眼部运动）。

Method: 在冻结的V-JEPA 2.1编码器上协同训练潜在场景预测与人物条件化的注视监督；输入为视频片段与人物头部框，模型估计注视位置并检测观察片段内的注视转移，并基于预测的场景特征对未来注视与转移进行预测。同时为VideoAttentionTarget与ChildPlay数据集补充事件级注视转移标注。

Result: 在注视转移检测上取得SOTA，四类AP比最强基线高约10个点；注视目标估计与最强图像类模型相当；在未来注视定位与转移预测任务上优于对比基线。消融显示潜在预测目标同时提升转移检测与注视定位性能。

Conclusion: 将世界模型的潜在场景预测与注视监督联合训练，可有效捕捉由场景动态驱动的细微注视转移，并支持从观察到预测的注视行为建模。

Abstract: Where a person looks indicates their focus of attention, and how their gaze shifts between targets reveals how that attention responds to a changing scene. Existing gaze target estimation methods largely operate frame by frame and do not model these shifts. Gaze shifts are often driven by dynamic changes in the scene, which is the kind of information world models are designed to encode. This relationship is subtle, however, since an event far across the frame may produce only a slight movement of the person's head or eyes. We therefore introduce the Gaze World Model (GWM), which co-trains latent scene prediction with person-conditioned gaze supervision on a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder; in our ablations, the latent prediction objective improves both shift detection and gaze localization. Given a video clip and the person's head box, GWM estimates gaze locations and detects gaze shifts in the observed clip, and forecasts future gaze and shifts from predicted scene features. To train and evaluate these tasks, we augment VideoAttentionTarget and ChildPlay with event-level gaze-shift annotations. GWM achieves state-of-the-art shift detection on these benchmarks, about 10 points higher in four-class AP than the strongest baseline, while remaining comparable to the strongest image-based models in gaze target estimation, and outperforms the compared baselines on future gaze localization and shift forecasting.

</details>


### [84] [SceneMemBench: A Benchmark for Scene Memory in Interactive Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31803)
*Yuheng Si,Linye Lyu,Jiawei Zhou,Lingyi Du,Nanfei Ye,Aobo Liu,Yu Liu,Yu Li,Cheng Zhuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SceneMemBench 基准，用于评测交互式视频世界模型的场景记忆，区分"已见视角回忆 vs 新视角恢复"与"受控诊断 vs 端到端交互"两个维度，包含 33 个 Unreal Engine 场景的 600 条受控轨迹与 60 个完整 rollout 案例，覆盖 8 个代表性开源/闭源模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆评测多聚焦已见视角重访与完整 rollout，跨视角场景恢复研究不足，且将记忆能力与轨迹跟随误差、累积生成退化混在一起，难以归因模型记忆能力。

Method: 构建 SceneMemBench 基准：设计两个互补评测维度（已见视角回忆 vs 新视角恢复；受控诊断 vs 端到端交互），提出基于共享真实观测历史的 Continued Rollout 与基于模型自身生成交互的 Full Rollout 两种协议；从主体一致性、外观保真度、几何一致性三方面评估场景恢复。

Result: 新视角恢复普遍难于已见视角回忆；在受控历史下得到的模型画像与完整交互下的表现可能差异显著，说明单一评测范式会掩盖互补的失效模式。

Conclusion: 仅依赖已见视角重访或端到端 rollout 会掩盖模型在场景记忆上的互补失效模式，SceneMemBench 通过解耦记忆与轨迹、生成退化因素，提供了更细粒度、可诊断的场景记忆评测框架。

Abstract: Interactive video world models generate navigable worlds frame by frame, but a persistent world requires previously observed scenes to remain recoverable as users move away and return. Existing memory evaluations, however, often focus on seen-view revisits and full rollouts, leaving cross-view scene recovery underexplored while entangling memory with trajectory-following errors and accumulated generation degradation. We introduce SceneMemBench, a benchmark for scene memory in interactive video world models. It evaluates two complementary dimensions: seen-view recall versus novel-view recovery, and controlled diagnosis versus end-to-end interaction. We introduce Continued Rollout from a shared ground-truth observation history, alongside Full Rollout over complete model-generated interactions. SceneMemBench contains 600 controlled trajectories across 33 Unreal Engine scenes and 60 Full Rollout cases, covering eight representative open- and closed-source models. We evaluate scene recovery along subject consistency, appearance fidelity, and geometric consistency. Results show that novel-view recovery is generally more challenging than seen-view recall, while model profiles under controlled histories can differ markedly from those observed in full interaction. Together, these findings reveal complementary failure modes obscured by seen-view revisits or end-to-end rollouts alone.

</details>


### [85] [A Well-Posed Fourth-Order Navier-Stokes Model for Image Inpainting: Theory, Order Selection, and Stripe Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31777)
*Yiwen Dou,Yiqiang Ding,Zhongyun Bao,Senyan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文为Bertalmío-Bertozzi-Sapiro的Navier-Stokes图像修复模型构建了首个系统性的高阶（四阶）扩展，证明朴素四阶修正不适定，并给出适定的门控前向四阶项与用于大块缺失的条纹分解策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NS修复模型是PDE类方法中唯一的输运型范式，却始终缺乏系统的高阶扩展；同时大块缺失区域是该模型的固有短板，需要在不引入训练的前提下同时解决高阶适定性与块状损伤两个问题。

Method: 在涡量-流函数表述下引入门控四阶项：后向形式为Perona-Malik型反扩散，属Hadamard不适定且实验有害；前向形式为一致抛物、能量稳定且有益。提出"阶数-耗散原理"（奇阶色散、偶阶耗散），据此判定四阶为最低可接受阶。针对大块缺失提出条纹分解：先以Telea基填充，再做交错的狭缝式NS迭代，将块状损伤转化为模型擅长的结构狭缝情形；该装置与基方法无关，且增益可与前向修正叠加。模型无需训练。

Result: 在BSDS500、DIV2K及中国古画基准三个数据集、裂纹/块状/文字遮挡三类损伤上：所有结构主导损伤样本均优于全部经典基线；在42幅古画全集上较Telea提升+1.02 dB PSNR，逐样本胜率42/42；与最强近期PDE求解器差距在0.4 dB以内，同时取得整个PDE族中最优感知质量；消费级GPU上单图耗时4–16 s。

Conclusion: 高阶NS修复的有效性取决于修正项的符号与前向性，四阶为理论允许的最低阶；配合条纹分解可将块状缺失纳入模型优势区间，从而以无训练的PDE框架在保真度与感知质量上同时达到PDE族前沿水平。

Abstract: The Navier-Stokes (NS) inpainting model of Bertalmío, Bertozzi and Sapiro is the only transport-type paradigm among PDE-based methods, yet it has never received a systematic higher-order extension. We show that the obvious fourth-order correction is ill-posed, and we construct the corrected, well-posed model. In the vorticity-streamfunction formulation we add a gated fourth-order term whose sign is decisive: the backward form is a Perona-Malik-type anti-diffusion, Hadamard ill-posed and consistently harmful in experiments, whereas the forward form is uniformly parabolic, energy-stable and consistently beneficial. An order-dissipation principle, stating that odd orders are dispersive and even orders dissipative, singles out the fourth order as the lowest admissible one. Large missing blocks pose a separate problem, because the correction gate stays silent there; we answer it with stripe decomposition, a Telea base fill followed by interleaved slit-wise NS passes, which converts block damage into the structural-slit regime where the model excels. The device is base-agnostic, and its gains add to those of the forward correction. On three datasets, namely BSDS500, DIV2K and a classical Chinese painting benchmark, and on three damage types, namely cracks, blocks and text occlusion, the training-free model beats every classical baseline on every sample of structure-dominated damage, gains +1.02 dB PSNR over Telea on the full 42-image painting test set with a 42/42 per-sample win rate, matches the strongest recent PDE solvers within 0.4 dB while attaining the best perceptual quality of the entire PDE family, and runs at 4-16 s per image on a consumer GPU.

</details>


### [86] [ET: Efficient Transfer from Softmax to Hybrid Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31770)
*Guangfu Guo,Xiaoqian Lu,Linsey Pang,Weiran Yao,Haolin Chen,Long Cheng,Kunpeng Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ET（Efficient Transfer）框架，实现无梯度、低成本的softmax注意力到高效线性注意力高保真转换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练softmax Transformer转高效注意力通常性能显著下降，而恢复需昂贵的微调，亟需低优化成本的高保真转换方法。

Method: ET融合精确局部注意力与共享键softmax注意力，配合均值锚定、免扫描的全局线性校正与自适应门控，实现序列长度线性复杂度；冻结预训练权重，仅用交替最小二乘在少量无标签样本上校准新增参数，无梯度更新。

Result: ImageNet-1K上DeiT-S/DeiT-B达79.64%/81.55% top-1，距教师0.25个百分点内；768×768下较T⁵高3.59个百分点；DiT-XL/2经250次LoRA更新FID-50K为2.59；SD 3.5 Medium在1K分辨率以0.73 A100 GPU小时无梯度转换匹配教师GenEval并获1.39×推理加速。

Conclusion: ET以无梯度的轻量校准实现近似无损的注意力转换，在分类与生成任务上兼顾保真度与线性效率。

Abstract: Converting pretrained softmax Transformers to efficient attention often causes substantial performance degradation, while recovery typically requires costly fine-tuning. We propose ET (Efficient Transfer), a framework for high-fidelity attention conversion with minimal optimization cost. ET combines exact local and shared-key softmax attention with a mean-anchored, scan-free global linear correction and adaptive gating, achieving linear complexity in sequence length. To preserve pretrained knowledge, ET freezes pretrained weights and calibrates only newly introduced parameters through alternating least squares on a small set of unlabeled samples, without gradient updates. On ImageNet-1K, ET achieves 79.64% and 81.55% top-1 accuracy on DeiT-S and DeiT-B, respectively, within 0.25 percentage points of their softmax teachers. At $768\times768$, ET outperforms T$^5$ by 3.59 percentage points at comparable inference FLOPs, without gradient-based fine-tuning. On DiT-XL/2, ET achieves an FID-50K of 2.59 with only 250 LoRA updates. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, ET matches the teacher's GenEval score at 1K resolution with just 0.73 A100 GPU-hours of gradient-free conversion and a 1.39$\times$ inference speedup.

</details>


### [87] [RoMo Hands: A Large Scale Richly Organized Text to Hand Motion Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31766)
*Yizhak Ben-Shabat,Jiahao Zhang,Joseph Liu,Seonghyeon Moon,Young-Yoon Lee,Haomiao Jiang,Oren Jacob,Mubbasir Kapadia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RoMo Hands——大规模野外双手运动-文本数据集（约542K序列、884小时、95.5M帧@30fps，规模比先前工作大一个数量级），并给出393维双手表示与系统性基准评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯手部动作生成受限于数据：现有数据集常把手视为刚性末端执行器、缺少细粒度文本标注、规模不足，难以支撑鲁棒的泛化能力。

Method: 1) 构建野外、文本配对数据集，采用严格灵巧度过滤器剔除低关节活动度序列，使分布聚焦复杂双手运动；2) 每段视频配5条递增粒度文本（从全局语义标签到原子级手指状态），组织为层级分类法；3) 提出393维双手表示，将冗余身体运动范式迁移到高自由度手部运动学，以衔接身体与手部架构。

Result: 对扩散、掩码token与自回归三类生成器进行基准测试，揭示其在手部特定适配下的不同权衡，尤其是语义对齐与运动学合理性之间的显著背离。

Conclusion: 数据集、表示与基准共同为下一代灵巧手部运动合成奠定严格基础。

Abstract: While text-driven body motion generation has matured, pure-hand synthesis remains bottlenecked by data. Existing datasets often treat hands as rigid end-effectors, lack fine-grained captions, or are too limited in scale to support robust generalization. We introduce RoMo Hands, an in-the-wild, text-paired dataset of ~542K sequences (884 hours, 95.5M frames at 30 fps) which is an order of magnitude larger than prior work. To ensure high-quality supervision, a stringent dexterity filter discards low-articulation sequences, focusing the distribution on complex bimanual movement. Each clip is paired with five captions at increasing granularities from global semantic tags to atomic finger states, organized under a hierarchical taxonomy. To bridge the gap between body and hand architectures, we propose a novel 393-D bimanual representation that adapts redundant body-motion paradigms to the high-DoF kinematics of hands. Systematic benchmarking of diffusion, masked-token, and autoregressive generators reveals distinct trade-offs under these hand-specific adaptations, including a sharp divergence between semantic alignment and kinematic plausibility. Our dataset, representation, and benchmark establish a rigorous foundation for the next generation of dexterous motion synthesis. Project page: https://romodataset.github.io/romo-hands/.

</details>


### [88] [Xtream: An Explicit Metric State for Large-Scale Streaming Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31757)
*Ernesto Lozano,Alberto Jaenal,Javier Civera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Xtream 是一个混合流式流水线，将 3D 基础模型作为几何前端，并以关键帧因子图维护显式度量状态，从而缓解在线重建中的漂移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DFMs 可前馈式稠密重建，但有效范围受跨视图注意力限制。现有通过视频块几何对齐+隐式记忆递归更新、或用位姿图扩展大场景的方案都易漂移，根源在于单目几何缺乏度量尺度可观测性。

Method: 提出 Xtream 混合流式框架：3DFM 承担几何前端，关键帧上的因子图维护显式度量状态；度量信息有两个来源——3DFM 的度量尺度预测，或可用时的惯性测量。

Result: 在 VBR、Oxford Spires、KITTI 等大规模基准上，Xtream 在基于 3DFM 的在线重建中取得 SOTA，平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）较已发表基线与同期工作均有降低。

Conclusion: 显式度量状态与因子图后端结合 3DFM 前端，可有效抑制漂移并实现大规模在线重建，度量和惯性信息的引入是关键。

Abstract: 3D foundation models (3DFMs) enable dense reconstruction in a feed-forward pass, yet their effective span is limited by cross-view attention. Local consistency has been expanded through geometric alignment of video chunks and recursive updates of an implicit memory, and large-scale scenes with pose graphs. However, both strategies are prone to drift, largely due to the lack of metric-scale observability from monocular geometry. We present Xtream,a hybrid streaming pipeline that maintains an explicit metric state through a factor graph over keyframes, while using a 3DFM as a geometric front end. Xtream incorporates metric information in two ways: through metric scale predictions from 3DFMs; or through inertial measurements if available. Across the large-scale benchmarks of VBR, Oxford Spires and KITTI, Xtream achieves state-of-the-art performance in 3DFM-based online reconstruction, reducing average absolute trajectory errors compared with published baselines and concurrent work. https://ernestolozano.github.io/xtream

</details>


### [89] [RVLM-X: Towards a Universal VLM Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31755)
*Aadi Palnitkar,Dmytro Kurdydyk,Xiaomin Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RVLM-X：一种任务通用的递归VLM外壳，让模型在代码REPL中自主控制全分辨率视觉上下文并递归调用自身；在7个公开基准上均优于单次调用且汇总准确率最高，并新提出MapGenBench（71.4% vs. 最强基线55.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM外壳多采用固定流程（如zoom tree）预先规定看哪里、如何融合证据，适用于弥补旧模型短板；但对于能可靠规划与使用工具的前沿模型，这种固定路径反而会降低准确率。同时现有基准多只考察"找一个细节"，缺乏细粒度感知与多步推理结合的测试。

Method: 借鉴Recursive Language Models的递归推理，RVLM-X在代码REPL中保存全分辨率图像，由VLM以程序化方式自主控制视觉上下文，并对其选定的区域递归调用自身；流程跨照片、图表、地图不加修改地通用。所有方法统一以高性价比前沿模型为基座进行对比。

Result: 在全部7个公开基准上均优于单次调用，汇总（pooled）准确率最高；在新建的MapGenBench（程序化生成地图，题目结合细粒度感知与多步推理）上，留出集准确率71.4%，最强基线为55.5%。

Conclusion: 随着VLM规划与工具使用能力增强，让模型自行编写视觉搜索策略优于预先固定流程，表明"模型自控视觉搜索"是更具扩展性的外壳设计方向。

Abstract: Harnesses for vision-language models (VLMs) have grown with the models' capabilities, notably for images far larger than those seen in training, where downscaling loses small details. Most of them wrap the VLM in a fixed procedure, such as a zoom tree, that decides in advance where it looks and how the evidence is combined. These procedures make up for the weaknesses of older models by keeping them on a task-specific path, but with frontier models that reliably plan and use tools, they can lower accuracy. We propose RVLM-X, a task-generalizable recursive VLM harness that runs unchanged across photographs, charts and maps. Following the recursive inference of Recursive Language Models, the VLM programmatically controls its own visual context in a code REPL that holds the full-resolution image and calls itself recursively on regions that it chooses. With a cost-efficient frontier model as the base of every method, RVLM-X is more accurate than a single call on all 7 public benchmarks and has the highest pooled accuracy. Because existing benchmarks mostly test whether a model finds one small detail, we also introduce MapGenBench, procedurally generated maps whose questions combine fine-detail perception with multi-step reasoning. There, RVLM-X answers 71.4% of held-out questions against 55.5% for the strongest baseline. Overall, our findings suggest that as VLMs plan and use tools more reliably, letting the model write its own visual search works better than fixing one in advance.

</details>


### [90] [EventSSM: Causal Spatial-State Modelling for Asynchronous Events Event-Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31720)
*Sadiq O. Macaulay,Dipon Ghosh,Hadfield Simon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EventSSM：以按时间顺序事件包更新的循环记忆实现因果的稠密度量深度估计，并通过位姿几何搬运与可微渲染在参考时刻建立监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机输出异步亮度变化，但度量深度监督仅在稀疏采样的参考时间戳可得；将事件聚合成类帧表示虽便于学习，却会模糊原始事件流的细粒度时间结构。

Method: 因果空间状态框架，用循环记忆（recurrent memory）按时间顺序逐个事件包更新，保持持久空间上下文与物理时间对齐的状态保留；为衔接异步预测与帧时刻监督，利用标定相机位姿将预测事件深度几何搬运（geometric transport），并在参考时间戳处可微渲染以计算损失。

Result: 在基准评测中，多种深度误差指标上优于既有事件深度方法；受控消融分别考察了跨模态初始化、时间循环、独立状态、读出（readout）、监督各组件以及事件包细分（packet subdivision）的影响。

Conclusion: 上述结果确立了EventSSM作为因果事件关联度量深度估计的有效框架，将持久空间上下文与物理时间对齐的状态保留相结合。

Abstract: Event cameras report asynchronous brightness changes, yet metric-depth supervision is typically available only at sparsely sampled reference timestamps. Aggregating events into frame-like representations simplifies learning but can obscure the fine-grained temporal structure of the original event stream. We introduce EventSSM, a causal spatial-state framework for event-associated metric-depth estimation using a recurrent memory updated by chronological event packets. To bridge asynchronous predictions and frame-time supervision, predicted event depths are geometrically transported using calibrated camera poses and differentiably rendered at reference timestamps. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate improvements over established event-depth methods across multiple depth-error measures. Controlled ablations further examine cross-modal initialization, temporal recurrence, individual state, readout, and supervision components, and packet subdivision. Together, these findings establish EventSSM as an effective framework for causal event-associated metric-depth estimation, combining persistent spatial context with physically timed state retention.

</details>


### [91] [HyMTS: A Multiscale Tensor Factorization-Based Network for Hyperspectral Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31506)
*Lei Xu,Fahad Sohrab,Moncef Gabbouj,Mehmet Yamac*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HyMTS高光谱复原网络，骨干基于多尺度张量求和(MTS)因子分解算子，将低秩先验直接嵌入网络算子而非依赖辅助损失或输出约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱图像具有强谱-空冗余，干净信号通常位于低维谱子空间并具局部低秩空间结构；现有方法主要依赖稠密注意力或跨谱段特征混合，未在算子层面显式嵌入低秩先验。

Method: 构建以MTS因子分解算子为骨干的复原网络；堆叠统一模块，将因子分解层与输入自适应层耦合，在谱与空间维度同时捕捉局部与全局依赖。

Result: 在无辅助数据的标准基准上，针对高斯噪声与真实噪声去噪、单图超分辨任务，性能优于或可比于多种SOTA方法，且效率较高。

Conclusion: 将低秩先验内嵌于网络算子是一种有效且高效的高光谱复原架构设计范式。

Abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) restoration has been explored using deep learning techniques recently. Because hyperspectral images have strong spectral and spatial redundancy, the underlying clean signal is usually represented in a low-dimensional spectral subspace and locally low-rank spatial structures. Existing methods primarily explore dense attention or feature mixing across spectral bands. In this work, we propose HyMTS, a hyperspectral restoration network with a backbone built on the Multi-scale Tensorial Summation (MTS) factorization operator. HyMTS provides a natural architectural mechanism for exploiting a low-rank prior, embedded directly in the network operator rather than imposed via an auxiliary loss or a constraint on the reconstructed output. Specifically, HyMTS stacks a unified block that couples factorized layers with input-adaptive layers, capturing both local and global dependencies across the spectral and spatial dimensions. Extensive experiments without auxiliary data on standard benchmarks for Gaussian and real-noise denoising and single-image super-resolution show that HyMTS efficiently achieves superior or comparable performance to various state-of-the-art approaches.

</details>


### [92] [DUALingo: A Dual-Hand Instruction-Guided Dataset for Affordance Grounding on 3D Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31919)
*Ming-Lun Lee,Yi-En Li,Feng-Dian Su,Ming-Han Lee,Kun-Ru Wu,Krzysztof Czarnecki,Yu-Chee Tseng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DUALingo，一个面向任务条件、角色感知的双臂3D可供性 grounding 大规模数据集，用全自动基础模型流水线生成27.1万任务/7.1万物体标注，训练后模型aIoU从10.3提升至37.8。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D可供性数据集大多只标注单一交互区域，而大量日常操作任务需要双手以互补协作角色完成；人工标注双手协同接触区域难以规模化，因此缺乏任务条件化、角色感知的双臂可供性数据。

Method: 构建DUALingo：将每个任务表示为两个协作、与左右手无关（hand-agnostic）的角色，每个角色在物体表面以热力图形式定位；数据由开放权重基础模型组成的全自动流水线生成，无需人工标注；并用专家评分与经验证的LLM评判验证标注质量。

Result: 数据集含71K物体上的271K自由形式任务；在DUALingo上训练的现有3D可供性模型可从自然语言指令同时grounding两个协作角色，最佳模型aIoU由零样本基线10.3提升至37.8（三倍以上）；机器人操作演示验证了预测双臂可供性的可执行性。

Conclusion: DUALingo为学习日常双臂可供性提供了可扩展的基础数据集，弥补了双臂协作、角色感知3D可供性数据的空白。

Abstract: Affordance grounding localizes where an agent should interact with an object to perform a task. Many everyday manipulation tasks, however, require bimanual affordance, in which two hands assume complementary and cooperative roles to accomplish a shared goal. Existing 3D affordance datasets primarily ground single interaction regions, and manually annotating dual-hand, cooperative contacts does not scale. To address this gap, we introduce DUALingo, a large-scale dataset for task-conditioned, role-aware bimanual 3D affordance grounding on diverse everyday objects. DUALingo represents each task as two cooperative, hand-agnostic roles, each grounded as a heatmap on the object surface. It contains 271K free-form tasks on 71K objects, generated by a fully automated pipeline of open-weight foundation models without human labeling. Expert ratings and a validated LLM judge confirm the quality of the resulting annotations. Trained on DUALingo, existing 3D affordance models learn to ground both cooperative roles from natural-language instructions, with the best-performing model achieving a more than threefold improvement in aIoU over the zero-shot baseline, from 10.3 to 37.8. Robotic manipulation demonstrations illustrate the actionability of the predicted bimanual affordances in performing cooperative tasks. These results position DUALingo as a scalable foundation for learning everyday bimanual affordances. Project page: https://nycu-pair-labs.github.io/DUALingo/

</details>


### [93] [Loupe: Reinforcing Knowledge-Intensive Video Generation Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31895)
*Kai Zeng,Ruichuan An,Zhen Fang,Xi Fang,Han Lyu,Moran Li,Yingchen Yu,Yifan Dai,Bohan Zeng,Quanqing Xu,Zhengzhou Zhu,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出视频生成智能体 Loupe，通过检索并验证文本与视觉证据构建有据可依的时序提示；引入基于评分细则的信用分配（RBC）及 RBC-SFT、RBC-GRPO 训练方法，并构建 Search-VBench 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识密集型视频生成困难，提示常缺失事实、外观与时序关系。搜索式流程依赖人工设计策略，难以自适应规划；传统训练受制于视频级反馈代价高、轨迹级信用分配粗糙。

Method: Loupe 智能体检索并验证文本/视觉证据，生成带参考图像的证据支撑时序提示。RBC 利用提示特定的事实、视觉、时序要求，在渲染前评估中间搜索与规划决策；RBC-SFT 按步骤质量重加权 assistant token 学习；RBC-GRPO 结合步骤级信用与最终规划奖励，RL 中无需渲染视频。构建含 150 条、7 类的 Search-VBench。

Result: 在三个视频生成器上四维评估全面提升，MiniMax-H3 总分由 32.80 升至 70.67，优于未训练搜索流程；完整 RBC 训练较标准 SFT+轨迹级 GRPO 高 5.27 分。人工评估及 Sci-VBench、KIVI-Bench 结果显示生成质量、科学性、事实精度与有用性提升。

Conclusion: 细粒度、基于评分细则的步骤级信用分配可在不渲染视频的前提下有效训练视频生成智能体，显著提升知识密集型生成的准确性与可靠性。

Abstract: Knowledge-intensive video generation remains challenging because prompts often omit the facts, appearances, and temporal relationships required for accurate generation. While search-based workflows can retrieve missing evidence, manually designed strategies limit adaptive planning, and conventional training suffers from costly video-level feedback and coarse trajectory-level credit assignment. In this paper, we present Loupe, a video generation agent that retrieves and verifies textual and visual evidence to construct evidence-grounded temporal video prompts with reference images. We further introduce Rubric-Based Credit (RBC), which leverages prompt-specific factual, visual, and temporal requirements to evaluate intermediate search and planning decisions before video rendering. Building on RBC, RBC-SFT reweights assistant-token learning by step quality, while RBC-GRPO incorporates step-level credits alongside a final planning reward, without rendering videos during RL. To address the lack of dedicated search-oriented evaluation, we construct Search-VBench, which contains 150 held-out prompts across seven categories. Experiments show that Loupe improves all four evaluation dimensions across three video generators, raising the overall score of MiniMax-H3 from 32.80 to 70.67 and outperforming an untrained search workflow. Ablation experiments show that full RBC training outperforms standard SFT followed by trajectory-level GRPO by 5.27 points. Human evaluations and results on Sci-VBench and KIVI-Bench further demonstrate improved generation quality, scientific grounding, factual precision, and helpfulness. Our project page is available at https://zengkaiya.github.io/Loupe/.

</details>


### [94] [Mind the Band: The Hidden Frequency Variable in Geometric RoPE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32171)
*Seonghyun Jin,Youngmin Kim,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统分析了多视图几何旋转位置编码（Geometric RoPE）中"频带"（频率范围）这一被忽视的超参数，指出其未标准化设置可导致基准排名反转，并给出频带诊断与实用指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何 RoPE（如 RayRoPE）通过按视线、深度与重投影坐标旋转特征来注入 3D 相机几何，但频率带沿用继承的默认值：或保留标准 2D RoPE 的最高频率，或让频率跨度随注意力头维度指数增长。这种未标准化设置使得不同规模/头维度模型间的比较失真，甚至反转基准排名，且缺乏对频带影响机制的清晰理解。

Method: 以 RayRoPE 为对象，在 RealEstate10K 新视图合成与双视图深度估计上做受控实验：改变模型规模（47M/25M）、头维度（144/48 通道）、固定模型宽度仅变头大小、以及人为设定频带宽度（如 48 通道下用 4 个频率覆盖 243× 范围 vs 默认 3×）；并从"前向-反向不对称"角度分析过宽频带的失效机制（对深度区间平均旋转在前向阻尼高频，但深度梯度未被阻尼），验证仅阻断高频深度梯度可恢复 90–93% 的损失 PSNR。

Result: 频带设置可反转排名：RayRoPE 在 47M（144 通道头）中与最强基线持平，但在 25M（48 通道头）中落后 1.2 dB，固定宽度仅变头大小时同样反转；在 48 通道用 4 个频率填充 243× 范围可挽回 0.9 dB。过窄频带在两类任务中一致模糊对应关系；三种基于投影的编码在最高频率落于每 8 像素块 0.3–3 次旋转（256×256 RealEstate10K 上 10–90 次旋转）时均稳定。仅阻断高频深度梯度即可恢复 90–93% 丧失的 PSNR。

Conclusion: 频带是几何 RoPE 的关键但被忽视的设计维度，应显式设定与报告。作者提炼出实用准则：在图像坐标中设定频带、在小头中填充频率跨度、避免无条件的同视图阻尼；并呼吁未来多视图基准中报告并匹配频率带，以保证可比性。

Abstract: Geometric rotary position encodings (RoPE) incorporate 3D camera geometry into multi-view attention by rotating token features according to viewing rays, depths, and reprojected image coordinates. Each coordinate is rotated across a progression of frequencies--its frequency band--yet existing implementations leave this band to inherited defaults, either retaining standard 2D RoPE's top frequency or letting the frequency span grow exponentially with the attention head dimension. We show that this unstandardized setting can reverse benchmark rankings. In novel view synthesis on RealEstate10K, RayRoPE matches the strongest baseline in the 47M model (144-channel heads), yet trails by 1.2 dB in the 25M model (48-channel heads), and exhibits the same reversal when varying head size alone at fixed model width. Populating a 243x range with four frequencies instead of the 3x default at 48 channels recovers 0.9 dB of that gap. Across view synthesis and two-view depth estimation, overly narrow bands consistently blur correspondence, whereas all three projection-based encodings perform reliably when their top frequency lies within 0.3--3 rotations per 8-pixel patch (10--90 rotations across 256x256 RealEstate10K). At the opposite extreme, overly wide bands degrade RayRoPE through a forward-backward asymmetry: averaging rotations over a predicted depth interval damps high frequencies in the forward pass, yet leaves their gradients with respect to predicted depth undamped. Blocking only those high-frequency depth gradients recovers 90--93% of the lost PSNR, showing that forward smoothing does not guarantee backward stability. Guided by this analysis, we distill practical guidelines--setting bands in image coordinates, populating spans in small heads, and avoiding unconditional same-view damping--and advocate reporting and matching frequency bands in future multi-view benchmarks.

</details>


### [95] [SoccerNarrate: Event-Grounded Streaming Soccer Commentary with Macro-Window Preference Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32153)
*Zihan Jia,Zhilin Dai,Zhengming Zhang,Min Yang,Zhenpeng Huang,Jiaqi Li,Caixia Sun,Xi Chen,Liang Li,Junlan Feng,Gangshan Wu,Limin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SoccerNarrate 通过数据构建、宏窗口偏好对齐与事件中心评测，将低延迟流式叙述与事件落地的专业足球解说结合，在全场比赛上提升事件覆盖率与事件对齐精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于片段的足球解说模型在未剪辑全场视频上存在延迟、重复与音画不同步问题；近期流式视频语言模型虽能实现低延迟，却偏向泛化描述，难以及时准确提及进球、红黄牌、换人、越位等关键事件。

Method: 1) 构建 SoccerNarrate-Data 大规模时间锚定数据集，含词级 ASR 对齐、质量过滤与实体校准；2) 提出宏窗口偏好对齐（MWPA），对同一流式前缀的因果多步 rollout 进行比较，对齐事件级解说语义，同时保持秒级推理不变；3) 采用事件错配的人工解说作为反事实负样本，强化事件语义而非解说风格。

Result: 引入基于时间约束事件蕴含的事件中心基准 SoccerNarrate-Eval；全场实验表明，SoccerNarrate 在事件覆盖率和事件对齐精度上优于强离线与流式基线。

Conclusion: SoccerNarrate 在数据、训练与评测三个层面统一了低延迟流式叙述与事件落地的专业足球解说，验证了事件级偏好对齐在实时体育解说中的有效性。

Abstract: Existing clip-based soccer commentary models often produce delayed, repeated, or poorly synchronized narration on untrimmed full-match videos. Recent streaming video-language models make low-latency full-match narration feasible, but they often favor general descriptions rather than professional, event-grounded soccer commentary. They may describe nearby actions while failing to mention key events such as goals, cards, substitutions, and offsides correctly and on time. In this paper, we present SoccerNarrate to bridge low-latency streaming narration with event-grounded professional soccer commentary across data, training, and evaluation. First, we construct SoccerNarrate-Data, a large-scale time-anchored dataset with word-level ASR alignment, quality filtering, and entity calibration. Second, we perform macro-window preference alignment (MWPA), which aligns the model with complete event-level commentary semantics by comparing causal multi-step rollouts from the same streaming prefix while keeping second-level inference unchanged. We further use event-mismatched human commentaries as counterfactual negatives to emphasize event semantics over commentary style. Third, we introduce SoccerNarrate-Eval, an event-centric benchmark based on temporally constrained event entailment. Full-match experiments show that SoccerNarrate improves event coverage and event-aligned precision over strong offline and streaming baselines. Code and models are released at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/SoccerNarrate.

</details>


### [96] [VIDE : Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection via Visual Intrinsic Distribution Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32138)
*Kevin D. Nguetche,Atif Belal,Lilian Hollard,Eric Granger,Marco Pedersoli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无训练框架VIDE，利用视频内部冻结CLIP嵌入自适应修正文本派生的异常评分，缓解VAD中的异常偏差与提示敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PRISM等方法依赖跨视频共享的文本正态参考与异常方向，但正常活动与异常外观随场景变化，且得分对提示选择敏感，导致正常片段与异常描述高相似（异常偏差）而产生误报。

Method: VIDE为无训练框架：用低初始异常分数的片段估计当前视频的正常场景内容并部分校正文本参考；重新缩放类别响应并惩罚跨类别强响应片段；用高分数片段精化异常方向；对多个提示视图的分数取平均以降低提示敏感性；融合两个冻结编码器的分数。

Result: 双编码器下，相比最佳PRISM，UCF-Crime、XD-Violence、MSAD的AUC分别提升1.5、1.9、3.5个点；XD-Violence的AP提升6.5点，MSAD提升9.3点。三个基准上AUC在无训练方法中最高，XD-Violence与MSAD上为所有对比方法中最高报告值。

Conclusion: 通过测试时的视觉内在分布估计与提示视图融合，可在无需训练的情况下有效缓解异常偏差与提示敏感性，提升VAD性能。

Abstract: In embedding-based video anomaly detection (VAD), normal clips can have high similarity to anomalous descriptions, an anomaly bias that leads to false positives. Methods such as PRISM mitigate this bias by measuring deviations from a normality reference along anomaly directions. Both the normality reference and the anomaly directions are derived from text and shared across videos, although normal activity and the appearance of anomalies vary across scenes. The resulting scores are also sensitive to prompt selection. To address these limitations, we propose Visual Intrinsic Distribution Estimation (VIDE), a training-free framework that adapts text-derived scoring to each test video using frozen clip embeddings. VIDE estimates normal scene content from clips with low initial anomaly scores and uses this estimate to partially correct the textual reference. It then rescales category responses, penalizes clips with strong responses across categories, and refines the anomaly directions using high-scoring clips. VIDE averages scores across prompt views to reduce sensitivity to prompt selection and fuses scores from two frozen encoders. With both encoders, VIDE improves AUC over the best PRISM result by $1.5$, $1.9$, and $3.5$ points on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and MSAD, respectively, and AP by $6.5$ points on XD-Violence and $9.3$ points on MSAD. VIDE yields the highest AUC among the compared training-free methods on all three benchmarks and the highest reported AUC among all compared methods on XD-Violence and MSAD. Our code is included in the supplementary material and will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [97] [SegPFN: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation with Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32045)
*Jiajian Ma,Yihao Qiao,Ke Chen,Kaiyue Feng,Wushuang Rui,Abhishek Jha,Aarti Darji,Yiqiu Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SegPFN：将上下文分割(ICS)重构为对冻结视觉特征的表格分类任务，借助冻结的表格PFN实现免训练上下文分割，在11个数据集上整体mIoU较最强基线提升4.7点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练ICS方法依赖人工设计的推理流程，参考信息组合方式不够灵活；而通过分割专用训练获得的学习式上下文推理能力，可能损害对未见域的泛化。因此作者提出核心问题：预训练的上下文学习器能否在没有分割专用训练的情况下，从标注参考中推断出要分割的目标。

Method: SegPFN为免训练框架：先提取冻结的视觉特征，将参考图像中已标注的patch作为上下文标签、目标图像patch作为待分类样本，把ICS重构为表格分类问题，交由冻结的表格先验数据拟合网络(PFN)完成分类。

Result: 在涵盖语义、部件与个性化分割的11个数据集上，与主流ICS方法全面对比：整体平均mIoU较最强基线提升4.7点，在5种任务-样本设置中的4种取得最高平均mIoU。分析表明，难负样本参考patch有助于细粒度目标判别，联合条件化使SegPFN能有效利用多张参考图。

Conclusion: SegPFN为免训练上下文分割提供了一种简单而有效的范式，证明无需分割专用训练即可复用预训练上下文学习器完成参考驱动的分割。

Abstract: In-context segmentation (ICS) uses one or a few annotated reference images to specify what to segment in a target image. Existing training-free ICS approaches typically rely on manually designed inference procedures, which may limit how flexibly reference information is combined. Learned in-context inference offers an adaptive alternative, but acquiring this capability through segmentation-specific training can compromise generalization to unseen domains. We therefore ask: can a pretrained in-context learner infer what to segment from annotated references without segmentation-specific training? We introduce SegPFN, a training-free framework that reformulates ICS as tabular classification over frozen visual features. A frozen tabular prior-data fitted network (PFN) uses labeled reference patches as context to classify patches in the target image. We comprehensively benchmark SegPFN against major existing ICS methods across 11 datasets spanning semantic, part, and personalized segmentation. SegPFN improves overall mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) by 4.7 points over the strongest overall baseline and achieves the highest average mIoU in four of five task-shot settings. Further analyses show that hard-negative reference patches improve fine-grained target discrimination, while joint conditioning enables SegPFN to use multiple references effectively. These results show that SegPFN offers a simple and effective paradigm for training-free in-context segmentation.

</details>


### [98] [Learning Agent States for Latent Action Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32017)
*Shaoan Xie,Fan Feng,Peiyuan Zhu,Peter Spirtes,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Agent-State LAM，联合学习紧凑的智能体状态表示与潜在动作，并用空间匹配时间判别（SMTD）抑制背景与外观等与动作无关信息，提升动作恢复、下游控制与世界模型预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在动作模型（LAMs）通过帧对推断与潜在条件预测从无标注视频中学习动作式潜在变量，但潜在变量需要解释什么取决于动作推断与转移预测所用的表示空间。若该空间将智能体不断变化的物理状态与视觉上下文（背景、持续性外观）纠缠，推断出的潜在变量会编码与动作无关的信息。

Method: 提出 Agent-State LAM：联合学习紧凑的智能体状态表示及建模其转移的潜在动作；该紧凑状态将稠密视觉特征聚合到动作推断与前向预测共享的空间中。为约束状态保留的信息，引入空间匹配时间判别（SMTD）：通过空间灵活匹配与冻结的局部视觉特征，使状态区分源帧与邻近帧；SMTD 按空间位置上最强的局部特征匹配对每帧打分，而非比较全局帧表示。

Result: 在含干扰的控制任务及六个真实机器人视频数据集上，动作恢复、下游控制与世界模型预测均取得提升。代码与检查点已公开。

Conclusion: 通过在空间匹配打分下让背景与持续性外观在帧间保持匹配、降低其作为源帧判别线索的信息量，可促使表示聚焦于智能体演变中的物理状态，从而获得更纯净的潜在动作表示。

Abstract: Latent action models (LAMs) learn action-like latents from unlabeled video by coupling frame-pair inference with latent-conditioned prediction, enabling policy and world-model pretraining. However, what the latent must explain depends on the representation space used for action inference and transition prediction. When this space entangles the agent's evolving physical state with visual context, such as background and persistent agent appearance, inferred latents can encode information unrelated to the agent's actions. To address this challenge, we propose Agent-State LAM, which jointly learns a compact agent-state representation and latent actions modeling its transitions. The compact state aggregates dense visual features into a shared space for both action inference and forward prediction. To guide what this state retains, we introduce spatially matched temporal discrimination (SMTD), which trains the state to distinguish its source frame from nearby frames through spatially flexible matching with frozen local visual features. Rather than comparing global frame representations, SMTD scores each frame by emphasizing its strongest local feature matches across spatial locations. This scoring allows background and persistent agent appearance to remain matched across frames despite displacement, making these shared cues less informative for identifying the source frame and encouraging the representation to capture the agent's evolving physical state. Extensive experiments on distracting control tasks and six real robot video datasets demonstrate improved action recovery, downstream control, and world-model prediction. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Mid-Push/Agent-State-LAM.

</details>


### [99] [Reconstructing Natural Images from Brain Activity during Natural Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31989)
*Tejasvi Kothapalli,Ryan Ressmeyer,Declan Rowley,Gregory D. Horwitz,Jude Mitchell,Alexander C. Huk,Bruno Olshausen,Jacob Yates*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种在灵长类动物自由观看静态自然场景时，从神经活动重建图像的框架；通过跨眼动、试次和会话整合高密度电极记录的LGN与V1脉冲活动，结合Transformer与扩散模型解码完整场景，并在fMRI、EEG、MEG和电生理等多种记录模态上刷新了脑活动重建自然图像的SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像重建服务于两个目标：构建脑机接口，以及理解大脑如何"看见"。由于眼睛输入不完整且有噪声，大脑需依赖对自然图像的先验进行填补，因此重建可用于检验何种自然图像先验最接近大脑先验。然而以往大多数重建研究要求被试注视不动，这与灵长类持续眼动的真实视觉行为不符，故需要研究自由观看条件下的重建。

Method: 在五只猴子的LGN与V1植入高密度电极阵列记录神经活动，被试自由观看静态自然场景。因感受野仅覆盖图像的一小部分，方法将跨眼动、试次和会话的神经活动整合以重建完整图像。首先给出带1/f先验的简单线性方法，再将其扩展为现代深度学习方案：对脉冲活动与实测注视点进行token化，输入Transformer与扩散模型进行场景重建。

Result: 重建质量由三个因素决定：观看时间内累积的神经证据量、眼动追踪精度、以及图像先验的选择。所提方法在fMRI、EEG、MEG与电生理等多种脑记录模态上均取得从脑活动重建自然图像的新SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 研究证明可在自由眼动条件下从神经活动重建自然场景，并表明神经证据累积、眼动追踪精度与先验选择是关键决定因素；所提框架在跨模态上具有优越性，为脑机接口与理解大脑自然图像先验提供了新工具。

Abstract: Reconstructing images from brain activity has two broad goals. The first is to build brain-computer interfaces. The second is to understand how the brain sees. The eyes deliver incomplete, noisy input, so the brain must fill in the gaps with its expectations of what natural scenes look like. This filling-in relies on the brain's prior over natural images. Image reconstruction lets us test which natural image prior best matches the brain's natural image prior. However, most previous work on image reconstruction relies on an unnatural condition: subjects must hold their eyes still. In reality, primates constantly move their eyes to see the world. We introduce a framework for reconstructing images from neural activity while a primate freely views a static natural scene. We record from five monkeys with high-density electrode arrays in the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN) and primary visual cortex (V1). The recorded receptive fields cover only a small part of the image. Thus, we combine neural activity across eye movements, trials, and sessions to reconstruct the full image. We first present a simple linear method with a 1/f prior. We then scale this approach up with modern deep learning. We train a decoder by tokenizing spiking activity and measured gaze; these tokens are fed into a transformer and diffusion model to reconstruct the full scene. Three factors determine reconstruction quality: the amount of neural evidence combined over viewing time, the accuracy of eye tracking, and the choice of image prior. Our method sets a new state-of-the-art performance in reconstructing natural images from brain activity, across brain recording modalities: fMRI, EEG, MEG and electrophysiology.

</details>


### [100] [Describe, Don't Decide: Correcting Answer Bias in Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31988)
*Shuwei Wu,Longin Jan Latecki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的 D³（Describe, Don't Decide）框架，让 MLLM 先分别描述图像中两个实体，再在不看图像的情况下基于描述做判断，并与直接答案融合，在 79 个模型-基准组合上全部提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型在图像中比较两个实体时常答错，作者发现偏差并非来自"看"的阶段，而是产生于"看着图像做决策"的阶段——模型自身对两个实体的描述往往已包含正确答案。

Method: D³ 分三步：先让模型单独描述每个实体；再在无图像条件下仅依据这些描述做出比较决策；最后将该决策与模型的直接答案进行融合。整个过程无需任何训练或微调。

Result: 在十个基准、八个 7-9B MLLM 上，79 个模型-基准组合全部取得提升；在留出的 GQA 比较类问题上，平均准确率从 72.4% 升至 83.2%（单模型最高 +21.5%），超过 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 直接作答的 82.8%。

Conclusion: 将感知与决策解耦可有效缓解 MLLM 的比较类回答偏差，且以零训练成本获得显著收益，方法通用性强。

Abstract: Comparing two entities in an image, multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) often answer wrongly. We find that the answer bias enters not when the model sees, but when it decides with the image in view: the model's own descriptions of the two entities often already hold the right answer. We therefore propose D$^3$ (Describe, Don't Decide): the model describes each entity alone, decides from these descriptions without the image, and merges this decision with its direct answer. Without any training, D$^3$ improves all 79 model-benchmark pairs across ten benchmarks and eight 7-9B MLLMs. On held-out GQA comparison questions, the mean accuracy of these models rises from 72.4% to 83.2% (up to +21.5% per model), higher than that of Qwen2.5-VL-32B answering directly (82.8%). Code will be available at https://github.com/paul-swu/describe-dont-decide.

</details>


### [101] [TANDEM: Temporal Anchor Densification With Reliability-Aware Memory for Lightweight Sparse Depth Completion in Endoscopic Robotic Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31922)
*Weikuan Qiu,Jiale Hou,Chongzhao Xu,Jinlian Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出因果式稀疏深度补全框架TANDEM，用视频时序对稀疏度量测量重投影形成显式记忆以实现致密深度重建，仅5.58M参数，在C3VD与StereoMIS上RMSE分别降低11.7%和32.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内窥镜机器人手术需要致密深度用于导航、器械定位与组织交互，但内窥镜视频缺乏可靠公制深度；通过跟踪、ToF或器械接触获得的公制测量仅覆盖每帧极小比例像素，故稀疏深度补全成为紧迫且未解决的挑战。单帧稀疏证据不足，而视频流中历史测量蕴含可复用的公制信息。

Method: 提出TANDEM（Temporal Anchor Densification with Reliability-Aware Memory）：1）因果式（仅用过去帧）时序锚点致密化，将历史测量重投影到当前视角以补足单帧缺失的度量证据；2）显式记忆模块，用解析式的重观测、时效（age）与运动视差因子对每个重投影测量打分，且不覆盖当前测量，保证证据可解释、准确且高效；3）轻量网络通过可靠性加权梯度积分与频率门控参考先验重建致密深度。

Result: 在C3VD结肠镜与StereoMIS腹腔镜数据集上，仅5.58M参数即相对最强基线将RMSE分别降低11.7%（C3VD）与32.0%（StereoMIS），达到SOTA精度；在报告级别的内窥镜位姿误差下仍保持精度。

Conclusion: 时序记忆与可靠性建模能有效缓解内窥镜稀疏深度的度量缺失，轻量因果框架在真实手术场景数据上兼顾精度与效率，并对位姿噪声具鲁棒性。

Abstract: For endoscopic robotic surgery, accurate dense depth perception serves as a foundational capability, which enables navigation, instrument localization, and tissue interaction. However, endoscopic video lacks reliable metric depth, while metric measurements obtained via tracking, time-of-flight sensing, or instrument contact only cover a small fraction of pixels in each frame, rendering sparse depth completion an urgent and unsolved challenge. In this work, we propose Temporal Anchor Densification with Reliability-Aware Memory (TANDEM), a causal sparse depth completion framework for endoscopic video. It adopts a lightweight design and leverages the video stream: past measurements re-projected into the current view recover the metric evidence unavailable within a single sparse frame. To keep this evidence interpretable, accurate, and efficient, an explicit memory scores each re-projected measurement with analytic re-observation, age, and motion-parallax factors without overriding current measurements. A compact network then reconstructs depth via reliability-weighted gradient integration and a frequency-gated reference prior. We evaluate TANDEM on the C3VD colonoscopy and StereoMIS laparoscopy datasets. With only 5.58 M parameters, TANDEM reduces the root mean square error by 11.7% and 32.0%, respectively, compared with the strongest baseline, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. It also remains accurate under pose errors of the magnitude reported for endoscopic pose estimation. Code will be released at https://github.com/Wk-cpu-art/TANDEM upon acceptance.

</details>


### [102] [HiGS: A Hierarchical Architecture for Fast Differentiable 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31918)
*Dawid Pająk,Martin Bisson,Rodolfo Lima,François Trudel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HiGS将3DGS中"分块、光栅化单元、并行工作单元"三者解耦：以粗粒度宏瓦片做高斯分配、细粒度渲染瓦片做光栅化、按有界深度排序批次处理，使帧时间取决于视图总工作量而非最密瓦片；同一批次复用为重建提供逐批可独立微分所需的透射率与颜色，并将优化器融合进反向传播、参数与动量减半、外观更新延后至视图外，从而在保证图像质量与精确前向alpha合成的前提下实现更快渲染与更快、更省内存的重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS将屏幕瓦片同时作为分区单元、光栅化单元与并行工作单元。分区偏好大瓦片以减少开销，光栅化偏好小瓦片以提高效率，单一粒度无法兼顾。由于每个瓦片为一个工作单元，最稠密瓦片的负载决定了整帧时间，造成负载不均视图下的性能瓶颈；同时重建阶段优化器内存访存成为主要开销。

Method: 提出层次化瓦片高斯泼溅（HiGS）统一渲染与重建架构：(1) 三粒度解耦——高斯在粗粒度宏瓦片上分配，在其内的细粒度渲染瓦片上光栅化，并以有界、深度排序的批次处理；稠密区域发出更多批次而非单个更长的工作单元。(2) 批次复用——alpha合成过程提供逐批独立微分所需的透射率与颜色，使每批可独立求导。(3) 优化器融合进反向传播，直接存储与更新的参数及动量减半，并将外观更新延迟到视图之外。

Result: 在所评估的所有已发表方法中渲染速度最快，且在负载不均的视图上优势幅度最大；重建速度更快、内存占用更低，同时保持同等图像质量，并实现精确的前向到后向alpha合成。

Conclusion: 通过为分区、光栅化与并行调度赋予各自合适的粒度，并将渲染批次结构复用于可独立微分的重建，HiGS缓解了最密瓦片主导帧时间的问题，并把训练瓶颈从优化器访存转移出去，实现了兼顾渲染与重建效率的统一架构。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) makes one screen tile the cell of partitioning, the cell of rasterization, and the unit of parallel work. Partitioning favors large tiles and rasterization small ones, and with one unit per tile the densest tiles set the frame time. We present Hierarchically Tiled Gaussian Splatting (HiGS), a unified architecture for rendering and reconstruction that gives each role its own granularity: Gaussians are partitioned over coarse macro-tiles, rasterized over the fine render tiles within them, and processed in bounded depth-sorted batches. A dense region issues more batches instead of one longer unit, so frame time follows the work in a view rather than its densest tile. The same batches carry reconstruction: compositing supplies the transmittance and color needed to differentiate each one independently, leaving optimizer memory traffic as the dominant training cost. We fuse the optimizer into the backward pass, halve the parameters and moments it stores and updates directly, and defer appearance updates outside the view. HiGS renders scenes faster than every published method we evaluate, by the widest margin on views with uneven load, and reconstructs them faster and in less memory, at equal image quality and with exact front-to-back alpha compositing.

</details>


### [103] [Beyond Expert Replay: Cross-Instruction Anchoring for Continual Vision-Language-Action Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31903)
*Ziyang Chen,Dehua Chen,Shaoguang Wang,Xu Yan,Hao Huang,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Cross-Instruction Anchoring (XIA)：在任务边界冻结旧策略为教师，对“旧指令+当前观测”匹配教师响应，与专家回放共同抑制VLA持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型需持续学习新操作技能同时保留旧指令跟随能力。经验回放(ER)受限于每任务仅保留少量历史专家帧，许多旧指令响应缺乏直接监督；在有限回放下出现结构化失效模式——较早的指令会触发后续学到的竞争性目标。

Method: XIA以ER为基线，在每个任务边界将上一时刻策略冻结为教师，使用“旧指令与当前观测”配对输入，令当前策略匹配教师的响应，从而把监督扩展到存储的历史样本之外，且不增加专家回放数据需求。评估覆盖多种VLA架构与三个LIBERO子集，并在相同历史专家数据预算下与ER对比；另在RoboCasa与真实世界实验中验证。

Result: 在多种VLA架构和三个LIBERO套件上，成功率提升、遗忘降低（同等历史专家数据预算下对比ER）；RoboCasa与真实世界实验进一步支持XIA的有效性。

Conclusion: 指令条件下的响应保持可作为专家回放的有效补充，在不增加回放数据的情况下缓解VLA持续学习中的跨指令干扰与灾难性遗忘。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models need to continually acquire new manipulation skills while retaining the ability to follow previously learned instructions. Experience replay (ER) can mitigate catastrophic forgetting, but retaining only a small number of historical expert frames per task leaves many old-instruction responses without direct supervision. Under limited replay, we observe a structured failure mode in which an earlier instruction can trigger a subsequently learned, competing goal. To address this gap, we propose Cross-Instruction Anchoring (XIA), which supplements expert replay with instruction-conditioned response preservation. At each task boundary, XIA freezes the previous policy as a teacher and matches its responses to old instructions paired with current observations. This extends supervision beyond stored historical examples without requiring additional expert replay data. Experiments across multiple VLA architectures and three LIBERO suites demonstrate improved success rates and reduced forgetting compared with ER under identical historical expert-data budgets. Additional RoboCasa and real-world experiments further support the effectiveness of XIA.

</details>


### [104] [RELAY: Learning Compatible Representations One Encoder at a Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31882)
*Yu Wang,Chuan Qin,Qiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RELAY 通过“先训练新查询编码器（带可学投影）+ 冻结，再训练新文档编码器”的两阶段方案，解决增量式图库重编码期间新旧文档嵌入并存的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 增量式图库重编码过程中，新旧文档嵌入同时存在，若直接替换会造成系统性能断崖；需要在回填期间保持检索可用。

Method: 两阶段训练：先用带可学投影的新查询编码器对齐原始图库并冻结，再训练新文档编码器；单次重编码过程中同一查询向量同时对新旧两版文档打分；回填完成后可选查询精炼，丢弃投影并复用已存文档向量。

Result: 在 COCO 与 Flickr30K 的三次文本-图像检索升级中，未改动图库上 Recall@1 较原系统提升 8.66–10.23 个百分点；直接重编码下按 Recall@1 曲线下面积计，Qwen-to-Qwen 升级排名第一，CLIP-to-Qwen 排名第二（原生打分与匹配校准两种设定）；固定嵌入时按文档版本分别校准可减小回填期 Recall@1 下降并改变最优方法归属；查询精炼后最终 Recall@1 与常规联合训练相差 0.97 个百分点以内。

Conclusion: RELAY 在嵌入升级过渡期显著保持检索质量，且最终性能接近联合训练，说明解耦式重编码是可行的增量升级范式。

Abstract: Old and new document embeddings coexist during incremental gallery re-encoding. RELAY trains a new query encoder with a learned projection against the original gallery, then freezes both to train the new document encoder. The same query vector scores both document versions throughout a single re-encoding pass. After backfill, optional query refinement drops the projection and reuses the stored document vectors. Across three text-to-image retrieval upgrades on COCO and Flickr30K, RELAY improves Recall@1 on untouched galleries by 8.66-10.23 percentage points over the original systems. For direct re-encoding, RELAY ranks first in both Qwen-to-Qwen upgrades and second in CLIP-to-Qwen by area under the Recall@1 curve, under both native scoring and matched calibration. With embeddings held fixed, calibrating scores separately for each document version can reduce drops in Recall@1 during backfill and change which method achieves the highest backfill AUC. After query refinement, final Recall@1 is within 0.97 percentage points of conventional joint training in all three upgrades.

</details>


### [105] [Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31358)
*Guo Chen,Fuxiao Liu,Haoqin Tu,Yiyang Zhou,Andrew Tao,Bryan Catanzaro,Cihang Xie,Yuyin Zhou,Huaxiu Yao,Didong Lu,Zongxia Li,Guilin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 agentic 框架 Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation，以 "Pixel as Code" 统一栅格图像的离散视觉 token 表示与结构化产物的显式程序表示，并配套 tokenizer、栅格生成器与结构化代码模型，在重建、编解码速度及多项视觉创作基准上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉创作既需要表现力强的图像生成，又需要对文本、布局与结构进行精确控制，现有方法难以在同一系统中兼顾二者。

Method: 1) 表示层：栅格图像用学到的离散视觉 token 表示，结构化产物（矢量图、网页、文档）用显式程序表示；2) 共享的生成—渲染接口将两类表示接入多类视觉反馈；3) Nemotron 原生 harness 协调规划与栅格候选选择，并对可编辑的结构化/混合产物做定向修复；4) 组件：Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer、自回归栅格生成器 Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B、结构化代码模型族 Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode。

Result: 约 178K 图像、六个视觉域上，tokenizer 将重建 PSNR 从 Emu3.5 IBQ 的 26.08 dB 提升至 29.57 dB，A100 batch size 1 下编码快 7.13x、解码快 10.93x；VisionCode 某变体在 Chart2Code、MMSVG、Design2Code、Image2Struct 综合指标上超过 Kimi K3.1 Pro；系统层面同栅格生成器下 GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM 由 31.71 升至 52.56；最佳配置在多数有对比的基准上与 GPT Image 2、Nano Banana Pro 相当。

Conclusion: "Pixel as Code" 与 agentic 编排可有效统合表现性生成与结构化精确控制，在组件级与系统级指标上均优于强基线，整体竞争力接近主流商用图像生成模型。

Abstract: Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure. We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code. Raster images are represented by learned discrete visual tokens, while structured artifacts use explicit programs. A shared generation-and-rendering interface connects these representations to visual feedback across images, vector graphics, webpages, and documents. A Nemotron-native harness coordinates planning and raster candidate selection, with targeted repair for editable structured and hybrid artifacts. To support this interface, we develop Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer, the autoregressive raster generator Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B, and the structured-code model family Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode. On approximately 178K images spanning six visual domains, our tokenizer improves reconstruction PSNR from 26.08 to 29.57 dB over Emu3.5 IBQ. It also provides 7.13x faster encoding and 10.93x faster decoding at batch size one on A100. In standalone evaluation, one Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode variant surpasses Kimi K3.1 Pro on the aggregate across Chart2Code, MMSVG, Design2Code, and Image2Struct. At the system level, the Nemotron-native configuration raises GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM from 31.71 to 52.56 using the same raster generator. With our best setting, Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation achieves performance competitive with GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro across most benchmarks with available comparisons.

</details>


### [106] [Ground, Guide, Act: Improving VLA Spatial Generalization with Multimodal Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31452)
*Guangting Zheng,Shaoxuan Wang,Yu Yuan,Zhipeng Tang,Jiajun Deng,Yanyong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MFM-VLA选择性协作框架：由多模态基础模型（MFM）负责目标定位与空间路径引导，控制器执行自由空间运动，VLA保留细粒度操作控制，并通过能力路由器决定是否介入，从而提升VLA的空间泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型能从机器人演示中学习动作策略，但对物体位置变化与任务目标变化泛化差；通用多模态基础模型（MFM）具备场景理解与空间推理能力，但速度慢、直接做细粒度控制不可靠。因此需要弄清MFM如何弥补VLA的空间泛化短板。

Method: 1）对多种VLA架构开展基于原子阶段干预的系统性能力分析，定位失败来源；2）构建MFM-VLA选择性协作框架：MFM提供目标定位与空间引导，控制器执行自由空间运动，VLA保留细粒度操作；3）用动作块级密集几何描述与扰动状态恢复数据微调VLA，提升对局部引导的跟随性与异常交接状态的恢复能力；4）设计经开发集校准的能力路由器，在直接VLA执行与MFM辅助执行间选择，避免不必要的干预。

Result: 能力分析发现多数失败源于目标定位（target grounding）不佳与全局空间路径规划（spatial routing）缺陷，而局部操作技能基本仍可用。实验中，MFM-VLA在LIBERO-PRO、ALOHA-Sim-PRO、RoboCasa365及真实化学任务上，相对对应基座VLA成功率分别提升14.9、74.0、3.6和30.9个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过按能力分工的“MFM规划+控制器导航+VLA操作”选择性协作，并配合动作块级几何监督与路由器决策，可显著改善VLA在物体位置与目标变化下的空间泛化，且在不同仿真基准与真实任务上均有效。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models effectively learn action policies from robot demonstrations, but struggle to generalize to changes in object positions and task goals. General multimodal foundation models (MFMs) offer complementary scene understanding and spatial reasoning, but remain slow and unreliable for direct fine-grained control. To understand how MFMs can improve VLA spatial generalization, we conduct a systematic capability analysis across multiple VLA architectures using atomic-stage interventions, revealing that many failures stem from poor target grounding and global spatial routing, while local manipulation skills remain largely usable. Based on these findings, we propose MFM-VLA, a selective collaboration framework in which an MFM provides target grounding and spatial guidance, controllers execute free-space motion, and the VLA retains control over fine-grained manipulation. We fine-tune the VLA with action-chunk-level dense geometric captions and perturbed-state recovery data to improve local guidance following and recovery from unfamiliar handoff states. A development-calibrated capability router selects between direct VLA execution and MFM-assisted execution to avoid unnecessary intervention. Across LIBERO-PRO, ALOHA-Sim-PRO, RoboCasa365, and real-world chemistry tasks, MFM-VLA improves success rates by 14.9, 74.0, 3.6, and 30.9 percentage points, respectively, over the corresponding base VLA. The project page is available at https://tom-zgt.github.io/MFM-VLA

</details>


### [107] [Generalizable Feed-Forward 3D Hand-Object Reconstruction with Coarse-to-Fine Contact Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31812)
*Seonghwan Park,Yong-Hoon Kwon,Min-Gyu Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HORCRUX：一个统一的前馈Transformer，实现从单张图像重建手-物3D姿态并估计二者接触，采用由粗到细的接触估计，对未见物体具泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联合前馈估计器依赖预定义物体集合，难以泛化到未见物体；且接触多由图像特征直接预测，缺少显式几何来精确定位接触。

Method: 冻结的基础模型从给定或图像重建的网格编码物体，避免物体特定知识；共享Transformer对物体与一/两只手联合推理以保持对齐；接触估计采用由粗到细策略：先由隐特征得到逐关节粗预测，再借助重建几何在手部更细区域上细化。

Result: 在七个基准上，物体与手部姿态精度在联合估计器中达SOTA，细粒度接触优于专用接触估计器。

Conclusion: 接触最好与重建联合估计，因为重建几何可直接用于定位接触。

Abstract: Reconstructing the 3D poses of hands and objects from a single image, together with the contact between them, is fundamental to understanding manipulation. To be practical, the reconstruction must generalize to unseen objects, and the contact must be localized precisely. Yet joint feed-forward estimators often rely on predefined object sets, while contact is typically predicted from image features alone, without the explicit geometry needed to localize it. To address both limitations, we present HORCRUX, a unified feed-forward transformer with coarse-to-fine contact estimation. For unseen objects, a frozen foundation model encodes the object from a given or image-reconstructed mesh rather than from object-specific knowledge. A shared transformer then reasons jointly over the object and one or two hands to keep them aligned. For precise contact, coarse per-joint predictions from latent features are resolved over finer hand regions using the reconstructed geometry.
