Across seven benchmarks, HORCRUX achieves state-of-the-art object and hand pose accuracy among joint estimators and outperforms a dedicated contact estimator in fine-grained contact. These results suggest that contact is best estimated jointly with reconstruction, whose geometry directly localizes it.

</details>


### [108] [LeanWAM: Learning Latent World Action Models from Frozen Video Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31740)
*Shaolong Li,Hongze Fu,Joyce Chai,Yinpei Dai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LeanWAM：从冻结视频生成器中蒸馏出少量预测token作为紧凑未来监督，仅1.4B参数即在LIBERO等基准上超越VLA/WAM基线，动作预测延迟25.1ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）需将大规模预训练视频生成器适配为同时预测未来观测与机器人动作，训练与部署成本高昂；且不清楚策略实际需要何种未来表征、能压缩到多紧凑。

Method: 探测研究表明互补的未来表征可压缩为少量token且保留大部分动作解码性能。据此设计两阶段训练：第一阶段Future Extractor将观测转移压缩为32个预测token，在冻结生成器条件下受动作、RGB、语义、几何多重监督，并从生成器隐状态紧凑读出世界token；第二阶段将两类表征蒸馏进策略，使策略从当前观测预测之并同时输出动作。

Result: 1.4B参数、无大规模具身预训练，在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0上优于强VLA与WAM基线；A100上动作块预测25.1ms，比代表性WAM快12.3–41.5倍。

Conclusion: 紧凑预测式监督即可将视频先验迁移到鲁棒且高效的控制策略，无需在线运行大生成器。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) typically adapt large pretrained video generators to jointly predict future observations and robot actions, incurring substantial training and deployment costs. However, it remains unclear which future representations a policy actually needs and how compactly they can be represented. Our probing study shows that complementary future representations can be compressed into a few tokens while retaining most of their action-decoding performance. Motivated by this finding, we introduce LeanWAM, a latent WAM that transfers video priors from a frozen video generator to a lightweight policy via two-stage training. In the first stage, a Future Extractor compresses observed transitions into 32 predictive tokens. These tokens condition the frozen generator and are jointly shaped by action, RGB, semantic, and geometric supervision, while a compact readout of the generator's hidden states supplies complementary world tokens. The second stage distills both representations into the policy, which learns to predict them from current observations while generating actions. With 1.4B parameters and no large-scale embodied pretraining, LeanWAM outperforms strong vision-language-action (VLA) and WAM baselines on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin~2.0. It predicts an action chunk in 25.1\,ms on an A100 GPU, 12.3--41.5$\times$ faster than representative WAMs. These results demonstrate that compact predictive supervision can transfer video priors to robust and efficient control.

</details>


### [109] [CSC-Mamba: Bridging multimodal convolutional sparse coding and state space models for multi-contrast MRI super-resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32144)
*Iman Marivani,David Van Hamme,Jan Aelterman,Wilfried Philips*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CSC-MAMBA，将深度展开的多模态卷积稀疏编码与 Vision Mamba 状态空间骨干统一，实现可解释的多对比度 MRI 超分辨重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多对比度 MRI 超分辨中，纯数据驱动网络依赖朴素拼接或黑箱交叉注意力等缺乏理论依据的启发式融合；基于模型的深度展开网络虽有显式先验，但其展开步骤受限于浅层卷积，缺乏捕获全局上下文的深层模块。

Method: 以展开的卷积稀疏编码从参考对比度中融合共享结构先验，再用 Mamba 状态空间骨干对对比度特定表征进行全局精炼，从而兼具模型引导的可解释融合与长程空间建模能力。

Result: 在 IXI 数据集上重建质量优于现有方法，PSNR 最高提升 0.62 dB，且计算效率保持良好。

Conclusion: CSC-MAMBA 通过统一深度展开稀疏编码与 Mamba 骨干，兼顾理论可解释性与全局上下文建模，为多对比度 MRI 超分辨提供了有效且高效的方案。

Abstract: Multi-contrast MRI super-resolution accelerates clinical protocols by reconstructing high-resolution (HR) target modalities from low-resolution (LR) inputs, guided by easily acquired reference contrasts. While purely data-driven deep neural networks achieve strong performance via rich representation capacity, they rely on heuristic fusion mechanisms (e.g., naive concatenation or black-box cross-attention) that lack theoretical grounding. Alternatively, model-based deep unfolding networks enforce principled cross-contrast fusion through explicit priors, yet their unrolled steps remain constrained to shallow convolutions, lacking modern deep blocks to capture global context. To bridge this gap, we propose CSC-MAMBA, unifying deep-unfolded multimodal convolutional sparse coding with the Vision Mamba state-space backbone. By fusing common structural priors from the guidance modality via unfolded sparse coding and globally refining contrast-specific representations with a Mamba back- bone, our approach benefits from interpretable, model-guided fusion and long-range spatial context. Experiments on the IXI dataset demonstrate that CSC-MAMBA outperforms state-of-the-art methods in reconstruction quality, achieving up to a 0.62 dB gain in PSNR while remaining computationally efficient.

</details>


### [110] [Instant LiDAR: Feed-Forward Gaussian Reconstruction for LiDAR Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32042)
*Xin Kang,Jiahui Huang,Jiawei Ren,Sipeng Zhang,Yu Chen,Weihua Zhang,Junjie Lai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Instant LiDAR：一种无需逐场景优化的前馈式管线，将多帧LiDAR扫描在数分钟内重建为可复用的高斯资产，支撑闭环自动驾驶仿真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LiDAR重建可支撑闭环自动驾驶仿真，但逐场景优化需数小时，使大规模资产库的构建与维护成本高昂；而直接用LiDAR点初始化高斯存在非均匀采样与视野受限问题：稀疏回波导致表面空洞，多帧拼接虽扩大覆盖却引入冗余图元。

Method: 提出前馈式Instant LiDAR管线，包含三项核心设计：（1）以测量为锚的高斯预测，在记录的回波点上锚定并细化高斯属性；（2）感知采样的高斯尺度，使空间支撑范围自适应LiDAR采样密度；（3）多帧融合，将重叠预测合并为覆盖整个驾驶日志的紧凑资产。

Result: 相较NuRec，在Physical AI（PAI）上重建速度约快46倍、在Waymo上约快70倍；在Waymo上取得可比的下游3D检测精度。

Conclusion: Instant LiDAR以分钟级前馈重建替代逐场景优化，在显著提升效率的同时保持下游任务精度，为大规模LiDAR高斯资产库的构建与维护提供了可行方案。

Abstract: LiDAR reconstruction supports closed-loop autonomous driving simulation, but hours of per-scene optimization make large asset libraries costly to build and maintain. We present Instant LiDAR, a feed-forward pipeline that reconstructs multiple LiDAR scans as reusable Gaussian assets in minutes without per-scene optimization. LiDAR measurements provide strong geometric priors, but directly initializing Gaussians from them yields poor reconstruction due to nonuniform sampling and a limited field of view. Sparse returns leave surface gaps, while combining scans expands coverage but introduces redundant primitives. To address these challenges, Instant LiDAR combines measurement-anchored Gaussian prediction, sampling-aware Gaussian scales, and multi-frame consolidation. The predictor refines attributes anchored to recorded returns, while the scales adapt spatial support to LiDAR sampling. Multi-frame consolidation merges overlapping predictions into a compact asset spanning the driving log. Compared with NuRec, Instant LiDAR reconstructs scenes approximately 46 times faster on Physical AI (PAI) and 70 times faster on Waymo. It also achieves comparable downstream 3D detection accuracy on Waymo.

</details>


### [111] [BodyWeave: Native Body-Conditioned 3D Garment Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32034)
*Junyi Zhang,Yuanchuan Wang,Qichao Wang,Wenzhe Qian,Shizhuo Cheng,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BodyWeave 通过原生 3D 人体条件统一服装生成与适配，在几何生成全程以人体为空间参照，实现高保真且低穿模的服装建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为数字角色生成 3D 服装需在保留参考设计的同时适配目标体形与姿态。缝合纸样方法难以复现陌生设计与精细细节；图像到 3D 生成器虽具丰富形状先验，但缺乏显式 3D 人体上下文。

Method: 基于 3D 生成先验，全流程以人体为空间参照：Global Body Adapter 在共享坐标帧中引导服装摆放与覆盖范围；Local Body Attention 借助邻近人体几何引导表面细化；Surface Penetration Loss 对解码表面施加监督以减少穿模；所得几何进一步条件化材质合成，生成具 PBR 属性的服装。并构建 GarmentWeave3D 数据集（293K 对齐服装–人体观测，含 114K 同设计跨体型配对）。

Result: 在域外 Artist-Created Garments 上取得高几何保真度与低人体穿透；跨体型评估显示对新穿着者适配准确、服装–人体间距一致；外观对比表明织物材质复现忠实。

Conclusion: 以人体为原生 3D 条件可将服装生成与适配统一于单一框架，兼顾设计保真、体型适配与材质真实感。

Abstract: Generating 3D garments for digital characters requires preserving a reference design while adapting the garment to the target body's shape and pose. Sewing-pattern methods can struggle to reproduce unfamiliar designs and fine details, while image-to-3D generators offer rich shape priors but typically lack explicit 3D body context. We present \textbf{BodyWeave}, a framework that unifies garment generation and fitting through native 3D body conditioning. Building on 3D generative priors, BodyWeave uses the body as a spatial reference throughout geometry generation: a \textbf{Global Body Adapter} guides garment placement and extent in the shared coordinate frame, while \textbf{Local Body Attention} guides surface refinement using nearby body geometry. A \textbf{Surface Penetration Loss} supervises decoded surfaces to reduce body intersections, and the resulting geometry conditions material synthesis to produce garments with physically based rendering attributes. To support learning across designs and wearers, we construct \textbf{GarmentWeave3D} with 293K aligned garment--body observations, including 114K same-design cross-body pairs. Evaluations on out-of-domain \textbf{Artist-Created Garments} demonstrate high geometric fidelity and low body penetration. Cross-body evaluations demonstrate accurate adaptation to new wearers with consistent garment--body spacing, while appearance comparisons show faithful fabric reproduction. Additional results and resources are available at https://gavin-jy.github.io/bodyweave-page/

</details>


### [112] [Do Occupancy World Models Really Follow Actions?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32029)
*Jongseong Bae,Ha Young Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ReCast，一种以自车轨迹为引导的Transformer占据世界模型，通过动作诱导的几何对应关系对齐跨帧特征，并构建反事实动作忠实性基准，在OOD轨迹下显著提升预测忠实性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有占据世界模型预测的未来3D场景未必忠实跟随给定轨迹（反事实动作下失效）。原因是驾驶数据集中每个场景的替代轨迹覆盖稀疏，模型只能从“场景—轨迹”组合中隐式学习自车运动的空间效应，导致动作效应与场景—轨迹相关性相互纠缠。

Method: 提出ReCast：以自车轨迹为引导的Transformer，将未来预测锚定在跨自车视角帧间由动作诱导的几何对应上；解耦历史编码与未来解码；利用相对自车变换对齐可变形交互（deformable interactions），同时保留对非刚性场景演化的建模灵活性；并构建覆盖分布内、尾部、分布外轨迹的反事实动作忠实性基准。

Result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上，ReCast在保持竞争力的标准预测性能的同时提升反事实预测能力，在分布外（OOD）轨迹下增益尤为明显。

Conclusion: 显式以自车轨迹作为几何先验对齐跨帧特征，可有效解耦动作效应与场景相关性，提升世界模型对反事实动作的忠实性，为可控场景预测提供新思路。

Abstract: Occupancy world models predict future 3D scenes conditioned on ego actions, yet their predictions may not faithfully follow the specified trajectory under counterfactual actions. Because driving datasets provide sparse coverage of alternative trajectories for each scene, existing models learn the spatial effect of ego motion implicitly from observed scene--trajectory combinations, which may entangle action effects with scene--trajectory correlations. We propose ReCast, an ego-trajectory-guided transformer that grounds future prediction in action-induced geometric correspondence across ego-centric frames. ReCast decouples historical encoding from future decoding and aligns deformable interactions using relative ego transformations, while retaining flexibility for non-rigid scene evolution. We also introduce a counterfactual action-faithfulness benchmark covering in-distribution, tail, and out-of-distribution trajectories. On Occ3D-nuScenes, ReCast achieves competitive standard forecasting performance while improving counterfactual forecasting, with particularly clear gains under out-of-distribution trajectories.

</details>


### [113] [WaveSR: Physics-Inspired Wave Evolution Attention for Efficient Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31984)
*Xiaoyan Lei,Biao Luo,Wenlong Zhang,Tingwen Huang,Chunhua Yang,Weihua Gui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出物理启发的波演化注意力框架WaveSR，利用二维波动方程在FFT域的闭式解析解实现频率-时间解耦的特征演化，用于高效图像超分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理启发神经网络具有可解释性，而波动方程的闭式频率-时间解耦解具备线性复杂度、各频率分量可独立演化，是高效图像超分辨率的潜在替代方案。

Method: 包含两个关键模块：波演化注意力（WEA）在FFT域通过二维波动方程解析解实现特征交互，不同频率分量借助可学习波速c与阻尼系数α独立演化；频率自适应前馈网络（FA-FFN）通过可学习谱调制实现自适应频率特征选择。训练上采用两阶段策略，混合目标由空域像素损失与频域损失组成。

Result: WEA支持各频率分量独立演化并保持线性复杂度；FA-FFN增强特征表示能力；混合空域-频域两阶段训练提升重建质量。

Conclusion: 该工作为物理启发神经网络用于高效图像超分辨率提供了初步探索。

Abstract: Recently, physics-inspired neural networks have gained widespread attention due to their interpretability. The closed-form, frequency-time decoupled solution of the wave equation offers linear complexity and allows different frequency components to evolve independently, making it a potential alternative solution for efficient image super-resolution. Therefore, a physics-inspired wave evolution attention framework is proposed, namely WaveSR. The WaveSR framework involves two key modules, i.e., wave evolution attention (WEA) and Frequency-Adaptive Feed-Forward Network (FA-FFN). The WEA module achieves feature interactions through the analytical solution of the 2D wave equation in the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) domain, enabling independent evolution of different frequency components with learnable wave speed \(c\) and damping coefficient \(α\). The FA-FFN module realizes adaptive frequency feature selection through learnable spectral modulation, effectively enhancing feature representation capability. Subsequently, we employ a two-stage training strategy with a hybrid objective that combines a spatial-domain pixel loss and a frequency-domain loss to improve reconstruction quality. Our method provides a preliminary exploration of physics-inspired neural networks for efficient image super-resolution.

</details>


### [114] [RoboProbe: Benchmarking Physical Plausibility of Robot World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32152)
*Zhuoying Yang,Jiachen Ni,Yichen Guo,Xiaoshan Wu,Mengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出五个定律特定的物理合理性度量（接触保真、物体持续性、固体性、机器人形变、物体形变），结合分割、跟踪、3D几何与外观比较得到的时空证据与VLM定向推理，并构建智能体评估框架RoboProbe及含761条人工标注生成视频和130条真实演示的RP-Bench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成视频被用于机器人规划的action proposal与可行性/安全评估，未检测的物理违规会导致错误的可行性判断；而现有视频生成器常产生物理上不合理的交互，VLM仅靠高层语义理解难以完成需要证据支撑的时空物理验证。

Method: 构建五个定律特定指标：将来自分割、跟踪、3D几何或外观比较的时空证据与针对性VLM推理相结合；在此基础上提出RoboProbe智能体式评估框架，协调各指标执行并通过受限动作选择性精化评估；同时构建RP-Bench，包含761条人工标注生成视频与239个操作任务（来自12个机器人数据集）的130条真实演示。

Result: 在RP-Bench上五个指标AUROC均超过0.85，优于所评估的学习型judge、既有评估器及仅用帧的Gemini基线；对五个视频生成器的应用揭示不同模型在违规类型与频率上呈现明显差异模式。

Conclusion: 证据支撑的定律特定指标加智能体协调，可有效、可解释地检测机器人世界模型生成视频中的物理违规，并揭示不同生成器的系统性物理缺陷。

Abstract: Evaluating the physical plausibility of generated videos is critical for reliable robotic planning with world models. These videos inform action proposal and assessment before real-world execution, so undetected physical violations can lead to erroneous assessments of action feasibility and safety. Yet current video generators often produce physically implausible interactions. Detecting such violations directly with vision-language models (VLMs) remains challenging as physical verification requires evidence-grounded spatiotemporal reasoning beyond high-level semantic understanding. We develop five law-specific metrics for evaluating physical plausibility by combining spatiotemporal evidence from segmentation, tracking, 3D geometry, or appearance comparisons with targeted VLM reasoning: Contact fidelity, Object persistence, Solidity, Robot deformation, and Object deformation. Building on this metric suite, we introduce RoboProbe, an agentic evaluation framework that coordinates metric execution and selectively refines evaluations through constrained actions. To evaluate the physical plausibility of robot world models, we further introduce RP-Bench, with 761 human-labeled generated videos and 130 real demonstrations of 239 manipulation tasks from 12 robot datasets. On RP-Bench, all five metrics achieve AUROCs above 0.85 and outperform the evaluated learned judges, prior evaluators, and a frames-only Gemini baseline. Applying these metrics to five video generators reveals distinct patterns of physical violations across models, in both violation types and frequencies.

</details>


### [115] [Improving Character Identity Consistency in Diffusion-Based Visual Story Generation through Identity Memory and Automatic Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32383)
*Maria-Emilia Grigore,Stelian Spînu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出模块化pipeline（SDXL+LoRA+ControlNet+IP-Adapter+Best-of-K重排序+身份记忆）提升多帧视觉故事生成的角色身份一致性，并在自建分级基准上验证可降低身份漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型生成连续帧视觉故事时，角色面部特征、服装、视觉风格与解剖比例常出现显著变化，跨帧身份一致性仍为开放难题。

Method: 基于Stable Diffusion XL的模块化系统：LoRA微调实现角色个性化，ControlNet进行姿态结构控制，IP-Adapter进行视觉身份迁移；引入基于Best-of-K候选选择的自动重排序机制与持久化身份记忆以挑选最一致的图像；同时将StoryDiffusion框架整合并扩展为可复现的本地工作流，并改进帧选择策略。

Result: 在包含多角色、按易/中/难分级组织的自建基准上，采用CLIP图像相似度、DINO相似度与CLIP图文对齐等自动指标评估SDXL基线、Best-of-K、身份记忆、完整pipeline及StoryDiffusion扩展版本，结果显示重排序、身份记忆与视觉条件控制可降低跨帧身份漂移，并提升整体连贯性与稳定性。

Conclusion: 将个性化微调、结构/身份条件控制与自动候选选择相结合，可有效缓解多帧故事生成中的角色身份漂移，且该模块化流程具备可复现性。

Abstract: Automatic visual story generation using diffusion-based models has become an increasingly important research direction in generative artificial intelligence. However, maintaining character identity consistency across consecutive frames remains an open challenge, as existing models often produce significant variations in facial traits, clothing, visual style, or anatomical proportions. This paper proposes a modular pipeline to improve character identity consistency in multi-frame visual story generation using Stable Diffusion XL alongside additional conditioning and automatic selection mechanisms. The proposed system integrates LoRA fine-tuning for character personalization, ControlNet for pose-based structural control, and IP-Adapter for visual identity transfer. Furthermore, a reranking mechanism based on Best-of-K candidate selection and persistent identity memory is introduced to automatically select the most visually consistent generated images. The work also includes integrating and extending the StoryDiffusion framework into a reproducible local workflow, along with improvements for generated frame selection. Performance evaluation uses automatic metrics such as CLIP image similarity, DINO similarity, and CLIP text-image alignment. Experimental evaluation was conducted on a custom benchmark of multiple characters and visual stories organized into difficulty levels (easy, medium, and difficult). Both progressive variants of the proposed pipeline and extended versions of StoryDiffusion were evaluated, including SDXL baseline, Best-of-K, Identity Memory, and the Full Pipeline. Results show that reranking, identity memory, and visual conditioning reduce identity drift across frames and improve the overall coherence and stability of generated visual stories.

</details>


### [116] [Sub-Riemannian structure for Oriented Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32361)
*Thomas Besnier,Stefan Sommer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出在位置-法向空间定义次黎曼接触度量，用显式 score 近似距离，替代欧氏局部性以缓解薄结构跨面特征泄漏，提升接触处分割与对应精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D（有向）点云框架在环境欧氏空间定义局部性（kNN图、半径球），会把空间相近但几何上不同的采样表面（如薄叶两面）误合并，导致特征跨边界泄漏、性能下降。

Method: 在 M=R^3×S^2 上定义次黎曼接触度量：点提升为 (x,n)，运动约束于非完整水平分布，空间速度须在法向正交平面内，且重新定向需付代价；由此导出可局部近似距离的显式score，用于比较有向点。

Result: 将该score作为可直接替换项嵌入PointNet++聚合机制，提升了接触附近的分割与对应精度；用于在有向点上模拟热扩散时减少了泄漏。

Conclusion: 以几何感知的接触度量替代欧氏局部性，可有效抑制薄结构跨面信息混合，为有向点云的下游任务提供简单可插入的改进方案。

Abstract: Many frameworks dealing with 3D (oriented) point clouds define locality in the ambient Euclidean space: $k$-nearest-neighbor graphs and radius balls in $\mathbb{R}^3$ are critical to define which points are "close to one another" and should exchange information. This can unintentionally merge sampled surfaces that are close in space but geometrically distinct such as the two faces of a thin leaf. Then, features are more prone to leak across boundaries which hinder performance. To address this, we propose to define a sub-Riemannian contact metric on position-orientation space $\mathbb{M}=\mathbb{R}^3\times \mathbb{S}^2$: points are lifted to $(x,n)$ with $n$ a surface normal, and "motion" is constrained to a non-holonomic horizontal distribution in which spatial velocity must stay in the plane orthogonal to the normal which can reorient at a cost. From this, we derive an explicit score, which locally approximate the distance, to compare oriented points for downstream tasks. We report improved segmentation and correspondence accuracy near contact when using the score as a drop-in change inside PointNet++ aggregation mechanism as well as reduced leakage when using it to simulate heat diffusion on oriented points.

</details>


### [117] [LookAnything: A Foundation Model for Holistic Gaze Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32351)
*Jiayu Tang,Yuchen Zhou,Hongsheng Wu,Hanjing Ye,Ke Huang,Cheng Wang,Yuqin Dai,Yufei Huang,Yonggen Ling,Chao Gou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出统一注视中心任务的基础模型 LookAnything，用可学习注视先验查询替代辅助输入，并构建 HoliGaze 大规模多任务语料库。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有注视跟随方法依赖高度定制化架构与头部裁剪、深度图等辅助输入，导致级联误差与推理开销；且多在单一域训练、局限于热力图输出的孤立注视跟随任务，缺乏灵活性与泛化性。

Method: 构建 LookAnything 基础模型，统一多种注视中心任务（定位、描述、推理）；核心引入可学习注视先验查询以促进注视感知表征学习，免除外部辅助输入；输出形式涵盖点、框、热力图与语言；并构建 HoliGaze 语料库与基准（311K 问答对，覆盖5个能力维度、9项任务），进行大规模多任务与跨域训练。

Result: 在整体注视跟随任务上稳定优于33个领先视觉语言模型；在5个常规目标检测基准上与专用专家模型相比仍具高度竞争力；在未见数据集与真实机器人部署上验证了强域外泛化与灵活适应能力。

Conclusion: LookAnything 以注视先验查询与大规模多任务跨域训练实现了统一、灵活、可泛化的注视理解范式，摆脱辅助输入依赖，并通过 HoliGaze 基准推动该方向研究。

Abstract: Human gaze provides a rich window into attention and intent, making its understanding essential for applications ranging from social signal analysis to human-robot interaction. Existing methods typically employ highly customized architectures relying on auxiliary inputs like head crops or depth maps, causing cascading errors and inference overhead. Trained on single domains and confined to isolated gaze following with heatmap outputs, they lack flexibility and generalization for diverse interactive scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present LookAnything, a foundation model that unifies diverse gaze-centric tasks for holistic gaze following. Benefiting from large-scale multi-task and cross-domain training, LookAnything flexibly adapts to various settings, generating diverse outputs (points, boxes, heatmaps, and language) and supporting broad gaze-centric localization, description, and reasoning. At its core, we introduce learnable gaze-prior queries to promote gaze-aware representation learning, eliminating the need for auxiliary external inputs. To facilitate this paradigm, we construct HoliGaze, a comprehensive corpus and benchmark comprising 311K question-answer pairs across 5 capability dimensions and 9 distinct tasks. Experiments demonstrate that LookAnything consistently outperforms 33 leading vision-language models on holistic gaze following, while remaining highly competitive with dedicated specialists across 5 conventional target detection benchmarks. Evaluation on unseen datasets and deployment on a real robot further validate its strong out-of-domain generalization and flexible adaptation in real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [118] [Part-Set Prototypes for Explainable Mountain Gazelles Sex Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32343)
*Tali Boneh Shitrit,Amir Kedem,Ilan Shimshoni,Anna Zamansky*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出set prototypes架构，从数据中同时挖掘部件数量与无约束空间布局，在冻结DINOv3 token网格上用截断Sinkhorn竞争做联合匹配，实现无需刚性几何约束的可自解释细粒度识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可自解释视觉模型依赖刚性几何约束，难以刻画野外影像中多样化的语义形状；相机陷阱数据还面临姿态、光照、遮挡、伪装及环境捷径等挑战。

Method: 引入set prototypes通用架构，部件基数与空间布局均直接从数据挖掘；采用联合匹配公式，通过截断Sinkhorn竞争将部件同时放置于冻结的DINOv3 token网格上，使无支持部件可弃权而不发生空间坍缩。

Result: 在山羊性别分类相机陷阱基准上取得0.878 macro-F1，优于既有架构并与无约束线性探针相当；最强原型定位于角、颈、躯干等生物特征区域，可供生态学家视觉核验。

Conclusion: 该公式可自然推广至单一物种之外的多种生态监测任务，兼具性能与可解释性。

Abstract: Self-explainable visual models for fine-grained recognition are often hindered by rigid geometric constraints that cannot capture diverse semantic shapes in unconstrained "in-the-wild" imagery. Real-world camera-trap data introduces challenges, including non-optimal poses, lighting variations, occlusions, animal camouflage, and environmental shortcuts. To address this, we introduce set prototypes, a general architecture where both part cardinality and unconstrained spatial layouts are mined directly from data. Our joint-matching formulation places parts simultaneously on a frozen DINOv3 token grid via truncated Sinkhorn competition, allowing unsupported parts to abstain without spatial collapse. We evaluate our approach on Mountain Gazelle sex classification, a camera-trap benchmark, where our model achieves 0.878 macro-F1--outperforming prior architectures and at par with an unconstrained linear probe. The strongest prototypes localize to distinctive biological areas such as horns, neck and body, allowing ecologists to visually verify decisions before trusting the metric. This formulation generalizes naturally to diverse ecological monitoring challenges beyond a single species.

</details>


### [119] [Get the Next Moment Right: Short-Term Event Planning for Physically Plausible Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32337)
*Hao Liu,Xiang Tang,Ruotong Li,Xiaopeng Fan,Yujiu Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STEP：免训练闭环框架，以短视频片段为单位逐轮引导视频生成，提升物理合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型能合成逼真画面，但物理演化不合理。已有方法在生成前一次性预测整段视频的运动轨迹作为引导，预测误差会沿时间累积，导致后续帧质量退化。

Method: STEP（Short-Term Event Planning）采用闭环、逐短视频生成的四步流程：①grounding，从最新生成帧中测量场景状态；②event planning，预测下一物理事件并渲染为控制片段；③latent-guided generation，在该控制下于潜空间生成下一短视频；④verification，检验事件是否发生，若未发生则重采样该片段。

Result: 在 Physics-IQ Verified 与 PhyGenBench 两个基准上，STEP 提升了三个冻结生成器的物理合理性。

Conclusion: 由于每轮均以实际生成帧为基准进行落地，控制仅依赖可靠的短程预测，避免了长程误差累积；该方法免训练，可直接迁移到新生成器。

Abstract: Video generation models synthesize realistic imagery yet still struggle to produce physically plausible evolution. Existing methods guide generation with a motion trajectory predicted for the entire clip in advance, so prediction errors accumulate and degrade later frames. We propose STEP(Short-Term Event Planning), a training-free closed-loop framework that guides generation one short clip at a time. Each round consists of four steps: grounding measures the scene state from the latest frames, event planning predicts the next physical event and renders it into a control clip, latent-guided generation produces the next short clip under this control, and verification checks whether the event occurs and resamples the clip if it does not. Because each round is grounded in the frames actually generated, control relies only on reliable short-range predictions. STEP improves the physical plausibility of three frozen generators on Physics-IQ Verified and PhyGenBench, and can be applied to new generators without training.

</details>


### [120] [Query-Guided Visual Minimization for Selective Disclosure to Cloud VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32302)
*Pedram Zaree,Kleomenis Katevas,Vandana Rajan,Nael Abu-Ghazaleh,Hamed Haddadi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出查询引导的视觉最小化框架 QGVM，在传输前保留查询相关视觉内容、抑制不必要敏感披露，兼顾任务效用与隐私。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云端 VLM 需将图像传出本地信任边界，可能泄露查询并不需要的敏感信息；现有查询无关匿名化无法按查询需求区分必要与非必要披露。

Method: QGVM 将查询接地与独立的敏感项清单结合，在类型、实例、文本内容三个层级判定披露必要性，并为黑盒下游 VLM 渲染最小化图像。

Result: GPT-6.1 Sol 下 DoxBench 正确率 85.3% vs PGP 77.5%；地理定位攻击 1 km 内成功率 5.8% vs 未保护 25.7%；Scene-Privacy 人脸重识别从 27.7%(PGP) 降至 4.5%；BIV-Priv-Seg 私文恢复从 33.9% 降至 15.3%；成对查询披露切换正确率 69.6% vs 仅接地裁剪 29.1%。

Conclusion: 区分视觉相关性与披露必要性具有价值，同时揭示选择性视觉披露存在隐私—效用权衡。

Abstract: Cloud-hosted vision-language models (VLMs) require sending images beyond the user's local trust boundary, potentially exposing sensitive information the query does not need. We study query-guided visual minimization: a trusted local transformation preserves query-relevant visual content and reduces unnecessary disclosure before transmission. Unlike query-agnostic anonymization, it preserves the same sensitive content when the query requires it and suppresses it otherwise. We introduce QGVM, a framework that combines query grounding with an independent sensitive-item inventory, determines disclosure necessity at the type, instance, and text-content levels, and renders a minimized image for a black-box downstream VLM. We evaluate QGVM on complementary benchmarks measuring task utility, directly recoverable sensitive information, and inferential geolocation leakage. With OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol, QGVM achieves 85.3% DoxBench answer correctness versus 77.5% for PGP, while a separately prompted Sol geolocation attacker succeeds within 1 km on 5.8% of QGVM images versus 25.7% of unprotected images. On Scene-Privacy, QGVM reduces face re-identification from 27.7% (PGP) to 4.5%. On held-out BIV-Priv-Seg, unnecessary private-text recovery falls from 33.9% (PGP) to 15.3%. To verify that disclosure is query-dependent, we evaluate paired queries that either require or do not require the same sensitive information. QGVM achieves 69.6% correct disclosure switching, compared with 29.1% for grounding-only cropping. These findings highlight the value of distinguishing visual relevance from disclosure necessity, while revealing the privacy-utility trade-offs of selective visual disclosure.

</details>


### [121] [MaskedVGGT: Masked Multi-View Transformers Are Scalable 3D Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32297)
*Zichen Zou,Xiaosong Jia,Wen-Ming Chen,Zuxuan Wu,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MaskedVGGT 冻结预训练的 2D 编码器，仅预训练随机初始化的多视角 Transformer，通过无标注的掩码自蒸馏学习跨视角交互，在 1B 规模下优于同数据同架构的监督式 VGGT-Ω 及 CroCo、MuM、Muskie、E-RayZer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视图前馈模型可扩展性强，但依赖昂贵的几何标注，限制了数据规模。现有 3D 自监督方法（CroCo、MuM、Muskie 的跨视图补全，RayZer、E-RayZer 的新视图合成）通常联合学习图像表示与跨视图交互，从零学习单图像表示既冗余，又无法利用 DINO、CLIP、前沿 VLM 等 2D 基础模型的持续进展。

Method: 冻结强预训练 2D 编码器，仅预训练新增的随机初始化多视角 Transformer。采用无标注掩码自蒸馏：学生网络基于完整 anchor 视图与重度掩码的其余视图预测被掩码位置的目标，EMA 教师网络基于未掩码输入提供预测目标。预训练后微调，并与同数据、同架构、同优化更新总数的单阶段监督 VGGT-Ω 训练对比。

Result: 在最高 1B 参数的各模型规模上，MaskedVGGT 预训练+微调优于相同训练数据、架构与优化更新总数的单阶段监督 VGGT-Ω；同时优于 E-RayZer、CroCo、MuM 和 Muskie。加入额外无标注视频扩展预训练可进一步提升泛化性，所学表示可迁移至多样下游任务。

Conclusion: 结果支持一种有效的学习分工：从 2D 预训练复用强图像表示，并从无标注多视图数据中学习跨视角交互，无需依赖几何标注；也证实以强 2D 表示为基础构建多视图预训练的有效性。

Abstract: Multi-view feed-forward models show strong scalability, but their reliance on costly geometric annotations limits data scaling. Existing 3D self-supervised approaches reduce this reliance through cross-view completion (e.g., CroCo, MuM, Muskie) or novel-view synthesis (e.g., RayZer, E-RayZer), typically learning image representations and cross-view interactions jointly. We argue that learning single image representations from scratch is unnecessary for 3D pretraining methods, as doing so fails to benefit from the continuing advances in 2D foundation models (e.g., DINO, CLIP, frontier VLMs). We introduce MaskedVGGT, which freezes a strong pretrained 2D encoder and pretrains only an added, randomly initialized multi-view transformer, focusing on learning interactions across views. MaskedVGGT pretrains the multi-view transformer through masked self-distillation without annotations: a student predicts targets at masked locations based on complete anchor views and heavily masked remaining views, while an exponential-moving-average teacher provides prediction targets based on unmasked inputs. In experiments across model sizes up to 1B parameters, MaskedVGGT pretraining followed by fine-tuning outperforms single-stage supervised VGGT-$Ω$ training with the same training data, model architecture, and total number of optimization updates. MaskedVGGT also outperforms E-RayZer, CroCo, MuM, and Muskie, providing evidence for the effectiveness of building multi-view pretraining on strong 2D representations. Finally, extending pretraining with additional unlabeled videos further improves generalization, and the learned representations transfer to diverse downstream tasks. These results demonstrate an effective division of learning: reuse strong image representations from 2D pretraining and learn cross-view interactions from unlabeled multi-view data without relying on geometric annotations.

</details>


### [122] [CaveBench: Benchmarking Abductive Physical Reasoning from Internal Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32251)
*Guanxin Lin,Chen Yang,Shenxiang Zeng,Honghui Zhu,Xin Li,Wenbo Deng,Jiansheng Fan,Chen Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CaveBench 基准，测试视觉语言模型能否从装置内部观测反向推断被隐藏的外部操作（溯因物理推理）；27 种 VLM 配置在六事件完整序列上最好仅 68.0%（闭源）与 12.5%（开源）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 在物理推理上不断进步，但能否从内部观测理解外部物理驱动因素仍未知；现有基准未专门针对这一"溯因"设定。

Method: 构建 CaveBench：模型仅获得装置描述与内部图像，外部控制被隐藏，需推断导致观测响应的操作。覆盖 5 个物理域、20 个装置场景、10,200 个仿真回合（9,000 训练 / 1,000 验证 / 200 测试）；问题涵盖 1–6 个事件，且每个事件都要求给出完整控制集；同步观测与控制记录作为输入与参考答案。评估 27 种 VLM 配置及 7 个适配基线。

Result: 六事件精确匹配最强闭源模型 68.0%、最强开源权重模型 12.5%；7 个适配基线显示单事件性能提升未必转化为完整序列提升；误差分析将失败归为视觉识别、物理推断、证据整合、动作组合四类。

Conclusion: 当前模型在将内部现象与外部原因对应上仍存在系统性短板，尤其在全序列溯因与动作组合层面；CaveBench 为诊断该类能力提供了细粒度评测框架。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are advancing in physical reasoning, but whether they can understand external physical drivers from internal observations remains an open question. Existing benchmarks have not specifically targeted this setting. To this end, we introduce CaveBench, a benchmark for abductive physical reasoning from internal observations. Models receive apparatus descriptions and internal images while the external controls remain hidden, and must infer the operations responsible for the observed responses. CaveBench spans 20 apparatus scenes in five physical domains and contains 10,200 simulated episodes, split into 9,000 training, 1,000 validation, and 200 test episodes. Questions span one to six events and require the complete control set at every event, testing whether an explanation accounts for the entire process. Synchronized observations and control records provide the inputs and reference answers. Evaluating 27 VLM configurations yields six-event exact-match accuracies of 68.0% for the strongest closed-source model and 12.5% for the strongest open-weight model. Seven adaptation baselines show that single-event gains need not improve complete sequences. Error analysis identifies failures in visual identification, physical inference, evidence integration, and action composition, specifying where current models struggle to connect internal phenomena with their external causes.

</details>


### [123] [FaceNet versus VGG Features in Wasserstein Distortion for Face Image Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32220)
*Xinyu Wang,Jona Ballé*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在Cool-Chic编解码器中用FaceNet中间特征替换Wasserstein失真目标里的VGG特征，在约0.15 bpp等码率下对20张LFW人脸图像进行对比，人类成对主观实验中FaceNet重建被偏好率达72.5%，20张中16张获多数被试偏好，表明WD中特征网络的选择会影响人脸压缩感知质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Wasserstein失真（WD）目标依赖为通用图像分类训练的VGG等网络特征，但这类特征未必能反映压缩人脸图像的感知质量，因此作者探究人脸识别网络特征是否更贴合人脸的感知质量评价。

Method: 在Cool-Chic编解码器中，将基于WD的目标中的VGG特征替换为FaceNet的中间特征图，构建FaceNet-based WD目标；在20张LFW人脸图像上，于约0.15 bits per pixel的匹配平均码率下比较两种目标；并开展初步的成对（pairwise）人类主观研究。

Result: FaceNet-based重建在72.5%的判断中被偏好，且在20张图像中有16张获得多数被试偏好（等码率约0.15 bpp条件下）。

Conclusion: WD内部特征网络的选择会影响人脸图像的感知质量；人脸识别特征是人脸感知压缩（face-aware perceptual compression）的一个有前景的方向。该研究为初步结果，样本规模较小。

Abstract: Wasserstein distortion (WD) compares local statistics of deep features and has been used to optimize learned image codecs for perceptual quality, but existing WD objectives rely on features from networks trained for generic image classification, such as VGG. We ask whether features from a face recognition network better reflect the perceived quality of compressed faces. In the Cool-Chic codec, we replace the VGG features in a WD-based objective with intermediate feature maps of FaceNet, and compare the two objectives on 20 LFW face images at a matched average bitrate of about 0.15 bits per pixel. In a preliminary pairwise human study, FaceNet-based reconstructions were preferred in 72.5% of judgments and by a majority of participants on 16 of the 20 images. These results suggest that the choice of feature network inside WD affects the perceived quality of face images, and that face recognition features are a promising direction for face-aware perceptual compression.

</details>


### [124] [Seeing Is Not Reaching: Instruction Shortcuts Override Visual Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32206)
*Qing Zhang,Xuesong Li,Zhaoyuan Yang,Changlin Song,Xinyu Tian,Jing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文揭示视觉-语言-动作模型(VLA)存在"看见却够不到"现象：模型具备视觉定位能力却常被指令捷径覆盖，作者提出免训练的路径分离引导(PSG)来放大定位通路、抑制捷径，显著提升位置扰动下的目标到达率与任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型被认为继承了视觉-语言模型的视觉定位能力，但物体被移动后模型仍倾向于伸向其在训练数据中的原始位置。作者希望厘清这种定位能力究竟未被使用，还是被其他通路覆盖，从而找出失效根源。

Method: 在六个VLA模型上识别出两种捷径：场景捷径（机械臂沿用场景原有任务，即便指令已变）与指令捷径（指令直接检索物体在训练中的位置）。以π_{0.5}为对象，观察到尽管物体名称注意力跟随移动后的目标，指令捷径仍持续存在。为判定定位通路的"未被使用"还是"被覆盖"，分别对图像中介的定位通路和指令到动作的直接通路进行掩码干预：掩码定位通路会消除对移动目标的伸取，掩码直接通路反而增加之。据此提出路径分离引导(PSG)，在无训练、无外部目标位置输入的情况下放大定位信号并抑制捷径。

Result: 在LIBERO-PRO Object的位置扰动设定下，PSG将目标到达率从22.0%提升至52.6%，任务成功率从16.6%提升至40.8%，同时在原始任务上基本保持原有性能。

Conclusion: VLA模型的视觉定位实际上已在引导动作，但常被经由直接通路的指令捷径所覆盖，形成"看见却够不到"的表象。通过路径层面的分离与调制（PSG）即可在不重训练的条件下部分恢复定位主导的行为，说明失效更多源于通路竞争而非能力缺失。

Abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are expected to inherit visual grounding from vision-language models, yet often reach for an object's training location after it has been moved. Across six VLAs, we identify two shortcuts: a scene shortcut, where the arm follows the scene's original task despite a new instruction, and an instruction shortcut, where the instruction retrieves the requested object's training location. In $π_{0.5}$, the instruction shortcut persists even though object-name attention follows the moved target. We call this Seeing Is Not Reaching. To determine whether this grounding is unused or overridden, we separately mask an image-mediated grounding pathway and a direct instruction-to-action pathway. Masking the grounding pathway eliminates reaches to moved targets, whereas masking the direct pathway increases them. Thus, grounding already guides action but is often overridden by the instruction shortcut, which acts through the direct pathway. We introduce Pathway-Separated Guidance (PSG), which amplifies grounding and suppresses the shortcut without training or external target locations. On LIBERO-PRO Object under Position perturbations, PSG raises the target-reaching rate from 22.0% to 52.6% and task success from 16.6% to 40.8%, while largely preserving performance on the original tasks.

</details>


### [125] [SplatTok: Data-Driven Compression of 3D Gaussian Splats with Scene-Level Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32202)
*Sai Karthikey Pentapati,Shashank Nelamangala Sridhara,Birendra Kathariya,Peng Yin,Guandao Yang,Alan C. Bovik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SplatTok是一个学习式场景重合成编解码器：用transformer将现有3DGS编码为紧凑的、空间锚定的潜变量token，再由共享解码器合成一组全新的标准高斯基元，通过渲染监督训练，实现约75–110倍压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D高斯泼溅虽支持实时渲染，但存储开销巨大。现有压缩方法要么直接编码给定splat的基元，要么为每个场景独立优化紧凑表示。而一个splat只是场景的一种实现：不同基元排布可产生几乎相同的渲染视图，这一自由度未被解码端利用。

Method: 提出SplatTok：(1) transformer将输入splat编码为紧凑、空间锚定的潜变量token；(2) 共享解码器合成一组新的标准高斯基元，不保持与输入的对应关系；(3) 表示通过渲染监督而非基元重建来学习；(4) 压缩时采用量化感知的潜变量搜索，仅优化场景码、冻结网络，以弥补编码器剩余误差。

Result: 在标准基准上，仅用输入splat的渲染图进行潜变量搜索（不使用原始训练图像）时，SplatTok 以4–6.5倍更小的文件达到与前馈编解码器FCGS相当的PSNR，对输入splat压缩约75–110倍；使用训练图像时可超过逐场景方法HAC++的PSNR，且文件小13–41%。在DL3DV上训练的单一模型可泛化到含数百万高斯的未见场景，并支持多种目标码率而无需重训练。

Conclusion: 利用渲染等价的多解自由度、在解码端重合成基元，是一种有效的3DGS压缩范式；学习式通用编解码器可在显著减小文件的同时保持甚至超越重建质量，并具备跨场景泛化与多码率适应能力。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian splats enable real-time rendering but require substantial storage. Existing compression methods either encode the primitives of a given splat or optimize a compact representation independently for each scene. Yet a Gaussian splat is only one realization of a scene: different arrangements of primitives can produce nearly identical rendered views. We exploit this freedom on the decoding side with SplatTok, a learned scene-resynthesis codec. Trained across thousands of real-world scenes, a transformer encodes an existing splat into compact, spatially anchored latent tokens, and a shared decoder synthesizes a new set of standard Gaussian primitives without preserving correspondence to the input. The representation is learned through rendering supervision rather than primitive reconstruction. At compression time, a quantization-aware latent search refines only the scene code, keeping the networks frozen, and closes most of the encoder's remaining error. On standard benchmarks, using only renders of the input splat for the latent search, without the original training images, SplatTok matches the PSNR of the feed-forward codec FCGS with 4 to 6.5 times smaller files, compressing input splats about 75 to 110 times. With the training images, it exceeds the PSNR of the per-scene method HAC++ with 13 to 41% smaller files. A single model trained on DL3DV generalizes to unseen scenes with millions of Gaussians and supports multiple target rates without retraining.

</details>


### [126] [MoGe-4D: Efficient, Flexible, and Unified Dense 4D Reconstruction and Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32198)
*Ruicheng Wang,Linlin Xin,Sicheng Xu,Jianfeng Xiang,Zelong Lv,Yu Deng,Yue Dong,Guangzhong Sun,Tong Zhang,Jiaolong Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoGe-4D 是一个前馈框架，通过“成对的 allocentric/egocentric 动态点图（dynamic point map）有序查询”统一几何与运动预测，实现从 RGB 视频重建动态场景并做稠密 3D 跟踪；配套 RigIDTrack 合成数据管线以刚性正则化仿射体压缩表面动态，并以约 15% 存储开销精确恢复任意帧 3D 轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从 RGB 视频重建动态场景需同时推理跨视角的 3D 几何与运动。现有方法存在两类缺陷：一是将重建与跟踪拆分为碎片化流水线（pipeline），缺乏统一性；二是稠密时空解码（dense spatiotemporal decoding）代价过高，难以灵活高效地支持稠密查询。此外，监督稠密 4D 查询需要连续 3D 对应关系，而原始轨迹存储开销过大。

Method: 1) 统一查询表示：以成对的 allocentric（世界/目标帧）与 egocentric（相机/源帧）动态点图作为有序查询，每个 query 将源像素同时映射到目标时刻的两个相机坐标系中，从而以闭式解（closed form）求相对相机位姿，并可灵活服务于深度估计、动态配准与稠密 3D 跟踪。2) 解耦式高效解码：将场景建模与查询解码分离——高容量 context encoder 一次性缓存粗粒度全局时空特征，轻量 query encoder 在灵活分辨率下快速解码稠密点图。3) 数据侧：提出 RigIDTrack 合成数据管线与数据集，将表面动态压缩为刚性正则化（rigidity-regularized）的仿射体（affine bodies），以约 15% 的 RGB-D 视频存储开销恢复任意帧的精确 3D 轨迹。

Result: 在多个基准上，MoGe-4D 取得最优的稠密 3D 跟踪性能，重建精度与专用 3D 基础模型（3D foundation models）相当，且运行速度显著快于既有 4D 基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过统一的双帧点图查询表示与场景建模/查询解码解耦的设计，MoGe-4D 以单一前馈框架同时完成几何重建、位姿求解与稠密 3D 跟踪，兼顾精度与效率；RigIDTrack 则以紧凑的刚性仿射表示解决了稠密 4D 监督的存储瓶颈。

Abstract: Reconstructing dynamic scenes from RGB video requires reasoning about both 3D geometry and motion across viewpoints, yet existing methods either split reconstruction and tracking into fragmented pipelines or face prohibitive dense spatiotemporal decoding costs. We introduce MoGe-4D, a feed-forward framework that unifies geometry and motion prediction via ordered queries of paired allocentric and egocentric dynamic point maps. Each query maps source pixels to a target time simultaneously in both camera frames, resolving relative camera pose in closed form while flexibly serving depth, dynamic registration, and dense 3D tracking. For efficient dense querying, MoGe-4D decouples scene modeling from query decoding: a high-capacity context encoder caches coarse global spatiotemporal features once, while a lightweight query encoder rapidly decodes dense point maps at flexible resolutions. Furthermore, as supervising dense 4D queries demands continuous 3D correspondences whose raw trajectory storage is prohibitive, we introduce RigIDTrack, a synthetic data pipeline and dataset that compresses surface dynamics into rigidity-regularized affine bodies, recovering exact arbitrary-frame 3D trajectories with $\sim15\%$ storage overhead over RGB-D video. Across diverse benchmarks, MoGe-4D achieves state-of-the-art dense 3D tracking, matches dedicated 3D foundation models in reconstruction, and runs substantially faster than prior 4D baselines.

</details>


### [127] [TDD: Target-Discrepancy Distillation for Underwater Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32467)
*Zefan Feng,Zhaocheng Yu,Laibin Chang,Kui Jiang,Junjun Jiang,Xiaopeng Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出目标-差异知识蒸馏（TDD）用于水下图像增强：将参考图像的目标外观与配对特征残差（差异）两种表征联合蒸馏进轻量引导网络，推理时仅需退化图像，并用渐进知识融合实现"先校正-后细化"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下退化改变图像外观，削弱引导增强的语义线索；仅识别场景内容并不能明确指定应恢复的目标外观，也无法刻画观测相对该目标的输入相关变化。因此需要围绕"目标外观"与"观测差异"两方面组织监督。

Method: 对每个退化-参考训练对，用水下视觉-语言教师提供参考特征作为目标外观监督，同时用配对特征残差描述观测相对同一目标的差异；二者联合蒸馏至轻量引导网络，从退化图像单独预测，推理阶段不需教师与参考图像。在多尺度增强网络中引入渐进知识融合：先由估计差异调制空间特征更新，再由目标外观引导细化更新后的特征，最后通过通道交互整合响应。

Result: 在六个水下基准上，全参考与无参考指标均取得有竞争力的性能；消融实验与特征可视化分析了知识来源、联合蒸馏及渐进融合的贡献。

Conclusion: 目标外观与差异残差构成同一复原问题的互补监督，联合蒸馏可实现无需参考的轻量推理；按监督角色安排的"校正-后-细化"渐进融合能有效利用两类知识。

Abstract: Underwater degradation changes image appearance and can compromise the semantic cues used to guide enhancement. Identifying scene content alone does not explicitly specify the appearance to recover or the input-dependent changes associated with that target. We propose target-discrepancy knowledge distillation (TDD) for underwater image enhancement, which organizes guidance around these two aspects of the same restoration problem. For each degraded-reference training pair, reference features from an underwater vision-language teacher provide target-appearance supervision, while paired feature residuals describe the observation's discrepancy relative to the same target. Both representations are jointly distilled into a lightweight guidance network that predicts them from the degraded image alone; neither the teacher nor reference images are required at inference. To align their use with their supervisory roles, we introduce progressive knowledge fusion within a multi-scale enhancement network. The estimated discrepancy first conditions spatial feature updates, after which target-appearance guidance refines the updated features and channel interactions consolidate their responses. This correction-before-refinement design lets target-guided refinement build on discrepancy-conditioned features. Experiments on six underwater benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance across full-reference and no-reference metrics. Ablations and feature visualizations analyze the contributions of the knowledge source, joint distillation, and progressive fusion.

</details>


### [128] [Qwen-Image-HD: Autoregressive Diffusion for High Definition Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32736)
*Zihao Liu,Zekai Zhang,Shengming Yin,Zikai Zhou,Donghao Zhou,Chenyang Zhu,Lihan Jiang,Ningyuan Tang,Bingxuan Zhao,Yanran Zhang,Yan Shu,Zhening Liu,Jiahao Li,Jie Zhang,Kaiyuan Gao,Kun Yan,Qihang Ai,Rui Song,Shuo Cao,Xiao Xu,Xiaoyue Chen,Yuxiang Chen,Zhendong Wang,Zhouyang Li,Bo Zheng,Jun Zhou,Xiu Li,Chenfei Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Qwen-Image-HD，通过局部训练与分块自回归生成将 Qwen-Image 2.0 适配到 4K 高分辨率合成，并在降低训练/推理开销的同时减少重复条纹伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在完整高分辨率画布上微调生成器需要长图像序列与大量算力；训练资源受限时，局部区域仍会出现不自然的重复条纹。因此需要一种更低成本的高分辨率生成方案。

Method: 采用局部训练 + 分块自回归生成：每次预测 1K 尺度的目标图块，以高分辨率上邻块与左邻块及压缩历史缩略图为条件；将两类历史与目标映射到共享画布坐标系，以表达空间关系与尺度差异。另提出 Wavefront-AutoRegressive 推理调度，在同一条反对角线上的图块跨 GPU 并行生成。

Result: 在 4K 的 Qwen-Image-Bench 上，整体评测优于 FLUX-3-Image-Klein 的直接 4K 生成；相比同骨干的全图 4K 监督微调，生成质量更好、训练算力更低、推理效率更高，原始分辨率对比中重复条纹更少。

Conclusion: 局部训练 + 分块自回归 + 共享画布坐标条件是一种高效、高质量的高分辨率图像生成范式，并通过波前并行调度降低单图延迟。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a generator on a complete high-resolution canvas requires long image sequences and substantial computation, yet local regions can still exhibit unnatural repetitive stripes when training resources are limited. We introduce Qwen-Image-HD, which adapts Qwen-Image 2.0 to high-resolution synthesis through local training and blockwise autoregressive generation. Each prediction covers a target tile at 1K scale, conditioned on high-resolution upper and left neighbors and a compressed historical thumbnail. These conditions provide adjacent fine-scale structures and an overview of the scene generated so far. To integrate these complementary cues, we map both forms of history and the target to a shared canvas coordinate system to express their spatial relationships and scale differences. On Qwen-Image-Bench at 4K, Qwen-Image-HD achieves stronger overall evaluation performance than direct 4K generation with FLUX-3-Image-Klein. Compared with full-image 4K supervised fine-tuning of the same backbone, it achieves better generation quality with lower training compute and higher inference efficiency, while exhibiting fewer unnatural repetitive stripes in original-resolution comparisons. We further introduce a Wavefront-AutoRegressive inference schedule that generates tiles on the same anti-diagonal concurrently across GPUs to reduce single-image latency.

</details>


### [129] [One Subspace Is Not Enough: LocalSubspaceAD for Training-Free Few-Shot Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32424)
*Daniel Pröll,Sebastian Hegenbart*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LocalSubspaceAD，将 SubspaceAD 的单一主成分子空间扩展为局部子空间混合（k-means 分组 + 每组一个子空间），免训练、免 EM，在 MVTec AD、VisA、Real-IAD 的 1/2/4-shot 设定下稳定提升异常检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业无缺陷样本在外观、纹理、几何上差异很大，少样本下建模困难。SubspaceAD 用基础模型 patch 特征的单一主子空间建模正常外观，但单一子空间必须覆盖全部正常变化，导致"某一语义区域的异常偏差可能落在另一区域的正常变化范围内"，检测被稀释。

Method: 对 patch 特征集合做 k-means 划分，为每个簇单独拟合一个主成分子空间；每个 patch 的异常分数取其在所有子空间上重投影残差的最小值。方法无需训练、无需 EM 迭代精修。消融对比"仅加簇均值偏移"与"局部子空间"两种设定，并检验是否只是容量增加（如与压缩 memory bank 对比）。

Result: 在 MVTec AD、VisA、Real-IAD（1/2/4 shot）上，两种骨干均优于 SubspaceAD：DINOv2 上 image AUROC 提升 1.2–1.8 点；DINOv3 上 image AUROC、pixel AUPR、AUPRO 提升 1.4–4.4 点。增益在多实例类别、PCB 等正常外观异质的对象上最明显。

Conclusion: 增益来自"局部化子空间带来的更细粒度变化建模"，而非子空间偏移（簇均值）；也不是单纯容量增加所致——局部子空间捕获了特征空间中连贯簇的结构，模型并非退化为压缩版 memory bank。

Abstract: Defect-free industrial samples can vary considerably in appearance, texture, and geometry. In few-shot anomaly detection, this variability has to be modeled from only a handful of images. SubspaceAD showed that a single principal subspace of foundation-model patch features is a strong training-free model of nominal appearance. However, a single subspace has to cover all of the nominal data's variability, so a deviation that is anomalous for one semantic region can be within the nominal variability of another. We propose LocalSubspaceAD, which extends SubspaceAD from a single subspace to a mixture of subspaces, assigning each group of patches with similar features its own subspace. The set of patch-features is partitioned using k-means, one subspace is fit per cluster, and each patch is scored by the minimum of re-projection residuals over all subspaces. The proposed method requires no training and no EM refinement. On MVTec AD, VisA and Real-IAD with 1, 2 and 4 shots, it improves over a single subspace (SubspaceAD) on both evaluated backbones: by 1.2 to 1.8 points image AUROC on DINOv2, and by 1.4 to 4.4 points in image AUROC, pixel AUPR and AUPRO on DINOv3. The gains are most pronounced on objects with heterogeneous nominal appearance, such as multi-instance categories and PCBs. Ablations show that the gains stem from a finer-grained model of variability through locally oriented subspaces, rather than from the subspace offsets (cluster means). We further show that the gains do not stem from added capacity alone: the local subspaces appear to capture the structure of coherent clusters in feature space, and the model does not merely act as a compressed memory bank.

</details>


### [130] [BEACON: Learning Observation-Conditioned Starting Points for Guided Conditional Flow Matching in Microscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32406)
*Anirban Ray,Florian Jug*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BEACON，一种面向引导式条件流匹配的Best-of-K自适应学习耦合方法，通过学习观测条件下基分布，替代独立的噪声-目标耦合，提升显微镜去雾与计算超分辨性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有引导条件流匹配将每个清晰目标与独立标准高斯样本配对，起点未利用退化观测，导致速度目标冲突、条件速度场难以学习。

Method: 训练时用轻量条件噪声模型为每个退化输入提出K个起点，选取流匹配损失最低者监督两个网络，并以KL项约束提案接近高斯先验；推理时单次采样并经速度场传输，无需候选选择或目标。

Result: 在涵盖显微镜去雾与计算超分辨的10个数据集、与13类基线族对比中，BEACON在每种保真度指标（PSNR、MicroMS-SSIM）与感知指标（LPIPS、FID）组合下均取得最优中位感知—失真秩。

Conclusion: 学习观测条件基分布可有效缓解噪声-目标耦合不当问题，在感知与失真权衡上显著优于现有方法，代码与预训练模型将开源。

Abstract: Fluorescence microscopy drives much of modern life science, but accessible imaging setups often yield images degraded by out-of-focus light, limited resolution, and strong signal-dependent noise. Computational restoration can recover high-quality images from such data, enabling cheaper and faster imaging at lower light dose, provided biologically meaningful structures are preserved. Guided conditional flow matching has recently shown strong results for microscopy dehazing and computational super-resolution by learning distributions of plausible restorations. However, it pairs each clean target with an independent standard Gaussian sample, so the starting point of every training path does not leverage the degraded observation. This arbitrary noise--target coupling can produce conflicting velocity targets and makes the conditional velocity field harder to learn. We present BEACON, a $BE$st-of-$K$ $A$daptive learned coupling for guided $CON$ditional flow matching, which learns an observation-conditioned base distribution. During training, a lightweight conditional noise model proposes $K$ starting points for each degraded input, and the candidate with the lowest flow-matching loss supervises both networks, while a KL term keeps the proposal close to the Gaussian prior. At inference, a single draw from the learned proposal is transported along the velocity field, requiring neither candidate selection nor the target. We evaluate BEACON on ten datasets spanning microscopy dehazing and computational super-resolution against 13 baseline families. BEACON achieves the best median perception--distortion rank for every pairing of a fidelity metric (PSNR, MicroMS-SSIM) with a perceptual metric (LPIPS, FID). Code and pretrained models will be released under a permissive license.

</details>


### [131] [Completion-Aware Compression for Progressive 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32628)
*Reagan Koo,Yeong-Gyu Kim,Eun-Seok Ryu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种渐进式3DGS编解码器，用单一紧凑码流支持任意字节预算下的细粒度部分重建，兼顾属性保真与图像收益，实现62–88倍压缩并在约0.2秒内提供可用重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS重建质量高但场景表示体积大、传输成本高；剪枝与压缩可减小文件，但渐进传输要求在完整数据到达前即可用。现有渐进表示只能提供部分场景，且基于层级的更新受预定义编码边界限制，缺乏任意字节预算下的细粒度可解码性。

Method: 设计渐进式3DGS编解码器，在属性保真度与“更早可用高斯带来的图像收益”之间做权衡；采用单一紧凑码流，随字节到达增量解码新高斯，无需独立编码或后续属性精化；并提出完成感知（completion-aware）的比特分配策略。

Result: 在相同完整文件大小与已接收字节下，完成感知分配相比仅属性分配在1/8进度时PSNR提升0.48–1.43 dB；对原始3DGS表示实现62–88倍压缩并保持接近参考的完整PSNR；在50 Mbps传输模型下，约0.2秒即可获得部分重建。

Conclusion: 单一码流的渐进式编码可在任意接收预算下实现细粒度、无需后处理精化的部分重建，显著提升早期进度下的渲染质量并大幅压缩场景体积，适合带宽受限的渐进式3DGS传输场景。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel-view rendering, but its large scene representations are costly to transmit. Pruning and compression reduce file sizes, yet progressive delivery also requires usable reconstructions before the full scene arrives. Existing progressive representations provide partial scenes, but level-based updates are limited by predefined coding boundaries. This paper presents a progressive 3DGS codec that balances attribute fidelity with the image benefit of making Gaussians available earlier. Its single compact stream supports partial 3D reconstruction and adds newly decoded Gaussians as more bytes arrive. The stream supports fine-grained updates at arbitrary received-byte budgets, without separate encodings or later attribute refinement. At matched complete-file sizes and received bytes, completion-aware allocation improves 1/8 PSNR over attribute-only allocation by 0.48-1.43 dB. The proposed codec compresses original 3DGS representations by 62-88 times while retaining near-reference Full PSNR. Under the evaluated 50-Mbps delivery model, partial reconstruction becomes available in approximately 0.2 s.

</details>


### [132] [CoReQ: Condition-Aware Cross-Modal Repair and Quality-Guided Robust Collaborative Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32588)
*Ziwei Guo,Lingzhi Li,Jin Wang,Yunjiang Xu,Yupeng Ouyang,Benyuan Yang,Yujun Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CoReQ框架，通过条件感知的双向跨模态修复与质量引导的多车融合，提升恶劣天气下LiDAR-4D Radar协同感知性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多车协同感知可缓解遮挡与感知范围受限问题，但恶劣天气导致的缺失回波和虚假回波会降低单车特征质量并影响协同检测；LiDAR几何信息丰富、4D Radar天气适应性强，二者互补具备在退化观测下提升感知的潜力，然而如何依据当前观测条件自适应调整跨模态修复，以及修复后多车特征可靠性仍存在差异时如何合理融合仍是未解问题。

Method: CoReQ包含两个核心部分：(1) 条件引导的双向跨模态修复模块CBCR，从点云占用率、密度与特征统计中提取车级观测条件，据此调整LiDAR与Radar特征的双向校正；(2) 结合局部可靠性评估与协同加权——任务感知质量估计模块TaQE利用EMA教师模型的分类与定位信息构建监督目标，预测修复后特征的空间质量；条件与质量引导融合模块CoQF将质量信息与内容匹配，并联合双方观测条件进行多车特征加权融合。

Result: 在V2X-R与V2X-Radar-C数据集上实验表明，该框架在多种观测条件下具有竞争力，在V2X-R雪天条件下AP@0.7取得显著提升，并在所对比的V2X-Radar-C方法中取得最高AP。

Conclusion: 通过条件感知的跨模态修复与质量引导的多车融合，CoReQ有效利用LiDAR与4D Radar互补性，在退化观测条件下实现了鲁棒的协同感知。

Abstract: Multi-vehicle collaborative perception can use observations from different perspectives to alleviate the problems of occlusion and limited sensing range. However, missing echoes and false echoes caused by bad weather will reduce the quality of single-vehicle features and affect collaborative detection. LiDAR provides richer geometric information, and 4D Radar has strong weather adaptability. The complementarity of the two provides the possibility to improve perception under degraded observations. However, how to adjust cross-modal repair according to the current observation conditions and how to reasonably integrate multi-vehicle features whose reliability still differs after repair are still problems that need to be solved. To this end, we propose CoReQ, a condition-aware repair and quality-guided collaborative perception framework. For the former, the condition-guided bidirectional cross-modal repair module (CBCR) extracts vehicle-level observation conditions from point cloud occupancy, density and feature statistics, and adjusts the bidirectional correction of LiDAR and Radar features accordingly. For the latter, we combine local reliability assessment with collaborative weighting: first, the task-aware quality estimation module (TaQE) uses the classification and positioning information of the EMA teacher to construct a supervision target and predict the spatial quality of the repaired features; then, the condition and quality guided fusion module (CoQF) matches the quality information with the content, and the observation conditions of both parties are jointly used for multi-vehicle feature weighted fusion. Experiments on V2X-R and V2X-Radar-C show that the framework is competitive under a variety of observation conditions, achieving significant gains in AP@0.7 on V2X-R under snowy conditions, and achieving the highest AP among the compared V2X-Radar-C methods.

</details>


### [133] [DiffAnchor: Anchor-Space Diffusion for Monocular 3D Hand Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32513)
*Changlong Jiang,Youci Tang,Haohong Kuang,Hang Xu,Jinghong Zheng,Ran Wang,Zhenghong Yu,Chen Feng,Xiaofeng Yue,Yang Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiffAnchor 提出在"锚点空间"而非关节坐标上做少步扩散的单目3D手部姿态估计框架：扩散仅搜索信息量高的中间锚点作为局部3D回归器，再由锚点到关节的偏移预测与加权聚合完成精确定位，从而以少量去噪步数和单一假设达到高精度与高推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的方法直接对最终3D关节坐标去噪，生成过程需同时承担"探索合理姿态"与"恢复精确坐标"两项任务，往往依赖更多去噪步数或多假设采样，推理成本高。作者的关键洞察是：随机探索不必直接作用于最终输出，可以在中间表示上进行。

Method: 提出锚点空间扩散：(1) 固定上下文锚点提供稳定的全局参考；(2) 含噪动态锚点经迭代去噪被细化至有信息量的关节区域，充当局部3D回归器；(3) 锚点-关节偏移预测加加权聚合完成精确关节定位；(4) 引入重要性引导的锚点选择与补充机制，保留有效锚点、剔除无效锚点并探索覆盖不足区域。

Result: 在 HO-3D V2、NYU、ICVL 与 InterHand2.6M 上实验：前三个基准取得SOTA，在具有挑战性的双手交互估计上具竞争力，且推理效率与确定性回归基线相当。

Conclusion: 将扩散的随机探索从最终关节迁移到中间锚点空间，可显著降低扩散过程的精度负担，仅需少步去噪和单一假设即可获得准确估计，在精度与效率间取得良好平衡，为扩散式姿态估计提供了新范式。

Abstract: Accurate and efficient monocular 3D hand pose estimation is an important perception capability for embodied human interaction and dexterous manipulation. Recent diffusion-based methods model pose uncertainty by iteratively denoising 3D joint coordinates. However, directly diffusing the final joints requires the generative process to simultaneously explore plausible poses and recover precise coordinates, often relying on additional denoising steps or multiple hypotheses and consequently increasing inference cost. In this work, we propose DiffAnchor, a few-step anchor-space diffusion framework that diffuses anchors rather than joints. Our key insight is that stochastic exploration does not need to operate directly on the final output. Instead, diffusion searches for informative intermediate anchors that serve as local 3D regressors, while anchor-to-joint offset prediction and weighted aggregation complete precise joint localization. Specifically, fixed context anchors provide stable global references, whereas noisy dynamic anchors are iteratively refined toward informative joint regions. An importance-guided anchor selection and replenishment mechanism further retains useful anchors, removes ineffective ones, and explores insufficiently covered regions. This design reduces the precision burden of the diffusion process and enables accurate prediction using only a few denoising steps and a single hypothesis. Extensive experiments on HO-3D V2, NYU, ICVL, and InterHand2.6M demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on the first three benchmarks and competitive performance on challenging interacting-hand estimation, while maintaining inference efficiency comparable to deterministic regression baselines.

</details>


### [134] [Progressive Reliable Supervision for Black-Box Universal Domain Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32474)
*Jing Li,Zhe Zhang,Huateng Sun,Yuhui Yang,Wanli Xue,Xu Cheng,Fan Shi,Jianhua Zhang,Qinghua Hu,Shengyong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出渐进式可靠监督（PReS），在黑箱源模型、基础模型与演化中的目标模型之间协同知识，为黑箱通用域适应（B²-UniDA）逐步构建并精炼可靠的目标域监督信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: B²-UniDA设定下源数据和源模型参数均不可见，无法获得可靠的目标域监督；而黑箱源模型因源域偏置和域偏移其预测可能不可靠，因此需要一种能在信息受限条件下逐步建立可靠伪标签的机制。

Method: PReS包含三部分：（1）利用扩散扰动下的语义一致性与黑箱源模型和CLIP之间的跨模型一致性识别可靠已知样本；（2）估计两个预测器的样本级可靠性并自适应融合其互补预测以构建伪标签；（3）对监督进行非对称利用——对可靠已知样本鼓励高置信、判别性预测，对潜在未知样本保持不确定但局部一致的预测；并随适应进程用涌现的目标域知识回流精炼伪标签与已知/未知划分，形成闭环。

Result: 在多种标签空间关系设定的多个基准数据集上，PReS在受限的B²-UniDA设置下取得最优或极具竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 通过协调黑箱源模型、基础模型与目标模型的互补知识并形成监督构建与目标适应的闭环互促，PReS可有效解决B²-UniDA中可靠监督缺失的问题。

Abstract: Black-Box Universal Domain Adaptation (B$^2$-UniDA) aims to adapt a target model to an unlabeled target domain under arbitrary label-space relationships, while neither source data nor source-model parameters are accessible during adaptation. Under such restrictive information access, reliable target supervision is unavailable, while predictions from the black-box source model can be unreliable due to source bias and domain shifts. To address this challenge, we propose Progressive Reliable Supervision (PReS), which progressively establishes and refines reliable target supervision by coordinating complementary knowledge from the black-box source model, foundation models, and the evolving target model. PReS first identifies reliable known samples by exploiting semantic consistency under diffusion-based perturbations and cross-model consensus between the black-box source model and CLIP. It then estimates the sample-wise reliability of the two predictors and adaptively integrates their complementary predictions to construct reliable pseudo labels. The resulting supervision is exploited asymmetrically to encourage confident and discriminative predictions for reliable known samples while maintaining uncertain yet locally consistent predictions for potential unknown samples. As adaptation proceeds, the emerging target-domain knowledge is further leveraged to refine both the pseudo labels and the known/unknown sample partition, forming a closed-loop process in which supervision construction and target adaptation mutually reinforce each other. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets under diverse label-space relationships demonstrate that PReS achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance under the restrictive B$^2$-UniDA setting.

</details>


### [135] [OmniPersist: Persistent Dynamic World Modeling via Coupled Panoramic Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32473)
*Zhilu Zhang,Xiaoyu Liu,Wenxi Liu,Shengfeng He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OmniPersist：单阶段扩散框架耦合透视视频生成与全景演化，用几何锚定与时间补偿解决视角外动态物体持续性，无需辅助模型或初始全景输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动作条件世界模型中，相机转离再返回时，视野外运动实体在潜空间中演化不合理（突变或消失），根源在于透视视角的视野受限，难以维持动态物体的持续性。

Method: 提出统一单阶段扩散模型，联合生成透视视频流与全景演化流；全景流采用较低帧率以控制计算开销；通过 Geometric Anchoring（GeoAnch）实现空间对应、Temporal Compensation（TemComp）实现时间聚合，在空间与时间上桥接两类视角；框架与相机控制架构无关，兼容潜空间级与注意力级条件注入，且无需辅助模型或初始全景输入。

Result: 在新建的动态基准上，针对图像到视频与视频续写任务，在视觉质量、相机可控性、重访一致性及动态持续性上均取得一致性提升。

Conclusion: 以全景演化补全透视视图外信息、并保持单阶段高效生成的方案，可有效缓解出视野动态物体的突变与消失问题，且具备良好的架构通用性。

Abstract: Action-conditioned world models play a vital role in robotics and autonomous driving, yet existing video diffusion models struggle to maintain dynamic object persistence. When the camera turns away and returns, out-of-view moving entities fail to evolve plausibly in latent space, often mutating or vanishing entirely due to bounded perspective views. To resolve this issue, we propose OmniPersist, a unified framework that couples perspective video generation with panoramic evolution within a single-stage diffusion model, without relying on auxiliary models or initial panoramic inputs. To maintain efficiency, we model the panoramic stream at a lower frame rate, bridging both views across space and time via Geometric Anchoring (GeoAnch) for spatial correspondence and Temporal Compensation (TemComp) for temporal aggregation. OmniPersist is agnostic to camera-control architectures, supporting both latent-level and attention-level conditioning. Extensive experiments on a newly constructed dynamic benchmark across image-to-video and video continuation tasks demonstrate consistent gains in visual quality, camera controllability, revisit consistency, and dynamic persistence.

</details>


### [136] [Knocked Off Course: Tracing Uncommanded Motion from Perception to Action in Embodied VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32705)
*Dan Zlotnikov,Nadav Alali,Ohad Ben-Shahar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究跟踪型VLA模型对"非指令自运动"（风、不平地形、路面颠簸等环境扰动引起的意外位姿变化）的鲁棒性，定位出表征与动作两个瓶颈，并用仅占原训练集1.7%的针对性数据微调Uni-NaVid显著提升目标丢失后的恢复成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型可同时处理第一视角视频与文本目标描述并输出动作指令以驱动具身跟踪平台，但平台实际运动常因风、不平地面、颠簸等扰动而偏离指令，形成"非指令自运动"。作者希望系统性地研究此类模型如何处理意外产生的自运动，并找出性能瓶颈。

Method: 在3个数据集上对3个跟踪VLA进行基准评测，分析其对不同环境扰动的敏感度；从像素到输出动作逐层追踪自运动信号，定位表征与动作两个环节的缺陷；据此设计一组由分析驱动的微调变体，仅用原训练集1.7%的数据微调Uni-NaVid。

Result: 不同模型最敏感的扰动类型各异，但都对目标的突然丢失高度敏感。机制上：在表征层面，运动可通过帧间显式关系可靠恢复，但对历史帧的激进压缩削弱了小运动读数；在动作层面，大幅旋转能进入决策状态，但解码出的方向仅保留镜像旋转约百分之几的转向效果。微调后在目标丢失条件下提升5–22个点且不损害干净场景成功率；平滑丢失情形下最佳变体相对提升72%，补齐了76%的与干净条件的差距。

Conclusion: 针对性微调可在不改变架构、不进行大规模数据采集或从头训练的前提下，部分通过文本中介的动作依赖提升自运动恢复能力，说明数据高效、分析驱动的干预即可弥补VLA在非指令自运动处理上的关键短板。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) enable simultaneous processing of egocentric video and textual target descriptions to produce action commands for embodied tracking platforms. However, these platforms rarely move exactly as commanded, in part due to unexpected environmental disturbances such as wind, unleveled terrain, and road bumps. Here we study how such models handle uncommanded egomotion. First, we explore performance across diverse disturbances by benchmarking three tracking VLAs on three datasets. We find that models differ in which environmental disturbances hurt them most, but all are sensitive to sudden target loss. Tracing egomotion from pixels to emitted actions, we identify two gaps. In representation, motion is reliably recovered through explicit relations between frames, but aggressive compression of past frames weakens small-motion readouts. In action, large rotations do reach the decision state, yet the decoded direction carries only a few percent of a mirrored rotation's effect on the turn. Targeting both gaps, we fine-tune one model, Uni-NaVid, on data amounting to just 1.7% of its original training set in a ladder of analysis-motivated variants. These gain 5-22 points after target-loss without degrading clean success; after a smooth loss, the best one improves success by 72% (relative), recovering 76% of its gap to clean. We also show that targeted fine-tuning improves recovery partly via a text-mediated action dependency, without new architecture, large-scale data collection or training from scratch.

</details>


### [137] [TokenMatte: Unlocking T2V Diffusion Priors for Pixel-Native Video Matting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32675)
*Zanyi Wang,Dengyang Jiang,Fengfei Yu,Shilong Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TokenMatte 将预训练视频扩散 Transformer 改造为单次推理、无需辅助输入的 RGB 到 alpha 预测器，通过像素原生输出接口直接生成全分辨率 alpha 序列，在精度与速度上均优于潜在空间输出基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率视频抠图需要精确的连续 alpha（发丝、软边界、运动模糊），但密集 alpha 监督稀缺；现有生成式视频抠图将 alpha 预测经由 RGB 训练的 VAE 潜在空间，易损失细节并带来额外解码开销。

Method: 提出共享线性读出层，将每个时空 token 直接映射为其对应的 (t×p×p) alpha 像素块，在同一局部视频块内预测空间细节与时间变化；平铺这些块即得全分辨率 alpha 序列，无需卷积解码器或学习式上采样。alpha 在像素空间直接监督，真值 alpha 不进入 VAE，从而消除目标侧 alpha 编码与输出侧 VAE 解码。仅用公开抠图数据集训练，推理时无辅助输入。

Result: 相比匹配的潜在输出基线，像素原生接口在提升抠图精度的同时实现 1.51× 推理加速；在 VideoMatte、YouTubeMatte 和 V-HIM60 上取得新的无需辅助输入的最优性能（SOTA）。

Conclusion: 像素原生读出接口结合预训练视频扩散先验，可在无需额外数据整理与推理辅助输入的情况下，兼顾精度与效率，为视频抠图提供简洁有效的范式。

Abstract: High-resolution video matting requires accurate recovery of continuous alpha values, including fine hair, soft boundaries, and motion blur, yet dense alpha supervision remains scarce. Pretrained text-to-video diffusion transformers (DiTs) offer rich spatio-temporal priors, whereas existing generative video matting approaches typically route alpha predictions through RGB-trained VAE latents, which can attenuate fine details and introduce additional decoding overhead. We present TokenMatte, which adapts a pretrained video DiT into a single-pass, auxiliary-free RGB-to-alpha predictor with a pixel-native output interface. At its core is a single shared linear readout that maps each spatio-temporal token directly to its corresponding ($t \times p \times p$) block of alpha pixels, predicting spatial details and temporal variations within the same local video block. Tiling these blocks produces the full-resolution alpha sequence without a convolutional decoder or learned upsampling. The predicted alpha is supervised directly in pixel space, while the ground-truth alpha never enters the VAE, eliminating target-side alpha encoding and output-side VAE decoding. Leveraging the pretrained video prior, TokenMatte is trained using only existing public matting datasets, without additional data curation or auxiliary inputs at inference. Compared with a matched latent-output baseline, our pixel-native interface improves matting accuracy while achieving a 1.51$\times$ inference speedup. TokenMatte establishes a new auxiliary-free state of the art on VideoMatte, YouTubeMatte, and V-HIM60.

</details>


### [138] [Attack-Inference Aligned Universal Adversarial Attacks on Video Object Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32658)
*Ruiqi Shen,Chang Liu,Henghui Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AUV对抗框架，与VOS“目标初始化+记忆传播”两阶段范式对齐，通过分阶段解耦优化的通用对抗扰动破坏共享记忆空间，实现跨模态提示无关攻击，刷新VOS攻击SOTA并具备优异时序特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VOS对抗攻击忽视了两阶段推理结构（初始化与基于记忆的传播），与真实VOS流程不匹配，攻击效果与实用性受限。

Method: AUV优化一个通用对抗扰动（UAP），针对初始化阶段与传播阶段分别设计解耦训练策略，并通过扰乱共享记忆空间实现提示无关（prompt-agnostic）攻击，覆盖mask、point、box、language等多种提示模态。

Result: 在DAVIS17-val上将基于mask的SAM3降至仅8.4 J&F（同训练设置下此前SOTA为55.4）；时序动态表现优越：起效最快、持续时间最久，并支持视频中途任意时刻攻击。框架可推广至不同VOS模型。

Conclusion: AUV揭示了真实流式VOS的脆弱性，其优化框架具有通用性，可适配多种VOS模型，代码已开源。

Abstract: Modern video object segmentation (VOS) relies on a two-stage inference paradigm: target initialization and memory-based propagation. However, existing adversarial attacks on VOS often overlook this structure. To bridge this gap, we propose AUV, an adversarial framework that Aligns with the Universal two-stage paradigm of VOS models. Specifically, AUV optimizes a universal adversarial perturbation (UAP) through decoupled training strategies tailored for both initialization and propagation stages. By disrupting the shared memory space, it achieves prompt-agnostic attacks across different modalities, including masks, points, boxes, and language. Extensive experiments show that AUV establishes state-of-the-art VOS attack performance, such as degrading mask-based SAM3 to only 8.4 J&F on DAVIS17-val (compared to 55.4 for the previous SOTA under the same training setup). It also exhibits superior temporal dynamics with the fastest onset, the most enduring persistence, and the support of any-time mid-video attacks. The AUV optimization framework is applicable to different VOS models, revealing vulnerabilities in real-world streaming VOS. Code is available at https://github.com/FudanCVL/AUV.

</details>


### [139] [LaWanle: Why Can't Leading Driving Models Make a Simple Turn?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32650)
*Chengzhi Gao,Junzhe Gao,Yongzhi Liu,Weichao Zhuang,Weilong Hu,Taonian Liang,Guodong Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发现主流端到端驾驶模型在NAVSIM上接近人类水平，却在真实感闭环仿真器中无法可靠完成简单90度转弯；作者构建LaWanle转角基准并定位误差源于路口入口的横向偏差，用闭环DAgger仅微调5%参数即将转弯通过率从19%提升至76%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端驾驶模型在NAVSIM等指标上已接近人类驾驶员，但作者意外发现这些模型在真实感闭环仿真器中连简单的90度转弯都无法稳定完成，这种评分与真实能力间的落差需要系统性诊断与改进。

Method: 构建LaWanle基准，从三个真实感闭环仿真器中采集转弯场景，每个转弯设置多个起始点进行驾驶测试；通过对同一模型的通过/失败对比、路口入口处车辆航向微旋转、以及对规划轨迹施加轻微航向修正等受控实验定位失败原因；随后对一个开源车道保持模型在其横向路径上进行闭环DAgger后训练，并进一步用恢复数据做微调实验。

Result: 同一模型对同一条转弯可从某一起点通过而从另一起点失败，且两次行驶在进入路口前几乎一致；在路口入口处将车辆旋转几度即可使原本通过的转弯失败；对规划施加轻微航向修正可挽救约半数失败转弯。闭环DAgger仅训练5%的参数即使转弯通过率从19%升至76%，增益可迁移到另外两个基准且在同类模型中居前列；但基于恢复数据的微调在三个基准上均未提升转弯表现，且所有变体仍远低于人类驾驶员。

Conclusion: 端到端驾驶模型在闭环真实感场景中的转弯失败主要源于路口入口处的横向/航向敏感性问题，而非整体驾驶能力不足；小比例参数的闭环DAgger微调能显著且可迁移地改善转弯表现，而朴素恢复数据微调效果有限，模型与人类驾驶员仍存在显著差距。

Abstract: We were surprised to find that leading end-to-end driving models across major paradigms, despite scoring close to human drivers on NAVSIM, cannot reliably make a simple 90-degree turn in photorealistic closed-loop simulators. To investigate why, we build LaWanle, a benchmark of turns drawn from three such simulators. Driving each turn from several starts, we find that the same model passes it from one start and fails it from another, and that the two drives look alike until they enter the junction. Rotating the car by a few degrees at the junction entry can fail a turn it otherwise passes. Conversely, a slight heading correction to the plans can rescue about half of the failed turns we tested. Such errors arise when a model drives by itself, so we post-train an open-source lane-keeping model with closed-loop DAgger on its lateral path. Training 5% of its parameters is enough to raise its turn pass rate from 19% to 76%. The gain transfers to the two other benchmarks, where the policy also scores among the leading models. Further fine-tuning on recovery data repairs the deviations it is trained on but, against a control trained equally long, improves turns on none of the three benchmarks, and every variant stays far below a human driver.

</details>


### [140] [MinPair: Measured Minimal Pairs for Fine-Grained Control in Text-to-Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32549)
*Lennart Schiweck,Cristóbal Curio*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MinPair 通过从真实动作片段构造"最小对比字幕对"并施加对比成对损失，迫使文生动作模型真正利用描述属性（如高度）的词，将单属性模板编辑的遵循率从 11% 提升至 60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文生动作生成主要解决"做什么动作"（what action），但对"如何执行"（how）的属性控制不足。例如仅修改 kick 请求中的高度词时，所测 SOTA 方法均无法同时满足膝、腰、头三个高度。原因在于：字幕中其他词往往隐含高度等信息，训练损失与标准指标均不强制模型使用明确表述该属性的词——只有当该词是区分两条其他方面完全相同字幕的唯一因素时，模型才被迫利用它。

Method: 1) 从规则化的动作描述子出发，测量每个真实片段的 3D 身体运动，并由语言模型据此撰写 MinPair 字幕（带时间标注、逐个身体部位说明如何运动）；2) 利用描述子找出同一动作两个片段在哪些属性上存在差异；3) 构造"测量得到的最小对比对"：一个片段的真实字幕 + 仅有一个属性被替换为另一片段实测值的改写副本；4) 采用对比成对损失，要求扩散去噪器从真实字幕重建片段比从改写副本更准确。无需合成动作数据，推理阶段不变。

Result: 在 22 个目标任务及每次仅改动一个属性的字幕编辑上评估：仅用 MinPair 字幕即可帮助动作达到目标并改善 M2M、R@3、FID，但模型仍忽略大多数单词级编辑；加入成对损失后，模板编辑遵循率由 11% 升至 60%，而标准指标未进一步提升；配合身体部位字幕，MinPair 达到的目标数超过使用多达 99 倍动作数据训练的 SOTA 方法。

Conclusion: 标准指标与常规训练目标无法保证属性级可控性，需以"最小对比"方式显式施加监督；MinPair 以零合成数据、零推理改动的代价显著提升细粒度属性控制，同时揭示标准指标与可控性之间存在脱节。

Abstract: Text-to-motion generation has made great progress in capturing what action to perform, yet it remains limited in controlling how that action is executed. For example, when only the height word of a kick request changes, none of the tested state-of-the-art methods reaches all three of knee, waist and head height. The other words of a caption usually imply an attribute such as height, so neither the training loss nor the standard metrics require a model to use the word that states it. A model has to use this word only when it alone separates two otherwise identical captions. We introduce MinPair, which creates such caption pairs from real motion clips. It starts from rule-based motion descriptors that measure the 3D body motion of each clip. From these descriptors a language model writes MinPair captions, timed body-part captions that say how each body part moves. The same descriptors show in which attributes two clips of the same action differ. A measured minimal pair joins the true caption of one clip with an altered copy in which only one attribute takes the value measured in the other clip. A contrastive pair loss then requires a diffusion denoiser to reconstruct the clip more accurately from its true caption than from the altered copy. Training needs no synthetic motion and inference stays unchanged. Control is tested on 22 target tasks and on caption edits that each change one attribute. MinPair captions alone help motions reach their targets and improve the standard metrics M2M, R@3 and FID, yet a model trained on them still ignores most single-word edits. The pair loss raises the share of followed template edits from 11% to 60%, while the standard metrics do not improve further. With body-part captions, MinPair reaches more targets than state-of-the-art methods that were trained on up to 99 times more motion data.

</details>


### [141] [HS-OVSeg: Multi-Granularity Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation in Remote Sensing via Heterogeneous Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32518)
*Wei Huang,Chenying Liu,Xudong Kang,Xiao Xiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HS-OVSeg：利用场景级、目标级与像素级异构监督联合训练遥感开词汇语义分割（RS-OVSS），通过 SAM3 生成伪标签并用 LoRA 微调，在 20 个训练数据集与 5 个留出数据集上显著超越现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感开词汇语义分割缺乏大规模、语义多样且具有精确像素级标注的数据集；而现有遥感数据集中存在大量场景级与目标级标注，蕴含丰富语义但缺少像素级监督，二者互补性未被充分利用。

Method: 提出统一训练框架 HS-OVSeg：以场景级类别名与目标级类别名+边界框为条件，用 SAM3 生成像素级伪标签；与真实语义掩码结合，以 LoRA 方式微调 SAM3，实现三种标注粒度（场景/目标/像素）的联合训练。训练覆盖 20 个遥感数据集（3 个场景分类、4 个目标检测、13 个语义分割），并从 7 个分类/检测数据集中人工标注 1,000 张图像用于像素级评测。

Result: 在 20 个训练来源数据集与 5 个留出数据集上，HS-OVSeg 均大幅优于现有 RS-OVSS 模型，在异构监督下展现出强多粒度分割能力。

Conclusion: 通过将场景级、目标级标注转化为像素级伪标签并与真实掩码联合训练，可有效缓解遥感 OVSS 像素级标注稀缺问题，验证了多粒度异构监督统一训练范式的有效性与泛化性。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) enables flexible, text-driven mapping of remote sensing (RS) imagery beyond predefined categories. Despite advances in segmentation foundation models, RS-OVSS remains constrained by the scarcity of large-scale, semantically diverse datasets with accurate pixel-level annotations. Meanwhile, existing RS datasets contain abundant scene- and object-level annotations that offer valuable semantic information but lack precise pixel-wise supervision. To exploit these complementary sources, we propose HS-OVSeg, a unified training framework that integrates heterogeneous scene-, object-, and pixel-level supervision for RS-OVSS. Specifically, we generate pixel-wise pseudo-labels using SAM3, conditioned on scene-level class names and object-level class names with bounding boxes. Combined with ground-truth semantic masks, these pseudo-labels enable joint training across all three annotation granularities through LoRA-based fine-tuning of SAM3. Our unified training spans 20 RS datasets, including 3 scene classification, 4 object detection, and 13 semantic segmentation datasets, with 1,000 images from the 7 classification and detection datasets manually annotated for pixel-level evaluation. HS-OVSeg substantially outperforms existing RS-OVSS models across both the 20 training-source and 5 held-out datasets, demonstrating strong multi-granularity segmentation capabilities under heterogeneous supervision. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

</details>


### [142] [Visual-State Graph Memory for Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32369)
*Ailar Mahdizadeh,Pritam Sarkar,Xiangteng He,Leonid Sigal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的视觉状态图（VSG）记忆，将流式视频存为对象-关系图与事件日志而非原始帧，在固定输入预算下提升对过去内容的推理并保持实时性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
