Motivation: 流式视频理解中，回答问题所需的证据可能已滑出近帧窗口；保存全部帧无法随视频长度扩展，丢弃旧帧又削弱对过去的推理能力。

Method: VSG为免训练方法，把流表示为对象及其关系构成的图（类似动态演化场景图）加事件日志。重复出现的对象用单一持久节点表示，并记录带时间戳的状态变化历史；通过比较新提及对象所参与的关系与已有对象的关系来判断其是否已在图中。记忆在视频到达时、问题未知前在线构建；问题到来后，在固定输入预算下检索相关对象、事件及近帧。

Result: 在四个流式视频基准、七个7B–32B参数的开源视觉语言模型上评估，在匹配输入预算条件下，VSG提升了对过去的推理，同时保持实时理解能力。

Conclusion: 以对象状态与关系为核心的紧凑结构化记忆可替代原始帧存储，在有限预算下兼顾长时程历史推理与实时流式理解，且无需额外训练。

Abstract: In streaming video understanding, the evidence needed to answer a question may have already left the recent-frame window. Keeping all frames does not scale with video length, while dropping older frames limits the model's ability to reason about the past. We propose Visual-State Graph (VSG), a training-free memory that stores the state of a stream rather than the raw sequence of frames. VSG represents the stream as a graph of objects and their relations, together with a log of events; similar to a dynamically evolving scene graph. An object observed repeatedly is represented by one persistent node, with a timestamped history of how its state changes. To determine whether a newly mentioned object already exists in the graph, we compare the relations it takes part in with those of stored objects. We build this memory as the video arrives, before the questions are known. When a question arrives, we retrieve relevant objects and events alongside recent frames under a fixed input budget. Our evaluation spans four streaming-video benchmarks and seven open-source vision-language models ranging from 7B to 32B parameters. Under matched input budgets, VSG improves reasoning about the past while preserving real-time understanding.

</details>


### [143] [GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32335)
*Weicong Zhang,Yuan Huang,Yu Zheng,Lin Chenxiao,Yingying Li,Lilong Fan,Liangdong Zhuang,Yufan Chen,Ruiping Liu,Junwei Zheng,Jiaming Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GOLD-SLAM：面向全景高斯泼溅SLAM的全向LiDAR深度耦合系统，在球域内完成跟踪与建图，提出DAEP模块并发布WHOLE数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景相机单帧可覆盖近全球面视场，但其覆盖范围与LiDAR视场不匹配，导致依赖LiDAR深度先验的全景高斯泼溅SLAM难以直接适用（LiDAR覆盖区域外的位姿估计与几何重建受限）。

Method: 在球面域进行跟踪与建图；利用LiDAR未覆盖区域的可跟踪视觉特征辅助位姿估计；提出深度感知地图扩展与剪枝（DAEP）以缓解新观测表面覆盖不足与增量建图中的漂浮伪影；采集UAV平台WHOLE数据集（弱几何、高动态、全向、低照、简单场景）。

Result: 在公开基准与WHOLE上取得有竞争力的渲染质量与更优几何精度；相较现有全景基线，平均PSNR提升5.56–9.10 dB，平均Depth-L1降低71.9–83.9%；Jetson Orin NX（16 GB）嵌入式配置可在线运行，但重建质量有所下降。

Conclusion: 全向LiDAR-视觉融合结合球域建模可有效提升全景SLAM的渲染与几何精度，并具备在UAV等资源受限平台部署的可行性（需权衡质量）。

Abstract: Panoramic cameras capture nearly the entire spherical field of view in a single frame. However, the mismatch between this panoramic coverage and the field of view of LiDAR poses a substantial challenge for panoramic Gaussian splatting SLAM that relies on LiDAR depth priors. We introduce GOLD-SLAM, a Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM system that combines high-quality rendering with accurate geometric reconstruction. It performs tracking and mapping in the spherical domain and uses tracked visual features in regions without LiDAR coverage to improve pose estimation. To address insufficient coverage of newly observed surfaces and floating artifacts during incremental mapping, we introduce Depth-Aware Map Extension and Pruning (DAEP). To enable broader evaluation, we collect a new dataset, WHOLE, using a UAV platform across Weak-geometry, High-dynamic, Omnidirectional, Low-light, and Easy scenarios. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and WHOLE demonstrate competitive rendering quality and improved geometric accuracy relative to perspective systems. Compared with existing panoramic baselines, GOLD-SLAM improves mean PSNR by 5.56-9.10 dB and reduces mean Depth-L1 by 71.9-83.9%. To assess deployment feasibility on resource-constrained platforms such as UAVs, we evaluate an embedded configuration of GOLD-SLAM on a Jetson Orin NX (16 GB), demonstrating online operation at the cost of reconstruction quality.

</details>


### [144] [Towards a Multimodal Aesthetic Agent for Photographic Reference Grading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32299)
*Kunjie Lin,Haitao Zhang,Bosheng Chen,Lanhui Xu,Gaofeng Pan,Yuxin Lin,Tianjiao Liu,Yi Yang,Yue Huang,Xinghao Ding,Zixu Lin,Yunlong Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多模态美学智能体 JarvisAura，将参考图引导的照片调色建模为可编辑参数空间中的结构化决策，通过三阶段训练实现从推理到渲染的执行闭环，在 Ref-Bench 上取得最优自动指标与74%人工任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参考图引导调色需理解用户想采纳哪些色彩与影调特征并转化为可控编辑。现有纯图像参考方法只能对齐整体外观、缺乏基于指令的选择性；像素空间生成式编辑器输出扁平图像、无可编辑参数，难以后续精修。

Method: 将调色表述为可编辑参数空间中的结构化决策；构建统一"推理—执行"流水线，连接美学规划、后端渲染与参数级精修；采用三阶段训练：参数-外观对齐的持续预训练、参考图引导的监督微调（推理与参数决策）、以及带多维奖励与动态数据推导的参考对齐分组相对策略优化（GRPO）。

Result: 在 Ref-Bench 上，所报告的自动指标均为最优，人工评测任务成功率74%，较 GPT-Image-2.5 高出9个百分点。

Conclusion: 参数化美学智能体范式在实现可解释、可控、可精修的参考图引导调色上优于图像级对齐与像素生成方法，验证了推理与执行统一训练的有效性。

Abstract: Reference-guided photographic color grading helps users realize their aesthetic intent by selectively drawing on the color and tonal characteristics of a reference photograph. Doing so requires understanding which characteristics users wish to adopt and translating these preferences into controllable edits. However, image-only reference methods align overall appearance without instruction-grounded selection, while pixel-space generative editors typically produce flattened images without editable parameters, limiting subsequent refinement. To address these challenges, we introduce JarvisAura, a multimodal aesthetic agent that formulates photographic color grading as structured decision-making in an editable parameter space. JarvisAura offers three key advantages: (1) an aesthetic agent paradigm that integrates visual attribute perception, strategy-level reasoning, and parameterized execution for interpretable and controllable photographic color grading; (2) a unified reasoning-to-execution pipeline that connects aesthetic planning with backend rendering and editable parameter refinement; and (3) a three-stage training strategy comprising Parameter-Grounded Continual Pre-Training for parameter-appearance grounding, Reference-Grounded Supervised Fine-Tuning for reference-guided reasoning and parameter decisions, and Reference-Aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization for rendered-outcome refinement with multidimensional rewards and dynamic data derivation. On Ref-Bench, JarvisAura achieves the best scores among methods with results across reported automatic metrics and a 74% human-rated task-success rate, exceeding GPT-Image-2.5 by 9 percentage points.

</details>


### [145] [Can You Find the Edit When Nothing Looks Wrong? A Paired Benchmark for Text-Driven Image Manipulation Localization Beyond Semantic Abnormality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32242)
*Peiyu Zhuang,Jianquan Yang,Zhuoying Cai,Yi Jiang,Yingquan Chen,Xinle Wang,Zeqin Yu,Dongdong Lin,Ruitao Xie,Kaige Li,Xiaochun Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 构建配对的“合理/异常”编辑基准（47,747个双语三元组，6,500张照片），发现篡改定位存在语义合理性捷径：编辑结果越“普通”，定位性能越差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准缺乏对同一目标的匹配式合理编辑与异常编辑，难以衡量定位性能如何随语义合理性变化。

Method: 对每张源图同一目标生成语义合理与异常的替换，控制编辑器、语言与生成参数一致；对每个输出单独估计掩码，仅保留掩码重叠充分的配对，实现两种语义条件下的直接对比。基准覆盖4种编辑器、3个源域、6类预期违规类型。

Result: 在9个公开定位器上，27组模型-数据集对比中有26组在合理编辑上的平均IoU更低；该差距在像素变化控制与区域大小分析下依然存在。

Conclusion: 揭示“语义合理性捷径”：编辑结果看似平常时定位常被削弱；该基准为量化此差距、开发对合理编辑仍有效的定位器提供受控实验环境。

Abstract: Instruction-driven image editing can alter a photograph while keeping the result coherent with the scene. Existing benchmarks lack matched plausible and anomalous edits of the same target, making it difficult to measure how localization performance changes with semantic plausibility. We construct a paired benchmark by generating semantically plausible and anomalous replacements of the same target in each source photograph. Both edits use the same editor, language, and generation settings. We estimate a separate mask for each output and retain pairs with sufficient mask overlap, enabling direct comparison of localization performance under the two semantic conditions. The release contains 47,747 bilingual triplets from 6,500 photographs, spanning four editors, three source domains, and six intended violation types. Across nine public localizers, editor-averaged IoU is lower on plausible edits in 26 of 27 model-dataset comparisons. This gap persists under pixel-change controls and region-size analyses. These findings reveal a semantic-plausibility shortcut: localization often weakens when an edited result looks ordinary. The benchmark provides a controlled setting for measuring this gap and developing localizers that remain effective on plausible edits.

</details>


### [146] [ST-SfM: Spatio-Temporal Structure-from-Motion for Initialising 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32231)
*Harshit,Sami Brandt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ST-SfM 提出一种面向同步标定多相机视频的稀疏时空 SfM 方法，将场景分解为静态分支（时中值图像上的结构检测与极线匹配）和动态分支（视频体中的时空兴趣点 STIP、HOG3D 描述、时空一致匹配与 union-find 加 RANSAC 三角化），输出静态 3D 点和带亚帧时间戳的动态 4D 点 (x,y,z,t)，用于初始化 4D 高斯泼溅，在 N3DV 场景上相比随机初始化在 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 上均有提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态高斯泼溅通常以随机点或仅首帧的 SfM 点云初始化，二者均不携带"何物、何处、何时运动"的信息，导致动态区域的初始化缺乏运动先验。作者希望从多相机视频中直接获得带时间信息的稀疏 4D 点云，为 4D 高斯泼溅提供更有信息的初始化。

Method: 面向同步且已标定的多相机视频，将 SfM 拆为两支：静态结构在每台相机的时中值图像上检测一次，经过时间稳定性门控，并沿极线匹配；运动通过视频体中的时空兴趣点（STIP）检测，用 HOG3D 描述，仅在极线与时间双重一致的候选间匹配；采用拒绝不一致合并的 union-find 构建轨迹，并在所有视图对上用 RANSAC 三角化，得到静态 3D 点与含亚帧时间的动态 4D 点。

Result: 在 N3DV 场景上，以 ST-SfM 稀疏 4D 点云初始化 4D 高斯泼溅，相比随机初始化在 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 三项指标上均取得提升。

Conclusion: 将静态与动态结构显式分离的稀疏时空 SfM 能为动态高斯泼溅提供有效的运动感知初始化，验证了 4D 稀疏先验的价值；文中仅报告了相对随机初始化的改进，未给出量化数值及与首帧 SfM 初始化的对比。

Abstract: Dynamic Gaussian splatting is usually initialised either with random points or with a structure-from-motion (SfM) cloud of the first frame. Neither says anything about what moves, where and when. We introduce ST-SfM, a sparse spatio-temporal SfM for synchronised, calibrated multi-camera video that splits the scene into two branches. Static structure is detected once per camera on a temporal-median image, gated for temporal stability and matched along epi-polar lines. Motion is detected as space-time interest points (STIPs) in the video volume, described with HOG3D and matched only between candidates that agree both epipolarly and in time. Union-find tracks that refuse inconsistent merges are triangulated with RANSAC over all view pairs, giving static 3D points and dynamic 4D points (x, y, z, t) with sub-frame times. We use ST-SfM derived sparse 4D cloud to initialise 4D Gaussian splatting. In comparison with random initialisation on N3DV scenes we get improvements in PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS.

</details>


### [147] [Relational Bottleneck Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32227)
*Shin'ya Yamaguchi,Kosuke Nishida*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出训练无关的 Relational Bottleneck Models (RBMs)，将任意现成 LVLM 转化为具备内在可解释性的模型，在零样本设置下同时提升可解释性与任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念瓶颈模型(CBM)可解释但依赖任务特定训练，且孤立视觉概念无法刻画高阶视觉语义关系；LVLM 虽具零样本 CoT 能力，但标准 CoT 的推理依据与最终输出间缺乏严格因果依赖，可信度不足。作者希望弥合"可解释性"与"高性能"之间的鸿沟。

Method: 提出两阶段、即插即用的免训练框架：(i) Structured Rationale Generation (SRG)，以主-谓-宾三元组显式建模视觉概念间的语义交互；(ii) Rationale-Grounded Decoding (RGD)，通过重要性加权专家乘积(product-of-experts)聚合以推理依据为条件的下一 token 分布，并在解码上下文中严格排除图像输入，从而强制依据与输出间的因果依赖。

Result: 在多种基准与多个 LVLM 骨干上的广泛零样本评测表明，RBMs 相比 CBM 基线取得更优的可解释性，同时提升任务性能，且完全无需任务特定微调。

Conclusion: RBMs 证明可通过结构化关系瓶颈与依据约束解码，在免训练条件下统一可解释性与性能，为 LVLM 的可信推理提供了一种通用、即插即用的方案。

Abstract: Achieving both interpretable and high-performance inference is a key challenge in deep learning. While Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) provide inherent interpretability, they are constrained by task-specific training and rely on isolated visual concepts that fail to capture higher-order visual semantic relationships. Conversely, Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate zero-shot capabilities through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, standard CoT lacks a strict causal dependency between the generated rationale and the final output, compromising faithfulness. To bridge this gap, we propose Relational Bottleneck Models (RBMs), a novel training-free framework that transforms any off-the-shelf LVLMs into inherently interpretable models in a plug-and-play manner. RBMs consist of two stages: (i) Structured Rationale Generation (SRG), which explicitly models semantic interactions between visual concepts as subject-predicate-object triplets, and (ii) Rationale-Grounded Decoding (RGD), which enforces a strict causal dependency between the rationales and the final output. RGD aggregates rationale-conditional next-token distributions via an importance-weighted product-of-experts strategy, strictly excluding the image inputs from the decoding context. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across diverse benchmarks and LVLM backbones demonstrate that RBMs achieve superior interpretability while improving task performance over CBM baselines, entirely without task-specific fine-tuning.

</details>


### [148] [Relation Before Action: Explicit Relation Modeling for Latent Action Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32226)
*Boning Zhang,Junyu Gao,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RELACT提出“关系优先”的潜在动作预训练框架，将“转移关系建模”与“预测性动作抽象”显式解耦：先构建结构化关系表示R，再推断状态条件的紧凑随机潜在动作U，并通过动作条件潜在动力学学习其预测效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从无标注视频学习潜在动作的方法将视觉转移建模与动作推断耦合，直接把成对观测或转移线索映射为潜在动作码，混淆了两个不同任务：刻画观测转移的关系结构，以及将其抽象为紧凑动作表示。

Method: RELACT分两步：1）构建结构化关系表示R，刻画视觉元素及其交互在观测间的演化；2）推断状态条件的紧凑随机潜在动作U，其预测效果由动作条件潜在动力学学习。所得表示可对齐到原生控制空间用于基于模型的规划，或用于监督下游具身策略。

Result: 在域内/域外图像目标导航、目标条件操作及下游策略适配上，预测性动作表示质量提升，规划与控制性能一致增益，验证了方法的有效性与通用性。

Conclusion: 显式分离关系建模与动作抽象的关系优先式潜在动作预训练，可提升无标注视频中学习到的动作表示质量，并泛化到多种具身规划与控制任务。

Abstract: Learning latent actions from unlabeled video sequences offers a promising way to acquire reusable action representations without relying on embodiment-specific control annotations. However, existing latent-action pretraining approaches commonly couple the modeling of visual transitions with action inference, directly mapping paired observations or derived transition cues into latent action codes. This formulation leaves two distinct tasks entangled: characterizing the relational structure of an observed transition and abstracting it into a compact action representation. We propose RELACT, a relation-first framework that explicitly separates transition relation modeling from predictive action abstraction. RELACT first constructs a structured relation representation $R$ that captures how visual elements and their interactions evolve across observations. It then infers a compact, state-conditioned stochastic latent action $U$, whose predictive effects are learned through action-conditioned latent dynamics. The resulting action representation can be grounded in native control spaces for model-based planning or used to supervise downstream embodied policies. Extensive experiments across in-domain and out-of-domain image-goal navigation, goal-conditioned manipulation, and downstream policy adaptation demonstrate improved predictive action representations and consistent gains in planning and control, supporting the effectiveness and generality of relation-first latent action pretraining.

</details>


### [149] [EvoSearch: Self-Evolving Active Perception for Wide-Area Geospatial Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32214)
*Zhenghao Xie,Jing Xiao,Zihao Yu,Wanyi Yu,Liang Liao,Gui-Song Xia,Mi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EvoSearch：自演化主动感知框架，协同演化感知策略与探索程序，在保持答案质量前提下压缩地理空间搜索轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地理空间搜索需在大范围、多尺度下发现证据；现有主动感知方法随搜索区域扩大，轨迹越来越长、代价越来越高。仅以最终答案正确性作为信号，无法指导"保留哪些观测"和"何时停止"，阻碍高效广域搜索。

Method: 提出EvoSearch，协同演化感知策略与探索程序：利用共享证据下已完成分支的质量-成本比较来训练策略，使其获取有用观测、避免冗余观测并在证据充分时停止；再用更新后策略的执行反馈指导探索程序修订，使经验生成适配策略变化的观测需求。同时构建GeoSearchBench基准，通过关系搜索与区域搜索评估搜索质量与视觉处理效率。

Result: 实验显示EvoSearch缩短了搜索轨迹，并显著降低视觉处理开销，同时保持整体搜索质量。

Conclusion: 该工作为广域地理空间搜索提供了可扩展的主动感知方案，将"质量-成本"信号引入策略学习与探索程序演化闭环。

Abstract: Geospatial search is fundamental to resource surveys and environmental monitoring, requiring the discovery of relevant evidence across large geographic areas and multiple spatial scales. Existing active perception methods adaptively select observation locations and scales to improve search efficiency, yet their search trajectories become increasingly long and costly as the search area expands. A key limitation is that final-answer correctness alone provides little guidance on which observations to retain and when to stop, hindering efficient wide-area search. To address this challenge, we propose EvoSearch, a self-evolving active perception framework that co-evolves the perception policy and exploration program to compress search trajectories while preserving answer quality. Specifically, quality-cost comparisons between completed branches from shared evidence train the policy to acquire useful observations, avoid redundant ones, and stop when sufficient evidence is available. Execution feedback from the updated policy then guides exploration-program revision, adapting experience generation to the policy's changing observation needs. We further introduce GeoSearchBench, a benchmark for evaluating search quality and visual processing efficiency through relational search and region search. Experiments demonstrate that EvoSearch shortens search trajectories and substantially reduces visual processing while maintaining overall search quality, supporting scalable active perception for wide-area geospatial search.

</details>


### [150] [FlashSegmentator: High-Throughput TotalSegmentator Inference without Loss of Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32208)
*Yosuke Yamagishi,Tomohiro Kikuchi,Shouhei Hanaoka,Takeharu Yoshikawa,Osamu Abe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlashSegmentator通过静态形状编译、流水线、批处理滑窗推理与GPU后处理，在不重训练、不损失精度的前提下将TotalSegmentator吞吐量提升最高57.7倍，A100云端成本由997美元降至29美元/万例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TotalSegmentator参考实现推理吞吐低，高分辨率模式精度好但慢；其低分辨率模式虽提速却显著降低Dice（-0.116/-0.241）。作者希望在不重训练、不牺牲分割精度的条件下大幅提升推理吞吐并开源发布。

Method: 回顾性研究，使用公开数据：TotalSegmentator测试集73例CT、BTCV 30例腹部CT、512例训练集CT（并发进程分析）、55例MRI。在GH200、A100、T4上对比参考实现（含低分辨率模式）与FastSegmentator。优化手段：静态形状编译、流水线、批处理滑窗推理、GPU后处理。精度用Dice等效性检验（双侧单侧检验，界值±0.01）。

Result: GH200/A100/T4吞吐分别为3782、1810、270例/小时，为参考实现的57.7/33.9/6.4倍，为编译版FastSegmentator的3.20/2.50/1.22倍；所有117个结构在各GPU上Dice均等效（平均差≤1.2×10^-5，P<.001），BTCV检查级亦等效。MRI吞吐提升94倍，50个结构全部等效。A100云端每万例成本从997美元降至29美元。

Conclusion: FlashSegmentator在数据中心级与入门级GPU上均显著提升TotalSegmentator吞吐，且相对参考实现无分割精度损失，已开源发布。

Abstract: Purpose: To develop, evaluate, and publicly release FlashSegmentator, an open-source inference pipeline that increases the throughput of TotalSegmentator without retraining or loss of segmentation accuracy. Materials and Methods: This retrospective study used public datasets: 73 CT examinations from the TotalSegmentator test split (median age, 65 years; 37 male, 35 female, one unknown), 30 abdominal CT examinations from the Beyond the Cranial Vault (BTCV) dataset, 512 training-split CT examinations for concurrent-process analysis, and 55 MRI examinations. FlashSegmentator adds static-shape compilation, pipelining, batched sliding-window inference, and GPU postprocessing. Throughput was compared with the reference implementation (including its lower-resolution modes) and FastSegmentator on GH200, A100, and T4 GPUs. Dice agreement was tested with two one-sided tests (margin, +/-0.01). Results: FlashSegmentator processed 3782, 1810, and 270 examinations per hour on the GH200, A100, and T4 (57.7, 33.9, and 6.4 times the reference implementation and 3.20, 2.50, and 1.22 times compiled FastSegmentator). Dice scores were equivalent for all 117 structures on every GPU (mean difference <= 1.2 x 10^-5; P < .001) and at the examination level on BTCV. In contrast, the lower-resolution modes of the reference implementation processed 181 and 213 examinations per hour on the A100 but reduced mean Dice by 0.116 and 0.241. On MRI, throughput increased 94-fold with all 50 structures equivalent. Estimated A100 cloud cost per 10,000 examinations decreased from 997 to 29 US dollars. Conclusion: FlashSegmentator increased the throughput of TotalSegmentator on data center and entry-level GPUs without loss of segmentation accuracy compared with the reference implementation.

</details>


### [151] [What to Change, What to Keep: Experience-Evolving Agents for Video Recasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32196)
*Shiying Zhang,Yuxia Zhu,Huaze Xue,Shengqi Dang,Yizhen Wu,Yijie Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RecastAgent 是一个在冻结权重下运行、由经验引导的智能体框架，用于源条件视频重铸（video recasting），通过经验积累的规划器选择编辑提示与输入状态以保持事件结构，并构建了 67 个源视频、134 组配对规格任务的基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频重铸需将现有视频的实体与环境替换为新视觉世界，同时保留核心动作与交互。但协同编辑易破坏原始事件结构，实现连贯变换仍具挑战。

Method: 提出 RecastAgent：冻结模型权重下的源条件视频重铸智能体框架。包含 Experience-Guided Planner，在定性视觉评判下选择编辑提示与输入视频状态，可基于部分进展继续或回溯以保持源结构；以及 Experience Accumulation 模块，将完成的轨迹蒸馏为条件化、证据关联的原则，记录编辑策略及其有效范围。另构建含 67 个源视频、134 个配对规格任务（六个创意类别）的评测基准。

Result: 在 Bernini 与 Ditto 上，RecastAgent 优于单次生成与智能体重写基线；积累的经验在留出测试视频上提升性能，并零样本迁移至 FiVE-Bench、VE-Bench 等外部基准。

Conclusion: 经验引导的智能体式规划与可迁移的经验积累能有效提升源条件视频重铸的连贯性与泛化性，且无需更新模型权重。

Abstract: Video recasting aims to transform the entities and environments of existing videos into new visual worlds while preserving their essential actions and interactions. However, achieving coherent transformations remains challenging, as coordinated edits can disrupt the original event structure. In this paper, we introduce RecastAgent, an experience-guided agentic framework for source-conditioned video recasting that operates under frozen model weights. Our framework employs an Experience-Guided Planner to choose edit prompts and input video states under qualitative visual critique, allowing the agent to build upon partial progress or backtrack to preserve source structure. Across tasks, an Experience Accumulation module distills completed trajectories into conditional, evidence-linked principles that record both an editing strategy and its scope of validity. We additionally construct a benchmark of 67 source videos with 134 paired-specification tasks across six creative categories for evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that RecastAgent outperforms single-pass and agentic rewriting baselines across Bernini and Ditto. Furthermore, accumulated experience improves performance on held-out test videos and transfers zero-shot to external benchmarks like FiVE-Bench and VE-Bench.

</details>


### [152] [TESS: Query-Guided Temporal Event-Structured Frame Selection for Long-Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32410)
*Qi Lu,Shiyan Tong,Shujie Li,Sen Li,Likun shi,Maofei Que,Xiaolong Jiang,Yao Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TESS：一种免训练、查询引导的"时间事件结构化"关键帧选择框架，在同帧预算下优于最强基线4.0–5.5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频中与问题相关的短事件稀疏分布于大量冗余内容中，视觉预算有限易漏掉关键事件及其时间上下文。已有帧选择方法侧重语义相关性或时间覆盖度，忽视了"定位相关事件并建立其时间关系"所需的互补证据。

Method: 提出免训练框架TESS：按要求的时序同时选取"参考事件"与"被问事件"的帧；基于冻结的视觉-语言表征，结合软时间门控（soft temporal gating）、角色感知的预算分配（role-aware budget allocation）与角色内冗余抑制。

Result: 在4个长视频理解基准、3种多模态骨干上，固定帧预算下较最强基线提升4.0–5.5个百分点；更长视频上提升更显著，更紧预算下仍稳健；独立证据标注验证事件与时间关系覆盖度提升。

Conclusion: 显式的时间证据组织是一种有效的免训练策略，可保留事件关系并支撑长视频的高效时间推理。

Abstract: Temporal localization in long videos is challenging because brief, question-relevant events are dispersed among extensive redundant content. Limited visual budgets increase the risk of omitting these events or their temporal context, undermining reliable reasoning. Existing frame selection methods emphasize semantic relevance or temporal coverage, often overlooking the complementary evidence needed to locate related events and establish their temporal relationships. To address this limitation, we propose TESS, a training-free framework for query-guided temporal event-structured frame selection. TESS selects frames that jointly show the reference event and the event asked about, in the required temporal order. Leveraging frozen vision-language representations, TESS integrates soft temporal gating, role-aware budget allocation, and within-role redundancy suppression to preserve complementary event evidence. Extensive experiments across four long-video understanding benchmarks and three multimodal backbones demonstrate that TESS consistently outperforms the strongest compared baseline by 4.0-5.5 percentage points under a fixed frame budget. Further analyses reveal greater improvements on longer videos and robust performance under tighter visual budgets, while independent evidence annotations confirm enhanced event and temporal-relation coverage. These findings establish explicit temporal evidence organization as an effective training-free strategy for preserving event relationships and supporting efficient temporal reasoning over long videos. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TESS_code.

</details>


### [153] [Beyond Static Semantics: Instance-Adaptive Vision-Language Alignment for Building Damage Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32777)
*Hang Yin,Jiepan Li,Hongruixuan Chen,Guangyi Yang,Wei He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LAMIA-IBDA 视觉-语言框架，通过自适应文本-视觉对齐与动态实例原型接地，将损伤语义逐级绑定到局部双时相证据与单栋建筑，实现实例级建筑损毁评估的 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实例级建筑损毁评估中，同一损毁等级在不同建筑上呈现多样视觉表现，离散类别标签难以提供足够监督；自然语言可显式描述物理损伤，提供补充语义线索，但现有视觉-语言方法未充分解决损伤语义如何适应局部双时相证据并作为实例特定参考用于严重度判别的问题。

Method: ATVA（自适应文本-视觉对齐）：在可靠性感知注意力监督下，联合对多种损伤描述与双时相视觉特征进行语境化，实现证据自适应语义交互；DIPG（动态实例-原型接地）：将语境化语义与单栋建筑区域关联，构建实例自适应原型用于细粒度损毁分类；并以实例级描述偏好监督融合阶段注意力，将语义适配与实例判别相耦合。

Result: 在 xBD 与 BRIGHT 数据集上，于光学-光学与光学-SAR 两种设置下均取得领先性能。

Conclusion: 通过渐进式将共享损毁语义接地到局部观测与个体建筑，视觉-语言信息可有效提升实例级建筑损毁评估的严重度判别能力。

Abstract: Instance-level building damage assessment (IBDA) from bi-temporal remote sensing imagery remains challenging, as the same damage grade may exhibit diverse visual manifestations across individual buildings. Natural language offers explicit descriptions of physical damage, providing complementary semantic cues beyond discrete category labels. However, existing vision--language approaches have not fully addressed how damage semantics should adapt to local bi-temporal evidence and subsequently serve as instance-specific references for severity discrimination. To bridge this gap, we propose LAMIA-IBDA, a unified vision--language framework that progressively grounds shared damage semantics in local observations and individual buildings. Specifically, Adaptive Text-Visual Alignment (ATVA) enables evidence-adaptive semantic interaction by jointly contextualizing multiple damage descriptions and bi-temporal visual features under reliability-aware attention supervision. Dynamic Instance-Prototype Grounding (DIPG) further associates these contextualized semantics with individual building regions to construct instance-adaptive prototypes for fine-grained damage classification. Instance-level description preferences additionally supervise fusion-stage attention, linking semantic adaptation with instance discrimination. Extensive experiments on xBD and BRIGHT demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across optical--optical and optical--SAR settings. The source code is publicly available https://github.com/Cutensil/LAMIA-IBDA.

</details>


### [154] [FlowVecFont: Scalable Vector Font Generation via Latent Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32327)
*Takumu Fujioka,Gouhei Tanaka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlowVecFont 证明仅用矢量轮廓训练、把简单模型规模化即可实现高质量纯矢量字体生成，无需外部预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有矢量字体生成依赖专用生成/精修机制、位图表示或外部预训练模型，导致系统复杂、计算与实现成本高并引入外部依赖。作者希望用简单的纯矢量模型结合规模化来替代这些复杂方案。

Method: 提出 FlowVecFont：基于潜空间流匹配（latent flow matching）的可扩展模型，仅在矢量轮廓上训练。用基于 Transformer 的变分自编码器将字形序列映射为定长连续潜变量 token，从而支持标准的条件流匹配进行矢量字形生成；条件可为类别标签或参考字形，后者支持对未见字符与字体的泛化。同时发布 TorchFont 矢量字体机器学习库。

Result: 在 Google Fonts 采集的约 500 万字形（含非拉丁字符）上实验，生成质量随模型规模在各条件策略下均提升。拉丁字形对比中，800M 参数的 FlowVecFont 优于 DeepVecFont-v2 和 DesigNet，与 27B 参数预训练模型 VecGlypher 的质量相当。

Conclusion: 纯矢量、无外部预训练的简单模型通过规模化即可达到高质量字体生成，性能远超其参数规模，说明复杂专用机制和外部依赖并非必要。

Abstract: Fonts are natively represented as vector outlines. Many existing studies on vector font generation have relied on specialized generation or refinement mechanisms, bitmap representations, or externally pretrained models to address the challenges of learning vector representations. These approaches often increase system complexity, incur additional computational and implementation costs, and introduce dependencies on external resources. We show that scaling a simple model enables high-quality pure vector font generation without external pretraining. We propose FlowVecFont, a scalable model for vector font generation based on latent flow matching and trained solely on vector outlines. A Transformer-based variational autoencoder maps glyph sequences into fixed-length continuous latent tokens, enabling standard conditional flow matching for vector glyph generation. The model supports conditioning on class labels or reference glyphs, with the latter enabling generalization to unseen characters and fonts. Experiments on 5M glyphs collected across Google Fonts, including non-Latin characters, show that generation quality improves with model scale across conditioning strategies. In a comparison on Latin glyphs, the 800M-parameter FlowVecFont outperforms DeepVecFont-v2 and DesigNet and achieves quality competitive with the pretrained 27B-parameter VecGlypher. We also provide TorchFont, a machine learning library for vector fonts.

</details>


### [155] [ViDM: Efficient and Order-Robust Parallel Visual Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32461)
*Xudong Tan,Peng Ye,Chenyu Huang,Yaoxin Yang,Huafeng Qin,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViDM 将多问题视觉推理转化为单次前向的并行决策，同时提升准确率与推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对共享同一视觉输入的多问题场景，自回归多模态大模型逐 token 生成答案，随问题数增长累积串行解码开销、延迟决策集完成，且预测结果受问题顺序影响。

Method: 将共享视觉上下文、多个问题与问题专属决策槽组织为单一序列，复用原生语言模型头一次性输出全部答案分布；提出 Decision-Query Mask，使每个决策查询的直接注意力对齐共享上下文及其对应问题；采用案例均衡的多顺序训练增强对问题重排序的鲁棒性。

Result: 在图像、多图像、视频共九个基准上，Qwen3.5-4B 平均准确率由 73.49% 提升至 77.55%，端到端平均吞吐为基线的 8.4 倍；GQA（每图平均 11.4 个问题）端到端加速达 20.3 倍；同时提升平均与最差顺序准确率、降低顺序引起的波动；在 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 与 InternVL3.5-4B 上得到进一步验证。

Conclusion: ViDM 通过并行决策范式在准确率与效率上同时优于串行解码基线，并显著缓解多问题推理中的顺序敏感性，具备跨模型与跨模态的泛化性。

Abstract: Visual decision-making demands accurate judgments and timely responses. Yet for multiple questions sharing the same visual input, autoregressive multimodal large language models generate answers token by token, accumulating sequential decoding costs as question count grows and delaying completion of the decision set. Their predictions can also vary with question order. We introduce ViDM, which transforms multi-question visual inference into parallel decisions in a single forward pass, improving both accuracy and inference efficiency. ViDM organizes shared visual context, multiple questions, and question-specific decision slots into one sequence, reusing the native language-model head to produce all answer distributions simultaneously. A Decision-Query Mask aligns each decision query's direct attention with shared context and its corresponding question, while case-balanced multi-order training strengthens robustness to question reordering. Across nine benchmarks spanning image, multi-image, and video tasks, ViDM improves Qwen3.5-4B's average accuracy from 73.49% to 77.55% while achieving 8.4x the baseline's average end-to-end throughput. On GQA, where each evaluated image has 11.4 questions on average, the end-to-end speedup reaches 20.3x. ViDM also improves mean and worst-order accuracy while reducing order-induced variation across multiple benchmarks, with further validation on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and InternVL3.5-4B.

</details>


### [156] [A Mesh to Remember: Persistent Appearance for Interactive Video Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32445)
*Joonghyuk Shin,Alex Trevithick,Katarína Tóthová,Liyuan Zhu,Shengyu Huang,Jaesik Park,Shalini De Mello,Laura Leal-Taixé,Riccardo de Lutio,Haithem Turki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 M2R（Mesh to Remember），一种少步因果视频渲染器，将自身特征以物体自身坐标系存刻于网格表面，并通过光栅化网格按需检索，使外观随物体运动、跨重访与多智能体持久一致，仅用合成数据训练即可零样本迁移到真实室内扫描与代码智能体构建的世界，在一致性上超越 SOTA 并实现 720p 实时（40 FPS）渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型能生成逼真画面但长程交互一致性差；text-to-3D 与代码智能体生成的显式 3D 世界状态持久但外观不真实。现有"以粗糙几何代理引导视频模型"的方法中，代理仅指定"东西在哪"，渲染器需自行虚构外观，表面重现时会被重新发明的外观取代，导致遗忘与不一致。

Method: 核心洞察：网格标识每帧每视角下每个像素对应哪个表面（即使物体运动），可作为渲染器生成内容的"地址"。M2R 采用少步因果视频渲染器，将自身特征存储于其描绘的表面之上，并置于每个物体的自身坐标系中；当这些表面重新进入视野时，通过光栅化网格检索特征。记忆随观察到的表面数量增长而非帧数增长。

Result: 仅用合成数据训练，零样本迁移到真实室内扫描及代码智能体构建的世界；在静态、动态与多智能体基准上一致性优于 SOTA，物体恒存性提升超过两倍，跨智能体一致性接近翻倍，同时以 40 FPS 实时渲染 720p 视频。

Conclusion: 将网格作为外观特征的持久化"地址"可有效解决长程交互中的外观遗忘与不一致问题，兼顾逼真度、持久性与实时性，且具备良好的零样本泛化能力。

Abstract: Video world models synthesize photorealistic observations in response to user actions but struggle to remain consistent over long interactions. Coding agents and text-to-3D models instead generate explicit 3D worlds whose geometry and state persist by construction, but whose appearance falls far short of photorealism. Recent methods combine the strengths of both by rendering such worlds into coarse proxies that guide a video model. However, since these proxies only specify where things are, the renderer must invent what they look like as the world is explored, and anything it forgets is reinvented when a surface reappears. Our key insight is that a mesh identifies which surface each pixel shows, across frames and views, even as objects move, allowing it to serve as an address for what the renderer generates. We propose M2R (Mesh to Remember), a few-step causal video renderer that stores its own features on the surfaces they depict, in each object's frame, and retrieves them by rasterizing the mesh whenever those surfaces come back into view. Appearance thus travels with objects wherever they move, persists across revisits, and is shared by every agent that observes it, while memory grows with the surfaces seen instead of the number of frames. Trained only on synthetic data, M2R transfers zero-shot to real indoor scans and to worlds authored by coding agents. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods in consistency across static, dynamic, and multi-agent benchmarks, more than doubling object permanence and nearly doubling cross-agent consistency, while rendering 720p video in real time (40 FPS).

</details>


### [157] [SpatialArena: Where Do Geometric Foundation Models Stand?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32816)
*Yu Chen,Haosen Yang,Su Ee Tan,Zhensong Zhang,Jifei Song,Jiankang Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SpatialArena 基准与工具箱，用统一指标和鲁棒、确定性的对齐规则评测 3D 几何基础模型，覆盖 5 类任务、23 个公开数据集（418,929 张图像）及自采集数据，评测 52 个模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 3D 感知模型评测不可靠：各论文在帧采样、分辨率、测试划分上做法不一导致数值不可比；上尺度（up-to-scale）预测所需的对齐误差可能超过模型间差距（错误的深度空间拟合会使误差近乎增至三倍，标准轨迹对齐会将失败方法的误差低估最多 2.6 倍）；且评测很少覆盖长时序录像、动态场景与航拍视角。

Method: 构建开放评测平台 SpatialArena，以相同指标与规则、鲁棒且确定性的对齐方式为几何模型打分；任务涵盖单目深度估计至 SLAM 共 5 项；数据包含 23 个公开数据集（室内、室外、航拍、物体中心、动态场景，共 418,929 张图像）以及自采集的 Spatial Arena 数据（含精确位姿与深度）；共评测 52 个模型。

Result: 单图像深度在公开基准上接近饱和，但在大规模、非受控场景上并非如此；性能提升主要来自跨帧与跨视角的一致性，前馈式 3D/4D 模型在该维度上可比肩或超越单目专用模型，并优于视频深度模型。

Conclusion: 可靠的 3D 几何模型评测需要统一指标、鲁棒确定性对齐与多样化场景覆盖；未来进展的关键在于跨帧/跨视角一致性而非单帧精度。基准、工具箱与榜单将公开发布。

Abstract: 3D perception is shifting from task-specific pipelines to geometric foundation models: monocular depth networks, feed-forward 3D/4D reconstruction models, and vision--language models that predict geometry. However, their progress cannot be measured reliably. Published numbers are not comparable, because every paper samples frames, sets resolutions, and selects test splits differently. They are not robust because the alignment required for every up-to-scale prediction can outweigh the gap between models: fitting depth in the wrong space nearly triples its error, and standard trajectory alignment understates the error of failing methods by up to $2.6\times$. And they rarely cover long recordings, dynamic scenes, or aerial views. We present SpatialArena, an open arena that scores geometric models with the same metrics and rules, with robust and deterministic alignment. SpatialArena spans five tasks, from monocular depth to SLAM. It covers 23 public datasets with 418,929 images across indoor, outdoor, aerial, object-centric, and dynamic scenes, together with Spatial Arena, our own captures with accurate poses and depth. Evaluating 52 models, we find that single-image depth is close to saturation on public benchmarks but not on large, uncontrolled scenes, and that progress now comes from consistency across frames and views, where feed-forward 3D/4D models match or surpass monocular specialists and overtake video depth models. The benchmark, toolbox, and leaderboard will be publicly released.

</details>


### [158] [Back to Raw Motion: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers for Text-to-Motion and Exact Conditional Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32793)
*Yun Chen,Jeonghyeok Do,Munchurl Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RawMo 将文本到动作生成迁移到原始动作空间（像素扩散思路），用 Motion Diffusion Transformer 与高噪声文本-动作对齐损失 HiNCE，避免编解码器误差并精确保持给定动作条件，在 HumanML3D 与 KIT-ML 上取得最优文本对齐与有竞争力的动作质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习式动作编解码器虽能通过紧凑潜表示提升生成效率，但会丢失细节且无法保证对给定条件的精确保持；而直接在原始数据空间生成可规避编解码器引入的误差。图像领域像素扩散已证明可在可接受算力下生成高质量样本，作者据此探索其在动作生成中的可行性。

Method: 提出 RawMo 框架，在原始动作空间做文本到动作扩散生成。核心为 Motion Diffusion Transformer（MiT），同时建模局部骨骼结构与全身动力学，并通过跨帧细化提升时间一致性；由于直接在原始动作空间工作，无需中间动作解码即可使用高噪声文本-动作对齐损失 HiNCE 增强文本一致性。单一条件模型支持多种动作条件任务，并精确保留给定动作条件。

Result: 在 HumanML3D 与 KIT-ML 上，RawMo 在对比方法中取得最佳文本对齐效果，动作质量具竞争力；消融实验验证了 MiT 与 HiNCE 的增益。

Conclusion: 像素级扩散范式可有效迁移至动作生成，原始动作空间建模在避免编解码损失、精确条件保持与多任务统一方面具优势，为后续原始空间动作生成研究提供了初步但有力的依据。

Abstract: As generative models tackle larger and more complex datasets, learned codecs enable efficient generation through compact latent representations, but may lose details and cannot guarantee exact preservation of given conditions. Generating directly in the original data space avoids errors introduced by the codec. Recent advances in image generation demonstrate that pixel diffusion can produce high-quality samples at practical computational costs. Inspired by these advances, we conduct a preliminary study of pixel diffusion, demonstrating its potential for adaptation to motion generation. Building on these findings, we present RawMo, a framework that brings text-to-motion generation to raw motion space. Our Motion Diffusion Transformer (MiT) models local skeletal structures and whole-body dynamics, while refining motion across frames to improve temporal consistency. Working directly in raw motion space further allows our high-noise text-motion alignment loss (HiNCE) to improve text consistency without intermediate motion decoding. RawMo supports multiple motion-conditioning tasks with a single conditional model while preserving given motion conditions exactly. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML show the best text alignment among compared methods and competitive motion quality, with ablations confirming the benefits of MiT and HiNCE.

</details>


### [159] [MemAnchorWorld: A Sparse World Model with Horizon-Conditioned Memory Retrieval for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32745)
*Xinyang Jia,Yuqi Zhang,Jiakai Wang,Yahu Yang,Guandong Pan,Chao Tong,Xianglong Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MemAnchorWorld：一种显式检索历史几何与语义证据的稀疏4D语义占据预测世界模型，通过预测时间条件化分层双路径记忆锚检索与点级残差适配器，在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏世界模型依赖场景状态隐式携带历史信息，导致误差在连续预测步中传播累积，长时程预测出现几何与语义偏差，历史时序证据利用不足。

Method: 受von Restorff效应启发，提出预测时间条件化的分层双路径记忆锚检索机制：以历史信息的有效年龄与语义兼容性为引导，结合查询级候选选择与点级记忆锚检索，为不同预测时刻的稀疏点提供历史证据；并设计点级残差适配器，由任务与预测时间联合门控，分别控制对语义、占据置信度与空间位置的残差修正。

Result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes数据集上，1–3 s预测时程的平均mIoU为13.55%、平均IoU为22.84%，两项指标均达到SOTA。

Conclusion: 显式历史证据检索可有效缓解稀疏世界模型的误差累积问题，提升长时程4D语义占据预测的几何与语义精度。

Abstract: Sparse world models for 4D semantic occupancy forecasting represent scenes with a small set of evolving queries to efficiently predict future geometry and semantics for autonomous driving. However, existing sparse world models face a bottleneck in using historical temporal evidence for long-horizon forecasting. They rely on scene states to carry historical information implicitly, allowing errors to propagate and accumulate across successive forecasting steps and causing geometric and semantic deviations. To address this limitation, we present MemAnchorWorld, a sparse occupancy world model that explicitly retrieves relevant historical geometric and semantic evidence for 4D semantic occupancy forecasting. Inspired by the von Restorff effect, we introduce a forecast-time-conditioned hierarchical dual-path memory-anchor retrieval mechanism. Guided by the effective age and semantic compatibility of historical information, it combines query-level candidate selection with point-level memory-anchor retrieval to provide historical evidence for sparse points at different forecast times. To better use memory anchors and existing features, a point-level residual adapter jointly gated by the task and forecast time separately controls residual corrections to semantics, occupancy confidence, and spatial positions. On Occ3D-nuScenes, MemAnchorWorld achieves an average mIoU of 13.55% and an average IoU of 22.84% across the 1-3 s forecasting horizons, attaining state-of-the-art performance on both metrics.Project page: https://memanchorworld.github.io/

</details>


### [160] [Every Edit Its Own Budget: Per-Instruction Token Freezing for Training-Free Acceleration of Multi-Edit Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32407)
*Jyotirmoy Nath,Neeraj Kumar,Brejesh Lall*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TIDE是一种免训练加速方法，为多指令图像编辑中的每条指令分配独立的计算预算，基于注意力定位的各指令区域与相对漂移阈值决定token冻结，并证明逐部误差预算的不可能性与最优阈值策略，在FLUX.2 Klein与Qwen-Image-Edit等模型上实现显著加速且编辑丢失最少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多编辑指令场景下，现有flow-matching图像编辑器的免训练加速器使用全图单一阈值跳过预测已稳定的token；为追求速度而调高的阈值会优先冻结果小、收敛慢的编辑，导致部分请求的编辑消失。因此需要按指令部件分别控制误差与计算预算。

Method: 1) 通过非平衡最优传输在编辑器自身注意力中定位每条指令部件对应的区域，无需掩码或外部模型；2) 当某token的漂移相对于其所属部件足够小时将其冻结，并沿直线路径外推到端点估计；3) 使用稀疏计算引擎只计算剩余未冻结token。理论部分证明部件无关规则无法保证逐部件误差预算，刻画最优逐部件阈值策略（至多每部件一个并列类），并给出该规则达到最优的条件。

Result: FLUX.2 Klein上，单一全局阈值在89%的MICE-Bench图像中至少破坏一个编辑的预算；TIDE在同等或更高速度下减少最多77%的编辑丢失（MICE-Bench上48%），人工评分印证该差距。在需较多步数的Klein Base上，TIDE在六个基准上均为最快（4.81–4.89x），TFLOPs较原模型减少5.3倍，为所测最大节省。相同设置下在Qwen-Image-Edit-2511上也最快（3.46–3.52x），并在全部六个基准上编辑丢失最少。

Conclusion: 逐部件、基于漂移的免训练加速策略在保持多指令编辑完整性的同时实现了显著加速与算力节省，且可跨模型族泛化；单一全局阈值方案存在系统性缺陷。

Abstract: Accelerating instruction-based image editing when one instruction requests several edits is challenging. Many training-free accelerators for flow-matching image editors skip tokens whose prediction has stopped changing, but decide this with a single threshold for the whole image. With several edits, such a threshold, tuned for speed, freezes small and slowly settling edits first, and requested edits disappear. We propose TIDE (Training-free Instruction-aware Drift-based Editing), which gives every instruction part its own compute budget. First, TIDE finds the region of each part in the editor's own attention by unbalanced optimal transport, without masks or external models. Second, it freezes a token once its drift is small relative to its own part and moves it along the straight path to its endpoint estimate. Third, a sparse engine computes only the remaining tokens. We prove that part-agnostic rules cannot guarantee per-part error budgets, characterize the optimal per-part threshold policy up to one tie class per part, and derive when our rule attains it. On FLUX.2 Klein, one global threshold breaks at least one edit's budget in 89% of MICE-Bench images, and TIDE drops up to 77% fewer edits at matched or higher speed (48% on MICE-Bench), a gap human raters confirm. On the many-step Klein Base, TIDE is the fastest compared method on six benchmarks (4.81-4.89x) and needs 5.3x fewer TFLOPs than vanilla, the largest saving we measure. With the same settings, it is also the fastest compared method on Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, a second model family (3.46-3.52x), and drops the fewest edits on all six benchmarks. Code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [161] [PRC4D: Physical Relation-Constrained Persistent 4D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32396)
*Junho Kim,Hyunyoung Choi,Jiseok Kim,Seongwon Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PRC4D：用物理关系约束筛选可靠的持久刚性关系，实现遮挡下一致的4D重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有4D重建通过局部空间与运动关联将运动外推到遮挡部分，但把短时接触或共享运动误判为持续刚性，会引入错误的运动约束并扭曲整体重建。

Method: 提出物理关系约束框架PRC4D：融合3D接触与相对运动一致性，并结合序列级验证区分持久耦合与瞬时交互，构建刚性关系图，用于观测位姿细化以及由可见部件向遮挡部件的运动传播，且不改变重建几何。

Result: 在多样真实多物体序列与可控遮挡仿真上，重建精度提升、相对位姿误差降低，可见性变化下物体构型更一致。

Conclusion: 以序列级验证的持久刚性关系替代局部启发式约束，可有效提升遮挡场景下多物体4D重建的空间一致性。

Abstract: A faithful 4D reconstruction should capture both the shape and motion of objects, even when they disappear from view. Existing methods preserve previously observed geometry and extend motion through occlusion using local spatial and motion associations. However, treating short-term contact or shared motion as sufficient evidence of persistent rigidity can introduce incorrect motion constraints and distort overall reconstruction. To address this limitation, we present PRC4D, a physical relation-constrained framework that identifies reliable rigid relations and uses them to maintain spatial consistency through occlusion. PRC4D combines 3D contact and relative motion consistency with sequence-level verification to distinguish persistent couplings from transient interactions. The resulting graph guides observed-pose refinement and motion propagation from visible to occluded components without altering reconstructed geometry. Experiments on diverse real-world multi-object sequences and controlled occlusion simulations demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy, reduced relative pose errors, and more consistent object configurations under changing visibility.

</details>


### [162] [DiCT: Teaching X-ray Vision-Language Models to Reason via Imagining CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32344)
*Zhenghao Lu,Xiaotian Zhang,Songtao Jiang,Yiqun Lin,Siming Fu,Hualiang Wang,Zuozhu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiCT：一个三阶段渐进式CT→X射线推理迁移框架，用CT视觉语言模型指导学生X射线VLM，使学生无需在推理时重建CT即可从2D X光进行3D解剖推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: X光诊断常需推理病灶3D位置及其与周围解剖结构的空间关系，但2D投影丢失了空间信息，使此类推理困难；而直接在推理时做CT重建代价高。

Method: 三阶段渐进迁移：(1) instruct the dreamer——赋予学生初始CT导向推理能力，建立区分X光观测与CT想象的显式接口；(2) visualize the dream——提出CT引导的on-policy蒸馏(OPD)，由CT教师选择性指导学生的推理轨迹以迁移3D解剖知识；(3) manifest the dream——将所学推理能力从数字重建影像(DRR)适配到真实临床X光。

Result: 在3D-RAD与ReXVQA两个基准、两种VLM骨干上验证有效性；在3D-RAD异常识别任务上较基于CT重建的基线提升1.66个百分点，同时推理计算量降低12.77倍。

Conclusion: CT引导的渐进式知识迁移可让X射线VLM内化3D空间推理能力，在保持临床可用性（推理仅需2D输入）的同时优于显式CT重建方案，兼顾精度与效率。

Abstract: Diagnosing with X-rays often requires reasoning about the 3D locations of abnormalities and their spatial relationships to surrounding anatomical structures, yet such reasoning remains challenging due to the loss of spatial information in 2D projections. To address this challenge, we propose Dreaming in CT (DiCT), a three-stage progressive CT-to-X-ray reasoning transfer framework that leverages a CT vision-language model (VLM) to guide an X-ray VLM. Through this CT-guided transfer, the student acquires CT-informed 3D reasoning capabilities, enabling it to reason directly from 2D X-rays without explicit CT reconstruction at inference time. The framework begins with instruct the dreamer, which equips the X-ray student with initial CT-oriented reasoning capabilities and establishes a structured interface that distinguishes X-ray observations from CT imagination. Building on this structure, visualize the dream introduces CT-guided on-policy distillation (OPD), where the CT teacher selectively guides the X-ray student's reasoning trajectories to transfer 3D anatomical knowledge. Finally, manifest the dream adapts the acquired reasoning capabilities from digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) to real clinical X-rays. Experiments across two VLM backbones on 3D-RAD and ReXVQA demonstrate DiCT's effectiveness across radiological reasoning tasks, achieving a 1.66 percentage point improvement over a CT reconstruction-based baseline on 3D-RAD Abnormality Identification with 12.77$\times$ lower inference computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/HongYep/DiCT.

</details>


### [163] [GUI-WEdit and GUI-SkillEvo: Gradient-Free Adaptation of Small GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32332)
*Haixia Bi,Yingtian Chen,Sihan Yang,Zuzheng Kuang,Yuzhen Tong,Kai Fu,Zhengyong Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 GUI-WEdit-4B 与 GUI-SkillEvo-2B 两种对 GUI-Owl-1.5 的无梯度适配方法：前者用轨迹反馈对末层 MLP 施加带保护约束的闭式更新，仅改动单个权重张量中 0.535% 的参数；后者在冻结权重下由助手迭代生成并精化程序化技能。在去除 Google Drive 任务的 361 项 OSWorld 子集上，两者最终聚合得分分别为 48.02% 与 45.47%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型 GUI 智能体虽能执行桌面工作流，但反复出现的局部错误与脆弱的过程性决策严重制约可靠性。作者希望在不进行梯度训练（避免昂贵反向传播与大改权重）的前提下提升其稳定性。

Method: 两种无梯度适配路线：(1) 对 4B 模型，利用轨迹反馈构造对后段 MLP 的闭式、有保护的更新，将成功状态作为保护约束，最终仅在一个权重张量内改动 23,739,095 个参数值（占 4,437,815,808 参数骨干的 0.535%）；(2) 对 2B 模型，权重完全冻结，由助手模块迭代提出并精化程序化技能（procedural skills）。

Result: 在排除 Google Drive 任务的 361 项 OSWorld 子集上，两个冻结系统（推理时不再更新）的最终聚合得分分别为 48.02%（GUI-WEdit-4B）和 45.47%（GUI-SkillEvo-2B）。

Conclusion: 结果说明提升 GUI 智能体可靠性不必依赖全参数梯度训练：极小范围、受约束的权重编辑与外部技能迭代均可在冻结骨干上取得可用的 OSWorld 性能，为轻量、低成本的智能体适配提供了两条互补路径。

Abstract: Small graphical user interface (GUI) agents can execute desktop workflows, but repeated local errors and fragile procedural decisions limit their reliability. We present GUI-WEdit-4B and GUI-SkillEvo-2B, two gradient-free adaptations of GUI-Owl-1.5 backbones. For the 4B model, we use trajectory feedback to construct guarded, closed-form updates to a late multilayer perceptron (MLP), retaining successful states as protection constraints. The final checkpoint changes 23,739,095 parameter values, or 0.535\% of the 4,437,815,808-parameter backbone, within one weight tensor. For the 2B model, an assistant iteratively proposes and refines procedural skills while the model weights remain fixed. On the 361-task OSWorld subset excluding Google Drive tasks, the frozen systems obtain final aggregate scores of 48.02\% and 45.47\%, respectively.

</details>


### [164] [SynAVID: A Synthetic Audio-Visual Immersive Dataset of Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32311)
*Jun Xu,Sujing Li,Chunhao Bi,Zhengxue Cheng,Ronghua Wu,Qunshan Gu,Li Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SynAVID：含8个室内外场景、分钟级片段、固定相机阵列与运动轨迹结合、同步且视角相关的双耳音频的合成视听沉浸数据集，并系统评测视觉重建、双耳音频重建与视听编辑方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 沉浸式场景建模需要视角与场景条件变化下同步的视觉与听觉观测，但难以获得可控场景变化的观测及参考，缺乏此类基准数据。

Method: 构建合成数据生成流程：共享的场景动态、声源事件与观察者位姿同时驱动视觉渲染与几何感知的声学合成；每段分钟级episode融合固定相机阵列与移动轨迹，输出同步、视角相关的双耳音频；并提供几何与实例标注及配对编辑参考。

Result: 混合观测配置通常提升固定与运动测试视角下的视觉重建，但瞬态占据与稀疏观测区域仍具挑战；各方法在频谱、双耳（interaural）与感知音频指标上排序不一致；几何与实例标注揭示观测支持不均及局部高斯表示的局限；配对参考可评估目标编辑与周边内容，受控几何变化产生依赖听者的声学响应。

Conclusion: SynAVID为视听沉浸建模提供可控、同步、多视角的合成基准，暴露现有重建与编辑方法的不足，项目页面见 https://avery-xu.github.io/synavid-project/。

Abstract: Immersive scene modeling requires synchronized visual and auditory observations under changing viewpoints and scene conditions. Obtaining such observations and references for controlled scene changes remains challenging. We introduce SynAVID, a synthetic audio-visual immersive dataset comprising eight indoor and outdoor scenes. Each minute-scale episode combines fixed camera arrays and moving trajectories with synchronized, viewpoint-dependent binaural audio. Shared scene dynamics, sound-source events, and observer poses drive visual rendering and geometry-aware acoustic synthesis. We evaluate existing methods for visual reconstruction, binaural audio reconstruction, and audiovisual editing. Mixed-observation configurations generally improve visual reconstruction on fixed and moving test views, while transiently occupied and sparsely observed regions remain challenging. Methods rank differently on spectral, interaural, and perceptual audio metrics. Geometric and instance annotations expose uneven observation support and local Gaussian representations beyond aggregate scores. Paired references assess target edits and surrounding content, while controlled geometry changes produce listener-dependent acoustic responses. The project page is available at https://avery-xu.github.io/synavid-project/.

</details>


### [165] [StreamCoach: Proactive Sports Coaching via Continuous Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32281)
*Xiaoye Liang,Yiming Huang,Jialu Wu,Yushe Cao,Ruxiang Duan,Yi Sun,Tie Liu,Lai Jiang,Mai Xu,Shikun Feng,Yiheng Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出流式动作质量评估框架 StreamCoach，在 OnCueCoaching 范式下结合连续思维链推理与主动式、证据门控的教练反馈，并构建 EE4D-Stream 数据集，采用时序-语义对齐强化学习训练，在干预时机、动作评估与指导质量上达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AQA 方法多针对已完成动作进行评估，难以提供及时反馈；流式方法虽降低延迟，但推理能力有限，难以利用细微动作线索与运动专项知识，且反馈碎片化，只关注单一身体部位，忽略其他部位细节与动作阶段间的转换。

Method: 提出 OnCueCoaching 范式下的流式 AQA 框架 StreamCoach：Technique-Aware Reasoning 依据运动专项标准追踪身体部位运动与动作阶段转换；Holistic Coaching 整合累积证据输出及时、全面的优势与技术错误反馈。基于 Ego-Exo4D 的 1,213 段体育视频，通过 LLM 辅助重标注与人工审核构建 EE4D-Stream，提供密集 CoT 标注与证据门控语音内容。使用时序-语义对齐强化学习（TSA-RL）联合优化反馈时机与内容。

Result: 在 EE4D-Stream 上与 11 个离线及流式基线（含 3 个专有模型）对比，StreamCoach 在干预时机、动作评估和指导质量三方面均取得 SOTA，优于 GPT-6.1 Sol 与 Claude Opus 5.5。

Conclusion: 将连续 CoT 推理与主动式证据门控反馈相结合，可有效缓解流式 AQA 的推理不足与反馈碎片化问题，实现及时且全面的运动技术指导。

Abstract: In fitness and sports training, timely action quality assessment (AQA) is essential for learners to identify and correct technical errors during movement execution. However, most AQA methods assess completed performances, limiting their ability to provide timely feedback. Streaming methods alleviate this latency, but limited reasoning hinders their use of subtle movement cues and sport-specific knowledge. Moreover, their fragmented feedback focuses on one body part at a time, overlooking movement details of other body parts and transitions between action phases. To address these limitations, we propose StreamCoach, a streaming AQA framework under the OnCueCoaching paradigm that couples continuous chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning with proactive, evidence-gated coaching. Technique-Aware Reasoning tracks body-part movements and action-phase transitions against sport-specific criteria, while Holistic Coaching integrates accumulated evidence to deliver timely, comprehensive feedback on strengths and technical errors. To support training and benchmarking, we construct EE4D-Stream from 1,213 sports video sequences in Ego-Exo4D through LLM-assisted reannotation and manual review of selected claims, pairing dense CoT annotations with evidence-gated speech content. Building on this dataset, we train StreamCoach using Temporal-Semantic Alignment Reinforcement Learning to jointly optimize feedback timing and content. We benchmark 11 offline and streaming baselines on EE4D-Stream, including three proprietary models. StreamCoach achieves state-of-the-art results across intervention timing, action assessment, and coaching quality, surpassing both GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5.

</details>


### [166] [MYSTIQUE: Few-Shot Facial Identity Transfer with Performance Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32232)
*Shihan Cheng,David Hyde,Junting Deng,Michael Bao,Paul Debevec,Roshni Cooper,Soshi Shimada*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MYSTIQUE：基于扩散模型的身份迁移方法，通过分离身份与表情/光照/场景流并引入多种解耦训练策略，抑制身份泄漏，在用户研究、人脸形状恢复与识别分数上优于对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉特效中的身份迁移需将驱动图像中的人物身份替换为目标人物，同时保留表情、光照、姿态与场景。由于成对真值稀缺，常用自重建训练，而模型会通过从驱动图像复制身份线索走"捷径"，导致推理时出现身份泄漏（驱动图像为他人时身份被污染）。核心观察是：泄漏可经由任何读取驱动图像的输入通道进入。

Method: 提出 MYSTIQUE 扩散式身份迁移方法：身份取自目标人物的一组照片，表情、光照与场景通过独立流读取。采用多阶段训练实现解耦，并在各流输入端施加解耦策略：(1) 随机块状掩码，其边界不沿脸部轮廓；(2) 自增强，随机改变表情输入中的脸型而保持表情不变；(3) 人脸随机化，替换表情与光照输入中的人物，而真值仍为驱动图像。推理时将光照输入形变到第一遍生成的脸型上，减少经光照流的脸型泄漏。评估结合人脸识别分数、人工判断，以及已知形状渲染人脸上的脸型指标。

Result: 用户研究中，评分者认为 MYSTIQUE 的结果比各对比方法更接近目标人物；在对比方法中，MYSTIQUE 恢复目标脸型最准确，且随提供目标照片数量增加，其识别分数提升最大。

Conclusion: 通过以分离流读取身份与表情/光照/场景，并在输入端施加针对性解耦策略（掩码、自增强、人脸随机化、推理期光照形变），可有效抑制身份泄漏，在感知相似度、脸型准确性与识别分数随参考照片增加的可扩展性上均取得最优表现。

Abstract: In visual effects, identity transfer replaces the identity in a driving image with that of a target person, while preserving the expression, lighting, pose and scene of that image. Paired ground truth is rarely available, so many methods are trained by self-reconstruction, where the model can learn a shortcut by copying identity cues from the driving image. This shortcut causes identity leakage at inference, where the driving image shows a different person. Our key observation is that leakage can enter through any input that reads the driving image. We therefore present MYSTIQUE, a diffusion-based identity transfer method that takes identity from a set of the target's photos and reads expression, lighting and scene through separate streams. It learns to disentangle identity from the other streams through multi-stage training, with disentanglement strategies at their inputs: a random block mask whose boundaries do not follow the face outline, self-augmentation, which randomly changes the face shape in the expression input and keeps its expression, and face randomization, which replaces the person in the expression and lighting inputs while the ground truth stays the driving image. At inference, we also warp the lighting input onto the face shape of a first pass, which reduces face-shape leakage through the lighting stream. Since face-recognition scores and human judgments each have limits, we evaluate identity with both, together with face-shape metrics on rendered faces of known shape. In a user study, raters judge MYSTIQUE's results more like the target than those of each compared method. Among these methods, MYSTIQUE also recovers the target's face shape most accurately, and its recognition score gains the most as more photos of the target are given.

</details>


### [167] [SolarFilNet-V4: Multi-Scale Transformer Vision with Physics-Informed Adaptive Post-Processing for Solar Filament Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32193)
*Indra Agustian,Ruvita Faurina*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SolarFilNet-V4：PVT-v2-B1+各向异性条带卷积+双频前馈+全分辨率浅支路的多任务日珥分割框架，在MAGFiLO 1.0基准上OOF PQ=0.4340、Public LB=0.380，含15.46M参数、224.34 GFLOPs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日珥（暗条）是磁场支撑的冷密色球等离子体结构，其失稳会触发日冕物质抛射与空间天气灾害，因此精确分割具有业务价值。但基于地基GONG H-alpha（2048×2048）的低对比度、湍流纤维、精细倒钩结构与标注者边界不一致，使个体日珥分割困难。

Method: 主干为轻量PVT-v2-B1；引入各向异性曲线条带卷积（k=15）与双频前馈块（DFFN）以贴合延展磁流绳并捕捉细窄中央脊线；并行1024×1024浅层全分辨率卷积分支保留高频边缘、缓解下采样损失；训练采用掩膜、中心线脊、倒钩边界与像素对比表征的多任务监督；推理时用8重二面体TTA（D4）、双线性上采样至原生2048×2048，并按宁静/活动日面自适应校准形态学连接参数。

Result: 官方基准上折外验证Panoptic Quality为0.4340，Public Leaderboard得分0.380；模型15.46M参数、单次前向224.34 GFLOPs，参数量较标准ResNet-34 U-Net基线减少36.8%。

Conclusion: 面向细长、低对比度日珥结构的定制化设计（条带卷积+全分辨率支路+多任务+活动自适应后处理）在可控计算量下取得了基准上的可用性能，报告作为技术说明给出了模型与流程细节。

Abstract: Solar filaments are cool, dense chromospheric plasma structures held by magnetic field lines above polarity inversion lines. Their destabilization triggers coronal mass ejections and severe space weather hazards. Segmenting individual filaments from ground-based GONG H-alpha observations (2048 x 2048 pixels) is challenging due to low contrast, turbulent fibrils, delicate barb structures, and annotator boundary variance. In this technical report, we describe SolarFilNet-V4, a targeted segmentation framework developed for the MAGFiLO 1.0 benchmark (Solar Filament Segmentation Challenge 2026). Our method couples a lightweight Pyramid Vision Transformer (PVT-v2-B1) backbone with anisotropic curvilinear strip convolutions (k=15) and dual-frequency feed-forward blocks (DFFN) to follow extended flux ropes while capturing thin central spines. A shallow full-resolution convolutional branch operating at 1024 x 1024 preserves high-frequency edge details and mitigates transformer downsampling. We train the network using multi-task supervision over masks, centerline spines, barb boundaries, and pixel-contrastive representations. At test time, we apply 8-fold dihedral test-time augmentation (D4), bilinearly upscale predictions to the native 2048 x 2048 grid, and apply an activity-adaptive post-processing routine that calibrates morphological joining parameters for quiet versus active solar disks. On the official benchmark, SolarFilNet-V4 achieves an out-of-fold validation Panoptic Quality of 0.4340 and a Public Leaderboard score of 0.380. The model contains 15.46M parameters and requires 224.34 GFLOPs per forward pass, reducing parameter count by 36.8% compared to standard ResNet-34 U-Net baselines.

</details>


### [168] [FewRef-5: Fixed-Reference Test-Time Adaptation for Virtual Staining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32591)
*Wenxuan Wang,Liwen Wang,Mingmin Wu,Xingbo Dong,Zhe Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FewRef-5：一种基于StainPromptInversion的少参考测试时自适应（TTA）虚拟染色方法，用5张真实MAS训练块的染色统计作为固定目标，在推理阶段逐查询优化视觉提示，无需重训生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚拟染色由H&E合成特殊染色图像，但固定推理规则无法利用部署时可获得的真实目标染色参考，限制了针对单个查询的染色外观校正。

Method: 对5张真实MAS训练块提取组织掩膜后的光密度均值与标准差并平均为固定染色目标；在StainPromptInversion基础上，以调度式统计匹配损失将目标注入逐查询视觉提示优化，并结合边缘/Gram一致性惩罚与继承的重建目标；目标跨查询保持不变，避免对先前生成输出的递归依赖，生成器保持冻结。

Result: 在1,989个查询的H&E→MAS输出上，相较Edge+Gram变体，目标集FID由183.201降至166.904，以源图像为参照的SSIM由0.92787升至0.94996；源PSNR与MS-SSIM下降。

Conclusion: 参考引导的TTA可在不重训生成器的前提下显著改善虚拟染色的染色外观与目标域分布匹配，但存在端点权衡（感知/结构相似性提升而像素级保真度下降），并非全面更优的重建。

Abstract: Virtual staining synthesizes special-stain images from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E), extending the information available from an existing digital slide. However, a fixed inference rule can leave available real target-stain references unused, limiting query-specific correction of stain appearance at deployment. Test-time adaptation (TTA) provides a mechanism for this reference-guided, query-specific refinement without retraining the generator. We therefore propose FewRef-5, a reference-assisted TTA method for virtual staining built on StainPromptInversion. We extract tissue-masked optical-density means and standard deviations from five real Masson's trichrome (MAS) training patches and average them into a fixed stain target. A scheduled statistic-matching loss introduces this target into per-query visual-prompt optimization alongside our edge/Gram consistency penalties and the inherited reconstruction objectives. The target remains unchanged across queries, avoiding recursive dependence on earlier generated outputs while the pretrained generator stays fixed. On recorded H&E-to-MAS outputs for 1,989 queries, FewRef-5 reduces target-set FID from 183.201 to 166.904 and increases source-referenced SSIM from 0.92787 to 0.94996 relative to our Edge+Gram variant. Source PSNR and MS-SSIM decrease, showing an endpoint trade-off rather than uniformly better reconstruction.

</details>


### [169] [SetCon: Setup-Conditioned IMU-Language Learning from 3D Human Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32548)
*Lennart Schiweck,Alaa Saleh,Cristóbal Curio*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SetCon 用"选择性不变性"替代现有 IMU-语言模型的全局不变性：先从少量无标签窗口估计设备佩戴方式（body site + mounting），再以该估计为条件调节编码器，实现零样本穿戴活动识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IMU 信号强烈依赖佩戴配置（body site 与 mounting 的组合）。现有领先的 IMU-语言模型让编码器对 mounting 完全不变，但同时也丢弃了设备相对身体的方向信息（如区分坐/站/躺的重力方向），造成信息损失。

Method: 1）选择性不变性：在已知 body site 上，利用少量无标签窗口估计每台设备的 mounting，并对编码器做条件化；利用佩戴期间 mounting 近乎固定、而身体在运动，将"运动身体"作为标定目标。2）标定与表示学习均由 3D 人体运动监督：同一动作可在多种已知传感器配置下仿真。3）测试时用类名或 anchor（类名与活动描述文本嵌入的平均）表示类别，无需标注窗口。4）在冻结编码器上构建语言模型，回答动作"如何做"及"执行顺序"。

Result: 仅使用与 AnyMo 相同的 Nymeria 动作捕捉仿真 IMU 训练，SetCon 在 13 个真实数据集上的平均零样本准确率为：使用类名 56.6%、使用 anchor 65.3%；对应 AnyMo 为 41.8% 与 46.7%。

Conclusion: 对 mounting 的完全不变并非最优；以估计出的佩戴配置为条件的"选择性不变性"，可保留重力方向等有用姿态线索，显著提升跨设备零样本活动识别性能，并支持基于冻结编码器的动作过程与顺序问答。

Abstract: Aligning inertial measurement unit (IMU) signals with text enables zero-shot activity recognition across wearable devices. A worn device's signal depends on its setup, the combination of body site and mounting. Leading IMU-language models make their encoders invariant to the mounting, which also discards the device's orientation relative to the body, such as the direction of gravity that separates sitting, standing and lying. We introduce SetCon, which replaces full invariance with selective invariance. It estimates each device's mounting on its known body site from a few unlabeled windows and conditions its encoder on this estimate. Because the mounting stays nearly fixed while the device is worn, the moving body serves as a calibration target. Both calibration and representation learning are supervised by 3D human motion, since one movement can be simulated under many known sensor setups. At test time, a class is represented by its name or by an anchor, which averages the text embeddings of the name and of activity descriptions and needs no labeled window. A language model built on the frozen encoder also answers how and in what order a movement is performed. Trained only on IMU simulated from the same Nymeria motion capture as AnyMo, SetCon reaches 56.6% mean zero-shot accuracy on 13 real datasets with class names and 65.3% with anchors, against 41.8% and 46.7% for AnyMo.

</details>


### [170] [Smooth Essential-Manifold Residuals for View-Graph Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32540)
*Viktor Larsson,Johannes Schönberger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对view-graph标定中本质矩阵流形距离的目标函数表示问题，提出等距约简到2x2矩阵的残差，使每支约束成为线性子空间，得到2维光滑残差且高斯-牛顿近似一般满秩，收敛更快、无需逐边SVD，同时保持几何精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统奇异值形式的残差将本质矩阵的两个独立约束坍缩为一个标量残差，导致每条边的高斯-牛顿模型秩亏，收敛性能差；本文希望为非线性最小二乘寻找更合适的流形距离目标表示。

Method: 通过等距约简将本质矩阵约束化为2x2矩阵问题，使约束每一分支对应线性子空间；构造光滑的二维残差，其平方范数精确等于原始流形距离，高斯-牛顿近似一般满秩，且无需逐边奇异值分解。

Result: 实验表明新残差在保持几何目标估计精度的同时，以更少、计算更廉价的迭代收敛；结合鲁棒初始化与优化，在接近廉价代数目标的运行时间下达到state-of-the-art的view-graph标定精度。

Conclusion: 2x2等距约简残差是本质流形距离的更优NLS表示，兼顾精度、收敛效率与计算成本，可用于高效高精度的view-graph标定。

Abstract: View-graph calibration jointly estimates camera intrinsics from multiple pairwise fundamental matrices. The correct intrinsics transform each fundamental matrix into an essential matrix, casting the calibration problem as minimizing the distance to the essential manifold. We study how to represent this objective for nonlinear least squares. The conventional singular-value formulation collapses two independent essential-matrix constraints into one scalar residual. Its per-edge Gauss-Newton model is therefore rank deficient, which leads to poor convergence. We instead derive an isometric reduction to 2x2 matrices, where each branch of the nonlinear essential-matrix constraint becomes a linear subspace. This reduction yields a smooth two-dimensional residual whose squared norm is exactly the original manifold distance, whose Gauss-Newton approximation is generically full rank, and whose evaluation requires no per-edge singular value decomposition. Experiments show that the new residual retains the estimation accuracy of the geometric objective while converging in fewer, computationally cheaper iterations. Combined with robust initialization and optimization, it achieves state-of-the-art view-graph calibration accuracy at a runtime comparable to inexpensive algebraic objectives.

</details>


### [171] [CalibTrack: Exploring Learned Heteroscedastic Covariance for Robust Multi-Camera Pedestrian Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32500)
*Jack Roberts,Aditya Iyer,Nora Ayanian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出检测端协方差预测器CalibTrack，用逐检测的异方差测量协方差替代均匀协方差，在WildTrack与MultiviewX上配合多种解析多视角跟踪器验证其对校准与鲁棒性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解析式多视角多目标跟踪（MV-MOT）依赖测量协方差来引导关联、融合与状态估计，但现有协方差多为启发式，需针对具体部署场景手工调参，缺乏原理性依据。

Method: 引入CalibTrack：在检测端预测每个检测的异方差测量协方差，替代均匀协方差；在WildTrack和MultiviewX数据集上，与身份信息增强的GM-PHD、JIPDA、剪枝delta-GLMB三种解析跟踪核心组合评估；并通过Stable Diffusion模拟恶劣天气、高斯噪声、相机偏色与相机丢失进行鲁棒性测试。

Result: 相比置信度缩放的协方差，CalibTrack在恶劣条件下平均跟踪性能更优，且预测校准更好；与更强的启发式协方差方法相比，学习协方差的收益受限于观测质量与下游跟踪器选择。

Conclusion: 学习式异方差协方差对不确定性感知的解析跟踪具有价值，但其优势是有限的；该工作为学习协方差估计提供了有原理支撑的探索框架。

Abstract: Analytical multi-view multi-object tracking (MV-MOT) systems rely on measurement covariance estimates to guide association, fusion, and state estimation. These covariance estimates are typically heuristic, requiring hand-tuning to the specific deployment scenario. We investigate how learned heteroscedastic measurement covariance affects calibration and robustness in analytical multi-camera tracking. To support this analysis, we introduce CalibTrack, a detector-side predictor that replaces uniform measurement covariance with per-detection covariance. We evaluate CalibTrack on the WildTrack and MultiviewX pedestrian tracking datasets with multiple analytical tracker cores, including an identity-informed GM-PHD, JIPDA, and pruned delta-GLMB filter. We additionally evaluate robustness by simulating adverse weather conditions with stable diffusion, Gaussian noise, camera browning, and camera dropout. CalibTrack improves average adverse tracking performance over confidence-scaled covariance, while producing better calibrated predictions, indicating the value of heteroscedastic covariance within analytical tracking. Comparisons with stronger heuristic covariance methods show that the benefits of learned covariance remain bounded by the quality of available observations and the downstream tracker choice. Together, these findings provide a principled exploration of learned covariance estimation and its potential for uncertainty-aware analytical tracking.

</details>


### [172] [X-3DComposer: Feed-Forward 3D Scene Composition with Any Assets from Any Views](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32491)
*Zidian Qiu,Ancong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出X-3DComposer，将单/多视图场景图像中的物体布局预测与资产生成解耦：把每个物体的资产渲染视为"视图"，用适配VGGT-Ω的多视图几何模型预测渲染相机，再由闭式解得到物体旋转、平移与逐轴尺度，单次前向约1秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建可编辑三维场景需要"资产+布局"，资产已可由3D生成与CAD检索获得，但布局缺乏通用解：场景生成方法把布局与生成耦合，位姿估计器一次仅处理单物体且依赖真实尺寸CAD、深度或迭代优化。

Method: 前馈式布局预测模型，与资产生成分离。输入：一或多张场景图像、物体掩码、任意来源的每物体资产。核心思路是"将物体视为视图"——把资产渲染图与场景图像一起送入由VGGT-Ω改造的多视图几何模型，每个物体的位姿由其渲染图所预测的相机闭式推导，同时得到旋转、平移与逐轴尺度；相机内参、位姿与深度为可选输入。

Result: 固定五种场景生成方法产生的网格、仅替换布局时，X-3DComposer布局精度优于这些方法的原生布局；与独立布局模型SceneMaker相比，在IndoorMix（六个室内数据集构成的测试集）上场景级Chamfer距离降低52%，在3D-FUTURE上降低28%。单次前向约1秒。

Conclusion: 布局可作为一种独立、可插拔的前馈任务求解，通过"物体即视图"的几何范式实现快速、通用的场景布局预测，并能直接提升现有场景生成方法的布局质量。

Abstract: Composing an editable 3D scene from images requires an asset for each object and a layout that places the assets. 3D generation and CAD retrieval now supply the assets, but layout still lacks a general solution: scene generation methods couple it with generation, and pose estimators handle one object at a time and need true-size CAD models, depth, or iterative refinement. We present X-3DComposer, a feed-forward model that predicts the layout separately from asset generation. Given one or more images of a scene, the object masks, and an asset for each object from any source, it jointly predicts the rotation, translation, and per-axis scale of all objects in a single forward pass of about one second. The key idea is to treat objects as views: renders of the assets are processed together with the scene images by a multi-view geometry model adapted from VGGT-$Ω$, and each object pose follows in closed form from the cameras predicted for its renders. Camera intrinsics, camera poses, and depth are optional inputs. When the meshes produced by five scene generation methods are kept fixed and only their layout is replaced, the layouts of X-3DComposer are more accurate than the native layouts of these methods. Compared with the stand-alone layout model SceneMaker, it reduces the scene-level Chamfer distance by 52% on IndoorMix, our test set from six indoor datasets, and by 28% on 3D-FUTURE.

</details>


### [173] [$ε$-Seg++: Ensembling Across Hierarchy and Training Time for Label-Efficient EM Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32290)
*Edoardo Giacomello,Sheida Rahnamai Kordasiabi,Mehdi Seifi,Florian Jug*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ε-Seg++ 在层级 VAE 的每一层都放置语义专家并用无参数的专家乘积融合，同时引入无泄漏的子体积切分协议以支持 3D 输入，并将检查点选择视为方法的一部分（对 top-ranked 检查点做跨训练时间集成）。在 BetaSeg FIB-SEM 上，2,500 标签时 2D 平均 Dice 提升约 0.1；≤600 标签时 2D 模型以约 1/11 的预测代价追平或超越 3D ε-Seg；>1000 标签时 3D 占优，等标注成本下 3D ε-Seg++ 平均 Dice 0.905 vs. D3PM 0.880，且预测快 5.4–27 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电镜体数据的语义分割是定量细胞生物学的核心步骤，但逐体素稠密标注代价过高。ε-Seg 表明只用稀疏标注体素训练层级 VAE 即可获得有竞争力的分割结果，但该方法仅从最高层潜变量分类，且只能处理 2D 图像块，未能利用层级结构的全部信息，也无法直接用于 3D 体数据。

Method: (1) 在层级 VAE 的每一层潜变量处均设置语义专家，并通过无参数的专家乘积（product of experts）整合各层预测；(2) 提出无泄漏的子体积切分协议，使模型可接受 3D 输入，并让 2D 与 3D 模型在相同的稀疏监督条件下可比较；(3) 将检查点选择纳入方法设计，对排名靠前的检查点做跨训练时间的第二重集成，以应对验证标签同样稀缺的问题。

Result: 在 BetaSeg FIB-SEM 数据集上：2,500 个训练标签时，多层专家使 2D 平均 Dice 提升约 0.1；训练标签不超过 600 时，2D 模型以约 1/11 的预测代价达到或超过 3D ε-Seg；标签超过约一千后 3D 输入占优，在同等标注成本下 3D ε-Seg++ 平均 Dice 达 0.905，优于 D3PM 的 0.880，且预测速度快 5.4–27 倍（分别对应检查点集成与单模型）。检查点集成平均性能与单最优选择相当，并在验证集较小时显著改善最差情况。

Conclusion: 多层级语义专家与专家乘积融合能有效利用层级潜变量信息；无泄漏子体积切分使 2D/3D 在同等稀疏监督下公平比较，并揭示标注预算（约一千标签）决定 2D 与 3D 的优劣切换；在稀疏标注与稀缺验证的场景下，检查点集成是稳健且几乎无额外推理成本的模型选择策略，使 ε-Seg++ 在精度与效率上同时优于 D3PM 等基线。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation of electron microscopy (EM) volumes is a central step in quantitative cell biology, but dense voxel-wise annotation is prohibitively expensive. $ε$-Seg showed that a hierarchical variational autoencoder trained on sparsely annotated voxels can yield competitive segmentations, but it classifies from its topmost latent level only and operates exclusively on 2D patches. We introduce $ε$-Seg++, which places a semantic expert at every level of the hierarchy and consolidates their predictions with a parameter-free product of experts. We further enable 3D inputs through a leakage-free sub-volume splitting protocol, which allows 2D and 3D models to be compared under identical sparse supervision. Because validation labels are just as scarce as training labels, we treat checkpoint selection as part of the method and average the top-ranked checkpoints, a second ensemble, this time across training time. On the BetaSeg FIB-SEM dataset, the multi-level experts improve 2D mean Dice by about 0.1 at 2,500 training labels. With up to 600 training labels, the 2D model matches or exceeds 3D $ε$-Seg at about one eleventh of its prediction cost. Above roughly a thousand labels, 3D inputs dominate, and at matched annotation cost 3D $ε$-Seg++ reaches a mean Dice of 0.905 versus 0.880 for D3PM, while predicting between 5.4 and 27 times faster (with our checkpoint ensemble or a single model, respectively). Checkpoint ensembling matches single-best selection on average and markedly improves the worst case when the validation set is small.

</details>


### [174] [LRQ-Cache: Compressing Feature Caches in Video Diffusion via Low-Rank Approximation and Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32345)
*Ruizhe Yao,Zhen Huang,Songpan Gao,Danyi Liu,Zijian Cao,Weijie Zheng,Haohuan Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LRQ-Cache：对视频扩散Transformer的时间缓存做低秩近似+量化压缩，将预测式缓存的持久状态缩减42–71倍（109–346 GiB→2.3–4.9 GiB），VBench质量基本持平，使原本超出单卡显存的缓存可驻留80 GB H100，推理较CPU卸载方案快2.7–5.9倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频DiT推理昂贵，时间缓存通过跨去噪步复用中间特征加速，但保留稠密特征张量的持久存储开销随视频长度、分辨率和缓存覆盖率增长，评估的预测式缓存单视频需109–346 GiB，超出单GPU显存，只能CPU卸载（拖慢生成）或序列并行分片（缓存规模而非算力决定GPU数量）。作者观察到缓存特征存在冗余：少量跨token共享的通道模式即可捕获其大部分能量，故直接压缩缓存状态本身。

Method: 提出LRQ-Cache，一种无需训练的方法，将低秩近似与量化结合用于特征缓存压缩：每个缓存特征用一小组因子表示，存储前对因子量化，复用时重建特征；不改变原有缓存机制，可即插即用于多种时间缓存方案。

Result: 在HunyuanVideo与Wan2.1上跨三种缓存机制：预测式缓存持久状态缩减42–71倍至2.3–4.9 GiB/视频；TeaCache的VBench指标与原生缓存差距在0.25个百分点内；Wan2.1预测式缓存最大3.5 pp的下降在更高秩下缩小；原本超出单张80 GB H100的预测式缓存可单卡容纳，生成速度较CPU卸载原生缓存快2.7–5.9倍。

Conclusion: 缓存压缩是缓解视频DiT时间缓存存储瓶颈的有效途径，以轻微质量损失换取大幅显存节省与显著加速；且压缩带来的质量损失可通过提高秩来调节。

Abstract: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) achieve high-fidelity generation, but inference is expensive because every denoising step evaluates a large transformer over all spatiotemporal tokens of the video. Temporal caching accelerates them by reusing intermediate features across denoising steps. However, retaining dense feature tensors introduces a persistent storage cost that grows with video length, resolution, and cache coverage, reaching 109-346 GiB per video for the predictive caches we evaluate. Such states exceed the memory of a single GPU, so native caches must either be offloaded to the CPU, which slows generation, or be sharded across several GPUs, e.g., with sequence parallelism, so that the cache rather than the compute sets the number of GPUs. We instead shrink the cached state itself, exploiting its redundancy: a few channel patterns shared across tokens capture much of the energy of each cached feature. Based on this observation, we propose LRQ-Cache, a training-free method that combines low-rank approximation and quantization for feature-cache compression. LRQ-Cache represents each cached feature with a small set of factors, quantizes them before storage, and reconstructs the feature at reuse time, leaving cache mechanisms unchanged. Across three caching mechanisms on HunyuanVideo and Wan2.1, LRQ-Cache reduces the persistent state of predictive caches by 42-71x, to 2.3-4.9 GiB per video. VBench stays within 0.25 pp of the native cache for TeaCache, and the larger drops of the Wan2.1 predictive caches, up to 3.5 pp, shrink at higher ranks. As a result, predictive caches that exceed the memory of a single 80 GB H100 GPU fit on it with LRQ-Cache, making generation 2.7-5.9x faster than with CPU-offloaded native caches.

</details>


### [175] [ShapeQuest: Towards Granularity-Controlled Edit-Conditioned 3D Asset Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32621)
*Faris Abu-Ali,Sankalp Sinha,Didier Stricker,Muhammad Zeshan Afzal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出编辑条件3D资产检索任务，构建ShapeQuest基准与ShapeQuester模型，通过联合重建与部件掩码监督实现精确编辑变体检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像领域的编辑条件检索已成熟，但针对单体3D资产的编辑检索研究不足，缺乏基准与有效方法。

Method: ShapeQuest开源流水线对带纹理网格进行部件增删、材质与颜色修改编辑；按影响表面积比例划分五级编辑粒度，并在一部分指令下保留多个有效目标；用视觉语言模型从暴露编辑部件的视角评判编辑，并由人工审核。ShapeQuester联合学习检索与编辑点云重建，用部件掩码监督变化区和保留区。

Result: 测试集上，冻结点云编码器时ShapeQuester达50.4 operation-macro mAP@10，优于同输入融合基线47.2与最强基线48.6；从头训练编码器时，重建贡献验证集提升6.5个点，其中部件掩码贡献3.3个点。

Conclusion: ShapeQuest与ShapeQuester为编辑条件3D资产检索建立基准与强基线，联合重建和部件掩码监督有效区分竞争性编辑变体。

Abstract: Given a reference asset and an instruction such as "remove one armrest," a retriever must find variants that make the edit and preserve the other parts. This search is well established for images but remains underexplored for individual 3D assets. To study this problem, we introduce ShapeQuest and ShapeQuester, a new benchmark and model for edit-conditioned 3D asset retrieval. ShapeQuest's open-source pipeline edits textured meshes through part additions, removals, and material and colour changes. It controls edit granularity across five levels, defined by the fraction of the object's surface area each edit affects. It constructs multiple valid targets when an instruction leaves the choice of part open. A vision-language model judges each edit from views chosen to expose the edited parts, and human raters audit its judgments. ShapeQuest has 87,824 queries in 50 categories and a 50,919-shape gallery with competing edits. To distinguish these variants, ShapeQuester learns retrieval alongside reconstruction of the edited point cloud, with part masks supervising changed and preserved regions. With a frozen pretrained point encoder, ShapeQuester reaches 50.4 operation-macro mAP@10 on the test split, against 47.2 for the fusion baseline with the same inputs and 48.6 for the strongest baseline. Reconstruction adds 6.5 points on the validation split when the point encoder is trained from scratch, including 3.3 from part masks.

</details>


### [176] [RestPose: Canonicalization for Open Object Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32696)
*Sandeep Inuganti,Weihang Li,Benjamin Busam,Didier Stricker,Jason Rambach*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 RestPose：无需参考模型与规范帧约定的开放物体位姿估计方法；由单张图像生成网格并做几何/物理分析实现规范化，再用基础模型稠密匹配估计位姿，在 HouseCat6D、NOCS、Omni6DPose 上免任务特定训练即超越监督 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
