Motivation: 现有学习式位姿估计依赖人为任意选定的规范帧（canonical frame），该约定决定真值标注生成，使方法被绑定于任意约定、泛化受限，且需要参考模型。

Method: 主张规范帧可由物体本身导出：从单张输入图像生成物体网格，基于几何与物理分析对其规范化，再利用基础模型（foundation model）的稠密匹配估计位姿；训练阶段不需参考模型或规范帧约定。

Result: 在类别级基准 HouseCat6D、NOCS、Omni6DPose 上，相较监督式 SOTA 绝对指标提升 18.3 分、尺度无关指标提升 13.8 分，且无需任务特定训练。

Conclusion: 规范帧可对任意物体自动推导，从而摆脱任意约定依赖，实现开放物体位姿估计；实验证明其在类别级基准上的有效性与强泛化能力。

Abstract: In object pose estimation methods, predicted poses are expressed with respect to a canonical frame, defined by a reference model of that object. In learning-based methods, an arbitrarily chosen modeling convention defines this canonical frame, which is then used to generate the ground-truth pose-annotations for training. Object pose estimation methods are therefore bound to such arbitrary conventions, restricting generalization. In this work, we propose that such a canonical frame can instead be derived for any object, and present RestPose, an approach towards open object pose estimation that does not require reference models or canonical frame conventions during training. From a single input image, we generate an object mesh and canonicalize it through a geometric and physical analysis of the object, then use foundation model-based dense matching to estimate the pose. We choose category-level benchmarks for our experiments, which contain instances across various object categories and enable us to measure the effectiveness of our canonicalization. Across HouseCat6D, NOCS, and Omni6DPose datasets, we improve on the supervised state-of-the-art methods by 18.3 points in absolute metrics and 13.8 points in scale-agnostic metrics, without requiring task-specific training. Code will be published.

</details>


### [177] [Adaptive and Detection-Aware Super-Resolution for Small Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32394)
*Cezica-Elena Luncanu,Stelian Spînu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究x4单图像超分辨率（SRCNN基线及其残差学习、Charbonnier损失、自适应损失变体），提出基于梯度的三区域（平滑/纹理/边缘）自适应损失，并用PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS、EdgeMAE评估，同时分析超分对YOLOv8目标检测的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超分在监控、遥感、医学成像与目标检测中有实际价值，但重建指标提升未必带来下游任务收益，因此需要从任务感知角度评估超分方法的有效性。

Method: 以SRCNN为基线，逐步引入残差学习、Charbonnier损失与自适应损失；提出利用梯度信息划分平滑、纹理、边缘三区域的自适应损失；在COCO验证集上比较双三次插值与各SRCNN变体，用PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS、EdgeMAE评价重建，并用YOLOv8评估检测性能。

Result: 重建质量提升并不总带来检测性能提升；但对小目标，检测感知变体结合残差缩放相比双三次基线提高了F1分数。

Conclusion: 超分用于计算机视觉流水线时应采用任务感知的评估方式，而非仅依赖重建指标。

Abstract: Image super-resolution aims to reconstruct a high-resolution image from a low-resolution input and is relevant for surveillance, satellite imagery, medical imaging, and object detection. This paper investigates SRCNN-based single-image super-resolution for a scale factor of x4, starting from a classical baseline and progressively introducing residual learning, Charbonnier loss, and adaptive loss functions. The proposed approach includes a three-region adaptive loss, where image areas are divided into smooth, texture, and edge regions using gradient information. The models are evaluated using PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and EdgeMAE in order to measure both reconstruction quality and structural detail preservation. In addition to reconstruction evaluation, the paper analyzes the impact of super-resolution on object detection. A YOLOv8 detector is applied to images processed through bicubic interpolation and SRCNN-based variants, using images from the COCO validation dataset. The results show that improved reconstruction quality does not always lead to better detection performance. However, for small objects, a detection-aware variant combined with residual scaling improves the F1 score compared to the bicubic baseline. These results highlight the importance of task-aware evaluation when super-resolution is used in computer vision pipelines.

</details>


### [178] [Cross-Version Compatibility of TESSERA Embeddings Through Lightweight Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32329)
*Yutong Yang,Zhengpeng Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文测试轻量转换器能否让在某一Tessera嵌入版本上训练的冻结分类器继续使用其他版本的嵌入。在四类土地覆盖任务中，转换后的v1.1将v2分类器准确率从0.061恢复至0.917，接近真v2的0.937；但跨地理队列迁移不可靠，嵌入相似度无法替代下游评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下游模型的生命周期往往长于其训练所依托的嵌入发布版本，版本更新会导致已部署冻结分类器失效（直接应用于raw v1.1时准确率仅0.061）。作者希望验证：仅用轻量转换器即可让旧分类器复用新版本嵌入，从而避免重训下游模型。

Method: 基于2024年25个站点、6,280个共址三元组，在v1、v1.1、v2之间拟合转换器，训练/验证/测试站点完全不相交。在四类土地覆盖任务上评估转换后嵌入的冻结分类器性能，比较直接v1→v2转换与经v1.1组合转换的误差，并设计20个新站点的独立队列检验地理迁移。另用2021年WorldCover标签及24个无有效原生v2值的采样站点扩展评估。

Result: 真v2分类器达0.937准确率、0.844 macro-F1；raw v1.1上仅0.061/0.050，转换后v1.1回升至0.917/0.795。直接v1→v2转换误差低于经v1.1的组合转换。新站点队列中对v2余弦相似度高达0.902，但转换器仅得0.597准确率，而在新队列内训练的转换器达0.784。WorldCover标签与无原生v2站点实验进一步印证上述趋势。

Conclusion: 在测试站点上，转换可恢复冻结分类器的大部分性能，表明轻量版本转换是延长下游模型生命周期的可行手段；但新站点结果说明地理迁移可靠性有限，嵌入相似度不能作为下游评估的替代指标，实际部署仍需在目标区域做下游验证。

Abstract: Downstream models often outlive the embedding release on which they were trained. We test whether lightweight converters let a classifier trained on one Tessera release use embeddings from another. We fit converters between v1, v1.1, and v2 on 6,280 co-located triplets from 25 sites in 2024, with disjoint training, validation, and test sites. On a four-class land-cover test, a classifier trained on true v2 reaches 0.937 accuracy and 0.844 macro-F1. The same classifier scores 0.061 and 0.050 on raw v1.1, but 0.917 and 0.795 on converted v1.1. Direct v1-to-v2 translation has lower error than composition through v1.1. Geographic transfer is less reliable. On a separate cohort of 20 sites, a converter trained on the original sites reaches 0.597 accuracy despite 0.902 cosine similarity to v2, whereas a converter trained within the new cohort reaches 0.784. Tests with 2021 WorldCover labels and at 24 sampled sites without valid native v2 values extend the evaluation. Conversion recovers much of the frozen classifier's performance on the tested sites, but the new-site result shows that embedding similarity cannot stand in for downstream evaluation.

</details>


### [179] [Longitudinal Characterization of Personalized Hydration Dynamics Using a Facial-Video Digital Hydration Biomarker](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32326)
*Janindu Athukorala,D. M. J. Prathapa,Thanveer Ahamed,Yudara Kularathne*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 面部视频水合评分随饮水出现纵向变化，但个体差异显著，支持个性化校准研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水合状态持续变化，但通常仅在单一时间点评估；面部视频生物标志物虽能追踪水合状态转变，其纵向行为尚不清楚，且个体间液体响应差异未知。

Method: 5名成人分别完成"饮水日"与"电解质日"，采用相同的2.0 L补液方案，每30分钟采集一次面部视频、持续12小时（共250段视频）；另在单独早晨进行500 mL电解质挑战，采集基线与2小时内4次随访视频（共25段）。分析指标包括轨迹、饮后变化、变异性、评分≥50的时间占比，以及起始评分与饮料日的探索性效应，并用置换检验作对照。

Result: 10天中有7天首帧为当日最低值。50次摄入中饮后平均变化+4.0分，显著高于打乱时间对照（p<0.001）。起始低于50的21次摄入中后续评分无一下降，平均升幅+11.3分，高于置换期望的+5.7分（p<0.001）；起始≥50者未见超随机上升。500 mL电解质后5人2小时平均变化均为正，峰值升幅7.2–22.6分，出现于30–90分钟。尽管补液方案相同，评分≥50的时间占比在16%–100%间波动；电解质日较饮水日晨间基线平均升幅更高（+7.7分），但日序固定。

Conclusion: 面部视频水合评分呈现与饮水相关的纵向变化及明显个体差异；这些探索性结果支持在更大规模对照研究中开展个性化校准与水合方案研究。

Abstract: Background. Hydration is often assessed at a single time point despite continuous changes in body water. A facial-video biomarker has tracked hydration-state transitions, but its longitudinal behavior is unclear.
  Objective. To assess within-person hydration score changes, individual differences in fluid response, and implications for personal calibration.
  Methods. Five adults completed water and electrolyte days with an identical 2.0 L fluid schedule, using facial videos every 30 minutes over 12 hours (250 videos). On a separate morning, each completed a 500 mL electrolyte challenge with baseline and four follow-up videos over 2 hours (25 videos). Analyses assessed trajectories, post-drink changes, variability, time at or above score 50, and exploratory effects of starting score and beverage day.
  Results. The first scan was the day's lowest on 7 of 10 days. Across 50 intakes, the mean post-drink change was +4.0 points, exceeding a shuffled-time comparison (p less than 0.001). For 21 intakes starting below 50, no subsequent score fell; the mean rise was +11.3 points versus +5.7 expected under permutation (p less than 0.001). Intakes starting at 50 or above showed no rise beyond chance. After 500 mL electrolytes, mean change over 2 hours was positive for all five participants, with peak increases of 7.2 to 22.6 points at 30 to 90 minutes. Despite identical fluid schedules, time at or above 50 ranged from 16% to 100%. The electrolyte day showed a greater mean increase from morning baseline than the water day (+7.7 points), although day order was fixed.
  Conclusion. Facial-video hydration scores showed longitudinal changes associated with drinking and marked individual differences. These exploratory findings support further research on personal calibration and hydration protocols in larger controlled studies.

</details>


### [180] [A recursive self-improvement framework for electron microscopy analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32325)
*Yaotian Yang,Sijia Tao,Yuping Zhang,Jiangjie Qiu,Qinghua Zhang,Xiao Chen,Fei Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出物理引导、专家反馈驱动的递归自我改进框架 PhyEvo-Mic-RSI，通过可执行算子/参数/路由规则的版本化继承，将一次性人工修正转化为可复用能力，用于电镜图像的局域原子结构解析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从电镜衬度中解析缺陷、界面等局域原子结构高度依赖研究者主观判断，效率低且标准不统一；现有模型与静态脚本无法积累专家知识。

Method: 框架由物理先验与专家反馈共同引导：给定研究者定义的任务后，系统基于图像特征、无需专家标签地选择分析路径；在固定预算下对代码更新进行测试与版本化继承，更新对象包括可执行算子、参数与路由规则，实现递归自我改进。

Result: 结合物理先验与专家反馈后，原子点缺陷检测性能优于更大规模模型；在10%面积预算内将跨材料界面覆盖率由5.13%提升至72.11%；迁移至未见过研究的显微图像时，通过将优化目标对齐到颗粒级测量，可进一步分离粘连纳米颗粒。

Conclusion: 该工作使计算显微学从独立模型与静态脚本走向可自我进化、能持续积累人类科学专业知识的平台。

Abstract: Resolving local atomic structures such as defects and interfaces from electron microscopy contrast relies heavily on researcher judgement, leading to low efficiency and subjective standards. Here we present PhyEvo-Mic-RSI, a physics-guided and expert-informed recursive self-improvement framework that turns one-off human corrections into reusable, verifiable capabilities by updating executable operators, parameters and routing rules with versioned inheritance. Given researcher-defined tasks, the system selects analysis paths from image features without expert labels, while testing and inheriting code updates under fixed budgets. Combining physical priors with expert feedback improves atomic point-defect detection over larger models and raises cross-material interface coverage from 5.13% to 72.11% within a 10% area budget. Adapting the framework to micrographs from unseen studies further separates touching nanoparticles by aligning optimization with particle-level measurements. This work moves computational microscopy beyond standalone models and static scripts towards self-evolving platforms that accumulate human scientific expertise

</details>


### [181] [SofaSpace: A Benchmark for Executable Visual Spatial Reasoning in Continuous Motion and Environment Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32285)
*Ze Rong,Kun Shi,Zhedong Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SofaSpace 基准，通过连续平面刚体搬运与环境构建任务评测视觉空间推理，并用几何验证器检查整段运动的连续有效性，揭示端点一致性与运动有效性、几何可行性与功能合规之间的巨大差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 刚体在起点和终点均不碰撞、却在两者之间与墙体碰撞的现象说明：仅凭端点一致性无法判断运动是否可行。受移动沙发问题启发，需要一个能对整段连续运动进行可执行几何校验的基准，来区分"看起来对"与"真正可执行"的空间推理能力。

Method: 构建 SofaSpace 基准，含 3,000 个场景，围绕几何兼容性、非局部机动规划、交互与时间协调三类挑战；设四种任务视图：规划运动、重建布局、设计满足搬运要求的环境、联合生成布局与运动；另设 534 个 SofaSpace-Hard 任务测试规划与判断。使用几何验证器对每份提交运动的整个刚体、全过程进行碰撞检查。

Result: 静态规划任务中，同一份提交计划的端点一致率与连续有效率差距显著：Claude 97.2%→52.8%，DeepSeek 100.0%→30.6%，Kimi 97.2%→29.4%，最强配置保持 98.3% 完全有效。环境构建差距更大：最强配置生成的 295 个可行布局中 181 个满足全部已评估功能要求，而 Kimi 的 172 个中仅 1 个满足。

Conclusion: 可执行校验能有效区分端点一致性与运动有效性、几何可行性与功能合规性；端点匹配不等于可行运动，几何可行也不等于功能合规，二者是模型空间推理的关键薄弱环节。

Abstract: A rigid body can fit at its start and goal yet collide with a wall as it moves between them. Inspired by the moving sofa problem, we introduce SofaSpace, a benchmark for visual spatial reasoning through continuous planar rigid-body transport and environment construction. SofaSpace contains 3,000 scenes organized around three challenges: geometric compatibility, nonlocal maneuver planning, and interactive and temporal coordination. Four task views ask models to plan a motion, reconstruct a layout, design an environment that meets transport requirements, or jointly generate a layout and a motion. A separate set of 534 SofaSpace-Hard tasks tests planning and judgment. A geometric verifier checks the entire body throughout each submitted motion. On static planning tasks, endpoint agreement and continuous validity differ substantially within the same submitted plans: Claude drops from 97.2% to 52.8%, DeepSeek from 100.0% to 30.6%, and Kimi from 97.2% to 29.4%, while the strongest configuration retains 98.3% full validity. Environment construction reveals a further gap. Of 295 feasible layouts generated by the strongest configuration, 181 satisfy all evaluated functional requirements; for Kimi, one of 172 does. These results show how executable checks distinguish endpoint agreement from valid motion and geometric feasibility from functional compliance.

</details>


### [182] [NativeDrive: Native Multimodal Foundations for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32216)
*Zehua Fan,Qi Jiang,Wei Li,Kai Tang,Yue Jiang,Yujian Li,Bailin Li,Feng Gao,Yan Wang,Kun Zhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 NativeDrive——一种无视觉编码器的原生多模态自动驾驶框架，将统一的理解-生成骨干网络适配为策略学习，并设计面向驾驶的稠密监督任务，在 NAVSIM v1/v2 上取得统一理解-生成模型中的竞争性规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶既需语义理解又需细粒度场景感知以精确预测动作。现有 VLA 的低维动作标签结构监督不足；用视觉生成任务扩展 VLA 或采用视频世界动作模型（WAM）都会引入与规划关联度较低的"外观重建"开销。原生多模态模型可在单一骨干内统一理解与生成，为规避上述问题提供新路径。

Method: 1) 原生编码器无关（encoder-free）多模态驾驶框架，将统一骨干适配为策略学习；2) Native Action Interface：复用理解专家的 token 预测接口实现离散策略，并适配生成专家实现连续策略；3) Driving Semantic Editing：训练时复用生成专家的编辑能力做稠密场景结构监督，推理时仅运行所选规划策略。

Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 与 v2 上，规划性能在统一理解-生成类模型中具有竞争力；消融实验验证了各组件（原生动作接口、语义编辑监督等）的有效性。

Conclusion: NativeDrive 表明，无需额外外观重建、无需视觉编码器的原生多模态骨干可直接服务于驾驶规划，并通过生成式稠密语义监督提升策略学习质量，推理阶段保持计算精简。代码将开源。

Abstract: Autonomous driving requires semantic understanding and fine-grained scene perception for precise action prediction. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit semantic priors, but low-dimensional action labels provide limited structural supervision. Some studies extend VLAs with visual generation tasks or adopt video-based world-action models (WAMs), but both approaches introduce appearance-reconstruction overhead, which is less relevant to planning. Native multimodal models offer an alternative to unify understanding and generation within one backbone. On this basis, we propose NativeDrive, a native encoder-free multimodal driving framework adapting the unified backbone for policy learning and introduce a dense supervision task tailored to driving. The Native Action Interface reuses the understanding expert's token-prediction interface for the discrete policy and adapts the generation expert for continuous policy. Driving Semantic Editing reuses the generation expert's editing capability for dense scene-structure supervision during training, while inference runs only the selected planning policy. NativeDrive achieves competitive planning performance among unified understanding-and-generation models on NAVSIM v1 and v2, with ablations validating its components' effectiveness. Code will be released.

</details>


### [183] [DocPristine: Content-Aware Document Appearance Enhancement under Real-World Mixed Degradations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32176)
*Zihan Huang,Junle Liu,Zhonghao Ye,Yuyi Zhang,Peirong Zhang,Hanlin Li,Yongxin Shi,Lianwen Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DocPristine利用冻结文档视觉编码器仍关注文本区域这一发现，通过多层特征自适应融合与跨窗口交叉注意力注入像素复原网络，实现SOTA文档外观增强并提升下游解析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机拍摄文档常出现高光、阴影、模糊等混合退化，扭曲背景并遮蔽文字细节。现有方法或依赖严重退化下不可靠的输入视觉线索，或依赖缺乏空间引导的LLM退化诊断。作者观察到预训练文档视觉编码器在退化文档中仍能关注文本区域，可提供内容感知引导。

Method: 提出DocPristine：自适应融合冻结文档视觉编码器的多层特征，并注入像素复原网络；融合机制包括自适应多层特征融合（AMFF）、分层门控条件化（HGC）与移位窗口交叉注意力（SWCA），其中SWCA跨窗口边界借鉴邻域结构线索以恢复细粒度文字细节。同时构建DocACE基准：合成混合退化训练集DocACE-Synthetic与含人工修复GT图像及文档解析标注的真实测试集DocACE-Real。

Result: 在三个基准上的综合实验表明，DocPristine取得SOTA的外观增强质量，并持续提升下游文档解析性能。

Conclusion: 以冻结文档视觉编码器的内容感知特征为引导、结合分层门控与移位窗口注意力的像素复原框架，可有效应对混合退化；配套的DocACE数据集为训练与真实场景评测提供支撑，代码、模型与数据将公开。

Abstract: Camera-captured documents often exhibit mixed degradations, such as highlights, shadows, and blur, that distort backgrounds and obscure text details. Document appearance enhancement (DAE) aims to mitigate these degradations and improve readability. Existing document appearance enhancement methods rely either on input-derived visual cues that can become unreliable under severe degradation or on LLM-based degradation diagnosis that lacks spatial guidance. Notably, we find that pretrained document visual encoders continue to attend to text regions in degraded documents, providing content-aware guidance. Based on this insight, we propose DocPristine, which adaptively fuses multi-layer features from a frozen document visual encoder and injects them into a pixel restoration network. To integrate these features into a pixel restoration network, DocPristine combines Adaptive Multi-Layer Feature Fusion (AMFF), Hierarchical Gated Conditioning (HGC), and Shifted-Window Cross-Attention (SWCA). Specifically, SWCA draws on structural cues from neighboring locations across window boundaries to recover fine text details.We also introduce DocACE, with a synthetic mixed-degradation training set (DocACE-Synthetic) and a real-world test set (DocACE-Real) containing manually restored ground-truth images and document parsing annotations. Comprehensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate that DocPristine achieves state-of-the-art appearance enhancement quality and consistently improves downstream document parsing. Code, models, and data will be publicly available.

</details>


### [184] [Video Models are Excellent Motion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32432)
*Kian Izadpanah,Ali Mahdavi Amiri,Daniel Cohen-Or,Yiorgos Chrysanthou,Andreas Aristidou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 视频基础模型已可视为优于专用运动模型的运动生成器，其运动先验在自然性与运动范围上更具优势；作者提出统一评测框架在三类设置下比较两类模型，发现视频模型更适合复杂/复合动作生成，且专用运动模型的角色应转向稀疏引导与控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者提出一个观点性主张：视频基础模型不仅是动态视觉内容生成器，还已成为优秀的运动生成器，其运动先验比专用运动模型更丰富、更通用。该优势体现在两点：运动自然性（身体协调、物理合理性、与物体和环境的真实交互）与运动范围（更广泛的活动类型与语义连贯性，尤其是不常见、复杂和复合动作）。为检验这一观点，需要构建跨模型类别的统一评测。

Method: 提出统一评测框架，在三种互补设置下比较视频基础模型与专用运动模型：(1) 纯文本驱动的运动生成；(2) 从稀疏关键帧重建视频生成的运 动；(3) 基于视频对运动模型输出进行增强。所有输出统一转换为共享的3D骨骼表示，并据此评估运动自然性、语义对齐度、动作覆盖度、物理运动特性以及对运动约束的保真度（含通过宽松骨骼控制的运动条件生成实验）。

Result: 结果显示视频基础模型能生成更自然、语义更有意义的运动，在复杂与复合动作上优势明显；在宽松骨骼控制下，专用运动模型并不能稳定提升视频生成的运动质量，而视频模型可利用稀疏运动引导增强骨骼动画。

Conclusion: 作者主张专用运动模型的角色发生转变：从生成完整动画转向对视频基础模型中已蕴含的更丰富运动能力进行引导与控制。

Abstract: Video foundation models have emerged as powerful generators of dynamic visual content, exhibiting remarkable capabilities in synthesizing complex actions and interactions. We argue that these models have also become excellent motion generators, with motion priors that are richer and more general than those learned by dedicated motion models. Their advantage extends beyond visual realism and is manifested in two important aspects: motion naturalness, including coherent body coordination, physical plausibility, and realistic interactions with objects and the environment; and motion scope, encompassing a much broader range of activities and semantic coherence, particularly uncommon, complex, and compound actions. To investigate this position, we introduce a common evaluation framework that compares video and dedicated motion models through three complementary settings: text-only motion generation, reconstruction of video-generated motion from sparse keyframes, and video-based enrichment of motion-model outputs. By converting all outputs into a shared 3D skeletal representation, we evaluate motion naturalness, semantic alignment, action coverage, physical motion characteristics, and fidelity to motion constraints. Our results suggest that video foundation models can generate more natural and semantically meaningful movements, particularly for complex and compound actions. Moreover, we investigate motion-conditioned generation through loose skeletal control, finding that dedicated motion models do not consistently improve video-generated motion, while video models can enrich skeletal animations using sparse motion guidance. Our findings suggest a shift in the role of specialized motion models, from generating complete animations to guiding and controlling the richer motion capabilities already embedded in video foundation models.

</details>


### [185] [A Morphological Approach to Inverse Lithography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32742)
*Gijs Bellaard,Bart M. N. Smets,Tim van der Leek,Alexandru Onose,Remco Duits*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对逆向光刻(ILT)中掩模的可制造性约束给出数学刻画，并设计可（次）微分的评分函数作为梯度优化中的正则项，提出MorphILT算法，生成的掩模满足制造约束且印刷质量接近无约束ILT结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ILT需寻找能在晶圆上印刷目标图案的掩模，但掩模必须满足一系列可制造性约束，这使设计变得困难；如何将这些约束嵌入优化流程是核心难点。

Method: 首先对制造约束进行数学建模刻画；随后构造评分函数来量化给定掩模是否满足约束以及违反程度；由于该评分函数具有（次）可微性，可作为梯度型逆问题求解器中的正则项，从而导出MorphILT算法。

Result: MorphILT能生成可制造的掩模，其印刷质量与无约束ILT所得（不可制造的）掩模几乎相当。

Conclusion: 用可微评分函数作正则项可有效将制造约束融入梯度优化，在保持印刷质量的同时获得可制造掩模。

Abstract: Lithography is a critical step in the manufacturing of chips that works by projecting light through a patterned mask and subsequently focusing it onto a photosensitive layer on top of a wafer. The task of finding a mask that prints a desired pattern on the wafer is called inverse lithography technology (ILT). The design of the mask is complicated by the fact that it must satisfy a set of constraints in order to be manufacturable. In this paper we provide a mathematical characterization of these constraints. Next, we develop a scoring function that allows us to measure whether a given mask satisfies the manufacturing constraints and if not, how badly the constraints are violated. Since our scoring function is (sub-)differentiable it can be used as the regularizer in a gradient-based inverse problem solver. We show that the resulting MorphILT algorithm that we developed can generate manufacturable masks that have nearly the same print quality as the (unmanufacturable) masks obtained from unconstrained inverse lithography.

</details>


### [186] [HazeFlux: Few-Step Generative Priors for Real-World Image Dehazing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32632)
*Yunong Liu,Danna Xue,Javier Vazquez-Corral*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出两阶段框架，将少步流匹配生成模型的先验适配到真实世界单图去雾：第一阶段用LoRA微调并加入像素级监督实现直接去雾，第二阶段在VAE解码器引入结构保持跳跃连接恢复精细边缘，在四个真实基准上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实场景单图去雾面临严重域偏移：成对真实数据稀缺，合成雾训练模型泛化差。预训练生成式编辑模型可作为强大图像先验来弥合泛化鸿沟，但存在两个问题：一是标准生成模型偏重分布对齐而非严格像素保真；二是潜空间压缩会丢失细粒度结构细节。

Method: 两阶段框架。第一阶段：以少步（few-step）流匹配为骨干，用LoRA微调潜空间主干，监督信号除流匹配目标外还加入像素级监督，从而支持直接的雾→清晰转换。第二阶段：在VAE解码器中引入结构保持的跳跃连接，绕过潜空间压缩伪影，恢复精确的空间边缘。

Result: 在四个真实世界去雾基准上，方法在真实条件下显著优于现有去雾方法。

Conclusion: 通过LoRA微调+像素级监督实现生成先验的像素保真适配，并以解码器跳跃连接补偿潜压缩细节损失，可有效解决真实去雾中的域偏移与结构保真问题。

Abstract: Real-world single-image dehazing suffers from severe domain shifts, as paired real data is scarce and models trained on synthetic haze generalize poorly to real-world haze. While pre-trained generative editing models offer powerful image priors to bridge this generalization gap, applying them to image dehazing poses two major challenges: standard generative models prioritize distribution alignment over strict pixel-level fidelity, and operating in compressed latent spaces inherently discards fine-grained structural details. In this paper, we propose a novel two-stage framework that adapts the generative prior of a few-step flow-matching backbone to real-world dehazing. In the first stage, we fine-tune the latent backbone using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), supervised not only on a flow-matching objective, but also on pixel-level supervision, thus enabling direct hazy-to-clear translation. In the second stage, we introduce structure-preserving skip connections directly to the VAE decoder, bypassing latent compression artifacts to recover precise spatial edges. Experiments on four realworld benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing dehazing methods in real conditions.

</details>


### [187] [On the Capabilities and Limitations of Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Cloud Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32625)
*Jose Sosa,Thomas Gillet,Rim Sleimi,Albert Abello*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文在零样本设置下系统评测12种开放词汇语义分割方法在6个遥感数据集上的云检测性能，涵盖二分类云检测与细粒度多类分割，并分析提示词敏感性，发现二分类表现可观而多类细粒度分割仍具挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言基础模型推动了无需任务特定训练的开放词汇语义分割（OVSS），为对地观测（EO）提供新机遇；但其在云检测上的能力尚缺乏系统探索，缺乏可比较的基准。

Method: 在零样本（不微调、不适配目标数据）条件下，对12种OVSS方法在6个公开EO数据集上进行评测；任务包括二分类云检测与四类分割（厚云、薄云、云阴影、背景）；并开展受控的文本提示敏感性分析，考察不同描述性提示对各模型的影响。

Result: 各模型与数据集间性能差异明显，SegEarth-OV3在6个数据集中的4个上取得最佳二分类云检测性能；多种方法在二分类任务上表现有前景，而多类分割（尤其细粒度云类区分）仍较困难；提示敏感性呈模型依赖特征，面向外观的提示对部分方法有益、对另一些则有损。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了零样本OVSS用于云检测的潜力与当前局限，为面向可泛化云分割的后续研究建立了对比基准，并公开代码。

Abstract: Recent advances in vision-language foundation models have enabled open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) without task-specific training, offering new opportunities for Earth Observation (EO) applications. However, their capabilities for cloud detection remain insufficiently explored. In this work, we evaluate twelve OVSS approaches across six publicly available EO datasets in a zero-shot setting, i.e., without fine-tuning or adaptation to the target data. We investigate both binary cloud detection and multiclass segmentation, distinguishing between thick clouds, thin clouds, cloud shadows, and background. Our results show differences in performance across models and datasets, with SegEarth-OV3 achieving the highest binary cloud detection performance on four of the six datasets. While several approaches demonstrate promising performance in binary cloud detection, multiclass segmentation remains more challenging, particularly when distinguishing between fine-grained cloud categories. Furthermore, our controlled prompt sensitivity analysis reveals model-dependent responses to alternative textual descriptions, with appearance-oriented prompts benefiting certain approaches while degrading the performance of others. Overall, our findings demonstrate both the potential and current limitations of zero-shot OVSS for cloud detection, establishing a comparative benchmark for future research on generalisable cloud segmentation. Code will be available at: https://github.com/josesosajs/zero-shot-cloudovss.

</details>


### [188] [UnifiedAD: One-Shot Anomaly Detection across Modalities via Evidence Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32551)
*Shangze Li,Chuancheng Shi,Simiao Xie,Wenhua Wu,Xingyu Zhu,Fei Shen,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 UnifiedAD，通过"异常证据校准"统一单模态与多模态异常检测，仅需每类一个正常参考且无需梯度更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单模态与多模态异常检测依赖模态特定建模与打分，在正常参考有限时难以获得可比较的异常证据，阻碍统一检测。

Method: 1) 在独立辅助数据集上用正常/异常样本导出神经元级判别先验，并结合目标参考在保常态变换下的神经元响应一致性，筛选"异常神经元"并确定异常方向；2) 对每层每模态，由所选神经元对参考的空间响构建低秩正态子空间，用投影残差量化查询特征偏离；3) 用正常参考及其变换的响应分布分别校准投影残差与异常方向响应，转为可比较异常证据并跨层跨模态聚合。

Result: 在多个异常检测基准上，图像级异常检测与像素级异常定位均取得强性能。

Conclusion: UnifiedAD 以校准式证据实现了单/多模态异常检测的统一框架，兼顾低参考需求（每类一个正常样本）与免训练特性，验证了统一范式的有效性。

Abstract: Both single-modal and multi-modal anomaly detection aim to identify deviations from normal patterns, providing a common foundation for unified detection. However, existing methods rely on modality-specific modeling and scoring, making it difficult to obtain comparable anomaly evidence with limited normal references. To that end, we propose UnifiedAD, which unifies single-modal and multi-modal anomaly detection through anomaly evidence calibration, requiring only one normal reference per target category and no gradient updates. Specifically, we first derive neuron-level discriminative priors from normal and anomalous samples in an independent auxiliary dataset and combine them with neuron response consistency under normality-preserving transformations of the target reference to select reliable neurons, termed anomaly neurons, and identify anomaly directions. Next, we construct a low-rank normal subspace for each layer and modality from the selected neurons' spatial responses to the reference and quantify query feature deviations from normal structure using projection residuals. Finally, we separately calibrate projection residuals and anomaly-direction responses using the response distributions obtained from the normal reference and its transformations, converting them into comparable anomaly evidence for aggregation across layers and modalities. Experiments on multiple anomaly detection benchmarks demonstrate that UnifiedAD achieves strong performance in both image-level anomaly detection and pixel-level anomaly localization.

</details>


### [189] [Align or Fail: The Hidden Gap in Cross-Domain Panoptic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32542)
*Huy Hoang Nguyen,Oliver Zendel,Tobias Glueck,Minh Nhat Vu,Andreas Kugi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在ODISE这一基于扩散的OVPS模型上系统替换视觉骨干（DINOv2/ConvNeXt/DINOv3），发现骨干升级会引发"分组-识别失配"，即密集区域特征与CLIP文本嵌入间的对齐鸿沟，并区分出可修复的视觉-CLIP接口缺口与词汇边界限制两类失效轴。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉基础骨干常被视为开源词汇全景分割（OVPS）中改进区域提案的即插即用升级，但其增益往往无法有效迁移到跨域下游性能，作者希望查明这一现象背后的机制。

Method: 以ODISE为测试平台，将其扩散视觉提取器替换为DINOv2、ConvNeXt或DINOv3；采用阶段性诊断、线性探针与区域-文本对齐分析定位失配；测试三类适配方案：文本侧适配器、共形掩码保留（CMR）及仅2.7M参数的视觉侧LoRA；并引入OVSeg、CAT-Seg、MaskCLIP分析ADE20K上难以提升的原因。

Result: DINOv3在源域与近域提升源域性能，但在多个跨域目标上崩溃，其他基线呈相反趋势；DINOv3嵌入保留语义信息但与CLIP在几何上不兼容；文本侧适配对词汇重叠更敏感，CMR仅带来有限且目标特定的增益，说明单纯保留无法解决跨域失效。

Conclusion: 跨域失效可分解为两条轴：一是可由视觉侧LoRA基本修复的视觉-to-CLIP接口缺口，二是所评估CLIP类识别系统共有的词汇边界限制，后者需不同的解决思路。

Abstract: Vision foundation backbones are often treated as drop-in upgrades for improving region proposals in open-vocabulary panoptic segmentation (OVPS). Yet, improvements in backbones often fail to translate well into downstream cross-domain performance. Using ODISE, a diffusion-based OVPS model with a CLIP-based recognition branch, as a testbed, we replace its diffusion visual extractor with DINOv2, ConvNeXt, or DINOv3, and find that backbone upgrades can introduce a grouping-recognition mismatch: an alignment gap between dense-region features and CLIP text embeddings. Across source and near-domain, the newer DINOv3 variant improves source-domain performance but collapses on several cross-domain targets, whereas other baselines, interestingly, show the opposite. Stage-wise diagnostics, linear probes, and region-text alignment analyses indicate that DINOv3 embeddings retain semantic information but are geometrically incompatible with CLIP. We test adaptations, including text-side adapters, conformal mask retention (CMR), and a lean 2.7M-parameter visual-side LoRA, and find that text-side adaptation is more sensitive to vocabulary overlap. CMR provides only limited and target-specific gains, indicating that retention alone cannot resolve the full cross-domain failure. To understand why ADE20K resists improvement across all interventions, we evaluate OVSeg, CAT-Seg, and MaskCLIP. This separates two failure axes: a recoverable visual-to-CLIP interface gap that visual-side LoRA largely repairs, and a vocabulary-boundary limitation shared by the evaluated CLIP-based recognition systems that requires different remedies.

</details>


### [190] [Advanced Synthetic Image Detection Using Hybrid Feature Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32538)
*Ameya Uppina,S Navaneetha Krishnan,Nikhil N Iyer,Joe Dhanith P R*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出结合CBAM+ResNet50与DCT选择性patch分析（SRM模块）的合成图像检测框架，通过细粒度纹理与复杂区域特征实现高精度真伪判别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型（GAN、MidJourney、DALL-E等）生成图像日益逼真，亟需鲁棒的real/fake图像鉴别方法。

Method: 利用CBAM注意力与ResNet50分析复杂结构形变；基于离散余弦变换(DCT)打分进行选择性patch分析，提取复杂度最高与最低区域，分别送入SRM模块与ResNet50模块处理。

Result: 实验表明该方法在真实图像与合成图像分类上取得高准确率，为构建更可靠的检测框架提供支撑。

Conclusion: 通过聚焦生成模型难以复现的细粒度纹理与复杂物体特征，并借助注意力机制与频域引导的patch选择，可有效提升合成图像检测性能。

Abstract: In the realm of generative AI, models such as GANs, MidJourney, DALL-E, and others have been continuously evolving to generate increasingly lifelike images. This rapid advancement has created an urgent need for robust methods to distinguish between real and AI-generated images. This paper proposes a novel approach for the detection of synthetic images by employing deep learning techniques for feature analysis. The proposed architecture classifies images by identifying variations that generative models struggle to replicate, particularly fine-grained textures and complex object features. Deformations in complexes are examined with the help of the CBAM architecture along with ResNet50. We have performed a selective patch-based analysis using Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) scoring, extracting the regions with the most and least complexity for further processing with an SRM Module and ResNet50 module. Experimental results show that our approach achieves high accuracy in classifying real-world images from synthetic ones, contributing to the development of more reliable detection frameworks.

</details>


### [191] [RSReasoner: Reformulating and Auditing Geospatial Reasoning Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32536)
*Xu Zhang,Xinpeng Zhang,Yunrui Zou,Hongliang Chen,Xiaotian Jiang,Yang Zheng,Kaitai Guo,Jimin Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出地理空间推理分割的新形式化框架（类别表达显/隐 × 属性性质感知/推断），审计发现现有基准推理数据匮乏且属性混杂严重，构建RSReasoner数据集与RSReasoner-Bench诊断基准，实现更精准的能力评估并暴露捷径行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有地理空间推理分割基准把"推理"简化为类别省略，忽略属性混杂问题，导致显式类别推理被忽视、引入感知捷径，无法精确评估真实推理能力。

Method: 沿"类别表达（显式/隐式）"与"属性性质（感知/推断）"两维重构任务定义；审计90,708条现有基准查询；基于OpenStreetMap属性设计三阶段流水线，抑制几何与语义噪声，构建106,610幅图像/213,220条推理查询的RSReasoner数据集，及含75,400条查询（四类典型类型+受控变体）的RSReasoner-Bench。

Result: 审计显示纯显式-推断查询仅占0.61%，而31.98%混合两类属性；实验表明RSReasoner-Bench可多维度精确评估并暴露捷径行为；在RSReasoner上微调同时提升推理与跨类型泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该工作为地理空间推理研究提供更严谨的任务形式化与可诊断基准，并为未来基准设计提供关键洞见，数据与代码将开源。

Abstract: Geospatial reasoning segmentation aims to localize geographic targets from language requiring semantic inference beyond direct visual perception. However, existing benchmarks often operationalize reasoning as category omission while overlooking attribute mixing, which neglects explicit-category reasoning, introduces perceptual shortcuts, and fails to precisely evaluate reasoning capability. To diagnose and address these limitations, we first reformulate geospatial reasoning segmentation along category expression (explicit vs. implicit) and attribute nature (perceptual vs. inferential), and audit 90,708 queries across existing benchmarks to reveal that pure explicit-inferential queries account for only 0.61% whereas 31.98% mix both attribute types. We then develop a three-stage pipeline that harnesses OpenStreetMap attributes while mitigating geometric and semantic noise to construct RSReasoner, a large-scale dataset of 106,610 images with 213,220 reasoning queries, and RSReasoner-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 75,400 queries across four canonical types and controlled variants. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSReasoner-Bench precisely evaluates model capability across multiple dimensions while exposing shortcut behaviors, and fine-tuning on RSReasoner boosts both reasoning and cross-type generalization. Our findings offer key insights for future geospatial reasoning research and benchmark design. Datasets and code will be released at https://github.com/Ricardo-XZ/RSReasoner.

</details>


### [192] [An Integrated Remote Sensing and Machine Learning Framework for Mapping Hazard Associated with Leached Metals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32505)
*Salman Karim,Bahareh Nojabaei,Hosein Foroutan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究融合卫星遥感、地下水监测与机器学习，在美国弗吉尼亚州四个燃煤残渣（CCR）场地开展浸出金属相关风险的制图筛查，结果显示随机森林在场地内分类精度较高，但跨场地泛化能力有限，需本地校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CCR场地中浸出金属对地下水的潜在污染需要空间化的风险评估手段，而传统依赖井点采样的地下水监测难以提供高分辨率的空间覆盖；同时，遥感与机器学习能否有效替代或补充地面监测、其可靠性边界尚不明确。

Method: 将各组分地下水浓度转化为危害商（HQ）并合成为综合危害指数（HI）；以Sentinel-2植被指数、生物物理参数及2019–2025时空指标为预测变量，辅以土壤、气候、水文、地形与土地覆盖协变量；评估六种监督分类器，采用空间分隔测试块、特征集消融与留一站点交叉验证（leave-one-site-out）进行验证。

Result: 33个“金属–场地”组合中有24个在监测井附近呈现高HQ对应低植被指数的关系（符号检验p=0.007）；三个场地的井HI与CIRE、冠层叶绿素含量负相关（Spearman ρ最低达−0.71）。随机森林场地内HI分类精度0.768–0.924，高HI类召回率0.965–0.999；34个“组分–场地”组合的HQ分类精度为0.775–0.989。环境协变量贡献普遍高于植被特征，移除植被预测因子未降低性能，单一场地上“距CCR单元距离”单独表现最佳；零样本跨场地精度降至0.734–0.749，不优于多数类基线。

Conclusion: 该框架可作为场地校准的空间筛查工具，捕捉的是间接环境关联而非直接探测溶解态金属，因此本地校准与独立验证不可替代。

Abstract: This study integrates satellite remote sensing, groundwater monitoring, and machine learning to map leached-metal-associated hazards at four coal combustion residual (CCR) sites in Virginia, USA. Constituent-specific groundwater concentrations were expressed as Hazard Quotients (HQ) and combined into a composite Hazard Index (HI). Predictors included Sentinel-2 vegetation indices, biophysical parameters, and spatiotemporal metrics (2019-2025), alongside soil, climate, hydrology, topography, and land cover. Six supervised classifiers were evaluated using spatially separated test blocks, feature-set ablation, and leave-one-site-out testing. Higher HQ coincided with lower vegetation indices in 24 of 33 metal-site combinations near monitoring wells (sign test p = 0.007). Well HI was negatively correlated with CIRE and canopy chlorophyll content at three sites (Spearman rho as low as -0.71). Random Forest achieved within-site HI classification accuracies of 0.768-0.924 and higher-HI-class recall of 0.965-0.999. For 34 constituent-site combinations, HQ classification accuracies ranged from 0.775 to 0.989. Environmental covariates generally contributed more predictive information than vegetation features. Removing vegetation predictors did not reduce performance, and distance to the CCR unit alone performed best at one site. Zero-shot cross-site accuracy declined to 0.734-0.749, no better than the majority-class baseline. These findings demonstrate the potential of integrating satellite observations and environmental data with groundwater measurements for site-calibrated spatial hazard screening. The framework identifies indirect environmental associations rather than directly detecting dissolved metals, highlighting the importance of local calibration and independent validation.

</details>


### [193] [Describe, Don't Ask: Caption-Driven On-Policy Distillation for Fine-Grained Visual Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32463)
*Haozhan Shen,Liangbo He,Jun Lan,Huijia Zhu,Weiqiang Wang,Tiancheng Zhao,Jianwei Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CaptionOPD 用固定的一组图像无关的 caption 提示替代定制问答，通过多视角自描述与特权视角蒸馏，把无标注图像转化为广泛视觉监督，在多个细粒度与通用感知基准上超越既有 OPD 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态 on-policy 蒸馏（OPD）依赖为每个区域精心合成的问题—答案对，导致三重缺陷：(1) 每个区域都需专属 QA，训练成本高且难以扩展到无标注图像；(2) 同一区域的所有 rollout 回答同一问题，教师只监督被问到的细节，区域中其他视觉元素缺乏监督；(3) 问题天然预设目标存在，使学生易在目标缺失时仍强行作答。

Method: 提出 CaptionOPD：用一组固定的、与图像无关的 caption 提示（涵盖总体描述及部件、颜色、数量、文字、布局等聚焦描述）替代定制问题。同一区域的不同 rollout 接收不同提示，教师因而监督该区域的多个方面；caption 提示要求描述可见内容而非查询特定目标，避免预设区域内容。以模型自身作为 crop 视角教师，仅需图像与区域框，无需问题、答案或更大模型标注。

Result: 在相同图像与区域上训练时，CaptionOPD 在多个细粒度与通用感知基准上均优于先前的 OPD 方法。

Conclusion: 多视角自描述结合特权视角蒸馏可将无标注图像转化为广泛视觉监督，是一种无需 QA 标注、可扩展且覆盖面更广的 VLM 细粒度蒸馏范式。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often recognize fine-grained details more accurately in a relevant crop than in the full image. Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) methods exploit this by transferring the advantage of a crop-view teacher to a full-image student. However, their supervision relies on region-specific questions curated through an elaborate synthesis pipeline, which brings three weaknesses: (1) every region needs a question--answer pair written exclusively for it, locking training into costly QA curation that is hard to scale to unlabeled images; (2) all rollouts of a region answer the same question, so the teacher supervises only the details it asks about, leaving other visual elements in the region unsupervised; and (3) every question presupposes that its target exists, so the student becomes prone to answering even when the target is absent. In this paper, we study how to turn unlabeled images into broad visual supervision through multi-aspect self-description and privileged-view distillation, and propose CaptionOPD, which replaces tailored questions with a fixed set of image-agnostic caption prompts, ranging from general descriptions to focused captions of parts, colors, counts, text, and layout. The rollouts of a region receive different prompts, so the teacher supervises various aspects of the region. Moreover, because caption prompts mask the model to describe what is visible instead of querying a specific target, they avoid presupposing what the region contains. Using the model itself as the crop-view teacher, CaptionOPD requires no questions, no answers, and no larger model annotations: only images and region boxes. Experiments show that, trained on the same images and regions, CaptionOPD outperforms prior OPD methods across multiple fine-grained and general perception benchmarks.

</details>


### [194] [Which Parameters to Update? An Instance-Specific Adaptation Framework for Real-World Pansharpening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32450)
*Jin-Liang Xiao,Liang-Jian Deng,Yu-Xuan Zhang,Hua Meng,Zhengchun Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种实例级测试时自适应框架，仅利用观测到的PAN-LRMS图像对选择并更新预训练全色锐化网络的部分参数，缓解训练-测试分布偏移，提升泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于深度学习的全色锐化方法依赖强非线性特征提取能力取得显著性能，但训练数据与测试图像之间存在分布偏移，导致预训练网络性能下降，限制其在真实场景中的泛化能力。

Method: 设计实例级测试时自适应框架：以单个PAN-LRMS图像对为输入；(1) 采用交叉评分（cross-scoring）在图像块层面识别哪些参数组的更新能够改善重建；(2) 仅更新被选中的参数组；(3) 损失函数由光谱一致性项与新设计的空间一致性项组合而成。

Result: 自适应后的网络性能优于其预训练版本，并在GaoFen-2、QuickBird及WorldView系列数据集上超越具有代表性的先进全色锐化方法。

Conclusion: 通过实例级、参数选择性的测试时自适应，可在无需标签的真实场景下有效提升全色锐化网络的泛化与重建质量，验证了部分参数更新策略与双一致性损失设计的有效性。

Abstract: Pansharpening aims to fuse a single observed image pair, comprising a low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) image and a panchromatic (PAN) image, to obtain a high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) image. Recently, deep learning-based methods have achieved significant performance due to their strong capability of extracting nonlinear features. However, distribution shifts between training data and test images can degrade the performance of pretrained pansharpening networks, limiting their generalization in real-world scenarios. In this work, we propose an instance-specific test-time adaptation framework that uses the observed PAN-LRMS pair to select and update only a subset of the pretrained network's parameters. Specifically, the framework uses cross-scoring to identify parameter groups whose updates improve reconstruction across image patches. It then updates the selected groups by minimizing a loss that combines a spectral consistency term with a newly designed spatial consistency term. Experiments show that the adapted networks perform better than their pretrained counterparts and outperform representative state-of-the-art pansharpening methods on GaoFen-2, QuickBird, and WorldView series datasets.

</details>


### [195] [ObsBridge: Observation-Grounded Conditioning for Ego Trajectory Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32447)
*Zhenhao Wang,Shaofeng Liang,Jiemin Wu,Sijia Chen,Keni Shi,Nan Li,Wenshuo Chen,Bowen Tian,Runwei Guan,Yutao Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ObsBridge，一种基于flow的轨迹预测框架，通过"观测锚定的历史桥接"将恢复的历史状态与原始观测证据共同作为条件，并用渐进式训练适配不完美的历史恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一视角行人预测受遮挡、可见性受限和跟踪误差影响，观测历史被污染，这对自主机器人导航危害大。现有方法要么先补全噪声历史再预测，要么联合训练辅助历史重建分支；但前者在部署时对恢复历史的残余误差敏感，后者仍在原始受损坐标上计算智能体间交互。

Method: 核心思想：让未来预测同时条件化于恢复的历史状态与原始观测证据，并用渐进训练适配不完美恢复。具体地，(1) 用冻结估计器从agent相对位置、ego相对位置、图像平面位置及可见性状态恢复历史运动；(2) 训练时引入agent-wise课程，在上下文编码前逐步用完整估计历史替换干净教师历史，使预测器渐进暴露于估计历史；(3) 设计残差几何适配器，将编码运动与原始观测证据融合；(4) 通过social attention聚合表征以条件化flow-based轨迹生成器。

Result: 在多个基准上超越SOTA；在EgoTraj-TBD上minADE@20降低6.5%，minFDE@20降低8.7%。

Conclusion: 同时利用恢复历史与原始观测证据并结合渐进训练，能有效缓解历史恢复残余误差带来的敏感性，提升第一视角行人轨迹预测的鲁棒性与精度。

Abstract: Pedestrian forecasting from ego-view observations is challenging because occlusion, limited visibility, and tracking errors corrupt observed motion histories. Such errors are particularly consequential for autonomous robot navigation. Existing paradigms typically either impute noisy history positions before forecasting or jointly train an auxiliary history reconstruction branch. However, predictors trained on clean histories may be sensitive to residual errors in recovered histories at deployment. Meanwhile, auxiliary reconstruction still computes inter-agent interactions over raw, corrupted coordinates. We investigate conditioning future prediction on both recovered historical states and raw observation evidence, with progressive training to accommodate imperfect recovery. Building on this insight, we propose ObsBridge, a flow-based trajectory forecasting framework with observation-grounded historical bridging. Specifically, ObsBridge first employs a frozen estimator to recover historical motion from agent-relative and ego-relative positions, image-plane locations, and visibility states. During training, we introduce an agent-wise curriculum that gradually replaces clean teacher histories with complete estimated histories before context encoding. This progressively exposes the predictor to estimated histories during training. Furthermore, we design a residual geometry adapter to fuse the encoded motion with original observation evidence. We aggregate the resulting representations through social attention to condition the flow-based trajectory generator. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ObsBridge outperforms state-of-the-art methods. On EgoTraj-TBD, it reduces minADE@20 by 6.5\% and minFDE@20 by 8.7\%. The code will be provided at https://github.com/shawnliang420/ObsBridge.

</details>


### [196] [PVWander: 3D Memory-guided Panoramic Video Wandering with Path-Facing Canonicalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32443)
*Chuanxin Song,Xiaodong Wang,Shijie Chen,Junliang Xie,Zhanmi Zhong,Suiying Wu,Peixi Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PVWander，以在线点云记忆引导全景视频长程漫游生成，并用路径朝向规范化与时步感知门控调制解决运动-朝向对齐与记忆伪影问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全景视频模型虽实现相机可控生成，3D 引导方法也提升了场景一致性，但长程漫游仍受两类问题制约：一是多样化的运动—朝向关系难以稳定建模；二是累积的生成伪影与深度误差导致记忆引导不完美。

Method: 构建 3D 记忆引导框架：将已生成观测累积为在线点云记忆并重投影以引导后续生成。两项设计：(1) Path-Facing canonicalization，利用 ERP 全景的水平循环对称性，将每个片段的 ERP 朝向统一对齐到其主平移方向，在保持指定相机路径的同时获得更一致的前向式相对运动；(2) Timestep-aware gating modulation，利用扩散去噪由粗到细的特性，以时步相关的通道级门控自适应调节重投影记忆引导，保留结构信息并抑制不完美投影带来的视觉伪影。

Result: 大量实验表明 PVWander 提升了长程生成质量，消融实验验证了两项设计的有效性。

Conclusion: 在线点云记忆结合朝向规范化与时步感知门控，可有效缓解长程全景漫游中的一致性与伪影问题，为相机可控的全景长视频生成提供可行方案。

Abstract: Long-horizon panoramic video wandering aims to continuously synthesize scene-consistent $360^\circ$ observations along user-specified camera trajectories from an initial equirectangular projection (ERP) panorama. Existing panoramic video models have achieved promising results in camera-controlled generation, while recent 3D-guided approaches further provide geometric guidance for improving scene consistency. However, stable long-horizon wandering remains challenging due to diverse motion--orientation relationships and imperfect memory guidance induced by accumulated generation artifacts and depth inaccuracies. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{PVWander}, a 3D-memory-guided framework that accumulates generated observations into an online point-cloud memory and reprojects it to guide subsequent generation, with two complementary designs: \textit{Path-Facing canonicalization} for motion--orientation alignment and \textit{Timestep-aware gating modulation} for adaptive memory guidance. \textit{Path-Facing canonicalization} exploits the horizontal cyclic symmetry of ERP panoramas to uniformly align each clip's ERP orientation with its principal translation direction, yielding more consistent, forward-like relative motions while preserving the prescribed camera path. \textit{Timestep-aware gating modulation} exploits the coarse-to-fine nature of diffusion denoising to adaptively regulate reprojected memory guidance through timestep-dependent channel-wise gates, preserving its structural benefits while mitigating visual artifacts from imperfect projections. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PVWander achieves improved long-horizon generation quality, while ablations validate the effectiveness of both designs.

</details>


### [197] [NRG-Twins: Pixel-Level Ground Truth for Rigidity Violations in Generated Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32431)
*Chenrui Fan,Qiyang Hu,Luca Scharr,Paolo Favaro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出NRG-Twins数据集与NRG-PD检测器，用真实视频与其生成孪生的配对获取逐像素非刚性偏差真值，量化并检测生成视频的3D不一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成视频并非3D一致（静态内容缓慢形变或滑动、重建退化），且误差过于细微难以人工标注，因此缺少"何处、偏离多少"的刚性破坏标注数据，以支撑使生成器3D一致或构建奖励/引导信号。

Method: 构建real-generated twins：真实片段与其由关键帧条件视频生成器重建的孪生配对；插入真实关键帧使孪生相机路径近似跟随真实路径，随后逐像素、以角度度量孪生偏离刚性场景的程度，得到真值标签。发布NRG-Twins（871对孪生）、构建代码及含官方测试划分的基准；并训练NRG-PD，仅由RGB预测逐像素偏差角度。

Result: NRG-PD区分一致与不一致像素的AUROC达0.85，优于七种现有一致性/运动分割方法（0.40–0.74）；其预测可提升含生成内容视频的3DGS重建质量。

Conclusion: 源自生成视频本身的逐像素刚性破坏标注可有效用于检测生成视频的3D不一致，并可作为提升3D重建及潜在生成器一致性的数据基础。

Abstract: Video generators now produce realistic clips of scenes and objects, which makes generated video an attractive source of 3D content. Yet generated video is not 3D consistent: static content slowly deforms or slides, 3D reconstruction degrades, and the errors are too subtle to label by hand. To make generators 3D consistent, or to build rewards and guidance that push them there, we need data that say where and by how much a generated video breaks rigidity, and these data must come from generated video itself. We obtain per-pixel ground-truth labels from real-generated twins: a real clip paired with its re-creation by a keyframe-conditioned video generator. After inserting real keyframes so that the twin camera roughly follows the real one, we measure per pixel, in degrees, how far the twin departs from a rigid scene seen along its own camera path. We release Non-Rigidly Generated Twins (NRG-Twins), 871 twins, the code that builds them for new generators, and a benchmark with an official test split. A detector trained on these data, the Non-Rigidly Generated Pixel Detector (NRG-PD), predicts the per-pixel angle from RGB alone. It separates inconsistent from consistent pixels with AUROC 0.85, against 0.40-0.74 for seven existing consistency and motion-segmentation methods, and its predictions improve 3DGS of video that contains generated content.

</details>


### [198] [Are We Rewarding the Wrong Module? Module-Specific Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32687)
*HuiSeong Cho,Jun Yeong Park,Yu Rang Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MSPO框架，通过分离视觉编码器与LLM的信用信号，缓解GRPO类多模态RLVR中的模块级信用纠缠问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于GRPO的多模态RLVR将视觉编码器、projector与LLM用同一优势信号联合优化，即使感知正确性与最终答案正确性不一致，导致"模块级信用纠缠"。

Method: 用感知清单（关于视觉信息的辅助问题）的响应为视觉编码器构造优势：计算置信度感知感知奖励（CaPR）——以清单准确率阈值化得到感知符号确定奖励方向，以潜变量感知准确率的Beta分布后验置信度缩放奖励幅度；再经组相对归一化并乘以主任务成功率得到视觉优势，仅更新视觉编码器，projector与LLM仍用基于结果的GRPO更新。

Result: 在7个数学与通用推理基准上，3B与7B规模均平均优于现有RL微调模型。

Conclusion: 按模块解耦感知与结果学习信号可有效提升MLLM多模态推理的RL训练效果。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been widely adopted to enhance the multimodal reasoning of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods share a common limitation of Module-Level Credit Entanglement, in which the vision encoder, projector, and LLM modules are jointly optimized using the same advantage signals even when perceptual correctness and final-answer correctness differ. To address this limitation, we propose Module-Specific Policy Optimization (MSPO), a framework that separates perceptual and outcome-based learning signals across model modules. Specifically, MSPO uses responses to perception checklists comprising auxiliary questions about visual information to derive an advantage for training the vision encoder. From these responses, MSPO computes the Confidence-aware Perception Reward (CaPR), using a perception sign obtained by thresholding checklist accuracy to determine reward direction and posterior confidence from a Beta distribution over latent perception accuracy to scale reward magnitude. We then derive the vision advantage through group-relative normalization of CaPR and scale it using main-task success rates. This advantage guides updates to the vision encoder, while the projector and LLM retain outcome-based GRPO updates. Extensive experiments on seven mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that MSPO outperforms existing RL-tuned models on average at both the 3B and 7B scales.

</details>


### [199] [Text Is Just Another Shot in Vision-Language Models: Simple Probes on Frozen Encoders Do It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32672)
*Reda Bensaid,Ismail Ben Ayed,François Leduc-Primeau,Vincent Gripon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文指出“文本分类器为锚、图像仅做修正”这一流行原则源于CLIP视觉特征的局限而非任务本质，据此提出贝叶斯解释（类名等价于κ=σ²/τ²张标注图像），并给出TASP：在冻结特征上把类名嵌入作为加权样本与正则先验的凸逻辑回归。在11数据集基准上，TASP配合冻结PE-Core-L在1 shot达87.1%、16 shots达91.4%，超出SOTA 4.6–11.0个百分点；匹配特征的受控实验表明现有冻结编码器适配方法并不显著优于该探针。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少样本视觉-语言适配方法日益复杂，但均共享“零样本文本分类器为锚、标注图像只做修正”的原则。作者认为该原则反映的是CLIP视觉特征的特性，而非任务本身的性质，因而需要更本质的解释与更简洁的方法。

Method: 提出贝叶斯解释：类名的价值等价于κ=σ²/τ²张标注图像（κ为类视觉离散度与类名错配度之比），该模型的贝叶斯分类器把文本计为κ个额外样本。据此设计TASP——在冻结特征上的简单凸逻辑回归（well-regularised convex probe），将类名嵌入同时作为加权训练样本和正则化先验。并进行匹配特征上的受控对比与消融（文本权重 vs. 融合方式、自监督+视觉-语言特征组合）。

Result: 11数据集基准上，TASP+冻结PE-Core-L：1 shot 87.1%、16 shots 91.4%，领先SOTA少样本视觉-语言适配方法4.6–11.0个百分点。受控对比显示，强表征解释了大部分提升；在匹配特征下，现有冻结编码器适配方法并未实质超越该探针。文本权重比其融入方式更重要；自监督视觉特征与视觉-语言表征结合对较弱编码器收益最大。

Conclusion: 少样本视觉-语言适配的进展更依赖于表征质量与文本监督的恰当使用，而非日益复杂的适配机制；简洁的凸探针加合理的文本先验即可达到甚至超越复杂方法。

Abstract: Few-shot adaptation of vision-language models has produced increasingly elaborate methods built on CLIP and on one shared principle: the zero-shot text classifier is the anchor, and labeled images only correct it. We argue that this principle reflects CLIP's visual features rather than a property of the task. We provide a simple Bayesian interpretation, in which a class name is worth exactly kappa = sigma^2 / tau^2 labeled images, the ratio between the visual spread of a class and the misalignment of its name. The Bayes classifier of this model counts text as kappa more samples. With modern frozen encoders, few-shot adaptation then reduces to a well-regularised convex probe. Specifically, we introduce TASP, a simple convex logistic regression on frozen features that incorporates class-name embeddings as weighted training examples and as a regularization prior. On the standard 11-dataset benchmark, TASP with frozen PE-Core-L features achieves 87.1% accuracy at 1 shot and 91.4% at 16 shots, outperforming state-of-the-art few-shot vision-language adaptation methods by 4.6 to 11.0 percentage points. While stronger representations explain much of this improvement, controlled comparisons on matched features show that existing frozen-encoder adaptation methods do not materially improve on this probe. We further find that the weight assigned to text matters more than how it is incorporated, and that combining self-supervised visual features with vision-language representations is most beneficial for weaker visual encoders. Together, these findings suggest that progress in few-shot vision-language adaptation depends more on representation quality and the appropriate use of text supervision than on increasingly complex adaptation mechanisms.

</details>


### [200] [ICLWorld: Benchmarking In-Context Learning of Agents from Digital to Physical Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32649)
*Qingle Liu,Jieming Li,Pei-lin Li,Shenghan Zheng,Ruize Yang,Sunqi Fan,Deyao Hong,Huan-ang Gao,Meng-Hao Guo,Shuojin Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出在线基准ICLWorld与统一测试框架UIverse，从数字世界到物理世界评估智能体的上下文学习（ICL）能力，覆盖计算机使用与机器人使用，构建30个环境、630段演示视频与160个反直觉规则任务，并揭示数字与物理世界、以及"识别规则"与"执行规则"之间的显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICL评测多为离线、基于文本或静态图像，存在训练数据污染风险；机器人评测仅停留在方法级消融，缺乏对前沿智能体ICL能力的系统在线评估。

Method: 构建ICLWorld在线基准与UIverse统一harness（将各环境统一为用户界面）；建立30个环境、630段演示视频（10+小时）、160个任务，每任务配备难以直观推断的定制规则；每个任务提供文本/视频三种规则版本，并按三层次（重放演示→新实例→未见环境）测试泛化；测试6个前沿模型并设置无规则对照。

Result: Claude Opus 5.5与GPT-6 Astra在计算机使用任务成功率82%/76%，机器人使用仅27%/26%；无规则对照成功率降至≤8%；GPT-6 Astra在三种规则版本下均成功仅占计算机任务38%（单规则的一半），机器人规则问答正确率98%但任务完成仅20%。前沿智能体能从视频与文本中相当程度地学习规则并跨环境迁移，较弱智能体依赖文本，演示情境重采样后视频学习成功率大幅下降。

Conclusion: 揭示了数字世界与物理世界之间、以及"识别规则"与"据此行动"之间存在实质性能力鸿沟，为前沿智能体ICL的在线、跨域评估提供了统一基准与方法论。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) lets agents acquire new rules from context and adapt to user-specific requirements at inference time. The same frontier agents now operate both computers and robots, yet their ICL remains insufficiently assessed: existing benchmarks are largely offline, rely on text or static images, and risk training-data contamination, while robot evaluations are limited to method-level ablations. We present ICLWorld, an online benchmark that evaluates the ICL of agents from digital to physical worlds, covering computer use and robot use, together with UIverse, a unified harness that turns every environment into a user interface. We build 30 environments, record 630 demonstration videos (10+ hours), and design 160 tasks with customized, often counter-intuitive rules that cannot be satisfied without learning from the context. Each task comes with three rule versions, given as text or video, and we test generalization at three levels, from replaying the demonstration to new instances and unseen environments. Across six frontier models, the strongest agents, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, succeed on 82% and 76% of computer-use runs but only 27% and 26% of robot-use runs, and a no-rule control reduces success to at most 8%. GPT-6 Astra succeeds under all three rule versions on only 38% of computer-use tasks, half its rate under a single rule, and answers 98% of robot rule questions correctly yet completes only 20% of these tasks. Frontier agents learn rules comparably well from video and from text and transfer them across environments, whereas weaker agents rely on text and lose most of their video-based success once the demonstrated situation is resampled. These findings reveal substantial gaps between the digital and the physical world and between identifying a rule and acting on it.

</details>


### [201] [VenusOCR2.0: Towards Efficient and Effective Document Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32617)
*Lei Li,Zheng Wei,Yi Yuan,Qingbin Liu,Jiang Bian,Zang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出1B参数的文档解析视觉语言识别器VenusOCR2.0，配合有界递归自改进数据引擎、紧凑OTSL表格表示与PTPv2并行草稿模块，在OmniDocBench v1.6上取得96.45总分与98.57公式CDM，单卡H20部署实现2.96倍单请求加速且与自回归解码无损等价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高精度文档解析多依赖大规模通用VLM，部署成本高、吞吐受限；同时自训练易发生模型崩塌，且自回归解码构成推理瓶颈。因此需在小参数规模下兼顾精度与吞吐。

Method: 1) 构建有界递归自改进(RSI)数据引擎：模型仅作为弱点探针，由多专家medoid共识、VLM视觉验证与因子化合成提供可靠监督，覆盖预训练、精标SFT与RLVR；2) 架构采用动态分辨率SigLIP2编码器+2x2空间token合并，解码端为Qwen3-0.6B，表格用紧凑原子OTSL token缩短序列；3) 提出PTPv2(~67M)解耦并行草稿模块，结合冻结多层验证器条件、独立学习掩码与块因果全位置下一token预测。

Result: OmniDocBench v1.6总分96.45，公式CDM达SOTA的98.57，超过Gemini-3-Pro(92.91)与Qwen3-VL-235B(89.78)；vLLM单H20部署下PTPv2单请求加速2.96倍、批量吞吐最高提升2.36倍，且与标准自回归解码逐token完全等价。

Conclusion: 小规模专用模型通过高质量数据引擎与并行解码优化，可在文档解析上超越超大通用VLM并实现高效无损部署。

Abstract: We present VenusOCR2.0, a compact 1B-parameter vision-language recognizer designed for both high-accuracy and high-throughput document parsing across text, tables, and formulas. To continuously improve recognition quality without self-training collapse, we build a bounded recursive self-improvement (RSI) data engine where the model acts strictly as a weakness probe, while external multi-expert medoid consensus, VLM visual verification, and factorized synthesis supply reliable supervision across pretraining, curated SFT, and RLVR. VenusOCR2.0 couples a dynamic-resolution SigLIP2 encoder and 2x2 spatial token merging with a Qwen3-0.6B decoder, adopting compact atomic OTSL tokens to shorten table sequences and reduce structural errors. To further eliminate the autoregressive decoding bottleneck, we introduce PTPv2, a lightweight ($\sim$67M) decoupled parallel draft module that combines frozen multi-layer verifier conditioning, a standalone learned mask, and block-causal all-position next-token prediction. On OmniDocBenchv1.6, VenusOCR2.0 achieves an overall score of 96.45 and a state-of-the-art 98.57 formula CDM, substantially outperforming massive general-purpose VLMs such as Gemini-3-Pro (92.91) and Qwen3-VL-235B (89.78). Deployed in vLLM on a single H20 GPU, PTPv2 delivers a 2.96x single-request speedup and up to 2.36x higher batched throughput while guaranteeing lossless, token-for-token equivalence with standard autoregressive decoding.

</details>


### [202] [Sol$^{3}$: Accelerating Video Diffusion for Free via Hierarchical Sparse Attention Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32562)
*Guoxin Fan,Weilun Feng,Chuanguang Yang,Mingqiang Wu,Xiaokun Liu,Jitao Lu,Zhulin An,Libo Huang,Boyu Diao,Di Gao,Yongjun Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的分层稀疏注意力方法 Sol³，通过高斯引导的分层路由将精确计算范围从块级细化到 token 级，在视频生成等任务中实现 86% 注意力稀疏度与 3.07× 加速且保持质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sol-Attn 虽结合稀疏精确计算与低成本代表性近似来加速扩散视频模型的免训练推理，但其块级决策存在问题：块内注意力常只聚焦少数 token，保留关键交互的同时仍需评估大量低响应成员，导致精确计算分配不够精细。

Method: 1) 高斯引导的分层路由：利用各层级统计阈值，逐级从块到 token 确定精确计算范围，仅对需细化的 Mixed 块内部分成员做精确计算，其余用代表性项近似；2) 异构路由统计：融合块中心相关性与块内 Key/Value 的变异程度，识别难以近似的 Mixed 块；3) 在这些 Mixed 块内，统一比较原始 token 相关性以筛选需要精确计算的成员。

Result: 在视频生成、音视频联合生成与世界模拟任务上，实现 86% 注意力稀疏度与 3.07× 注意力加速，同时保持生成质量。代码已开源。

Conclusion: Sol³ 通过将精确计算的分配从块级细化到 token 级的分层稀疏路由，显著提升稀疏注意力的效率-质量权衡，是一种免训练、可推广的扩散视频模型加速方案。

Abstract: Sol-Attn (Sparsifying online attention) combines sparse exact computation with low-cost representative approximation to accelerate training-free inference in diffusion video models. However, intra-block attention can focus on only a few tokens. While preserving these key interactions exactly, the block-level decision incurs the cost of evaluating many low-response members. We propose Sol$^{3}$, a training-free hierarchical sparse attention method that further refines how exact computations are allocated. First, we introduce Gaussian-guided hierarchical routing, which determines the scope of exact computation step by step, from blocks to tokens, using statistical thresholds at each level. Only a subset of members within Mixed blocks that require refinement is selected for exact computation, while representative terms approximate the remaining members. We further design heterogeneous routing statistics that combine block-center correlations with variations in Key and Value within blocks to identify blocks that are difficult to approximate. Among these Mixed blocks, we uniformly compare raw token relevance to select members requiring exact computation. Experiments on video generation, audio-video co-generation, and world simulation tasks demonstrate that Sol$^{3}$ achieves 86% attention sparsity and delivers a $3.07\times$ attention speedup while preserving quality. Our code is available at https://github.com/FofGofx/sol3.

</details>


### [203] [PartAgent: Agentic 3D Part Segmentation via Expert Integration and Closed-Loop Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32554)
*Yang Cao,Zhe Zhu,Yiheng Zhang,Zhengqiang Zhang,Haoyuan Li,Le Wan,Dan Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PartAgent是一个无需训练的智能体式框架，通过融合3D专家的区域提议与2D专家的语义线索，并对分区进行闭环迭代精修，实现3D物体语义部件分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D部件分割需要同时推理几何结构与语义上下文。预训练3D专家提供空间上可信的区域提议，2D专家提供识别部件所需的语义线索，难点在于如何整合这两种互补能力，并能在统一框架内产生有意义的部件分割并渐进式精修。

Method: 提出PartAgent，包含两个互补模块：(i) 结构-语义专家集成：借助图像到表面的对应关系，将3D专家预测的区域与2D专家的多视图语义证据结合，构建多粒度的组合式部件分区；(ii) 观测驱动的闭环分区精修：观测当前分区及其支持证据，选择针对性的检查、证据修复、组合或重选动作，验证所提出的变更，并用更新后的状态与动作结果指导后续决策。整个框架无需训练。

Result: 在PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT上取得68.41 mIoU，超过最强对比方法8.53个点；在3DCoMPaT200、PartNeXt、PartNetE和PartObjaverse-Tiny上均取得最高mIoU，四数据集平均69.36，比对比方法中最高均值高7.28个点。

Conclusion: 结构-语义专家集成与闭环精修的智能体设计能有效融合2D与3D互补先验，在无需训练的条件下实现领先的3D部件分割性能，并在多个数据集上表现出一致优势。

Abstract: Segmenting a 3D object into semantically meaningful parts requires joint reasoning about geometric structure and semantic context. Pretrained 3D experts provide spatially grounded region proposals, while 2D experts provide semantic cues for identifying object parts. The challenge is to integrate these complementary capabilities into a framework that can both produce meaningful part segmentations and progressively refine them. We present PartAgent, a training-free agentic framework for 3D part segmentation built upon two complementary modules: (i) Structural-Semantic Expert Integration combines regions predicted by the 3D expert with multiview semantic evidence from the 2D expert through image-to-surface correspondences, constructing compositional part partitions at multiple granularities. (ii) Observation-Driven Closed-Loop Partition Refinement observes the current partition and its supporting evidence to select targeted inspection, evidence repair, composition, or reselection actions. It verifies proposed changes and uses the updated state and action outcomes to guide subsequent decisions. On PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT, PartAgent achieves 68.41 mIoU, outperforming the strongest competing method by 8.53 points. Across 3DCoMPaT200, PartNeXt, PartNetE, and PartObjaverse-Tiny, PartAgent achieves the highest mIoU on each dataset, averaging 69.36 across the four datasets, 7.28 points above the highest mean among competing methods.

</details>


### [204] [Rescuing Discarded Boundary Samples in Semi-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32532)
*Yuzhao Jiang,Meng Zhang,Jie Ma,Xiaohong Guan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BRC（边界精炼与纠正），作为置信度阈值式半监督学习的附加模块，从被丢弃样本中挽救有用样本并赋予纠正后的软伪标签，降低确认偏差同时保留边界信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伪标签范式的SSL主要难点是确认偏差；常用手段是置信度阈值丢弃低置信样本，但被丢弃样本多位于类别边界附近，导致有价值边界信息流失。

Method: BRC为插件式方法，不改变基座SSL的伪标签选择规则，仅在被拒绝集合上操作：先识别对训练仍可能有用的被丢弃样本，再将其原始伪标签替换为纠正后的软伪标签并重新纳入无监督损失。

Result: 在CIFAR-100、STL-10、TissueMNIST上验证，错误率最多降低4.97个百分点；在近边界样本上Top-1提升12.80个百分点；延伸至语义分割取得1.03–2.39 mIoU的一致增益。

Conclusion: BRC可在不改动基座方法的情况下缓解边界信息损失、精炼决策边界，跨数据集、跨基座方法与跨任务（分类→分割）均具灵活性与泛化性。

Abstract: The field of semi-supervised learning (SSL) has seen substantial progress, driven by ongoing refinements within the pseudo-label SSL paradigm. The main difficulty lies in reducing the adverse impact of confirmation bias. The predominant approach is to apply a confidence threshold during training to discard low-confidence samples. Nevertheless, while this mitigates the bias, the discarded samples are mostly situated near class boundaries, and consequently, this strategy also loses valuable boundary information. To address this problem, we propose Boundary Refinement and Correction (BRC), an add-on for confidence-thresholded SSL that rescues useful discarded samples without changing how the base SSL method selects pseudo-labels. BRC keeps the original confidence-based selection rule and operates only on the rejected set. It first identifies discarded samples that may still be useful for training, then replaces their original pseudo-labels with corrected soft pseudo-labels and returns them to the unsupervised loss. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, STL-10, and TissueMNIST demonstrate the flexibility and broad applicability of BRC across diverse datasets and base SSL methods, reducing error rates by up to 4.97 percentage points. On boundary-near samples, BRC further improves Top-1 accuracy by 12.80 percentage points, directly supporting its ability to refine the model's decision boundary. An exploratory extension to semantic segmentation also yields consistent gains of 1.03-2.39 mIoU, indicating that BRC generalizes beyond image classification.

</details>


### [205] [GeoVLDrive: Geometry-Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32510)
*JiaHui Huang,Songyan Zhang,Hanbing Li,Hanchao Leng,Kuiyuan Yang,Guang Chen,Hangjun Ye,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoVLDrive：几何接地（geometry-grounded）的VLA框架，通过3D基础模型多层特征注入、结构化隐式CoT与场景接地的轨迹打分，实现3D时空推理与规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA规划器虽继承预训练VLM的语义知识，但其推理很少以3D场景结构及其时序演化为依据（缺乏几何接地），导致空间/运动理解不足。

Method: 1) 用门控交叉注意力（gated cross-attention）将3D基础模型的多层特征注入视觉-语言主干；2) 结构化隐式链式思维（CoT）将未来场景几何、关键智能体运动与meta-action组织为有序、分别监督的隐状态；3) 动作专家由这些隐状态与多层场景特征生成轨迹提案，并用场景接地、相互作用的score token进行排序；4) 提出NAVSIM 3DQA基准用于训练与评测度量级3D空间与运动理解。

Result: NAVSIM v1 上 PDMS 91.8；NAVSIM v2 上 EPDMS 90.9；NAVSIM 3DQA 上几何接地主干总体 89.2%，较微调的 Qwen3-VL-2B 基线高 4.6 个百分点；LingoQA 上 Lingo-Judge 准确率 68.6%。

Conclusion: 显式引入3D几何接地与结构化隐式推理链，可同时提升VLA的度量级空间/运动理解与端到端规划性能，并提供了配套的3DQA评测基准。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) planners inherit semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language models, but their reasoning is rarely grounded in 3D scene structure and its evolution over time. We introduce GeoVLDrive, a geometry-grounded VLA framework for 3D spatiotemporal reasoning and planning. Multi-layer features from a 3D foundation model augment the vision-language backbone through gated cross-attention. A structured latent chain of thought (CoT) organizes future scene geometry, key-agent motion, and meta-actions into ordered, separately supervised latent states. An action expert generates trajectory proposals from these states and multi-layer scene features, and ranks them using scene-grounded, interacting score tokens. We also introduce NAVSIM 3DQA to train and evaluate metric 3D spatial and motion understanding. GeoVLDrive achieves 91.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. On NAVSIM 3DQA, the geometry-grounded backbone scores 89.2% overall, 4.6 percentage points above the fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B baseline. On LingoQA, the backbone achieves 68.6% Lingo-Judge accuracy.

</details>


### [206] [Déjà-VAE: Training-Free Consistent Editing with Pseudo-Invertible Encoders and Latent Back-Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32501)
*Ron Libman,Yamit Ehrlich,Ohad Fried,Assaf Shocher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Déjà-VAE，无需训练即可同时实现精确自编码一致性（E'(D'(z))=z）与校准式编辑稳定化，减少多轮编辑漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式工作流中反复处理应保留未被请求修改的信息；但潜扩散模型中VAE自编码误差与编辑模型的非预期改动会逐步累积，逐渐改变图像的结构、纹理与颜色。

Method: 1) 自编码部分：将预训练VAE改造为满射伪可逆网络，用固定增益平衡对原编码器/解码器的偏离；新解码器D'按构造是E'的显式非线性右逆，满足E'(D'(z))=z，使D'成为自反广义逆，潜空间往返可数值精确保持、重复重建幂等。2) 编辑稳定部分：自适应小波反投影，在满足小波系数变化低于校准阈值（即与上一潜变量一致）的约束下，求编辑器输出在ℓ2意义下最近的潜变量；每轮仅校正一次，校准后无需额外网络评估。

Result: 支持纯潜空间工作流以及生成与像素空间操作/约束交替的工作流；在多种模型与编辑基准上，漂移低于原生管线及专门的类一致性方法。

Conclusion: 通过精确自编码一致性与校准式编辑稳定化的组合，可在免训练条件下显著抑制多轮编辑中的累积漂移。

Abstract: Consistency is essential to generative workflows: repeated processing should preserve information beyond the changes explicitly requested. In latent diffusion models, this requires stability both when moving between latent and pixel spaces and when applying successive edits. Autoencoding errors and unintended changes from the editing model can accumulate across these operations, progressively altering image structure, texture, and color. We introduce Déjà-VAE, a framework that combines exact autoencoding consistency with calibrated editing stabilization, without training or fine-tuning. Its autoencoding component converts a pretrained variational autoencoder into a surjective pseudo-invertible neural network, with a fixed gain balancing deviations from the pretrained encoder and decoder. The modified decoder $D'$ is an explicit nonlinear right inverse of the encoder $E'$, satisfying $E'(D'(z))=z$ by construction. Consequently, $D'$ is a reflexive generalized inverse: latent round trips preserve their input, up to numerical precision, and repeated image reconstruction is idempotent. To suppress editing drift, adaptive wavelet back-projection finds the closest latent to the editor's output in $\ell_2$, subject to matching the previous latent on wavelet coefficients whose changes fall below calibrated thresholds. This correction is applied once per turn, with no additional network evaluations after calibration. Together, these components support workflows that remain in latent space or interleave generation with pixel-space operations and constraints. Tests across models and editing benchmarks show less drift than stock pipelines and dedicated consistency methods.

</details>


### [207] [COHERE4D: Training-Free Dense Surface Alignment for Coherent Metric 4D Human-Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32482)
*Zhumei Wang,Shaofei Wang,Xiang An,Mingtao Pei,Siyuan Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: COHERE4D是一个免训练框架，通过直接配准独立预训练的人体与场景基础模型所预测的人体表面，重建一致的米制4D世界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人体模型可恢复米制人体网格但缺乏场景定位，场景模型估计全局一致的3D几何与相机运动但尺度不可靠；两者重建的是同一前景人体表面，而现有方法未直接利用这一共享表面，仅依赖稀疏接触约束或数据驱动对齐模块，泛化性差。

Method: 在可见人体表面上建立稠密、像素对齐的3D对应关系；采用RANSAC结合跨帧一致性抑制遮挡、背景污染与深度噪声产生的离群点；求解两个互补几何量：序列级共享尺度（将场景几何与相机运动校准到米制人体尺度）与逐帧人体平移（将相机空间人体网格对齐至缩放后场景几何，保证时空一致性）。

Result: 在多种骨干网络与基准上，COHERE4D在人体-场景对齐、米制场景与相机位姿重建、全局人体运动估计方面显著优于先前方法，仅增加约4 ms/帧开销，整体推理可达14 FPS。

Conclusion: 直接配准两个基础模型共享的人体表面是一种高效且免训练的4D重建途径，可同时获得米制尺度的场景、相机与人体运动，且计算开销极低。

Abstract: Human and scene foundation models offer complementary strengths for monocular 4D reconstruction: human models recover metric-scale body meshes but lack scene grounding, whereas scene models estimate globally consistent 3D geometry and camera motion without reliable metric scale. Crucially, both models reconstruct the same foreground human surface. Yet existing methods do not directly exploit this shared surface: lacking reliable foreground human geometry in scene reconstructions, earlier approaches either resort to sparse contact constraints or learn data-driven alignment modules that generalize poorly to out-of-distribution scenes. We present COHERE4D, a training-free framework that directly registers the human surfaces predicted by independently pretrained human and scene foundation models to reconstruct a coherent, metric 4D world. COHERE4D establishes dense, pixel-aligned 3D correspondences over the visible human surface and employs RANSAC with cross-frame consensus to suppress outliers from occlusion, background contamination, and depth noise. This formulation solves for two complementary geometric quantities: a sequence-level shared scale that calibrates scene geometry and camera motion to metric human size, and per-frame human translations that align camera-space human meshes with the scaled scene geometry to enforce spatial and temporal consistency. Across diverse backbones and benchmarks, COHERE4D substantially outperforms prior methods in human--scene alignment, metric scene and camera pose reconstruction, and global human motion estimation, adding only 4,ms/frame, enabling overall inference at up to 14 FPS.

</details>


### [208] [Beyond Image-Text Pairs: Aligning Semantic Changes for Fine-Grained Visual Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32817)
*Yujie Sun,Zeqing Wang,Shuang Liang,Zhenlin Zhao,Kunyu Zhang,Xiaowu Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出后训练方法语义差异对齐（SDA）损失，通过对齐视觉与文本表征变化方向学习跨模态语义变化对应关系，并构建VarFamily-40K数据集，提升组合理解与下游分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像-文本对齐训练范式对"语义变化如何在模态间对应"的监督有限，导致表征不够细粒度、判别性不足。

Method: 设计SDA损失，对齐成对样本中视觉与文本表征变化的方向；与成对sigmoid匹配损失联合训练，同时学习图文对应与跨模态语义变化；构建含受控跨模态语义变化的VarFamily-40K图文对数据集作为训练支撑。

Result: 在组合理解与下游分类任务上取得一致性提升；将适配后的视觉编码器集成到VLM中，在多模态任务上获得进一步增益。

Conclusion: 显式建模跨模态语义变化对应关系是一种有效的后训练策略，可提升视觉表征的细粒度性与判别性，并迁移至下游及多模态任务。

Abstract: Image-text alignment serves as a foundation for modern vision-language models (VLMs), yet prevailing training paradigms provide limited supervision for learning how semantic changes correspond across modalities. To address this limitation, we propose a post-training method that learns cross-modal semantic change correspondences through controlled visual and textual variations. Specifically, we introduce a Semantic Difference Alignment (SDA) loss which can align the directions of corresponding visual and textual representation changes. We combine our proposed SDA with pairwise sigmoid matching to jointly learn image-text correspondences and cross-modal semantic changes, encouraging more fine-grained and discriminative visual representations. To support this learning, we construct VarFamily-40K, a dataset of image-text pairs with controlled cross-modal semantic variations. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in compositional understanding and downstream classification performance, alongside further gains on multimodal tasks when the adapted visual encoder is integrated into VLMs.

</details>


### [209] [AnyPrune: Optimization-Free Pruning for Any Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting Pipeline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32735)
*Nicola Leonetti,Federico Stella,Aoxiang Fan,Saqib Javed,Pascal Fua,Luigi Di Stefano*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AnyPrune 是一个基于 Transformer、无需优化的前馈 3DGS 剪枝模块，通过短时单卡训练学习特定管线的冗余模式，在保持渲染质量的同时显著压缩高斯数量，并可在消费级 GPU 上约 5 秒剪枝 160 万高斯场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈 3DGS 单次前向即可重建并实时渲染，但生成的高斯数量远超忠实渲染所需（尤其输入视图多时），导致内存与存储开销剧增。现有剪枝方法要么需昂贵再优化（违背单次前向初衷），要么依赖无法充分利用信息的简单策略。

Method: 提出 AnyPrune：可叠加于任意前馈 3DGS 管线之上的 Transformer 剪枝模块。在冻结的目标前馈管线上进行短时单 GPU 训练，学习并利用该管线特有的冗余模式，实现免优化剪枝。

Result: 在多数设置下渲染质量优于现有免优化剪枝方法，并泛化到未见数据集（跨多管线、多数据集、多输入视图数实验验证）；消费级 GPU 上约 5 秒剪枝 1.6M 高斯场，快于所有高斯合并或场再优化方法；可与管线内置剪枝结合，在中等比例下进一步剪枝且保持或提升质量；并能给出保留大部分质量的场景自适应剪枝比例。

Conclusion: AnyPrune 以低成本 Transformer 模块实现高效、通用、免优化的前馈 3DGS 冗余剪枝，兼顾质量、速度与可组合性。

Abstract: Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipelines reconstruct a scene from images in a single forward pass, representing it as real-time-renderable 3D Gaussians. However, the resulting representations contain far more Gaussians than are needed to render the scene faithfully, especially when there are many input views. This drastically increases memory and storage requirements. Existing pruning methods either require costly re-optimization, which defeats the purpose of a single forward pass, or rely on simple strategies that do not exploit all the available information. We present AnyPrune, a transformer-based, optimization-free pruning module designed to work on top of any feedforward 3DGS pipeline. To remove unnecessary Gaussians, AnyPrune learns and exploits pipeline-specific redundancy patterns through a short single-GPU training on the frozen target feedforward pipeline. AnyPrune achieves better rendering quality than existing optimization-free pruning methods in most settings and generalizes to unseen datasets, as shown through extensive experiments across multiple feedforward pipelines, datasets, and input view counts. It prunes a 1.6M-Gaussian field in about $5\,\mathrm{s}$ on a consumer GPU, faster than every method that merges Gaussians or re-optimizes the field. It can also be combined with the pruning built into feedforward pipelines, pruning further at moderate ratios while preserving or improving rendering quality. Finally, it can even suggest a scene-specific pruning ratio that retains most of the quality.

</details>


### [210] [Diving Deeper into Dense Keypoint Localization in Object Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32728)
*Jiahong Chen,Jinghao Wang,Yueneng Yang,Banglei Guan,Zi Wang,Dewen Hu,Qifeng Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GHLAPose，将混合格雷-二进制(HGB)编码与局部感知精炼(LAR)结合，实现刚体6D位姿估计的全局到局部精确关键点定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于密集语义关键点的方法采用二进制编码进行高效全局关键点定位，但二进制编码的不连续性阻碍高分辨率训练，且其离散性与量化误差带来显著定位不确定性。

Method: 构建全局到局部框架：HGB编码缓解不连续性以获得准确初始全局关键点定位；LAR模块估计不确定性并精炼关键点定位以解决内在编码误差；通过聚合全局与局部特征实现精确的全局到局部策略。

Result: 在LM、LM-O、YCB-V、TUD-L数据集上超越SOTA，细粒度指标提升明显：LM-O上ADD(-S) 0.02d与0.05d分别领先次优方法1.4%和1.9%，YCB-V上ADD(-S) 0.1d提升1%。

Conclusion: HGB编码与LAR精炼的协同有效缓解二进制编码的不连续性与量化误差，验证了全局到局部策略在刚体6D位姿估计中的优越性。

Abstract: 6D pose estimation of rigid objects is a fundamental and challenging task in computer vision.
