Recent dense semantic keypoint-based methods employ binary encoding for efficient global keypoint localization, delivering strong performance in object pose estimation. Nevertheless, the discontinuous nature of binary encoding hinders effective training at high resolutions, while its inherent discrete and quantization errors lead to significant localization uncertainty. We propose GHLAPose, a global-to-local framework that synergizes hybrid Gray-binary (HGB) encoding with local-aware refinement (LAR). Specifically, HGB encoding first alleviates discontinuity to achieve accurate initial global keypoint localization. To further address intrinsic encoding errors, the LAR module estimates uncertainty and refines keypoint localization. This synergy enables a precise global-to-local strategy by aggregating global and local features. Extensive experiments on LM, LM-O, YCB-V, and TUD-L datasets demonstrate that GHLAPose surpasses state-of-the-art methods, particularly on fine-grained metrics. On LM-O, it outperforms the second-best method by 1.4% and 1.9% on ADD(-S) 0.02d and 0.05d respectively, and on YCB-V by 1% on ADD(-S) 0.1d. The code will be available at GHLAPose.

</details>


### [211] [Verify then Steer: Progress Hallucination-Aware Recovery for Continuous Vision-and-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32400)
*Jiewen Hou,Guanxiang Qi,Meina Kan,Shiguang Shan,Xilin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究VLN智能体在测试时路线偏离后难以恢复的问题，将其归因于"进度幻觉"现象，并提出测试时恢复框架PHAR（先验证后引导），在R2R-CE与RxR-CE上提升了多种SOTA方法的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLN方法在测试时遇到路线偏离后恢复能力差。作者从"指令进度"视角溯源，发现智能体把偏离路线的观测误判为任务进展的证据，导致内部指令进度超前于真实任务阶段，从而无法依据更早的子指令进行回溯恢复。

Method: 提出PHAR框架，遵循"验证—引导"范式：验证器检查VLM残差流表示，识别轨迹上跨模态证据的不匹配，并用分裂共形校准控制虚警率；一旦报警，引导模块用上下文老虎机自适应选择指令进度的回退幅度，实现在线恢复。

Result: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上的大量实验表明，该框架在测试阶段提升了多种SOTA视觉语言导航方法的可靠性。

Conclusion: 进度幻觉是VLN测试时恢复失败的关键机制；通过验证跨模态证据一致性并自适应回退指令进度，可在不重训练的情况下增强现有VLN方法的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to follow language instructions to reach a target in an unseen 3D environment. However, existing methods still struggle to recover from route deviations at test time. We investigate this limitation through the lens of instruction progress, and trace it to a phenomenon we term progress hallucination: agents misinterpret off-route observations as evidence of task progress, causing their internal instruction progress to advance beyond the actual task stage and hindering recovery based on earlier sub-instructions. To address this failure mode, we propose PHAR (Progress Hallucination-Aware Recovery), a test-time recovery framework following a verify-then-steer paradigm. The verifier examines residual-stream representations of the Vision-Language Model (VLM) to identify mismatch of cross-modal evidence along the trajectories, and uses split conformal calibration to control false alarms. When an alarm is raised, the steering module uses a contextual bandit to adaptively select the rewind extent of instruction progress for online recovery. Through extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, our framework enhances the reliability of multiple state-of-the-art vision-language navigation methods at test time.

</details>


### [212] [CREDIT: Compositional Reliability Learning for Noisy Composed Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32310)
*Tiancai Zhou,Yongxiang Li,Suimei Liu,Zhong Yuan,Dezhong Peng,Xi Peng,Xu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对组合图像检索(CIR)中噪声三元组对应(NTC)问题，提出CREDIT框架，用证据不确定性量化三元组可靠性并辅以扩散引导的参考图像精化，抑制噪声监督传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实训练数据常存在噪声三元组对应(NTC)，参考图像、修改文本与目标图像间的语义对应不可靠。现有方法隐含假设三元组正确性可由固定判决规则判定，但在NTC下语义对应真实性难以准确判断，且不同三元组具有程度不同的语义可靠性而非二元对错；确定性置信度无法刻画可靠性，导致对不可靠三元组过度自信监督，并在组合表示学习中逐步强化噪声语义。

Method: 提出CREDIT框架，含两个互补模块：(1) 证据组合不确定性学习(ECUL)：基于证据学习显式建模对应关系的不确定性，实现不确定性感知的可靠性估计以抑制噪声监督；(2) 扩散增强参考精化(DRR)：在ECUL提供可靠监督的基础上，通过文本条件扩散精化参考表示，生成更鲁棒的组合查询特征。

Result: 大量实验表明，CREDIT在多种设置下持续优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 将三元组对应建模为连续可靠性而非二元正确性、并以证据不确定性进行显式量化和抑制噪声传播，是提升NTC条件下CIR鲁棒性的有效途径。

Abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image that satisfies user intent based on a multimodal query consisting of a reference image and a modification text. However, real-world training data are often corrupted by Noisy Triplet Correspondence (NTC), where the semantic correspondence among the reference image, modification text, and target image becomes unreliable. Existing methods implicitly assume that the correctness of triplet correspondence can be determined by fixed decision rules. However, under NTC, the authenticity of semantic correspondence is difficult to determine accurately, and different triplets exhibit varying degrees of semantic reliability rather than binary correctness. Consequently, deterministic confidence is insufficient to faithfully characterize correspondence reliability, often leading to overconfident supervision for unreliable triplets and progressively reinforcing noisy semantics during compositional representation learning. To address this challenge, we propose a Compositional Reliability learning framework with Evidential uncertainty and DiffusIon-guided refinemenT (CREDIT), which explicitly quantifies the uncertainty of triplet correspondence to estimate its reliability and suppress the propagation of noisy supervision. CREDIT consists of two complementary components: The Evidential Compositional Uncertainty Learning (ECUL) module explicitly models correspondence uncertainty via evidential learning, enabling uncertaintyaware reliability estimation to suppress noisy supervision. Building upon the reliable supervision provided by ECUL, the Diffusion-enhanced Reference Refinement (DRR) module further refines reference representations through textconditioned diffusion, producing more robust compositional query features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CREDIT consistently outperforms existing methods under various settings.

</details>


### [213] [LoopFit: Retrofitting Pretrained Diffusion Transformers with Recurrent Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32175)
*Xiaocheng Lu,Haoxi Li,Dazhao Du,Tao Han,Jian Liu,Hao Chen,Bohai Gu,Siyu Yan,Jingcai Guo,Jie Zhang,Song Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LoopFit 通过循环复用 Transformer 块增加单步去噪深度，并用残差注意力调制与残差中继损失让预训练 DiT 在重复前向中逐块纠错，配合噪声相关深度调度，在同等算力下以更少的采样步数取得更好效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 增加采样步数可提升 DiT 性能，但每步去噪预测的深度不变；循环复用 Transformer 块能在单步内增加计算以进一步精炼隐表示。对预训练模型做改造可避免重复预训练，但难点在于：原本为固定深度学习到的块，需要在自身重复应用时修正局部误差，又不破坏先前通道已建立的结构。

Method: 提出 LoopFit：(1) Residual Attention Modulation (RAM)：用每个图像块在一次前向中的特征变化，对下一次前向中送入注意力的输入进行缩放与平移；(2) Residual Relay Loss (RRL)：训练时对误差在多次前向中持续存在的块赋予更大权重；(3) 噪声相关深度调度：高噪声阶段用四次前向、低噪声阶段用一次，以加速采样。

Result: 在可比算力下，以四次前向训练的骨干用循环深度解决的问题多于增加采样步数；在 12 个视觉谜题设定中，LoopFit 解出 89.8% 的棋盘，而覆盖全部 12 个设定的最强基线为 87.8%；增益主要来自迷宫与冻结湖面上长路径的追踪。

Conclusion: 将推理算力投入到单步内的循环深度（而非单纯增加采样步数）是提升 DiT 的有效途径，且可通过轻量改造使预训练模型获得该能力。

Abstract: Scaling inference computation offers a way to improve diffusion transformers (DiTs), but taking more sampling steps leaves the depth of each denoising prediction unchanged. Recurrently reusing Transformer blocks increases computation within each step, allowing further refinement of hidden representations. Retrofitting pretrained models enables this capability without repeating pretraining, but requires blocks learned for fixed-depth computation to refine states produced by their own repeated application. The challenge is to use each additional pass to correct local errors without disrupting the structure established by earlier passes. We introduce LoopFit, which uses feedback from earlier passes to guide refinement at each image patch. Residual Attention Modulation (RAM) uses each patch's feature change in one pass to scale and shift its input to attention in the next. During training, Residual Relay Loss (RRL) gives greater weight to patches whose prediction errors persist across passes. A noise-dependent depth schedule speeds up sampling by using four passes at high noise and one at lower noise levels. At comparable cost, backbones trained with four passes solve more problems using recurrent depth than extra sampling steps. Across 12 visual puzzle settings, LoopFit solves 89.8% of boards, compared with 87.8% for the strongest baseline evaluated on all 12. Most of the gain comes from tracing long paths on mazes and frozen lakes.

</details>


### [214] [SplatSeg3D: Efficient Zero-Shot 3D Segmentation via Point Cloud Surfelization and Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32716)
*Sandeep Inuganti,Mahdi Chamseddine,Marcel Rogge,Martin R. Oswald,Didier Stricker,Jason Rambach*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SplatSeg3D，仅凭纯彩色点云即可实现开放词汇3D分割，无需配套图像、相机位姿、类别监督或实例掩码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇3D分割依赖配准图像上的2D基础模型，但在许多场景中图像不可得；而直接的3D点云分割需要语义类别监督，难以零样本部署。

Method: 先将输入点云surfel化得到有向2D高斯，通过splatting渲染场景视图，并采用最大化场景覆盖的最少视图选择策略；再对渲染视图进行文本提示分割，为每个3D点赋多视图语义线索，融合得到3D分割结果。

Result: 在ScanNet、ScanNet++、Replica、S3DIS四个基准的语义分割与新类实例分割任务上，性能优于或持平SOTA，且运行时与计算开销更高效。

Conclusion: SplatSeg3D验证了无需图像与位姿、通过点云高斯splatting渲染+2D开放词汇分割融合即可高效实现零样本开放词汇3D分割。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D segmentation methods rely on 2D foundation models applied to registered images captured alongside the 3D point clouds. However, such images may not be available in many cases, while direct 3D point cloud segmentation methods require semantic class supervision and are challenging to deploy in a zero-shot manner. To address these issues, we present SplatSeg3D, which segments a bare colored point cloud in an open-vocabulary manner without requiring the accompanying images, camera poses, class supervision, or instance mask proposals. To achieve this, we first surfelize the input point cloud and obtain oriented 2D Gaussians. We then render views of the scene by splatting, with a view selection strategy that maximizes scene coverage with as few views as possible. Next, we apply text-prompted segmentation on the rendered views, giving each 3D point a set of multi-view semantic cues, fused to produce a 3D segmentation of the scene. We evaluate SplatSeg3D on semantic segmentation and novel-class instance segmentation on 4 standard benchmarks: Scannet, Scannet++, Replica, and S3DIS. Our pipeline not only performs better or on-par with the state-of-the-art, but we also achieve these results efficiently across runtime and compute requirements. Code will be published.

</details>


### [215] [PointX: Multi-View Consistent Intrinsics by Querying Surface Points](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33157)
*Miguel Farinha,Sam Sartor,Iliyan Georgiev,Giuseppe Vecchio,Ronald Clark,Michael Fischer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PointX：一种前馈模型，将本征分解（albedo、roughness、metallicity、normal、irradiance）从"逐像素"改为"逐3D表面点"预测，利用多视图Transformer池化同一表面点在多视图中的token，实现构造上天然跨视图一致的本征预测，并支持一致的重光照与编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本征分解具有歧义性，现有逐像素方法对同一表面点在不同视图中给出不同分解结果，导致跨视图不一致，难以用于一致的重光照与编辑。

Method: 设计简单的单次前馈模型：多视图Transformer编码一组无位姿图像；对任意查询的表面点，将各视图中该点对应的token池化，一次解码出该点的本征属性。对点云/网格的每个点只产生单一预测。同一模型通过查询每个像素所在的点，也能生成单图或多图的逐视图本征图。

Result: 跨视图一致性显著优于现有方法；单视图精度保持竞争力，且随视图数量增加而提升；逐视图本征图在估计几何与对应关系精度范围内跨视图一致。

Conclusion: 将本征预测的表示从像素级改为3D点级，是利用几何一致性解决跨视图歧义的有效途径，可支撑视图一致的重光照与编辑任务。

Abstract: The appearance of a scene is determined by the albedo, roughness, metallicity and normal of every point on its surface, and by the light that reaches it, its irradiance. Recovering these intrinsics from images is ambiguous, and methods that predict them per pixel give the same surface point a different decomposition in every view. We introduce PointX, a simple feed-forward model that predicts intrinsics per 3D surface point instead. A multi-view transformer encodes a set of unposed images, and for any queried surface point, PointX pools the point's tokens across the views in which it appears and decodes the point's intrinsics once. Each point of a 3D reconstruction of the scene, such as a point cloud or a mesh, thus receives a single prediction, which is exactly consistent across views by construction and enables view-consistent relighting and editing. The same model also predicts per-view maps, from one image or many, by querying the point seen at every pixel. These maps agree across views up to the precision of the estimated geometry and correspondences. PointX is significantly more consistent than existing methods, while remaining competitive in accuracy from a single image and improving as views are added. Project page: https://pointx-paper.github.io/

</details>


### [216] [Train What You Run: Probabilistic Convolutions for Learning Token Compaction in State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33009)
*Piotr Kubaty,Mikhail Saladkou,Jacek Tabor,Łukasz Struski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ProbConv 在激活前按保留概率精确计算期望卷积，使 token 保留决策可微，实现强压缩下的视觉 token 精简。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉 token 压缩（仅将选中的图像块或视频 token 传入后续层）可降低推理成本；但在含局部卷积的序列模型中，每次删除 token 都会改变邻域关系，因此“学哪些 token 该保留”需要能感知新邻域的训练信号。

Method: 提出 ProbConv：在独立保留决策假设下，于被保留位置、激活之前精确计算期望卷积；该算子对保留概率可微。当决策取二值时，ProbConv 与阶跃门控可复现压缩后的 Mamba 块。

Result: 在图像、视觉-语言与视频骨干网络上，ProbConv 在强压缩条件下表现最优，且相对匹配训练基线（matched training controls）的优势随删除 token 增多而扩大；在 Cobra 上，于同等推理预算下优于已发表视觉-语言剪枝方法的适配版本；在视频帧选择与语音帧丢弃任务上优于匹配的零掩码（zero-mask）训练。

Conclusion: 将邻域变化纳入训练信号的期望卷积式可微门控，是强压缩场景下 token 精简的有效方案，并具跨模态泛化性。

Abstract: Visual token compaction reduces inference cost by passing only selected image patches or video tokens to later layers. In sequence models with local convolutions, each removal changes which tokens are neighbors. Learning which tokens to keep therefore requires a training signal that accounts for the new neighborhoods. We introduce ProbConv, which computes the exact expected convolution before activation at a kept position under independent keep decisions. The operator is differentiable in the keep probabilities. With binary decisions, ProbConv and step gating reproduce the compacted Mamba block. Across image, vision--language and video backbones, ProbConv is strongest under strong compaction: its advantage over matched training controls grows as more tokens are removed. In Cobra, it also outperforms adaptations of published vision--language pruning methods at matched inference budgets. ProbConv also improves over matched zero-mask training in video frame selection and speech frame dropping. Our code is available at: https://github.com/gmum/probconv

</details>


### [217] [NEST: Uncovering and Nesting Unknown Objects in Open-World Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32981)
*Yuchen Zhang,Yuan Gao,Sebastian Schmidt,Johannes Betz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文同时解决开放世界检测中的"未知物体定位（uncovering）"与"未知物体归类到类别taxonomy中的广义类别（categorizing）"两个问题，提出class-agnostic ranker提升未知召回，并用基于Euler图的categorizer对未知物体进行分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放世界检测器只能把未见类物体标注为"unknown"，仅告知"有物体"而非"是什么"；而若给出其所属的广义类别，可支持更明智的决策。同时作者发现，多数未知物体其实已在base detector中被定位并标为unknown，但因background得分更高而在top-k选择中被丢弃。

Method: 1）Uncovering：提出class-agnostic ranker，估计每个预测框与物体的匹配程度，并用该得分替代原得分进行最终预测的top-k选择，从而避免unknown预测被background挤掉。2）Categorizing：借鉴Euler diagram（类别区域包含其成员区域）的思想，用已知类构建每个广义类别的区域，并学习为未见成员预留的"空间/余量"，从而将未知物体归入给定类别taxonomy中的广义类别。

Result: 在三个benchmark上，相对于各任务中最强baseline，未知召回提升3.8%~195.1%（相对值），同时保持有竞争力的已知类检测性能；在相同检测结果上，分类器对未知物体的归类准确率优于现有层次化方法。

Conclusion: 通过class-agnostic ranker修正top-k选择可显著挽回被丢弃的未知物体，而基于Euler diagram的区域建模能有效将未知物体映射到广义类别，二者共同构成更完整的开放世界检测框架（NEST）。

Abstract: Open-world object detectors aim to localize objects of classes not covered by their training annotations, but most label them only as "unknown". This label tells a system that an object is present but not what it is, while its broader category would allow a more informed decision. We therefore address both uncovering unknown objects and assigning them to the broader categories of a given class taxonomy. For uncovering, we find that most unknown objects are already localized and labeled "unknown" in our base detector, but are discarded during final top-k selection because background receives higher scores. To mitigate this, we propose a class-agnostic ranker that estimates how well each predicted box fits an object and uses these scores to select the final predictions. Across three benchmarks, our detector improves unknown recall by 3.8% to 195.1% relative to the strongest baseline in each task, while maintaining competitive known-class detection. For categorizing, we draw on Euler diagrams, in which the region of a category contains the regions of its members. Our categorizer builds each category's region from the known classes and learns how much room to leave for members it has never seen. On the same detections, it categorizes unknown objects more accurately than existing hierarchical methods. Code is available at https://github.com/TUM-AVS/NEST.

</details>


### [218] [Teaching Time Without Losing General Retrieval: Adapting Multimodal Embeddings for Time-Sensitive Video Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32971)
*Toya Oyama,Rainer Lienhart,Shin'ichi Satoh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 通过保持损失、配对损失与中层LoRA三个组件，在单一模型、每段视频单一向量的约束下同时实现强通用检索与时间敏感检索，通用R@1保持58.4，反向副本gallery R@1由55.5升至63.2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM嵌入模型在场景描述型（通用）文本-视频检索上表现良好，但在动作及方向描述型（时间敏感）检索上较差。TARA通过带时间硬负例的文本三元组微调改善了时间敏感检索，却损害了通用检索（六基准平均R@1由58.4降至44.8），其发布模型需与Qwen3-VL-Embedding集成才能保住通用性能。作者目标是仅用单一模型、每段视频单一向量同时获得两类检索的强性能。

Method: 由三条发现对应三个简单组件：(1) Keep loss——通用检索性能取决于输出嵌入相对基模型的漂移量而非权重移动量，故将输出嵌入约束在基模型附近，即使不用通用域数据也能保住大部分通用检索；(2) Pair loss——动作描述与其反向版本在文本嵌入空间中区分明显，但视频与其反向副本的视频嵌入距离过近，故沿两段文本嵌入之差的方向拉大对应视频嵌入间距；(3) Middle-layer LoRA——帧融合发生在中间层，时间信息在中间层或其紧邻之后达到峰值，故仅在这些层上训练LoRA，以0.15%的参数在多数时间敏感基准上接近全参数训练，并更好保持通用检索。

Result: 通用R@1保持58.4；gallery中加入每段视频反向副本时R@1由55.5提升至63.2；增益可迁移到未见基准及InternVL2-8B-RA。Keep loss同样可修复TARA方案（通用R@1由44.8升至57.8）；TARA与本文方法集成后在RTime及未见CiA上取得对比模型中的最高分。

Conclusion: 输出嵌入漂移约束、方向性配对间隔与中层LoRA的组合，以极低参数量在单一模型单向量设定下兼顾通用与时间敏感检索，并对既有TARA方案具通用改进价值。

Abstract: In text-to-video retrieval, MLLM-based embedding models do well when the text describes the scene (general retrieval), but poorly when it describes actions and their direction (time-sensitive retrieval). TARA, a pioneering work, fine-tunes such a model on text triplets with temporal hard negatives; it improves time-sensitive retrieval but lowers general retrieval (mean R@1 over six benchmarks in our rerun on Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B: 58.4->44.8), and its released model keeps general retrieval only when ensembled with Qwen3-VL-Embedding. Our goal is strong general and time-sensitive retrieval with one model and one vector per clip. Three findings lead to three simple components. Keep loss: general retrieval follows how far the output embeddings drift from the base model, not how far the weights move; we therefore keep them near the base model, which keeps most general retrieval even without general-domain data. Pair loss: the text embeddings of an action description and its reversed-direction version are well separated, but the video embeddings of a clip and its reversed copy are close; we therefore widen the gap between the video embeddings of each clip and its reversed copy, in the direction of the difference between their two text embeddings. Middle-layer LoRA: frames are combined in the middle layers, and temporal information peaks in or just after them; we therefore train LoRA only on these layers, which nearly matches training all weights on most time-sensitive benchmarks with 0.15% of the parameters and keeps general retrieval better. General R@1 stays at 58.4, while R@1 with each clip's reversed copy in the gallery rises from 55.5 to 63.2; the gains carry over to unseen benchmarks and InternVL2-8B-RA. The keep loss is also a remedy for the TARA recipe (general R@1: 44.8->57.8), and ensembling TARA with Ours gives the highest scores on RTime and unseen CiA among the compared models.

</details>


### [219] [Benchmarking Evidence Sufficiency in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32964)
*Nhat Ha Nguyen,Sudipta Chowdhury,Lokesh Das*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DriveAnswer基准（20,151题、7类推理），通过强/弱证据配对配置把"答案正确性—证据充分性—定位"统一评估，要求弱证据下弃答；最强零样本基线强证据准确率67.31%但联合达标仅21.55%，受控适配后Gemma-4-12B达63.29%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有驾驶VLM评测把视觉定位（grounding）与可答性（answerability）当作独立指标，无法区分"证据充分支撑的预测"与"定位到相关但不足证据上的预测"，导致语义正确、证据充分、定位三种能力被混同。

Method: 构建DriveAnswer基准：20,151个问题、七个推理类别；核心是匹配的强证据/弱证据配置配对——每对保持场景事实与语义答案不变，仅改变观测是否足以支撑回答（弱证据下弃答为正确响应）；并定义联合指标：同时满足"答/弃正确"与"完整定位"。

Result: 六类推理评测中，最强零样本基线强证据准确率67.31%，但仅21.55%的配对题同时满足答案-弃答行为正确与完整定位；受控适配后Gemma-4-12B联合能力达63.29%，约为零样本的三倍；Qwen3-VL-8B在证据敏感回答与定位上呈同样幅度提升。

Conclusion: 语义正确性、证据充分性与定位是三种彼此不同的能力，应进行联合评估；单看准确率会显著高估模型可靠度。

Abstract: Reliable driving VLMs must do more than answer correctly or localize relevant scene actors: they must determine whether the available visual evidence is sufficient to support an answer. Existing evaluations largely treat grounding and answerability as separate measurements, making it difficult to distinguish well-supported predictions from those localized to relevant but insufficient evidence. We introduce DriveAnswer, a benchmark of 20,151 questions across seven reasoning families, that operationalizes this distinction using matched strong- and weak-evidence configurations. Each pair preserves the underlying scene fact and semantic answer while changing whether the observations support answering, making abstention the appropriate response under weak evidence. On the six-family evaluation, the strongest zero-shot baseline reaches 67.31% strong-evidence accuracy, yet only 21.55% of matched questions satisfy both answer-abstain behavior and complete grounding. With controlled adaptation, Gemma-4-12B reaches 63.29% on this joint capability, nearly tripling its zero-shot performance. Qwen3-VL-8B exhibits the same broad improvement in evidence-sensitive answering and grounding. These results show that semantic correctness, evidence sufficiency, and grounding are distinct capabilities that should be evaluated jointly.

</details>


### [220] [Do Vision-Language Models Know Their Own Visual Weaknesses? Probing Capability-Level Metacognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32940)
*Dohoon Kim,Taesup Moon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 视觉语言模型（VLM）事先几乎不知道自己视觉上的弱点（既不能判断各任务的共享难度，也误判图像退化的影响），但一旦开始作答，其自身答案概率就隐含着模型特有的弱点信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 元认知不仅是判断单个答案对错，还应包括预先知道自己在哪些任务类型和图像条件下会失败。作者要检验VLM是否具备这种"事先自知"，并把"对所有模型都难"的共享难度与"模型特有"的弱点区分开，从而干净地衡量模型对自身的知识。

Method: 在大量开源与专有VLM上，跨多种视觉任务与图像退化条件做评测：对比模型对自身准确率的预测与真实准确率，并区分共享难度与模型特有难度；进一步训练VLM预测自身准确率；再检验模型在少量无标注问题上对自身答案所赋概率是否反映其特有弱点。

Result: VLM事先几乎不了解自身视觉弱点：整体准确率误判，甚至无法识别所有模型都难的任务类型，多数模型误判图像退化对自身的影响。训练其预测准确率只能学到未见任务类型上的整体准确率水平，学不到哪些类型对其困难。但开始作答后，模型对自身答案的概率在任务类型与图像条件上呈现出模型特有的弱点模式。

Conclusion: VLM内部已持有关于自身弱点的信息，但其显式预测尚未反映出来。通过分离"模型特有"与"所有模型共有"的难度，该评测为训练VLM认识自身弱点的方法提供了检验标准，而答案概率可作为这类方法的起点信号。

Abstract: Metacognition includes knowing one's own strengths and weaknesses across kinds of tasks, not only judging whether a single answer is correct. We test whether vision-language models (VLMs) know in advance which kinds of visual tasks and image conditions are hard for them, across a wide range of open and proprietary models. Because some tasks are hard for every model, we separate what a model knows about this shared difficulty from what it knows about itself. We find that VLMs know little in advance about their visual weaknesses. They misjudge their overall accuracy and do not even know which kinds of tasks are hard for every model, and most misjudge how degraded images affect them. We further train VLMs to predict their own accuracy, which teaches them their own level of accuracy on kinds unseen in training but not which kinds are hard for them. However, information about these weaknesses appears once a model starts solving. On a few unlabeled questions of a kind, the probability a model assigns to its own answers follows weaknesses particular to the model, across kinds of tasks and image conditions. VLMs thus hold information about their own weaknesses that their stated predictions do not yet reflect. By separating what is particular to a model from what holds for every model, our evaluation offers a test for methods that aim to teach VLMs their own weaknesses, and the answer probability offers them a signal to start from.

</details>


### [221] [Efficient Video Retrieval Augmented Generation via Token Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32938)
*Ayush Barik,Fan Lai,Francis Y. Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Lembas：将长视频RAG建模为帧与字幕的共享预算令牌分配问题，用迭代注水算法求解并支持多轮对话复用，在同等算力下最高提升7.2个百分点准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高效长视频理解需要在减少VLM处理令牌数的同时定位相关证据。现有视频RAG方法仅做帧选择与令牌压缩，忽视了"每个额外令牌的价值"这一维度，导致预算分配次优。

Method: 提出即插即用框架Lembas，把视频RAG表述为帧与字幕在共享预算下的令牌分配问题。核心假设：令牌价值在单个条目内递减，且当相似证据获得更多令牌时进一步下降；将两种效应统一到单一目标函数，用具有收敛性保证的高效迭代注水（water-filling）算法求解。多轮对话中复用前轮已处理令牌，并以VLM注意力无额外成本地精化相关性。

Result: 在可比算力下，准确率较SOTA基线最高提升7.2个百分点；多轮视频理解场景下准确率最高提升1.5个百分点，同时TFLOPs减少1.7–17.3倍。

Conclusion: 以令牌边际价值为核心的预算分配是视频RAG的有效建模范式，兼具理论收敛保证与显著的精度—效率双赢，且可作为插件集成到现有流程。

Abstract: Efficient long-video understanding requires identifying relevant evidence while minimizing the tokens processed by vision-language models (VLMs). Existing video retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods rely on frame selection and token compression, but overlook how much each additional token is worth. We introduce Lembas, a plug-and-play framework that formulates video RAG as a token allocation problem over frames and subtitles under a shared budget. Our key insight is that the value of a token diminishes within each item and decreases further as similar evidence receives more tokens. Lembas captures both effects in a single objective and solves it with an efficient iterative water-filling algorithm that has a provable convergence guarantee. For multi-turn conversations, Lembas reuses the tokens processed in earlier turns and refines relevance with the VLM's attention at no extra cost. Our evaluations show that Lembas improves accuracy by up to 7.2 percentage points over state-of-the-art baselines at comparable compute. On multi-turn video understanding, Lembas achieves up to 1.5 percentage points higher accuracy with 1.7-17.3x fewer TFLOPs.

</details>


### [222] [Motion Conditioned World Modeling for Embodied Visual Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32900)
*Jiahao Zhang,Xuan Yao,Junyu Gao,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出运动条件世界模型（Motion-Conditioned World Modeling），将目标运动分布与机器人自运动注入潜状态转移，用于具身视觉跟踪，以0.5B轻量骨干在三个基准上提升跟踪性能与跨环境泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身视觉跟踪中，目标运动不确定与机器人视角变化共同影响观测，使未来状态预测困难；需要同时建模运动不确定性与动作引起的几何变换。

Method: 几何—进度（Geometry–Progress）模块以共享运动模式联合建模几何路径与单步行进距离，并经路径条件进度分布捕捉路径选择与进度区间的不确定性及依赖；通过动作诱导的坐标变换将预测路径映射到下一机器人坐标系，作为未来视觉状态预测的几何条件；以未来视觉特征重建经条件转移分支监督运动预测器；联合运动似然、特征重建与专家动作监督优化。

Result: 在三个具身跟踪基准上，采用0.5B轻量骨干即取得跟踪性能提升与跨环境泛化改善。

Conclusion: 将显式运动表示与条件潜状态转移结合、用重建与似然目标链接预测线索与观测，可有效支撑具身跟踪策略；轻量骨干下仍具竞争力。

Abstract: World models support embodied decision-making by predicting future environment states. In embodied visual tracking, uncertain target motion and robot-induced viewpoint changes jointly affect visual observations, making future-state prediction challenging. We propose Motion-Conditioned World Modeling, which incorporates predicted target-motion distributions and robot ego-motion into latent state transitions. A Geometry--Progress module jointly models geometric paths and single-step travel distances through shared motion modes and path-conditioned progress distributions. This formulation captures uncertainty in route selection and motion progress while preserving their dependence. Action-induced coordinate transformations express predicted paths in the next robot frame, providing geometrically grounded conditions for future visual-state prediction. Future visual feature reconstruction supervises the motion predictor through the conditioned transition branch, linking explicit motion representations to subsequent observations. The model is jointly optimized with motion likelihood, feature reconstruction, and expert-action supervision, enabling the tracking policy to combine visual context with predictive motion cues.Experiments on three embodied tracking benchmarks demonstrate improved tracking performance and cross-environment generalization with a lightweight $0.5$B backbone.

</details>


### [223] [Biomechanically Grounded Prediction of Selective Motor Control and Clinical Outcomes from Infant Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32890)
*Divya Joshi,Ruize Yang,Colleen Peyton,R. James Cotton*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出婴儿生物力学三维身体管线BB3D，从单目视频估计关节角轨迹，并用以训练时空Transformer实现BabyOSCAR选择性运动控制评分自动化，AUC 0.79、总分Spearman 0.86、CP区分AUC 0.86。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑瘫早期识别依赖GMA、BabyOSCAR等观察性评估，需要受训评分者且耗时；现有自动化方法基于二维关键点手工特征，仅描述像平面运动，无法刻画单个关节的三维行为。

Method: 构建婴儿适配的生物力学管线BB3D，从单摄像机视频估计关节角轨迹；以17名婴儿的多视角无标记动捕为参考评估精度；用1k+单目录像的BB3D关节角轨迹预训练时空Transformer，再在350名婴儿的550段视频上微调，逐项预测BabyOSCAR条目及总分。

Result: 关节中心中位Procrustes对齐误差17.5 mm、标记点20.4 mm；各BabyOSCAR条目平均站内AUC 0.79，总分Spearman 0.86；未用诊断训练的情况下预测总分区分CP的AUC为0.86，高于复现的二维特征分类器（0.67），低于临床专家评分（0.97）；预测分数亦携带功能能力与身体分布信息，但弱于专家评分。

Conclusion: 生物力学支撑的单目视频表征可支持可扩展、关节层面的婴儿期选择性运动控制评估。

Abstract: Early identification of cerebral palsy (CP) relies on observational assessments of spontaneous infant movement, such as the General Movement Assessment (GMA) and the Baby Observational Selective Control AppRaisal (BabyOSCAR), which require trained raters and substantial scoring time. Existing automated approaches derive hand-engineered features from two-dimensional keypoints, which describe image-plane motion rather than the three-dimensional behavior of individual joints. We present Baby Biomechanical 3D Body (BB3D), an infant-adapted, biomechanical pipeline that estimates joint-angle trajectories from single-camera video. Against a multi-view markerless motion capture reference in 17 infants, BB3D's median Procrustes-aligned error was 17.5~mm for joint centers and 20.4~mm for marker sites. A spatio-temporal transformer, pretrained on BB3D joint-angle trajectories from 1k+ single-camera recordings, and fine-tuned on 550 videos from 350 infants, predicted each individual BabyOSCAR item with a mean within-site AUC of 0.79 and the BabyOSCAR total with a Spearman correlation of 0.86 on held-out recordings. Without being trained on diagnosis, the predicted total separated infants with CP from those without CP with an AUC of 0.86, exceeding a replicated two-dimensional feature classifier (0.67) but below the expert clinician rater's total (0.97). Predicted scores also carried information about functional ability and body distribution, though less than expert clinician scores. These results show that biomechanically grounded representations of monocular video can support scalable, joint-level assessment of selective motor control in infancy

</details>


### [224] [VidForce: Predicting Force-Aware Articulation by Observing Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32967)
*Rafay Mohiuddin,Jiaqi Chen,Marc Pollefeys,Hermann Blum*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VidForce从第三人称RGB视频估计交互轨迹与力曲线，借助少量力测量学习"物理原型"先验，实现人类交互的力推断并部署于四足机器人操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类可通过观察他人估计物体运动与交互所需力气，但具身智能体难以从视频获得该能力；直接力测量依赖专用设备、数据量稀缺，因此需要把有限测力数据转化为可用于解释人类视频的先验。

Method: 输入为第三人称RGB视频，2D接触点击与文本"物体-动作"提示为可选。核心是学习共享力水平与时间剖面的"物理原型"作为先验，由视觉与语义线索决定各原型贡献；几何与视觉-语言特征将先验适配到具体观测；联合条件流模型同时细化初始跟踪轨迹与力剖面。用配对的人类视频与仪器化夹爪记录提供监督力参考，另训练力矩模型验证框架可扩展到其他感知量。

Result: 在Hoi!数据集留出交互上：ATE 6.6 cm，峰值力MAE 4.81 N、RMSE 5.92 N，力曲线RMSE 5.52 N；真实视频中运动与力推断稳定一致；在Spot机器人上由人类演示估计的轨迹与力曲线驱动机器人操作，并给出多次试验成功率。

Conclusion: 以少量仪器化测量构建原型先验，可从纯视觉视频中可靠推断交互轨迹与力，并迁移至真实机器人操作，且该建模范式可推广到力矩等其他物理量。

Abstract: People can anticipate how an object moves and the effort an interaction may require by watching others. How can embodied agents acquire this understanding from video? Force measurements provide direct sensory supervision, but require specialized equipment and remain limited in quantity. We introduce VidForce, which estimates an interaction trajectory together with a force profile from a third-person RGB video; 2D contact clicks and textual object-action prompts are optional. Our approach makes limited instrumented measurements useful for interpreting human interactions through learned physical prototypes as a prior. The prototypes share learned force levels and temporal profiles across interactions of comparable effort, with visual and semantic cues determining their contribution to each observation. Geometric and vision-language features adapt this prior to the observed interaction, while a joint conditional flow refines an initial tracked trajectory together with the force profile. Paired human and instrumented-gripper recordings provide measured force references for supervising human video, and a separately trained torque model demonstrates that the formulation extends to other sensory quantities. We evaluate trajectory recovery and force estimation through baseline comparisons and controlled ablations on held-out interactions from the Hoi! dataset. On this evaluation subset, VidForce achieves 6.6 cm ATE, peak-force MAE and RMSE of 4.81 N and 5.92 N, respectively, and force-profile RMSE of 5.52 N. On real-world videos, VidForce infers motion and force reliably and consistently despite the variability in human execution. We further deploy VidForce on a Spot robot, where trajectories and force profiles estimated from human demonstrations drive real-world articulated-object manipulation, and report success rates across repeated trials. Project page: https://rafaymhddn.github.io/vidforce

</details>


### [225] [CityRecast: Suppressing Persistent Artifacts in Generative Satellite 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32863)
*Shuo Cui,Yingyan Hou,Wanxuan Lu,Hongfeng Yu,Daobing Zhang,Xian Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CityRecast通过高斯场景修复与监督校准，抑制卫星三维重建中的鬼影、条纹和模糊伪影，尤其改善低仰角渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星三维重建受稀疏观测与多时相变化限制，现有基于生成先验的方法虽能补全缺失视觉细节，但在高斯场景中仍残留鬼影、条纹和模糊，低仰角渲染时尤为明显。

Method: 提出CityRecast，包含高斯场景修复与监督校准两部分：1）多角度预热约束高斯分布空间范围，减少注入渐进式精化的初始鬼影；2）表面引导替换在保留现有外观的同时继续修复高斯分布；3）观测校准缓解多时相观测干扰，提供更可靠监督；4）联合精化减少生成视角间的冲突。

Result: 在DFC2019与IARPA数据集上显著减少低仰角渲染伪影，同时保持卫星视角保真度；相比Skyfall-GS，FID-CLIP分别降低25.3%和51.8%，MUSIQ分别提升14.54和24.95分。

Conclusion: 通过显式的高斯分布修复与监督信号校准，可有效抑制卫星重建中的伪影并提升多视角渲染质量，为稀疏、多时相观测下的三维重建提供可行方案。

Abstract: Satellite-based 3D reconstruction is limited by sparse observations and changes across acquisition dates. Existing methods use generative priors to recover missing visual detail, but ghosting, streaking, and blur persist in their Gaussian scenes. These artifacts become particularly apparent in low-elevation renderings. We introduce CityRecast to suppress these artifacts through Gaussian scene repair and supervision calibration. To correct the Gaussian distributions that produce these artifacts, we first use multi-angle warm-up to constrain their spatial extent. This reduces the initial ghosting carried into progressive refinement. Surface-guided replacement then continues to repair the Gaussian distribution while preserving existing appearance. To provide more reliable supervision for this process, observation calibration mitigates interference from multi-temporal observations. Joint refinement further reduces conflicts among generated views. Experiments on DFC2019 and IARPA demonstrate reduced artifacts in low-elevation renderings while maintaining satellite-view fidelity. Compared with Skyfall-GS, CityRecast reduces FID-CLIP by 25.3% on DFC2019 and 51.8% on IARPA. MUSIQ increases by 14.54 and 24.95 points, respectively.

</details>


### [226] [SUPRA: Synthesizing Amyloid PET from MRI and Plasma Biomarkers with an Explicit Regional SUVR Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33061)
*Hanwen Li,Fadi Deek,Zhi Wei,Ruixiang Tang,Feng Liu,Bharat Biswal,Michal Schnaider Beeri,Auriel Willette,Chenxi Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SUPRA方法，用血浆生物标志物提供淀粉样蛋白信息、MRI提供图像质量，合成绝对SUVR值的淀粉样蛋白PET，在ADNI及另一独立队列上显著优于四个已发表模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 淀粉样蛋白PET可定量脑内Aβ（SUVR），但成本高、可及性差；结构MRI常规可得，血浆p-tau217等标志物日益实用。仅凭MRI合成淀粉样PET是病态问题（解剖结构几乎不含Aβ负荷信息），需引入血浆信息。

Method: SUPRA（SUVR先验引导的淀粉样合成）将任务分解：先用回归把血浆标志物组映射到区域SUVR水平，并绘制到受试者MRI分割上作为显式先验；再用3D网络在MRI引导下做残差修正；输出为绝对SUVR，模型亦可仅用p-tau217运行。

Result: ADNI队列（111测试对）：PSNR 23.4 dB，对比已发表模型最高20.7 dB；在复合皮层、早期累积区和纹状体与真实SUVR的秩相关0.56–0.67，对比最高0.24。第二认知正常队列（143测试对，其他血浆平台）：22.8 dB、0.32–0.61，对比最高21.4 dB与0.20；淀粉样阳性AUC 0.91与0.82，对比最高0.63。

Conclusion: 消融显示血浆提供淀粉样信息、网络提供图像质量；MRI结合血液检测可生成逼真且能跨脑区追踪Aβ负荷的合成淀粉样PET。

Abstract: Amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) quantifies brain amyloid-$β$ as a standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR), but is costly and not widely available. Structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is routine, and plasma biomarkers such as phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) are becoming practical. Synthesizing amyloid PET from MRI alone is ill-posed, because brain anatomy reveals little about amyloid burden. We present SUPRA (SUVR prior-guided amyloid synthesis), which divides this task between MRI and plasma biomarkers. A regression maps the plasma panel to regional SUVR levels, painted onto the subject's MRI segmentation as an explicit prior. A 3D network then adds a residual correction guided by MRI. The output is in absolute SUVR, and the model also runs on p-tau217 alone. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort (111 test pairs), SUPRA reaches a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 23.4 dB, against at most 20.7 dB for four published models, and rank correlations of 0.56 to 0.67 with true SUVR in the composite cortex, an early-accumulation region and the striatum, against at most 0.24. In a second, cognitively unimpaired cohort with other plasma platforms (143 test pairs), it reaches 22.8 dB and 0.32 to 0.61, against at most 21.4 dB and 0.20. Its area under the curve for amyloid positivity is 0.91 and 0.82, against at most 0.63. Ablations show that plasma supplies the amyloid information and the network the image quality. Combining MRI with a blood test yields synthetic amyloid PET that is realistic and tracks burden across regions.

</details>


### [227] [Spectrify: Framework for Hyperspectral Image Generation Using Computer Graphics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33042)
*Yasin Mamedov,Daniil Vladimirov,Sofiia Dorogova,Bakhtiyar Khalfin,Egor Ershov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Spectrify将3D场景数据集经逐波长路径追踪渲染为高光谱图像（HSI），并配套按材质标注的反射光谱库；仅用其合成HSI训练的高光谱重建网络在多数测试集上对未见真实数据集的泛化优于用最大真实HSI数据集训练的网络，且按材质（而非仅颜色）赋光谱可稳定提升迁移效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实HSI采集慢、成本高，最大数据集仅约1000幅；高层视觉可用3D渲染图像替代稀缺真实数据，但低层任务需要物理正确的光谱，要求场景中每种材质都有实测光谱。现有光谱渲染仅覆盖少量场景且多采用简化的成像模型，因此缺乏大规模、物理可信的HSI数据来源。

Method: 提出Spectrify框架：将3D场景数据集转换为HSI，并构建按材质标注的反射光谱库（由近距离高光谱数据集与分光光度计测量整理）。光谱随材质赋予：每个物体依其材质类别获得基于物理的光学模型与实测反射光谱或光学常数，每盏灯获得对应类型的发射光谱，天空使用建模的日光光谱；用Mitsuba 3对每个场景逐波长路径追踪完整光传输。

Result: 仅在本合成HSI上训练的高光谱重建网络，在大多数测试集上对未见真实数据集的泛化优于用最大真实HSI数据集训练的网络；以材质类别而非仅颜色赋光谱，在所有测试集上均提升迁移效果。由该HSI投影得到的RAW图像作为颜色恒常性训练数据，性能与现有合成RAW生成器相当。发布4500幅渲染HSI、Spectrify代码及材质标注反射光谱库。

Conclusion: 物理正确的光谱渲染合成的HSI可作为真实高光谱数据的有效替代，为高光谱重建与相机管线（如颜色恒常性）提供可扩展训练数据。

Abstract: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) record the full spectrum of light at every pixel, so projecting an HSI through a camera's spectral sensitivities gives that camera's RAW image, and one HSI can supply training data for hyperspectral reconstruction and camera-pipeline methods. Real HSIs, however, are slow and expensive to capture, and the largest datasets hold only about 1,000 images. High-level vision commonly replaces scarce real data with images rendered from 3D scenes. Low-level tasks, however, need physically correct spectra, which requires spectral rendering with a measured spectrum for every material in a scene, and existing spectral renderings cover only a handful of scenes, mostly with a simplified image formation model. We present Spectrify, a framework that converts 3D scene datasets into HSIs, together with a library of reflectance spectra labeled by material and compiled from close-range hyperspectral datasets and spectrophotometer measurements. In Spectrify, spectra follow the material: each object receives a physically based optical model and measured reflectance spectra or optical constants from its material category, each lamp an emission spectrum of its type and the sky a modeled daylight spectrum, and Mitsuba 3 path-traces the full light transport of each scene per wavelength. We show that a hyperspectral reconstruction network trained only on our synthetic HSIs generalizes to unseen real datasets better than networks trained on the largest real HSI datasets on most test sets, and that assigning spectra by material category instead of by color alone improves this transfer on every test set. RAW images projected from our HSIs are also useful training data for color constancy, performing on par with existing synthetic RAW generators. We release the 4,500 rendered HSIs, the code of Spectrify and its material-labeled reflectance library.

</details>


### [228] [GRAPE-Bench: When Vision Degrades, Does Video Reasoning Hold?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33020)
*Ce Zhang,Junyi He,Tianshi Ming,Jinxi He,Jianshu Zhang,Xiyuan Yang,Jianuo Zhu,Yicheng Tao,Xiyu Luo,Minghao Fu,Jiahui Zhu,Kehan Guo,Yunzhong Xiao,Jingyang Lin,Wei Chow,Lingdong Kong,Katia Sycara,Yaqi Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 GRAPE-Bench，联合评估视觉退化条件与问题难度下的视频推理能力，并展示合成数据微调与偏好引导对鲁棒性和行为控制的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多依赖模拟退化或高难度提问，无法反映模型在自然退化视频上的表现，也无法刻画安全驾驶等场景所需的简单判断能力。

Method: 构建 GRAPE-Bench：合成集覆盖日常生活与驾驶视频的12类退化；真实集为夜间及雨雪雾驾驶画面；每段视频配三道递进难度问题（从具安全含义的基础判断到高难度推理）。测试开放权重与前沿模型，并采用合成数据微调、clean-privileged on-policy 蒸馏、偏好引导（preference steering）。

Result: 发现合成与真实条件下模型排名出现反转，整体准确率掩盖了分难度层级的薄弱点；合成数据微调将 Qwen3.5-9B 真实场景准确率从 76.7% 提升至 81.1%，clean-privileged on-policy 蒸馏在另一推理设定下达 80.4%；偏好引导可在整体准确率基本不变时连续调节冻结模型在安全相关判断与高难推理间的权衡。

Conclusion: GRAPE-Bench 为退化视觉条件下视频推理的评估、改进与行为控制提供统一测试平台。

Abstract: Despite strong performance on standard benchmarks, video reasoning models remain vulnerable to visual degradation, raising concerns about their reliability in safety-critical scenarios. Existing benchmarks address this concern in part by simulating visual degradation or probing model reasoning with challenging questions, leaving open how well models handle naturally degraded video and whether they can make the simpler judgments that matter for safe driving. To this end, we introduce GRAPE-Bench, which jointly evaluates video reasoning across visual degradation conditions and question difficulty. It combines a synthetic set spanning twelve corruption types across daily-life and driving videos with real-world footage of driving at night or in rain, snow, or fog. Each video is paired with three progressively challenging questions, from fundamental judgments with potential safety implications to demanding reasoning stress tests. Across open-weight and frontier models, we observe ranking reversals between synthetic and real-world conditions and level-specific weaknesses obscured by overall accuracy. Synthetic-data fine-tuning improves Qwen3.5-9B's real-world accuracy from 76.7% to 81.1%, while clean-privileged on-policy distillation reaches 80.4% in a separate reasoning-enabled setting. Through preference steering, we further demonstrate continuous control over a frozen model's trade-off between safety-relevant judgments and challenging reasoning, with little change in overall accuracy. Together, GRAPE-Bench provides a unified testbed for evaluating, improving, and controlling video reasoning under degraded visual conditions.

</details>


### [229] [RePix-VFI: Re-rendering Observed Pixels for Video Frame Interpolation with Generative Priors from One-Step Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33016)
*Dayeon Kim,Jeonghyeok Do,Munchurl Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RePix-VFI：将“草稿条件单步视频扩散”与“观测关键帧像素重渲染”耦合的多帧视频插帧框架，兼顾中间运动准确性与纹理保真，并实现32–42×加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多帧VFI需在稀疏关键帧间重建稠密视频，时间跨度增大时：光流法能保留观测纹理但在运动歧义下错位；迭代潜空间扩散法能合成合理内容，但采样成本高，且VAE重建会改变细节。需要一种兼顾忠实外观与高效推理的方案。

Method: 1) 预训练视频扩散模型对整窗光流渲染草稿进行单次前向（一步）精修；2) 生成式回读：对每个目标帧，用光流估计器将其上下两个关键帧与生成预测对齐，得到对应关系；3) 在VAE之外，依据该对应关系重渲染原始关键帧RGB像素；4) 轻量外观融合头将重渲染结果与生成外观融合。

Result: 在SNU-FILM ×8/×16上取得最高PSNR与最低LPIPS、FloLPIPS、tOF；PSNR分别超过最佳扩散基线1.71 dB和1.48 dB；相比SOTA多帧VFI扩散模型快32–42×。

Conclusion: 以“观测像素重渲染”补偿扩散生成，可在保持真实纹理的同时显著降低采样开销，为大时间间隔多帧插帧提供高效高保真方案。

Abstract: Multi-frame video frame interpolation (VFI) aims to reconstruct dense video from sparse keyframes, requiring accurate intermediate motion and faithful appearance. As temporal gaps grow, flow-based methods can retain observed textures but misplace them under ambiguous motion, whereas iterative latent-diffusion models can synthesize plausible content but incur substantial sampling costs and may alter details during reconstruction with a variational autoencoder (VAE). We present RePix-VFI, named for Re-rendering observed Pixels, a multi-frame VFI framework that couples draft-conditioned one-step video diffusion with reconstruction from observed keyframes. A pretrained video diffusion model refines a flow-rendered draft of the whole window in a single forward pass. For each target frame, our generative readback matches its two bounding keyframes to the generated prediction using an optical-flow estimator. The resulting correspondences guide re-rendering of original keyframe RGB pixels outside the VAE. A lightweight appearance fusion head combines these renderings with generated appearance. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate significant improvements in reconstruction and perceptual quality. On SNU-FILM at $\times$8 and $\times$16, RePix-VFI achieves the highest PSNR and the lowest LPIPS, FloLPIPS, and tOF among the compared methods, exceeding the best evaluated diffusion-based baseline by 1.71 and 1.48dB in PSNR, respectively. It also runs 32--42$\times$ faster than the state-of-the-art multi-frame VFI diffusion model.

</details>


### [230] [Training Lightweight Gaze Models without Target Gaze Annotation: What Makes a Good Teacher?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33014)
*Scott J. Lewis,Di Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在注视目标估计任务中，用统一的受控实验比较11种监督条件，发现模型生成的标签可替代人工标注、表面能力强的大模型可能依赖复制坐标的捷径、且教师好坏可在训练学生之前通过验证标签误差预判。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轻量视觉模型训练需要大量标签，模型生成标签是可扩展方案，但"什么使一个模型成为好教师"以及"能否在学生训练前就判断"尚不清楚；交互机器人场景还要求模型既准确又高效。

Method: 在注视目标估计中做受控对比：仅改变注视点标签来源，固定学生模型、训练协议与361k训练样本，覆盖3个视频数据集、2种学生规模（ViT-Tiny、ViT-Small）、3个随机种子，共11种监督条件，全部以人工标注评估；并用"提示中给出他人脸部中心"的探测考察大模型是否走捷径。

Result: (1) 未经目标数据集注视标注训练的Gaze-LLE可训练出与人工标注训练相当的学生（ViT-Tiny持平），在ViT-Small上显著更优（平均距离误差0.187 vs 0.196），ViT-Tiny学生在笔记本CPU上比教师快32倍；(2) 提示中给出脸部中心时，InternVL3与Qwen3-VL分别在93.4%和81.1%样本上直接复述该坐标，复制坐标基线即可匹配InternVL3的标签与学生；去掉该坐标后二者远落后于专家模型；(3) 验证集标签误差可排序学生测试误差（Spearman ρ=0.91），仅10段标注视频在95%抽样中识别出两个专家教师。

Conclusion: 提出三条实用原则：评估监督质量时应先排除捷径式"伪能力"，可用小规模验证标注在学生训练前筛选教师，且强专家模型生成的标签可作为轻量模型的可扩展监督来源。

Abstract: Model-generated labels offer a scalable route to training lightweight vision models, but what makes a model a good teacher, and can we tell before training a student? We study this in gaze target estimation, where interactive robots need models that are both accurate and efficient. In a controlled comparison of eleven supervision conditions, we vary only the source of gaze-point labels, keeping the student, training protocol and 361k training samples fixed, across three video datasets, two student sizes and three seeds; every student is evaluated against human annotation. Three findings emerge. First, imperfect model-generated labels can replace human annotation: Gaze-LLE, never trained on the target datasets' gaze annotation, trains students that match annotation-trained ones on ViT-Tiny and are significantly more accurate on ViT-Small (average distance error 0.187 vs 0.196), and the ViT-Tiny student runs 32$\times$ faster than its teacher on a laptop CPU. Second, apparent competence can conceal unreliable supervision: given another person's face centre in the prompt, InternVL3 and Qwen3-VL return it on 93.4% and 81.1% of test samples, and a copy-the-coordinate baseline matches InternVL3's labels and students. Without that coordinate, both models fall far behind the specialist. Third, good teachers can be identified before training: validation label error ranks student test error (Spearman's $ρ= 0.91$), and ten annotated clips single out the two specialist teachers in 95% of draws. These findings give practical principles for assessing supervision, exposing shortcuts and selecting teachers for lightweight models.

</details>


### [231] [One, No One and One Hundred Thousand CTs: Testing Anatomical Control in Text-to-CT Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33003)
*Francesca Pia Panaccione,Eugenio Lomurno,Matteo Matteucci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CtrlCT评测工具包，从可信性（Credibility）与可控性（Control）两个维度统一评估Text-to-CT生成器，并配套Report Card汇总指标；在五个公开生成器上发现"最可信者几乎不响应报告编辑、最响应者生成质量与多样性较差"的权衡，而既有文献分析无法揭示该现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Text-to-CT生成器（基于CT数据集与配对报告）的评测在预处理与指标上各行其是，难以横向比较；且评测协议几乎从不检验"编辑报告是否按预期改变CT"（即便固定随机种子也未做），导致"报告控制解剖结构"这一假设缺乏证据支撑，控制的程度与一致性未知。

Method: 提出CtrlCT工具包，检验生成器的两种属性：(1) Credibility——将生成CT作为群体与真实CT及报告比较；(2) Control——采用蜕变测试（metamorphic testing），无需参考CT：固定种子时，编辑某一征象应产生所请求的改变、被否定的征象应保持缺失、远处解剖的变化不应超过换用新种子带来的变化，且该改变应跨种子稳定保持。最终以Report Card汇总各生成器的全部指标与洞见。在940例胸部CT与687条胸腔积液、心影增大编辑上对五个公开生成器进行基准测试，并留出第六个用于检验工具包本身。

Result: 最可信的生成器对"新增胸腔积液"几乎无响应；响应性最强的生成器所产CT的真实性与多样性较差。二者存在明显权衡，而文献中已有的分析并未揭示这一点。

Conclusion: Text-to-CT评测需同时关注可信性与可控性；CtrlCT提供了可复现、可比对的统一协议与Report Card。录用后将公开CtrlCT、编辑数据、随机种子及30,525张合成CT。

Abstract: Recent advances in deep learning and the public availability of computed tomography (CT) datasets with paired reports have enabled many Text-to-CT generators. However, their evaluations almost always differ in preprocessing and metrics, which hinders comparison. Moreover, their protocols almost never test how editing the report changes the CT, not even at the same seed, so the report is often assumed to control the anatomy without evidence of how much and how consistently it does. We therefore propose CtrlCT, a toolkit that tests two properties of a generator, Credibility and Control. Credibility tests compare generated CTs, as a population, with real CTs and reports; Control tests are metamorphic and need no reference CT: at a fixed seed, editing one finding should change it as requested, keep negated findings absent and shift distant anatomy no more than a new seed, and the change should hold across seeds. A Report Card summarises all measures and insights for each generator. We benchmark five public generators on 940 chest CTs and 687 edits of pleural effusion and cardiomegaly, holding out a sixth to test the toolkit. Among them, the most credible generators barely respond to an added effusion, while the most responsive produce less realistic and less diverse CTs. The analyses proposed in the literature do not reveal this. We release CtrlCT, its edits, seeds and 30,525 synthetic CTs after acceptance.

</details>


### [232] [PAVE: Preference-Aligned Visual Egocentric Learning for the Blind and Low-Vision Users](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32996)
*Nan Li,Shaofeng Liang,Shiyun Zhao,Keni Shi,Zhencheng Huang,Bowen Tian,Jiemin Wu,Wenshuo Chen,Kaishen Yuan,Runwei Guan,Yutao Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PA-EgoQA偏好对齐数据集与PAVE框架（结构化答案策略微调+问题条件路由+Filter-GRPO），使第一视角视频问答响应符合BLV用户的实际辅助需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有第一视角视频问答基准与模型仅优化与参考答案的语义一致性，把视觉辅助退化为纯事实匹配；而事实正确但缺乏空间方位、可操作细节或简洁性的回答对BLV用户实际无用。

Method: 基于EgoBlind的真实BLV第一视角视频与真实用户查询构建PA-EgoQA偏好对齐数据集，按实证BLV交流准则重构参考答案；提出PAVE统一学习与推理框架，将结构化答案策略微调与确定性的问题条件路由相结合，在推理时按查询表层形式适配回答表述；并用Filter-GRPO对齐，采用分层正确性-质量奖励与基于对比的候选组过滤，从事实正确性对比和正确答案间细粒度质量差异中提取学习信号。

Result: 在三个视觉-语言骨干网络上进行大量实验，事实准确性一致提升，辅助回答质量显著增益。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了将人本响应需求转化为第一视角监督信号、生成策略与后训练目标的具体范式。

Abstract: Egocentric video question answering enables blind and low-vision (BLV) users to query their immediate surroundings through natural language. However, existing benchmarks and models primarily optimize for semantic agreement with reference answers, reducing visual assistance to a purely factual matching task. In real-world scenarios, a factually correct response remains practically unhelpful if it lacks the spatial orientation, actionable detail, or conciseness required by the immediate task of the user. Drawing upon real BLV egocentric videos and authentic user queries from EgoBlind, we construct the PA-EgoQA, a preference-aligned dataset that reconstructs reference answers according to empirical BLV communication criteria. Based on this dataset, we introduce Preference-Aligned Visual Egocentric Learning (PAVE), a unified learning and inference framework that couples structured answer-policy fine-tuning with deterministic question-conditioned routing to adapt response formulation directly to the surface form of the query at inference time. We further align the model via Filter-GRPO, which pairs a hierarchical correctness-quality reward with contrast-based candidate-group filtering to extract learning signals from both factual accuracy contrasts and fine-grained quality variations among correct answers. Extensive experiments across three vision-language backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in factual accuracy alongside substantial gains in assistive response quality. These results establish a concrete paradigm for translating human-centered response requirements into egocentric supervision, generation policies, and post-training objectives. Code will be provided at https://github.com/shawnliang420/PAVE.

</details>


### [233] [Decision-Native Multimodal Clinical Modeling via Anatomical Grounding and Confidence Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32993)
*Juntao Jiang,Wenqi Zhong,Guangyu Guo,Dexia Chen,Yilong Hu,Yunhao Bai,Zhenyu Yi,Jianwei Xu,Tony C. W. Mok,Muxuan Gao,Ling Zhang,Yong Liu,Jiangning Zhang,Zhongwei Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Radev 是决策原生的 3D 医学多模态模型，通过解剖引导的视觉压缩、直接候选预测与反事实校准训练，实现准确的临床决策与置信度校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 体数据 CT 的结构化临床决策需要解剖学上有依据的预测和校准的置信度，但现有 3D 医学多模态模型存在自回归解码未校准、依赖无关解剖区域的捷径两大缺陷。

Method: (1) 冻结 3D 编码器提取可复用的器官级特征，由查询动态选择，在预测的解剖边界内关注 2D 切片特征，压缩为紧凑视觉 token；(2) 语言主干单次前向直接估计候选概率，无需自回归解码；(3) 提出反事实校准训练（CCT），比较完整与干预器官表示下的预测：去除目标器官证据致决策质量下降时应降低置信度，去除无关器官时惩罚过度置信下降；(4) 构建 CT-Verdict 基准，覆盖二元征象、多选问答与序数严重度评估，含分布内与外部队列。

Result: Radev 在决策准确率与置信度校准上显著优于 SOTA，并在分布偏移下保持稳健泛化。

Conclusion: 解剖引导压缩 + 直接候选预测 + 反事实置信监督可有效缓解 3D 医学多模态模型的校准不良与捷径依赖问题；配套的 CT-Verdict 基准为严格评估提供支撑。

Abstract: Structured clinical decisions from volumetric computed tomography (CT) require anatomically grounded predictions and calibrated confidence estimates. However, existing 3D medical multimodal models often suffer from uncalibrated autoregressive decoding and shortcut reliance on irrelevant anatomical regions. We introduce Radev, a decision-native multimodal model that integrates anatomy-guided visual compression, direct candidate prediction, and counterfactual confidence supervision. To bridge global context with fine-grained slice details, a frozen 3D encoder extracts reusable organ-level features, which are dynamically selected by the query to attend to 2D slice features within predicted anatomical bounds. The resulting compact visual tokens enable the language backbone to estimate candidate probabilities in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding. We further propose Counterfactual-Calibrated Training (CCT) to compare predictions under intact and intervened organ representations. CCT encourages confidence to decrease when removing target-organ evidence degrades decision quality, while penalizing excessive confidence drops under unrelated-organ removal. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we construct CT-Verdict, a comprehensive benchmark spanning binary finding presence, multiple-choice questions, and ordinal severity assessment across both in-distribution and external cohorts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Radev significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both decision accuracy and confidence calibration, while generalizing robustly under distribution shifts. Project page at https://juntaojianggavin.github.io/projects/Radev/

</details>


### [234] [SHARPnP: Self-Supervised and Plug-and-Play Hyperspectral Super-Resolution from Real Noisy Unaligned Camera Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33032)
*Mohamad Jouni,Brayan Monroy,Jorge Bacca,Mauro Dalla Mura*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SHARPnP：无需干净参考、可解释的配准-重建耦合框架，实现噪声与失配条件下的RGB引导高光谱超分辨。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 快照高光谱相机单次曝光成像但空间分辨率低、噪声大；低成本RGB相机可提供精细可见光细节引导NIR重建，却带来空间变化的跨相机失配。现有监督融合方法依赖大规模干净高分辨高光谱数据、对噪声敏感、跨传感器泛化差。

Method: 提出SHARPnP框架：通过固定即插即用融合模块反向传播的跨视角损失微调预训练配准模型；利用时间对与重损坏对在噪声输入上实现无参考自监督；测试时校准跨相机辐射度量并精化对齐；融合采用序贯三波段去噪的即插即用策略。

Result: 在REAL基准上，干净输入下4×、8×、16×均优于监督融合基线，高斯噪声(σ=5/255、10/255)下4×亦领先；在原生RGB-HSI快照测量上重建全部51个VIS-NIR波段（超出常规31波段VIS设定），且无需高分辨参考。

Conclusion: 配准与重建耦合、免参考自监督的即插即用设计可在噪声、失配、无干净标签条件下实现灵活可解释的高光谱超分辨，并拓展至全谱段重建与跨传感器泛化。

Abstract: Affordable snapshot hyperspectral cameras capture spectral images in a single exposure but suffer from limited spatial resolution and sensor noise. Low-cost RGB cameras provide fine visible details to guide NIR reconstruction, but introduce spatially varying cross-camera misalignment. Supervised fusion methods require relatively large datasets of clean, high-resolution hyperspectral images, are sensitive to sensor noise, and generalize poorly across new sensors. We introduce SHARPnP, an interpretable, flexible framework coupling registration and reconstruction for RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution from noisy, unaligned measurements without clean references. We adapt a pretrained registration model via a cross-view loss backpropagated through a fixed plug-and-play fusion module. Temporal and recorrupted pairs enable reference-free self-supervision on noisy inputs. At test time, we calibrate cross-camera radiometry and refine alignment. Plug-and-play fusion employs sequential three-band denoising. On the REAL benchmark, SHARPnP outperforms supervised fusion baselines at $4\times$, $8\times$, and $16\times$ on clean inputs and at $4\times$ under Gaussian noise ($σ=5/255, 10/255$). On native RGB-HSI snapshot measurements, it reconstructs all 51 VIS-NIR bands, beyond the conventional 31-band VIS setting, without high-resolution references.

</details>


### [235] [DOPER: Deep Object Pose Estimation Revisited](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32846)
*Hugo Hadfield,Alperen Degirmenci,Jonathan Tremblay*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DOPER 是一个 RGB 6D 位姿估计框架，通过共享视觉骨干联合检测、分割与关键点预测，并经 PnP 求解位姿，在多个数据集上达到实时 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅用 RGB、无需深度与学习式位姿精化器的前提下，实现已知物体 6D 位姿估计，并解决合成训练到真实观测的域差距、模糊关键点对应以及欠完备 CAD 模型的问题。

Method: 共享骨干同时输出检测、分割和关键点；以合成训练为基础，利用部分监督与标定多视图几何约束进行真实域自适应，同时保留合成关键点标签；推理时可选热图精化，将刚性位姿直接拟合到预测的关键点分布以消解对应歧义；并从欠完备 CAD 出发迭代精化物体表示与位姿估计器。

Result: 在 HANDAL、HOPEv2、HOT3D、T-LESS 的单视图与多视图配置上取得检测 AP 的 SOTA；SPEED+ 与 SHIRT 上验证了对光照变化的有效适应及准确时序位姿估计；单模型单 GPU（GB300）实时运行 35 Hz。

Conclusion: 联合学习检测与位姿关键点、结合真实观测与几何约束，是提升纯 RGB 6D 位姿估计性能的有效途径。

Abstract: We present DOPER, an RGB pose estimation framework that shares a visual backbone across object detection, segmentation, and keypoint prediction to recover the 6D pose of known objects through Perspective-n-Point. Starting from synthetic training, DOPER adapts to real observations using partial supervision while retaining synthetic keypoint labels. Calibrated multi-view observations provide geometric constraints for keypoint supervision. During inference, optional heatmap refinement fits a rigid pose directly to the predicted keypoint distributions, resolving ambiguous correspondences without depth input or a learned pose refiner. Starting from underspecified CAD models, DOPER progressively refines the object representation and pose estimator. Results on SPEED+ and SHIRT further demonstrate effective adaptation to illumination changes and accurate temporal pose estimation. Across the evaluated single-view and multi-view configurations, DOPER achieves state-of-the-art detection AP results on HANDAL, HOPEv2, HOT3D, and T-LESS while using only RGB and running in real time (35 Hz per object model on one GB300). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly learning detection and pose keypoints, with real observations and geometric constraints.

</details>


### [236] [Reliable and grounded reporting of any computed tomography scan with FORA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32823)
*Sezgin Er,Utku Turkbey,Alperen Gur,Omer Faruk Durugol,Suprosanna Shit,Murong Xu,Julia Wolleb,Jiayi Wang,Xiaoliang Wang,Hadrien Reynaud,Teodora Spasojevic,Dong Yang,Andriy Myronenko,Pengfei Guo,Yufan He,Can Zhao,Marc Edgar,Andreas Maier,Michael Moor,Mehmet Kemal Ozdemir,Daguang Xu,Bernhard Kainz,Bjoern Menze,Ibrahim Ethem Hamamci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FORA是一个通用CT基础模型，可识别并空间定位1,028个层级化放射学概念，覆盖28种CT协议，无需病灶级标注即可实现异常识别、定位与报告生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CT人工智能系统多局限于特定解剖区域、检查类型或预定义异常，难以提供全面且具空间依据的解释，缺乏跨协议的通用性。

Method: 基于304,962例常规CT检查及其配套报告的弱监督训练，采用多示例学习结合可解释概念瓶颈（concept bottleneck）架构，将空间证据、放射学发现与报告生成串联；先在胸片上验证架构，再训练独立的3D CT模型。

Result: 在36,619例留出CT上，概念识别macro-AUROC达0.918，超18个现有CT模型中最强者0.21；在三个公开基准排名第一，跨机构优于Merlin（0.907 vs 0.826）；在肺栓塞、肾肿块、肋骨骨折定位基准中，最强空间证据落于标注病灶内的比率最高达随机水平的348倍；报告生成的macro平均发现召回率超最强现有生成器三倍以上。

Conclusion: 单一模型可在12类CT检查中统一实现广谱异常识别、空间定位与报告生成，且仅依赖常规报告而无需病灶级监督，展示了通用CT基础模型的可行性。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence systems for computed tomography (CT) remain largely restricted to specific anatomical regions, examination types or predefined abnormalities, limiting their ability to provide comprehensive and spatially grounded interpretations. Here we present FORA, a general-purpose CT model that recognizes and spatially localizes 1,028 hierarchically organized radiological concepts and generates reports across the 28 CT protocols represented in our cohort. Trained on 304,962 routine CT examinations supervised by their accompanying reports, FORA learns to localize abnormalities without manually annotated lesions. Its architecture combines multiple-instance learning with an interpretable concept bottleneck that connects spatial evidence, radiological findings and report generation. We first developed and benchmarked the architecture on chest radiographs, achieving state-of-the-art performance, before training a separate model on three-dimensional CT examinations. On 36,619 held-out CT examinations, FORA achieved a macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.918 for radiological concept recognition, exceeding the strongest of 18 existing CT models by 0.21. FORA also ranked first on three public benchmarks, outperforming Merlin on its own test set without training on that institution's data (AUROC 0.907 versus 0.826). On independent localization benchmarks for pulmonary emboli, renal masses and rib fractures, FORA's strongest spatial evidence fell within annotated lesions at rates up to 348 times greater than chance. FORA achieved more than threefold higher macro-averaged finding recall than the strongest existing report generator. These results show that a single model can combine broad abnormality recognition, spatial localization and report generation across 12 CT examination types, using routine reports without lesion-level supervision.

</details>


### [237] [BioLoom: Scaling Biomedical Vision-Language Models by Learning from the Structure of Scientific Articles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33151)
*Yuwei Yang,Xiaoxiao Sun,Alejandro Lozano,Yuan-Sen Ting,Yuhui Yuan,Liang Zheng,Serena Yeung-Levy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出利用科学文献自身的结构关系（图、子图、caption、正文段落）作为额外监督信号构建对比学习图像-文本对，构建了Loom52M数据集并训练出BioLoom模型，在零样本分类和检索任务上显著超越现有生物医学VLM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生物医学视觉-语言模型主要依赖扩大图文数据规模来提升性能，但将图、子图、caption与正文视为独立图文对，忽略了它们之间的结构关系，浪费了文献中蕴含的丰富跨模态监督信息。作者假设文献结构本身可作为补充监督来源。

Method: 将文献结构关系融入对比图文监督：保留精确图文匹配的同时，为相关对（如子图与其兄弟子图的caption）引入较弱正样本监督；对同内容类型的跨文章负样本加权以增强细粒度判别；利用视觉内容、原始figure caption和提及段落丰富子图描述。最终将子图与丰富描述配对、整图与原始caption配对，构建Loom52M数据集（5240万图文对，涵盖科学图表与生物医学图像），训练BioLoom（DFN-2B）。

Result: BioLoom在43个数据集、10个领域的67个零样本分类任务上取得56.82%的领域平衡平均准确率，高于MedPMC-CLIP的48.77%；在BioLoomBench和BioMedFlickr上双向平均Recall@1分别为63.20%和10.59%，对应最强基线BiomedCLIP和MedPMC-CLIP分别为46.37%和7.55%。

Conclusion: 除规模扩展外，利用科学文献结构关系作为监督可显著提升生物医学VLM的表征质量，在零样本分类与检索任务上均取得一致且大幅的性能提升，并开源了代码、数据、基准与模型。

Abstract: The development of biomedical vision-language models (VLMs) with contrastive image-text pretraining has been driven by scaling to increasingly large and diverse image-text datasets. Beyond scaling, further progress can come from learning richer representations from existing data. We hypothesize that the structure of scientific literature itself provides an additional source of supervision: figures, panels, captions, and accompanying article text encode rich relationships across modalities. Yet, treating these as independent image-text pairs overlooks their relationships. To address this limitation, we incorporate these structural relationships into contrastive image-text supervision. We preserve exact image-text matches while introducing weaker positive supervision for related pairs, such as a panel and the caption of a sibling panel. We upweight cross-article negatives of the same content type to encourage finer discrimination. We also enrich panel descriptions using visual content, original figure captions, and mentioning paragraphs. Pairing panels with these descriptions and whole figures with their original captions yields Loom52M, a dataset of 52.4 million image-text pairs spanning scientific charts and biomedical images. Using Loom52M, BioLoom (DFN-2B) achieves 56.82% domain-balanced mean accuracy across 67 zero-shot classification tasks from 43 datasets in 10 domains, compared with 48.77% for MedPMC-CLIP. On BioLoomBench with concise captions and BioMedFlickr, it achieves bidirectional mean Recall@1 of 63.20% and 10.59%, versus 46.37% and 7.55% for the respective strongest evaluated baselines, BiomedCLIP and MedPMC-CLIP. Code, datasets, benchmarks, and models are available at https://bioloom-clip.github.io/.

</details>


### [238] [The Radar-based Activities of Daily Living (R-ADL) Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33088)
*Dominique Regli,Brian C. Williams*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 R-ADL 数据集：包含一名受试者在两室两卫公寓中5个不同位置执行8类高层日常活动（ADL）的超过8小时标注雷达记录，并给出数据集构建指导（ADL优先级分析、采集与标注策略、后处理流程）及标准机器学习架构的基线结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于雷达的居家日常活动（ADL）监测可在保护隐私的同时克服其他传感模态的技术局限，但受限于大规模标注数据稀缺；现有数据集存在规模小、房间配置单一、多停留在原子动作层面等问题。

Method: 1) 综合学术研究、健康调查工具与临床试验分析ADL的优先次序，筛选具临床意义的ADL；2) 在5个采集位置、8类活动上采集超过8小时标注数据；3) 制定实验设计、数据采集与标注策略及从原始数据到R-ADL的后处理流水线；4) 在标准机器学习架构上建立基线。

Result: 构建了超过8小时、8类活动、5个采集位置的标注雷达数据集，并给出标准机器学习架构上的基线识别结果。

Conclusion: R-ADL为ADL识别系统研究提供了有价值的资源，并为未来更大规模、更多样化ADL数据集的构建提供实践指导。

Abstract: Monitoring Activities of Daily Living (ADLs) supports safety and well-being for people living at home, especially older adults, and radar sensing is gaining increasing attention in the field of activity recognition for its ability to ensure privacy in the home while also surpassing technical limitations of other sensing modalities. However, radar-based activity recognition remains constrained by the limited availability of large-scale datasets. We introduce the Radar-based Activities of Daily Living (R-ADL) dataset to addresses the gaps identified in existing work: 1) it expands the scale of available data by providing over eight hours of annotated recordings in which a person performs eight distinct activities; 2) it overcomes room configuration limitations by recording from five different locations in a two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment; and 3) it extends beyond primitive actions to focus on high-level ADLs. In addition to the dataset, this paper introduces practical guidance for future ADL dataset construction. We conducted a detailed analysis of how ADLs are prioritized across academic research, health survey tools, and clinical trials to identify clinically significant ADLs. Furthermore, we provide our experimental design, data collection and annotation strategies, post-processing pipeline for forming the R-ADL dataset from raw data, and baseline results on standard machine learning architectures. The R-ADL dataset serves as a valuable resource for advancing ADL recognition systems as we continue building larger and more diverse datasets.

</details>


### [239] [Linear Probes Can Guide: Training-Free Control of Representation Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33037)
*Pengwei Wang,José Morano,Botond Fazekas,Hrvoje Bogunović*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出语义均值空间（Semantic Mean-Space）概念，将表示空间生成模型上的语义引导转化为贝叶斯线性逆问题，并提出统一框架 LiSM 及新求解器 Fit-Path，实现轻量、无需训练条件的全局与局部可控生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练视觉基础模型（VFM）此前主要被用于加速训练和提升样本保真度，但其高度组织化、线性可读的表示空间未被充分利用。作者观察到该特性可消除后验引导（post-hoc guidance）的关键障碍，从而避免训练时条件化（training-time conditioning）的开销。

Method: 基于期望线性性，证明对理想去噪器预测施加干净探针（probe）可在任意噪声水平得到探针分数的精确后验均值，从而将语义引导形式化为贝叶斯线性逆问题；据此提出统一框架 LiSM，开发并适配多种求解器，按“探针空间不确定性估计”与“校正信息在表示中的传播方式”进行刻画；并设计兼顾全局与局部控制的 Fit-Path 求解器。

Result: 在四类控制设定（类别、属性、前景、关键点）上，LiSM 系列方法（尤以 Fit-Path 为代表）在全局与局部任务上均实现有效且轻量的控制，优于噪声感知引导与像素空间引导方法。

Conclusion: VFM 表示空间的组织性使后验语义引导可归结为线性逆问题，无需训练时条件化；LiSM 提供了统一、通用且轻量的可控生成范式，Fit-Path 在全局与局部控制上表现突出。

Abstract: Representation-space generative models, such as Representation Autoencoders (RAEs), leverage pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) primarily to accelerate training and improve sample fidelity. Yet VFMs are more than reconstruction tokenizers, as they feature rich representation spaces that are highly organized and linearly readable. We observe that this removes a key obstacle of post-hoc guidance: by linearity of expectation, a clean probe applied to an ideal denoiser's prediction yields the exact posterior mean of the probe scores at any noise level. This regime, which we call Semantic Mean-Space, turns semantic guidance into a Bayesian linear inverse problem, bypassing the need for training-time conditioning. With this foundation, we propose LiSM, a unified framework for Linear Guidance in Semantic Mean-Space. To validate the framework, we developed and adapted different solvers, and characterized them based on how they estimate probe-space uncertainty and propagate the correction through the representation. In addition, we propose Fit-Path, a solver designed to achieve strong global and local control. Our results in four control setups (class, attributes, foreground, and keypoints) show that LiSM methods, and Fit-Path in particular, provide effective, lightweight control across global and local tasks, outperforming noise-aware and pixel-space guidance.

</details>


### [240] [HARI4D: Hand-Articulation Aware 4D Reconstruction of Human-Object Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32932)
*Semin Kim,Xianghui Xie,Chuqiao Li,Jongyoo Kim,Gerard Pons-Moll*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HARI4D: 从单目RGB视频重建手部关节感知的4D人体-物体交互


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RGB单目下的4D人体-物体交互重建困难，尤其涉及关节化手部；已有全身重建方法忽略手部，导致手穿透物体或悬浮于物体外。

Method: 历史感知的物体跟踪器提供稳定跟踪；基于轨迹做由粗到细的交互配置推理：ReachNet在接触阶段将全身与手臂对齐到物体，TouchNet再依据时序上下文与局部物体几何精化手部关节。

Result: 在训练未见过的ARCTIC数据集上，物体误差降低56%，手部接触F1由0.866提升至0.921。

Conclusion: 方法可恢复准确的全身体-物体交互与一致的手部关节，并适用于在线视频；代码与预训练模型将公开。

Abstract: Reasoning about human-object interaction from RGB cameras is important for gaming, VR environments, and robot learning. Yet 4D reconstruction from a monocular RGB camera is challenging, especially when articulated hands are involved. Prior full-body works neglect hands during reconstruction, causing them to penetrate into, or float from the object. We present HARI4D, a hand-articulation-aware method for reconstructing spatially and temporally consistent 4D human-object interaction from monocular RGB video. We introduce a history-aware object tracker that provides robust and stable tracking. Based on these tracks, we improve the interaction configuration through coarse-to-fine reasoning that follows the order of object manipulation: ReachNet first brings the full body and arms to the object during contact, and TouchNet then finalizes hand articulation according to temporal context and local object geometry. On ARCTIC, unseen in training, our method reduces the object error by 56% and improves hand contact F1 from 0.866 to 0.921 over prior art. Our method recovers accurate full body-object interaction with coherent hand articulations and applies to online videos. Our code and pretrained models will be released.

</details>


### [241] [FocusAnchor: Zero-Shot Metric Depth by Anchoring a Depth Foundation Prior to Focus Cues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32970)
*Ashkan Ganj,Hang Su,Tian Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FocusAnchor：一种循环模型，通过焦点体查找（focus-volume lookups）反复对齐冻结基础模型的相对深度先验与当前深度估计，形成反馈回路，将纹理区域恢复的度量尺度传播到焦点线索弱的区域，并配合带独立逐切片噪声的随机化合成与可变堆栈训练，实现跨相机泛化与少切片鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 depth-from-focus 方法在焦点线索弱、新相机、焦平面切片较少时性能退化；同时跨相机迁移需合成训练堆栈，但合成会引入伪深度线索。

Method: 循环式反馈框架：用焦点体查找精化度量深度，并迭代对齐冻结基础模型输出的相对深度先验；对齐后的先验引导后续精化。为跨相机迁移，合成时随机化相机参数与对焦距离；针对堆栈合成对不同切片的噪声模糊不一致所产生的伪线索，加入独立逐切片噪声抑制；并提出可变堆栈训练以提升少切片鲁棒性（FocusAnchor-flex）。

Result: 相比 FOSSA ViT-B，微调后 AbsRel 在 NYU Depth V2 降低 36%，在 DDFF-12 降低 9%；零样本评测中 FocusAnchor 与 FocusAnchor-flex 在全部五个基准上取得最低的两个 AbsRel；ZEDD 测试上 AbsRel 比最佳竞品 FOSSA ViT-B 低 9%，FocusAnchor-flex 在 ZEDD 验证集上用少 40% 焦平面切片即获得更低 AbsRel。

Conclusion: 将相对深度先验与焦点线索以循环反馈方式融合，并辅以噪声抑制的合成数据与可变堆栈训练，可显著提升 DFF 度量深度的精度、跨相机迁移性与少切片实用性。

Abstract: Existing depth-from-focus methods can struggle with weak focus cues, new cameras, or fewer focal slices. We present FocusAnchor, a recurrent model that uses focus-volume lookups to refine metric depth and repeatedly aligns a relative depth prior from a frozen foundation model to the current depth estimate. The aligned prior guides subsequent refinement in a feedback loop, carrying metric scale recovered from textured regions into regions where focus cues are weak while preserving scene structure. To support transfer across cameras, we synthesize training stacks with randomized camera parameters and focus distances. However, stack synthesis blurs existing image noise differently across slices, creating artificial depth cues even on textureless surfaces. We add independent per-slice noise to suppress these cues. We also introduce variable-stack training to improve robustness with fewer focal slices and support more practical mobile capture. Compared with FOSSA ViT-B, FocusAnchor reduces AbsRel by 36% on NYU Depth V2 and by 9% on DDFF-12 after fine-tuning. In zero-shot evaluation, FocusAnchor and its variable-stack variant, FocusAnchor-flex, achieve the two lowest AbsRel values on all five benchmarks. On ZEDD test, FocusAnchor achieves 9% lower AbsRel than the best competing method, FOSSA ViT-B, while FocusAnchor-flex achieves lower AbsRel with 40% fewer focal slices on ZEDD validation.

</details>


### [242] [OmniHarness-RSI: Modality-Aware Harness Evolution for Omnimodal Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32951)
*Shilin Ma,Xingming Shui,Jinglin Chen,Zetong Zhao,Jingqi Tian,Deyi Zhu,Yansong Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 OmniHarness-RSI，将 harness 递归自我改进扩展到全模态理解，通过三维修能力分解与模态引导演化，在三个基准上分别提升 8.86/8.13/6.23 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 harness 的递归自我改进（RSI）在不更新基座模型参数的前提下演化可执行 agent 工作流，已提升视频理解性能；但迁移到全模态理解时，多模态感知与推理的异构性和相互依赖导致演化空间复杂、难以进行有针对性的 harness 优化。

Method: 将演化空间分解为三个能力维度：模态路由与协作、模态感知的证据定位、模态特定感知；据此构建 Factorized-Harness Agent，集成专门化感知专家与音视频检索工具；引入模态引导的 harness 演化，通过结构化的模态—能力归因定位缺陷，并借助交互式代码修改与执行反馈精炼 harness 策略；采用验证集引导的选择与留出评估衡量数据集内及跨数据集的泛化能力。

Result: 在 WorldSense、Daily-Omni、OmniVideoBench 上测试准确率分别提升 8.86、8.13、6.23 个百分点，稳定优于模态无关的 RSI；演化后的 harness 无需适配即可跨数据集迁移，同时减少 planner 调用次数与查看帧数。

Conclusion: 模态感知的因子化演化空间能有效支撑全模态 agent harness 的定向优化，在性能、泛化性与推理效率上均优于模态无关的 RSI 基线。

Abstract: Recent advances in harness-based recursive self-improvement (RSI) have improved video understanding by evolving executable agent workflows without updating foundation model parameters. However, extending this paradigm to omnimodal understanding remains challenging, as the heterogeneous and interdependent nature of multimodal perception and reasoning creates a complex evolution space, making targeted harness optimization difficult. To address these challenges, we propose OmniHarness-RSI, a modality-aware framework for evolving agent harnesses. Specifically, we factorize the evolution space into three capability dimensions: modality routing and collaboration, modality-aware evidence localization, and modality-specific perception. Based on this factorization, we construct a Factorized-Harness Agent integrating specialized perception experts and audio-video retrieval tools. We further introduce modality-guided harness evolution, which identifies deficiencies through structured modality-capability attribution and refines corresponding harness strategies through interactive code revisions and execution feedback. Validation-guided selection and held-out evaluation assess generalization within and across datasets. Experiments on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, and OmniVideoBench demonstrate test accuracy improvements of 8.86, 8.13, and 6.23 percentage points, respectively, consistently outperforming modality-agnostic RSI. The evolved harnesses also demonstrate cross-dataset transfer without adaptation, while reducing planner calls and viewed frames.

</details>


### [243] [Aqua2CAD : Observation-Guided Point Cloud Correction and Completion for CAD Reconstruction from Underwater Stereo Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32835)
*Weizhao Huang,Jiayi Zhang,Pangkit Fong,Chongrong Fang,Jianping He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Aqua2CAD 利用水下立体图像的跨视角信息，两阶段修正并补全点云，进而拟合出可编辑 CAD 模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下立体重建得到的点云存在位置偏移与缺失区域，而点云融合过程中丢失了原始视图间的跨视角分歧与光线证据，导致难以恢复准确、完整且可编辑的 CAD 几何。

Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段通过视角条件修正与质量过滤建立可靠几何支撑；第二阶段以多视角观测为条件驱动学习到的形状先验，在原始度量坐标系下推断缺失表面；随后进行表面拟合与实体装配，并人工修订面分组。

Result: 在基于 OceanSim 的合成基准上，点云 Chamfer 距离较原始立体重建降低 60%；相比匹配的纯点云补全骨干，5 mm 缺失区域恢复率由 16.27% 提升至 24.16%；共享 CAD 后端下外部验收由 6/19 提升至 14/19；真实水下采集上成功恢复六个 3D 打印对象的主体结构。

Conclusion: 保留并利用原始视图证据可显著提升水下立体重建的几何精度与完整性，并支撑从图像到可编辑 CAD 模型的完整流程。

Abstract: Recovering editable computer-aided design (CAD) models from underwater stereo images requires accurate and complete geometry, yet stereo reconstruction produces displaced points and missing regions. The original views retain cross-view disagreement and ray evidence lost during point-cloud fusion. Aqua2CAD exploits this evidence in two stages: view-conditioned correction and quality filtering establish reliable geometric support, while multi-view observations condition a learned shape prior to infer missing surfaces in the original metric frame. The recovered points support surface fitting and solid assembly with manually revised face groups. On an OceanSim-based synthetic benchmark, Aqua2CAD reduces point-cloud Chamfer distance by 60% relative to the stereo reconstruction. Compared with a matched point-only completion backbone, it improves missing-region recovery at 5,mm from 16.27% to 24.16%. With a shared CAD backend, exterior acceptance increases from 6/19 to 14/19. Qualitative results on selected real underwater captures demonstrate recovery of the main structures of six 3D-printed objects.

</details>


### [244] [EEG-World: Context-Conditioned Dynamics of the Watching Brain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32825)
*Junxiang Zhang,Jiayu Zuo,Wenhao Ye,Junfeng Xia,Xiang Chen,Mo Wang,Quanying Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出EEG-World——一种递归世界模型，利用6秒历史EEG和随后的视听刺激预测未来10秒的EEG频带功率动态，并在大规模数据上验证了非线性递归预测优于线性基线、且具备跨被试迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
