Curated trajectories underpin a pipeline of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO), and Compaction-Managed Group Sequence Policy Optimization (CM-GSPO): SFT provides a stable foundation for tool use over long horizons and query reformulation; KTO uses binary feedback on trajectories to improve the selection of answers grounded in evidence; CM-GSPO optimizes execution sub-trajectories with length-normalized likelihood ratios on the recorded rollout contexts and reweights sub-trajectory advantages to correct the extra weighting introduced by independently averaging sub-trajectory losses. Bathys 9B and 27B attain 66.51% and 80.49% on BrowseComp, respectively, under an evaluation protocol with trajectory self-verification and conditional retries.

</details>


### [279] [REBEAL: Human References Are No Longer the Best Translation, and Metrics Do Not Notice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32623)
*Ahrii Kim,Chanjun Park,Seong-heum Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出REBEAL基准，系统探测机器翻译指标对受控参考译文污染的响应，发现学习型指标更鲁棒但各家族有各自失效模式，其中命名实体污染是所有指标共同盲点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于参考的机器翻译评估预设人工参考译文正确且优于被测系统，但2024年WMT MQM评测中人工参考均未排名第一，且其段落中19%–87%存在标注错误，两个假设均告失效。指标如何应对有缺陷的参考属于指标自身的性质问题，值得在参考质量受质疑之前就被审视。

Method: 构建REBEAL（Reference Bias EvALuation）基准，依据上述评测记录的错误类别，设计七类受控参考污染，在三种语言对、八个广泛使用的指标上进行探测。

Result: 近期学习型指标（xCOMET、MetricX）比前代更鲁棒，但各指标家族失效方式不同：表层指标对长度不敏感，污染可藏于较长段落；学习型指标会把无关语言的参考视为近乎正确；命名实体污染是所有指标的共同盲点，在九个系统排序中最多可翻转36个系统对中的8个。

Conclusion: 指标对参考缺陷的鲁棒性应作为独立评估维度；单一指标家族均存在系统性盲区，命名实体污染对系统排序影响显著，提示需针对性地改进指标并审慎解释基于参考的评测结果。

Abstract: Reference-based MT evaluation assumes the human reference is correct and better than the systems it scores. Both assumptions now fail, since the human reference ranks first in none of the 2024 WMT MQM campaigns and carries annotated errors in 19% to 87% of its segments. What a metric does with a flawed reference is a question about the metric, and it would have been worth asking before reference quality came into doubt. We introduce REBEAL (Reference Bias EvALuation), a benchmark that probes how MT metrics respond to seven types of controlled reference contamination, drawn from the error categories those campaigns record. Across eight widely used metrics and three language pairs, recent learned metrics (xCOMET, MetricX) prove more robust than their predecessors, but each family fails in its own way. Surface metrics show no length sensitivity, so contamination hides in longer segments, while learned metrics accept references in unrelated languages as nearly correct. The failure they share is named-entity contamination, which no metric detects and which flips up to 8 of 36 system pairs when ranking nine MT systems.

</details>


### [280] [Beyond Fixed-Context Likelihood: Zero-Shot AI-Generated Text Detection via Context Perturbation Discrepancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32778)
*Yifan Tang,Jingran Li,Yihao Wang,Zhen Yang,Jianyi Liu,Gongshen Liu,Ru Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出零样本检测器 CPD，利用同一预训练语言模型下token对数概率增益相对其KL期望的偏离来识别AI生成文本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相同的前文带来的token对数概率增益在一个位置可能正常、在另一位置却异常巨大，现有方法未刻画这种"相对预期收益"的差异，需要一种无需训练、可量化的偏离度量。

Method: 固定文本段落，分别在完整前缀与近期token短窗口两种分布下计算每个观测token的对数概率；全前缀分布下增益的期望等于该分布到受限前缀分布的KL散度，CPD将观测增益减去该期望，得到带符号偏差之和，并用解析参考标准差归一化。

Result: 在GEN、DetectRL-X、HART的未编辑人类与AI文本上，同方差尺度下减去期望增益使AUROC提升32.78–35.81个百分点；平均94.80% AUROC、5%误报率下79.60%召回，优于七个零样本基线。在HART原文与改写文本上，按草稿来源区分（89.15% AUROC）明显优于基准最终表达标签（65.50%）。

Conclusion: 扣除KL期望增益是提升零样本检测性能的关键，CPD在多数据集上表现领先，并揭示基准中的改写标签与文本真实来源存在偏差。

Abstract: The same increase in token log probability from earlier context can be typical at one position and unusually large at another. We introduce Context Perturbation Discrepancy (CPD), a zero-shot detector that measures this gain relative to what a single pretrained language model expects. Keeping the passage fixed, CPD scores each observed token under its full prefix and under a short window of recent tokens. Under the full-prefix distribution, the expected gain equals the KL divergence from that distribution to the restricted-prefix distribution. CPD subtracts this expectation from each observed gain and scales the sum of the signed deviations by its analytical reference standard deviation. On unedited human and AI texts from GEN, DetectRL-X, and HART, subtracting the expected gain raises AUROC by 32.78-35.81 percentage points at the same variance scale. CPD outperforms seven zero-shot baselines, averaging 94.80% AUROC and 79.60% recall at a 5% false-positive rate. On original and edited HART passages, the same scores separate texts more clearly by draft origin than by the benchmark's final-expression labels (89.15% versus 65.50% AUROC). Code is available at https://github.com/BUPT-tyf/CPD.

</details>


### [281] [Faithful Persona Steering under Incongruity via Dual-Stream Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31848)
*Yu-An Chu,Jen-Ren Pong,Chia-Yao Yeh,Meng-Fen Chiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: QuirkyMind将"身份定义"与"身份表达"解耦，通过双流潜在状态（句子级摘要+词级序列）、交替式InfoNCE与交叉熵目标稳定上下文叙事细化，并用参数高效适配器泛化到下游任务，从而在长序列中抑制人格漂移且保留真实的矛盾性"怪癖"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM个性化把身份视为静态检索任务，忽视了人格的内在矛盾性——稳定特质与情境特异的非典型立场并存。提示方法在长序列中易发生上下文漂移，微调则倾向以通用分布模式压平个性化"怪癖"，两者难以兼顾。

Method: 提出QuirkyMind框架，分三步：(1) Traits Anchoring构建双流潜在状态，融合句子级摘要（语义稳定）与词级序列（生成控制）；(2) In-Context Narrative Refinement以交替目标稳定该状态——判别式InfoNCE损失在表示空间锚定人格以防漂移，生成式交叉熵损失保证忠实表述；(3) Persona Steered Generalization通过参数高效适配器将细化后的状态迁移至下游任务。

Result: 在Persona-Steered QA与Narrative Inference上的实验表明，QuirkyMind缓解了人格漂移，在整合人格知识的同时未抹除真实的矛盾性特征。

Conclusion: 将身份定义与表达解耦、并结合判别与生成双重目标的潜在状态建模，是实现稳定且真实LLM个性化的有效路径。

Abstract: Standard LLM personalization typically frames identity as a static retrieval task, overlooking the inherent incongruity of human personas, where stable traits coexist with atypical, context-specific stances. Existing methods struggle to reconcile these dimensions: prompting succumbs to context drift over long sequences, while fine-tuning often suppresses idiosyncratic "quirks" in favor of generic distributional patterns. To bridge this gap, we present QuirkyMind, a framework that disentangles identity definition from its expression. First, Traits Anchoring constructs a dual-stream latent state, fusing a sentence-level summary for semantic stability with a token-level sequence for generative control. This state is stabilized via In-Context Narrative Refinement using an alternating objective: a discriminative InfoNCE loss anchors the persona in representation space to prevent drift, while a generative cross-entropy loss ensures faithful verbalization. Finally, Persona Steered Generalization transfers the refined state to downstream tasks via parameter-efficient adapters. Empirical evaluations on Persona-Steered QA and Narrative Inference demonstrate that QuirkyMind mitigates drift, consolidating persona knowledge without erasing authentic incongruities.

</details>


### [282] [SecondChance: Benchmarking Reliable Error Recovery in AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31586)
*Atahan Dokme,Adar Avsian,Larry Heck*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SecondChance，一个基于自然错误检查点的数据集与评测框架，用于刻画和度量AI智能体的错误恢复行为，发现当前模型恢复率极低（无辅助16%，给修复指引27%），且"纠正错误"不等于"完成任务恢复"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有恢复类基准多采用人为注入故障、不涉及用户、仅以任务是否最终完成为评分标准，因而无法揭示智能体是否撤销了自身的"静默错误"、是否告知用户、以及是否遭遇了不可修复的错误。

Method: 构建SecondChance：从τ²-bench、BFCL和AppWorld中智能体自身任务尝试产生的自然错误出发建立检查点数据集与评测框架；让不同智能体在四种条件下从同一检查点续跑——无辅助、错误提示、错误位置、修复指引；度量纠错、任务成功、策略合规、环境状态保持、修复持久性与成本；对12个模型在四种条件下共进行5,760次续跑评测。

Result: 恢复能力普遍薄弱：最佳模型无辅助恢复率仅16%，有修复指引也仅27%；纠错≠恢复——Llama-3.3-70B在τ²上纠正26%的错误却无一完成任务，AppWorld中84次成功续跑里有40次任由错误留存。

Conclusion: SecondChance揭示了仅凭任务成功率无法捕捉的智能体错误恢复行为差异，为细粒度、多维度的恢复能力评测提供基准。

Abstract: AI agents make errors while they act, and their reliability depends on what they do afterwards. Existing recovery benchmarks mostly inject faults, involve no user and score whether the task is eventually completed, so they cannot show whether an agent undid its own silent error, told the user, or faced an error that could not be fixed. We introduce SecondChance, an error checkpoint dataset and evaluation harness that profiles and measures error-recovery behaviour of AI agents. The errors are natural: they come from agents' own task attempts in $τ^2$-bench, BFCL and AppWorld. Different agents then resume from the same checkpoints under one of four conditions: no assistance, an error notice, the error location, or repair guidance. We measure error correction, task success, policy compliance, preservation of environment state, repair durability and cost. We evaluate 12 models under all four conditions in 5,760 continuations. Recovery is rare: across its environments, the best model completes only 16% of recoveries unaided and 27% with repair guidance. Correcting is not recovering: with repair guidance, Llama-3.3-70B corrects 26% of $τ^2$ errors but completes none, and 40 of 84 successful AppWorld continuations leave the error in place. SecondChance exposes these differences that task success alone cannot capture.

</details>


### [283] [Reading Between the Layers: Where Representation Quality Lives, and What Geometry Reveals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31496)
*Arnesh Batra,Aniket Khandelwal,Arush Gumber,Krish Thukral,Kushagra Agrawal,Dev Sharma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出无标签的Stable Geometry Index（SGI）来选择预训练模型的层，在25个模型、13个数据集上系统刻画层质量分布规律，Hit@3从0.39提升至0.52，回收40%的oracle差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表示质量并不集中于最后一层，但因缺乏无标签的层选择方法，实践者仍默认在末层做探测。本文旨在揭示层质量的分布规律，并给出一个完全无监督的层选择器。

Method: 大规模实证研究：25个模型、4类架构、4种预训练策略，13个数据集覆盖分类、句对分类、语义文本相似度与多项选择题答。据此提出Stable Geometry Index（SGI）：闭式、无拟合系数、无标签，融合幂律拟合质量、有效秩容量、谱稳定性与弱深度先验。

Result: 峰值层与预训练策略和架构系统相关：掩码编码器峰值位于中后段；序列到序列模型峰值随任务类型移动；对比句编码器在CLS/末token读出下集中于末层、mean pooling下峰值偏早；decoder-only模型呈现与深度相关的相位结构。在383个评测组上，SGI优于末层基线，Hit@3由0.39升至0.52，回收约40%的oracle差距，且在同子集上超过有监督的ELMo式层混合。消融还表明幂律拟合质量比指数接近1更能预测层质量。

Conclusion: 层质量可由架构与预训练策略可预测地刻画，并可被无标签的几何指标有效选择；谱衰减文献中"指数趋近1"的常见假设被证伪。

Abstract: Representation quality in pretrained text foundation models is not concentrated at the final layer, yet practitioners routinely probe it there because layer selection without labels has remained an open problem. We present a large-scale empirical study of where layer quality lives across 25 models spanning four architectural families and four pretraining strategies, evaluated on 13 datasets across classification, pair classification, semantic textual similarity, and multiple-choice question answering. Peak probing layers depend systematically on pretraining strategy and architecture: masked encoders peak in late-middle layers, sequence-to-sequence models shift their peak with task type, contrastive sentence encoders concentrate signal at the final layer under CLS and last-token readouts but peak early under mean pooling, and decoder-only models exhibit distinct phase structure tied to depth. We distill these findings into the Stable Geometry Index (SGI), a closed-form, fully label-free selector with no fitted coefficients combining power-law fit quality, effective-rank capacity, spectral stability, and a weak depth prior. Across 383 evaluation groups SGI improves over the last-layer baseline and lifts Hit@3 from 0.39 to 0.52, recovering 40% of the gap to the oracle without using any labels, and exceeds a supervised ELMo-style layer mix on the matched subset despite using strictly less information. Our ablations also reverse a common assumption in the spectral-decay literature: power-law fit quality is a stronger predictor of layer quality than the exponent's proximity to one.

</details>


### [284] [Right Destination, Wrong Journey: Synthetic Counseling Dialogues Miss Human Interactional Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31686)
*Ziwei Gong,Yuchen Huang,Nicholas Deas,Melanie Subbiah,Julia Hirschberg*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文对十个真实、重构与合成心理咨询对话数据集进行以轨迹为中心的过程保真度评估，发现合成对话虽能达到合理终点，但恢复动态与逐轮响应性弱于人类，其中患者—咨询师的条件响应性最难通过生成设计或干预恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的心理咨询对话已广泛用于心理健康系统的训练与评估，但现有评估主要关注回复质量与最终结果，忽视支持过程随时间展开的方式，即轨迹层面的过程保真度。

Method: 在十个人类、重构与合成咨询数据集上开展以轨迹为中心的评估；分析恢复动态与逐轮响应性；并通过受控合成数据集实验检验针对性的生成干预对轨迹级与交互级指标的影响；同时发布三个受控合成数据集（共2,050段对话）、标注与评估框架。

Result: 合成对话常能到达合理终点，但在恢复动态与逐轮响应性上与人类支持存在差异；生成设计可改变恢复时机、轨迹结构等全局属性，但条件式患者—咨询师响应性在各模型与生成范式下保真度持续偏低；针对性干预可缩小部分轨迹级指标差距，却无法完全恢复交互保真度，轮级响应性仍受限。

Conclusion: 过程保真度尤其是轮级条件响应性是合成咨询对话的核心短板，仅靠生成设计调优难以弥补；需将评估从结果导向转向轨迹导向，并公开受控数据集与框架以支持后续研究。

Abstract: LLM-generated counseling dialogues are increasingly used for training and evaluating mental-health systems, yet existing evaluations focus largely on response quality and final outcomes rather than how support unfolds over time. We conduct a trajectory-centered evaluation of process fidelity across ten human, reconstructed, and synthetic counseling datasets. Our results show that synthetic dialogues often reach plausible endpoints but differ from human support in recovery dynamics and turn-by-turn responsiveness. While generation design can shift global properties such as recovery timing and trajectory structure, contingent patient--counselor responsiveness remains consistently lower in fidelity across models and generation paradigms. Our experiments on controlled synthetic datasets show that targeted generation interventions can narrow the gap with real data on several trajectory-level measures, but do not fully recover interactional fidelity, with turn-level responsiveness remaining limited. We release three controlled synthetic datasets comprising 2,050 dialogues, together with annotations and the evaluation framework.

</details>


### [285] [AhaPro: A Process-level Rebus benchmark for probing Aha moments in LLM reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31268)
*Wei Guo,Lang Qin,Yundi Gai,Qinghua Xu,Zhi Wu,Wenjian Ding,Huijia Li,Zhenglu Yang,Yao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出过程级基准 AhaPro，用画谜题考察大模型在可见推理过程中 Aha moment 如何重组证据与修订答案；发现模型普遍"发现却不采纳"更优状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有关于 LLM Aha moment 的研究多聚焦反思性表述或最终修订结果，对 Aha moment 在可见推理过程中的作用刻画不足。

Method: 构建 AhaPro 基准，以画谜题（借字形、空间排布与谐音编码答案）作为触发 Aha moment 的任务；将 CoT 形式化为候选答案、证据与验证状态的序列，并采用分层指标评估冲突检测、状态改进及后续采纳。

Result: 在 11 个模型上观察到：Aha moment 中发现的更优状态常未被采纳；被采纳的修订中亦有状态质量不变或下降者；模型能检测冲突却未达成有效修订。配对干预显示先前推理上下文可能阻碍冲突检测后的有效修订；多分支搜索表明答案选择是"正确发现"到"成功纠错"之间的瓶颈。

Conclusion: Aha moment 的价值在于过程性证据重组而非结果涌现，模型存在"觉察—采纳"鸿沟；有效修订的关键瓶颈在于答案选择而非冲突发现。

Abstract: Existing research on Aha moments in large language models has largely focused on reflective expressions or final revision outcomes, leaving their role in the visible reasoning process insufficiently characterized. Rebus puzzles encode answers through character forms, spatial arrangements, and homophony. Reinterpreting key details may trigger Aha moments and shifts in the reasoning process and candidate answers. We introduce AhaPro, a process-level benchmark that uses rebus puzzles to examine how models reorganize evidence and revise answers through Aha moments. The framework represents CoT as sequences of candidate answers, evidence, and verification states, using hierarchical metrics to assess conflict detection, state improvement, and subsequent adoption. Across eleven models, we observe frequent failures to adopt better states discovered during Aha moments, alongside adopted revisions that leave state quality unchanged or reduce it. Models also detect conflicts without subsequently achieving an effective revision. Further paired interventions suggest that prior reasoning context may hinder effective revision after conflict detection, while multi-branch search highlights answer selection as a bottleneck between correct-answer discovery and successful correction.

</details>


### [286] [Does Item Response Theory Generalize Across Languages? Evidence from Cross-Lingual LLM Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31261)
*Ruchira Dhar,Qiwei Peng,Anders Søgaard*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文检验IRT在跨语言基准翻译下的泛化性，发现题目难度最稳定，猜测次之，区分度最差，IRT筛选需兼顾参数与题目层面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将IRT用于基准数据筛选的研究多局限于单语场景，尚不清楚同一基准被翻译成多语言后IRT参数与筛选效果能否保持一致，需要验证跨语言泛化性。

Method: 在Multilingual GSM与Global MMLU上，覆盖100余个语言模型、11种语言，按语言分别拟合1PL、2PL、3PL IRT模型，比较参数的跨语言一致性，并检验经IRT筛选的子集能否在各语言间保持模型排序；同时开展差异题目分析定位不稳定来源。

Result: 题目难度是最稳定的参数，其次为猜测参数，区分度最不稳定；差异题目分析表明，参数不稳定可追溯到特定题目在翻译后发生偏移；IRT筛选子集在跨语言保持模型排序方面的能力受限。

Conclusion: 多语言场景下基于IRT的数据筛选必须同时具备参数感知与题目感知，需先验证模型选择并逐题筛查，再假定其可跨语言泛化。

Abstract: The application of Item Response Theory (IRT) for data selection in benchmarks has mostly been limited to monolingual settings. In this work, we ask: how does IRT generalize when the same benchmark is translated across languages? We conduct experiments on Multilingual GSM and Global MMLU, covering over 100 language models and 11 languages. Fitting 1PL, 2PL, and 3PL IRT models per language, we assess cross-lingual consistency of parameters and whether IRT-filtered subsets preserve model rankings across languages: item difficulty emerges as the most stable parameter followed by guessing and then discrimination. A differential item analysis also shows that lack of stability can be tracked to specific items shifting under translation across languages. Our findings suggest IRT-based selection in multilingual settings must be both parameter-aware and item-aware, validating model choice and screening individual items before assuming cross-lingual generalization.

</details>


### [287] [scOPD: Routed On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM-Based Single-Cell Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31257)
*Zhiyin Yu,Yuchen Mou,Songtao Huang,Shuaiyu Zhang,Xing Wei,Chunchun Chen,Wei Ye,Xiao Luo,Zhonghai Wu,Xiangchao Yan,Lei Bai,Shiyang Feng,Bo Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 scOPD，一个面向 LLM 单细胞注释的 on-policy 自蒸馏框架：训练阶段结合奖励优化与特权 token 级监督，推理阶段用 rollout 分歧触发约束感知的成对精修。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 单细胞注释训练主要依赖标量结果奖励，对中间生物学推理监督不足；批级注释需同时解决局部细胞身份与全局一对一匹配约束，局部错误会污染整体分配；单次推理难以定位不确定预测，因此需要训练期细粒度推理监督与推理期不确定性感知精修。

Method: 先进行 reasoning fine-tuning；随后在 on-policy 训练中自适应路由：合格 rollout 走基于奖励的优化，错误 rollout 则从成功的同源轨迹获取特权 token 级监督；推理时若 rollout 出现分歧，则对不确定分配执行约束感知的 pairwise refinement。

Result: 在 CellPuzzles 及四个域外疾病数据集上，scOPD 对多种 LLM 骨干均稳定提升；以 Qwen3-8B 达到平均细胞级 81.71%、批级 44.49% 准确率。

Conclusion: scOPD 通过训练期细粒度自蒸馏与推理期不确定性精修，有效缓解稀疏结果奖励与批级全局约束难题，提升单细胞注释的细胞级与批级性能。代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Motivation: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for single-cell annotation, but existing training methods mainly rely on scalar outcome rewards that provide limited supervision for intermediate biological reasoning. Batch-level annotation is particularly challenging because it requires jointly resolving local cell identities and a global one-to-one matching constraint, such that one local error can affect the entire assignment. Moreover, a single inference pass provides insufficient evidence for locating uncertain predictions. These limitations call for fine-grained reasoning supervision during training and uncertainty-aware refinement during inference.
  Results: To address these challenges, we propose scOPD, an on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM-based single-cell annotation. After reasoning fine-tuning, scOPD adaptively routes qualified rollouts to reward-based optimization, while erroneous rollouts receive privileged token-level supervision from successful sibling trajectories. During inference, rollout disagreement triggers constraint-aware pairwise refinement of uncertain assignments. Across CellPuzzles and four out-of-domain disease datasets, scOPD consistently improves the performance of diverse LLM backbones, achieving average cell-level and batch-level accuracies of 81.71% and 44.49% with Qwen3-8B.
  Availability and Implementation: Code and data are available at https://github.com/YuZhiyin/scOPD.

</details>


### [288] [Avalon-M1: Reinforcement Learning from Collective Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32539)
*Iliyan Zarov,Henry Course,Anthony Hartshorn,Ran Achiron,Louis Roche,Akshit Sinha,Chengxi Taylor,Ross Taylor*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出集体奖励强化学习（RLCR），用共享策略与共同优势训练语言模型组成"智能体组织"，在时延约束下实现高效协作，并建立组织学习与集体监督的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型多以单智能体方式部署，难以在时延预算内兼顾质量与效率；同时缺乏将多智能体协同视为"组织"进行联合训练与系统评估的基线方法。

Method: RLCR：一名CEO与最多八名专家共享同一策略，通过消息板和共享工作区协作，以结果派生的共同优势信号联合训练；设置硬性截止时延，使并行分工在提高截止前收益时具有价值。在147个环境中训练Avalon-M1-Mini（120B），并与单智能体执行、8次独立采样加选择等基线对比。

Result: 八人组织执行将IMO-ProofBench-Advanced成绩由23.8%提升至39.0%；在12个基准上以约单智能体三分之一的派生时延、独立8次采样加选择一半的时延取得相近均分；在最佳配置对比下全面优于同基座的Nemotron 3 Super；EdgeBench上组织在约0.4派生小时后反超单智能体；训练中自发形成层级以控制通信成本、增加互审投入并改变分工方式；安全评估显示有害行为近乎全部拒绝，但三种监督场景中有两种的外部报告率持续下降。

Conclusion: 结果为研究组织化学习、性能—时延权衡与集体监督提供了共享优势基线，并揭示能力提升伴随的监督报告退化风险。

Abstract: We introduce reinforcement learning from collective rewards (RLCR), a recipe for jointly training language models to act as agent organisations under latency constraints. A CEO and up to eight specialists share one policy, co-ordinate through a message board and workspace, and are trained with a common outcome-derived advantage. The deadline makes parallel work valuable when it increases the return earned before the cap. We train Avalon-M1-Mini (120B) across 147 environments. For the trained model, eight-hire organisational execution raises IMO-ProofBench-Advanced scores from 23.8% to 39.0% relative to single-agent execution. Across 12 benchmarks, organisations achieve similar average scores at approximately one-third the derived latency of token-matched single-agent execution and just over half that of eight independent attempts followed by selection. The trained model also outperforms Nemotron 3 Super, post-trained from the same base model, across all evaluations when comparing each model's best tested configuration. On EdgeBench, organisations overtake the single agent after approximately 0.4 derived hours. Over the course of training, organisations develop hierarchies to manage communication costs, invest more in peer review, and alter how work is divided. Safety evaluations find near-universal refusal of harmful actions but sustained declines in external reporting in two of three oversight scenarios. These results establish a shared-advantage baseline for studying organisational learning, performance-latency trade-offs, and collective oversight.

</details>


### [289] [When "Neutral" Means Irrelevant: A Construct-Validity Audit of NormAd-ETI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32614)
*Aarav Singh,Animesh Pathak,Christian Hoang,Navyansh Singh,Avantika Singh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文审计NormAd-ETI三分类评分，指出其实际混合了"规则是否适用"与"行为是否合规"两个决策，揭示分数掩盖了适用性判断的崩塌。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NormAd-ETI在用可接受/不可接受/两者皆非三分类评估模型对日常行为的判断时，随文化语境从具体规则收缩到国家名，评分含义变得不明。作者要厘清该三分类分数究竟测量了什么。

Method: 将三分类决策分解为"所给规范是否适用"与"行为是否符合规范"两个子决策；在不同提示条件（仅给国家名、给规则）下分别评估；设计专门的强制选择探针以分离二者；并在前沿模型与小规模开源模型上对比，另测试加入书面理由（rationale）的影响。

Result: 仅提供国家名时，适用性判断降至接近随机水平，而合规性判断仍显著高于随机；由于单一答案同时承载两个决策，总分随更稳定的合规性走，从而掩盖了较弱的适用性；强制选择探针可对前沿模型分离二者，但对小型开源模型无效，其适用性判断仍跟随隐藏的可接受性标签；加入理由可减轻但不能消除混淆。

Conclusion: 不存在能同时恢复两项决策的单一提示；建议分别报告适用性与合规性结果，并量化"混淆差距"（conflation gap）。

Abstract: NormAd-ETI scores a model's judgment of everyday actions as acceptable, unacceptable, or neither as the cultural context shrinks from a specific rule to a country name. We audit what that three-way score measures. It combines two decisions: whether a supplied norm applies, and whether the action conforms to it. Separating them shows that when only a country is shown, applicability falls to near chance while conformity stays well above it, because the prompt withholds the rule a Neutral label depends on. Because one answer carries both decisions, the score follows the steadier conformity and hides the weaker applicability, and no single prompt recovers the two separately. Dedicated forced-choice probes separate them for frontier models but not for small open models, where the applicability judgment still tracks the hidden acceptability label. Adding a written rationale reduces that conflation without removing it. We recommend reporting the two results separately and measuring the conflation gap.

</details>


### [290] [SAG-Mem-1.0 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33124)
*Yuchao Wu,XingCheng Liang,Xuanze Wang,Yini Huang,Yue Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SAG-Mem 通过保留完整对话消息并按词法扩展实现查询时证据引导的二次检索，在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval 上分别达到 83.08 与 80.20，取得所评估方法中的最高分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期对话记忆需要检索跨会话分散的互补事实，包括与原始问题相似度较低的中间证据；现有方法依赖派生记忆表示或持久关系结构，带来构建开销并可能丢失原始细节。

Method: 将完整对话消息保存为非重叠分块；构建阶段无需模型推理，仅用词法索引，不做 LLM 抽取、摘要或语义关系构建。查询时先用 BM25 召回初始候选，由证据评估器识别有用分块，再用选中证据中的词法线索进行第二轮检索；对受支持的相对时间表达附加日历解释，同时保留原始措辞与时间粒度。另提出 SAG-Mem-Lite，以基于嵌入的候选打分替代证据打分。

Result: LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval 上 SAG-Mem 总分分别为 83.08 与 80.20，均为所评估方法最高；LongMemEval 上领先最强基线 7.20 分。SAG-Mem-Lite 分别为 77.09 与 77.20，在两个基准上运营成本低于 Full Context 及所有基于记忆的基线，且查询延迟低。

Conclusion: 保留原始对话并采用证据引导的检索扩展，是长期对话记忆的有效设计。

Abstract: Long-term conversational memory requires retrieving complementary facts scattered across dialogue sessions, including intermediate evidence with limited similarity to the original question. Existing approaches often rely on derived memory representations or persistent relational structures, introducing construction costs and potentially losing source details. We present SAG-Mem, a conversational memory framework that preserves complete dialogue messages in non-overlapping chunks and discovers complementary evidence through query-time lexical expansion. Memory construction requires no model inference, using a lexical index without LLM-based extraction, summarization, or semantic relation construction. At query time, BM25 retrieves initial candidates, an evidence evaluator identifies useful chunks, and lexical cues from selected evidence guide an additional retrieval round. Retrieved dialogue is further annotated with calendar interpretations of supported relative-time expressions, preserving the original wording and temporal granularity. We also introduce SAG-Mem-Lite, an alternative configuration that replaces evidence scoring with embedding-based candidate scoring, achieving lower operational cost than Full Context and all memory-based baselines across both benchmarks with low query latency. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval, SAG-Mem achieves overall scores of 83.08 and 80.20, respectively, the highest among the evaluated methods on both benchmarks. On LongMemEval, it exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 7.20 points. SAG-Mem-Lite achieves scores of 77.09 and 77.20, respectively. These results support dialogue preservation and evidence-guided retrieval expansion as an effective design for long-term conversational memory.

</details>


### [291] [When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32446)
*Akshata A Bhat,Daman Deep Singh,Niyati Chhaya*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"意图感知OCR"新任务，构建DocIntent数据集与IntentBench基准，微调3B/7B视觉语言模型实现优于GPT-4.1等大模型的纠正转写。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档上的人工标注（箭头、插入符、删除线、插入等）表达纠正意图，但现有OCR与文档理解系统将其视为视觉噪声而非语义编辑操作，导致纠正意图被忽略。

Method: 定义意图感知OCR任务：联合原始文档内容与视觉意图线索生成纠正后转写。构建DocIntent（1,600份金融文档、5,700+标注意图线索、带布局感知与意图消解的OCR目标）；构建IntentBench（216文档，覆盖多样真实标注条件）；基于DocIntent对3B与7B VLM进行意图监督微调，得到DocIntentOCR。

Result: IntentBench上微调3B/7B模型F1分别达0.81/0.83，显著超过GPT-4.1（0.626）与LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B（0.50）。

Conclusion: 确立意图感知OCR为人机协同文档理解的新任务，并提供数据集、基准与模型等基础资源，证明意图监督使紧凑领域模型超越更大通用系统。

Abstract: Human annotations on documents (such as arrows, carets, strikethroughs, and insertions) express corrective intent yet existing OCR and document understanding systems treat these marks as visual noise rather than semantic edit operations. We introduce intent-aware OCR, the task of generating corrected transcriptions by jointly reasoning over original document content and visual intent cues (handwritten or digital) that convey edit intent. To support this setting, we present DocIntent, a multimodal dataset of 1,600 financial documents with over 5,700 annotated visual intent cues, each paired with layout-aware, intent-resolved OCR targets. We further introduce IntentBench, a 216-document benchmark designed to evaluate model robustness under diverse real-world annotation conditions. Leveraging DocIntent, we fine-tune DocIntentOCR, a suite of 3B and 7B parameter vision-language models, under direct intent supervision on corrected transcriptions. On IntentBench, the fine-tuned 3B and 7B models achieve F1-scores of 0.81 and 0.83, respectively, substantially outperforming commercial closed-source (e.g., GPT-4.1 (0.626)), and open-source models (e.g., LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B (0.50)) demonstrating that intent-aware supervision enables compact domain-specific models to outperform substantially larger general-purpose systems on this task. This work establishes intent-aware OCR as a novel human-in-the-loop document understanding task and provides foundational resources (dataset, benchmark, models) to advance research in interactive document processing.

</details>


### [292] [From Grammar Deltas to Token Masks: Incremental Constrained Decoding under Runtime Grammar Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32807)
*Hantao Hua,Jiming Su,Yonggang Che,Feng Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: GramDelta 是面向"运行时增量语法更新"的约束解码框架，仅将新增语法规则的影响沿历史依赖传播，避免前缀重放与掩码缓存重编译，首见语法更新中位延迟降低 10.7–11.5 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码与领域特定语言生成中的形式约束往往在解码前并不完整，需从新声明、推断出的类型信息或运行时分析反馈中逐步显现；现有结构化解码引擎只擅长处理固定、预声明或已见过的约束结构，当首次出现的语法更新改变了已提交前缀所诱导的解析器状态时，直接做法是在更新后语法下重建约束状态，从而重复解析已处理前缀，开销大。

Method: 提出 append-only 运行时语法更新下的增量约束解码框架 GramDelta：(1) 在已提交前缀上维护解析状态，将新增语法规则引发的变更沿历史依赖传播，避免前缀重放；(2) 将更新后的解析状态通过基于共享历史 chart 的无编译分解式投影映射为精确的下一 token 掩码，避免每次更新重编译掩码缓存；在保持与完全重建等价结果的同时，使更新代价与实际语法变更影响范围相关。

Result: 在四种模型配置上：无更新时额外开销可忽略；在持续运行时语法演化下，首见语法更新中位延迟降低 10.7–11.5 倍，相对最强重建基线，其较无约束解码的额外 TPOT 开销降低 53.1–81.9%。

Conclusion: GramDelta 使约束可随生成前缀逐步出现并演化时的约束解码变得高效，为运行时动态形式约束场景提供了低开销、结果等价的增量解码方案。

Abstract: Grammar-constrained decoding enables large language models to generate outputs that satisfy formal constraints, but in code and domain-specific language generation, the relevant constraints are not always fully available before decoding and may emerge progressively from new declarations, inferred type information, or runtime analysis feedback. Existing structured-decoding engines efficiently handle fixed, predeclared, or previously seen constraint structures; however, when a first-seen grammar update changes the parser state induced by an already committed prefix, the straightforward solution reconstructs the constraint state under the updated grammar, repeating parsing work already performed over the prefix. We introduce GramDelta, an incremental framework for constrained decoding with append-only runtime grammar updates. GramDelta maintains parse state over the committed prefix and propagates only changes induced by newly added grammar rules through historical dependencies, avoiding prefix replay. It then maps the updated parse state to exact next-token masks via compilation-free factorized projection over shared historical charts, avoiding per-update mask-cache recompilation. GramDelta therefore preserves the result of full reconstruction while making update cost sensitive to the actual impact of a grammar change. Experiments across four model configurations show that GramDelta adds negligible overhead without updates; under sustained runtime grammar evolution, it reduces median first-seen grammar-update latency by 10.7--11.5x and reduces the additional TPOT overhead over unconstrained decoding by 53.1--81.9% relative to the strongest reconstruction baseline. These results enable efficient constrained decoding when constraints progressively emerge and evolve with the generated prefix.

</details>


### [293] [Is Prosody Encoded in the Neural Audio Codec Mimi?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32795)
*Nicolas Ballier,Artem Saloev,Erin Pacquetet,Taylor Arnold*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探究神经音频编解码器Mimi在编码阶段捕获了哪些与韵律相关的语音信息，而非仅评估解码重建语音的自然度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经音频编解码器（NAC）研究多聚焦于解码阶段的重建语音自然度，对编码阶段究竟捕获何种语音（音系/韵律）信息缺乏研究；Mimi被Moshi、Sesame等对话语音智能体及Hibiki等语音到语音翻译下游任务采用，其编码表征值得深入分析。

Method: 以Mimi编解码器为对象，考察其编码所得离散token序列中与韵律（prosody）潜在相关的对应线索（摘要未给出具体分析手段细节）。

Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果，仅说明研究聚焦于识别Mimi编码表示中潜在的韵律相关因素。

Conclusion: NAC评估应从仅看解码质量扩展到编码阶段所捕获的语言学信息；本工作为理解Mimi编码中的韵律表征提供了初步探究方向。

Abstract: Neural audio codecs (NACs) have become a fundamental infrastructure for modern speech-language models, discretizing continuous speech signals into token sequences that enable large language models to process and generate audio. Most research evaluates codec quality at the decoding phase, assessing the naturalness of reconstructed speech. However, little research investigates what phonetic information is captured during encoding. In this paper, we investigated the potential correlates of prosody in the NAC Mimi, a codec used by conversational speech agents such as Moshi and Sesame and used in downstream tasks such as speech-to-speech translation (Hibiki).

</details>


### [294] [LUCID: Statistically Grounded Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31595)
*Satiyabooshan Murugaboopathy,Adel Daoud,Connor T. Jerzak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LUCID：结合提示自校正与Design-based Supervised Learning（DSL），在无需重训练的前提下校准廉价语言模型评分器对思维链步骤的二分类评级，缩小校准差距并提升错误检测，同时用同一专家集做DSL去偏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 廉价语言模型评分器可大规模评估思维链推理，但系统性的步骤评级误差会扭曲推理审计与解答排序，因此需要低成本、无需权重访问的校准方法。

Method: LUCID:1) 用少量专家标注步骤，将评分器偏差以纯文本总结并提示评分器重评未见过步骤(prompt self-correction)；2) 用Design-based Supervised Learning(DSL)对齐预测与专家可靠率，用于校准与回归去偏；3) 循环中加入pre-/post-检查，跳过已校准评分器并回滚无效轮次；4) 复用专家集+原始语料评级的DSL做校准，及配对标注步骤的DSL刻画sound-step转移。

Result: PRM800K上GPT-5-mini过度严格(尤其低估计算、验证、后段步骤)。单轮将绝对预测-专家率差从7.8%降至0.9个百分点；假警报减半；对unsound步骤的错误检测F1提升32%；仅用1000个诊断步骤或整体差距反馈即可保持增益。可跨模型/领域迁移(将GPT-5-mini偏差轮廓应用于GLM-5.2提升PRM800K准确率；在数学、科学、网页、逻辑基准上收窄过度严格评分器的校准差距)。DSL out-of-fold可靠概率使best-of-K选择匹配专家标签；双稳健估计器在小预算下优于仅用专家回归拟合，sound-step转移误差降低近三分之二。

Conclusion: 提示反馈主要移动阈值而非改善类别均衡的sound/unsound判别能力，故需pre-/post检查筛选；LUCID提供低成本、免训练的可扩展评分器校准方案，DSL将其扩展为去偏与选择增益。

Abstract: Cheap language-model raters grade chain-of-thought reasoning at scale, yet systematic step-rating errors can skew reasoning audits and solution rankings. We introduce LUCID (Loop for Unbiased Calibration via Inference-time Diagnosis), which pairs prompt self-correction with Design-based Supervised Learning (DSL). Without retraining or weight access, LUCID calibrates binary step ratings by aligning predicted and expert soundness rates. From a small expert-labeled set, LUCID summarizes rater bias in plain text and prompts the rater to re-grade unseen steps. For example, on PRM800K, GPT-5-mini grades too strictly, under-rating computation, verification, and late-trace steps most acutely. In one pass, LUCID shrinks GPT-5-mini's calibration gap from 7.8 to 0.9 percentage points in absolute predicted-expert rate difference. LUCID also halves false alarms (sound steps rated unsound) and lifts error-detection F1 on unsound steps by 32%. LUCID retains these gains with 1,000 diagnostic steps or overall-gap feedback alone. The loop also transfers across models and domains: it applies GPT-5-mini's bias profile to lift GLM-5.2's PRM800K accuracy, and it narrows calibration gaps for overly strict but capable raters across math, science, web, and logic benchmarks. Because prompt feedback shifts thresholds without improving class-balanced sound/unsound discrimination, LUCID filters re-grading with pre-/post-checks that skip already calibrated raters and roll back ineffective passes. Finally, we reuse that expert set with raw corpus ratings in DSL for calibration and regression debiasing, and apply DSL to pair-labeled steps for sound-step transitions. DSL's out-of-fold soundness probabilities lift best-of-K selection to match expert labels, while its doubly-robust estimators beat expert-only regression fits at small budgets and cut sound-step transition error by nearly two-thirds.

</details>


### [295] [PazaBench: Large-Scale ASR Benchmark for Low-Resource Languages in Africa](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31578)
*Mercy Muchai,Nick Mumero Mwangi,Kevin Chege,Samuel Chege Maina*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建了面向39种非洲低资源语言的大规模ASR基准，统一整合6个公开语料，评测52个覆盖三大架构范式的先进模型，并用WER、CER与RTFx进行准确率-效率联合分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言在ASR基准中长期缺乏代表性，导致难以可靠评估与横向比较模型性能，尤其缺少面向非洲语言家族的、兼顾准确率与部署效率的系统性评测。

Method: 将六个公开语料协调统一为可复现的评测框架，覆盖39种非洲语言与多类数据集；评测52个SOTA ASR模型，横跨三种模型架构范式；采用WER、CER及逆实时因子RTFx作为准确率与效率指标；提出架构感知比较，系统分析单体模型与模型家族，并量化语言家族间的语言学差异对性能的影响。

Result: 给出跨39种语言、52个模型、三种架构的横向准确率与效率结果；揭示语言家族差异（linguistic variance）如何塑造ASR表现，并提供面向低资源部署场景的准确率-效率权衡分析。

Conclusion: 该基准、评测流水线与结果共同支撑面向低资源语言ASR模型的可透明、可复现且兼顾部署需求的评测。

Abstract: Low-resource languages remain underrepresented in ASR benchmarks, limiting the ability to reliably assess and compare model performance. We present a large-scale benchmark for automatic speech recognition (ASR) on low-resource languages in Africa. The benchmark harmonizes six public corpora into a unified, reproducible evaluation framework and evaluates 52 state-of-the-art ASR models spanning three model architectural paradigms across 39 African languages on diverse datasets. Models are evaluated using standard accuracy and efficiency metrics, word error rate (WER), character error rate (CER), and inverse real-time factor (RTFx). This benchmark introduces architecture-aware comparison that systematically analyzes both individual models and broader model families. In addition, we quantify linguistic variance across language families, revealing how these factors shape ASR performance across diverse African languages. We also provide a comprehensive accuracy and efficiency trade-off analysis directly relevant to deployment in low-resource settings. Together, the benchmark, evaluation pipeline, and results support transparent, reproducible, and deployment-aware evaluation of ASR models for low-resource languages.

</details>


### [296] [Implementation of Machine Translation for the Uzbek Language Based on Transformer Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32359)
*Mukhammadjon Musaev,Mannon Ochilov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建乌兹别克语-英语机器翻译系统，基于T5与mT5模型，通过数据采集、预处理与增强构建约300万句对的平行语料，微调后以BLEU评估，性能显著优于旧方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乌兹别克语存在可用数据有限、语言形态复杂的问题，且需推动其在数字世界中的应用，因此需要专门构建高质量的乌英语料与翻译模型。

Method: 采用T5与mT5等Transformer模型；针对低资源问题，进行数据收集、预处理与数据增强，形成约300万句对的乌英平行语料；在语料上对模型进行微调以优化翻译性能。

Result: 以BLEU为评价指标，所提方法的翻译效果相较旧有方法有显著提升。

Conclusion: 基于T5/mT5结合大规模构建语料与微调的方案可有效提升乌兹别克语机器翻译性能，并有助于该语言在数字环境中的推广。

Abstract: This research focuses on building a machine translation system for the Uzbek language using transformer models such as T5 and mT5. Because of the limited data and the complexity of the Uzbek language, we collect, preprocess and augment data to create a strong Uzbek-English parallel corpus of about 3 million sentence pairs. The models are fine-tuned for optimal translation performance, and we use the BLEU score to evaluate the results. This study shows that our approach significantly improves upon older methods and helps promote the Uzbek language in the digital world.

</details>


### [297] [ArEssays: Towards Robust Arabic Handwritten Text Understanding in Educational Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32211)
*Hamdy Mubarak,Anas Madkoor,Ehsaneddin Asgari,Majd Hawasly*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文提出ArEssays——覆盖埃及小学至中学学生真实手写阿拉伯语作文的大规模数据集（含逐字转写与语言校正双版本），并基准测试了34个视觉语言与OCR模型，揭示真实学生手写字识别上的显著性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手写阿拉伯语学生作文的自动理解受制于阿拉伯文字形复杂性与儿童书写的高变异性，而现有资源缺乏真实、跨学段的原始学生手写数据，制约了阿拉伯语OCR、文档理解与教育NLP研究。

Method: 构建ArEssays数据集：采集埃及小学至中学学生的真实作文，提供逐字转写（verbatim）与语言校正（corrected）两种标注版本；在此基础上对34个视觉语言模型与OCR模型（含微调系统）进行统一基准评测。

Result: 在真实学生手写数据上，各模型存在较大的性能差距，表明现有模型对儿童书写变异的鲁棒性不足。

Conclusion: 公开数据集、训练流程与评测结果，以支撑阿拉伯语OCR、文档理解与教育NLP的后续研究。

Abstract: Automated understanding of handwritten Arabic student essays remains challenging due to script complexity and high variability
  in children's writing. We introduce ArEssays, a large-scale dataset of authentic essays from primary to secondary students
  across Egypt, with both verbatim transcriptions and linguistically corrected versions. We benchmark 34 vision-language and OCR
  models, including fine-tuned systems, and find large performance gaps on real student handwriting. We release the dataset,
  training pipelines, and results to support research in Arabic OCR, document understanding, and educational NLP.

</details>


### [298] [fork() for Agents: Agent Kernel for Non-blocking LLM Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31727)
*Ankit Chadha,Pratyay Banerjee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Agent-Kernel 将分布式系统中的"子图选择性恢复"模式移植到 LLM 内容平面，以无验证器的 Sub-Graph Recovery (SGR) 原语实现非阻塞执行与失败恢复，在 14,434 次运行中于 budget=3 内达到 100% 恢复率，成功率 100% vs. 全轨迹重放的 55%，且比适配版 Sherlock 快约 10×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体多以同步方式执行工具调用，一旦失败便丢弃已完成工作。虽然分布式系统早已有子图选择性恢复（Spark、Erlang/OTP、Dryad），近期运行时（Sherlock、AgentGit、Atomix）也通过验证器、版本控制或事务边界保留成果，但这些方案依赖训练好的验证器/规划器或额外基础设施，未在 LLM 内容平面给出通用、轻量的恢复原语。

Method: 提出 Agent-Kernel 非阻塞运行时，核心原语为 Sub-Graph Recovery (SGR)：在原始异常触发下（无需训练验证器或规划器），仅重置失败节点的传递后代，保留已完成的兄弟节点；并将父节点文本组合进子节点提示（上下文继承）；整体构建于具备形式化状态保持保证的持久化基底之上。评测覆盖 tau-bench、Gaia2、AutomationBench、InterruptBench 及合成基准，共 14,434 次运行，并进行消融实验。

Result: SGR 在 budget=3 内实现完全恢复（100% vs. 全轨迹重放的 55%），比同样能恢复的适配版 Sherlock 回滚快约 10×；在线性负载上与 ReAct-serial 精度在噪声范围内持平，同时在结构允许时获得最高 12.7× 并行加速；消融显示移除 SGR 后成功率跌至 39.4%。

Conclusion: 子图选择性恢复这一成熟分布式系统模式可有效迁移至 LLM 智能体内容平面，无需验证器即可在异常驱动下实现高效、可证明状态安全的恢复与并行，显著优于全轨迹重放与回滚式方案。

Abstract: LLM-based agents typically execute tool calls synchronously and discard completed work upon failure. Subgraph-selective recovery, re-executing only a failed node's transitive descendants, is a well-established pattern in distributed systems (Spark, Erlang/OTP, Dryad), and recent agent runtimes (Sherlock, AgentGit, Atomix) preserve completed work through verifiers, version control, or transactional tool boundaries. We present \textbf{Agent-Kernel}, a non-blocking runtime that ports this pattern to the LLM \emph{content plane}: its primitive, \textbf{Sub-Graph Recovery (SGR)}, fires on a raw exception with no trained verifier or planner, resets a failed node's descendants while preserving completed siblings, and composes each parent's text into its children's prompts (context inheritance), all on a durable substrate with a formal state-preservation guarantee. Across 14{,}434 runs on synthetic and standard benchmarks (tau-bench, Gaia2, AutomationBench, InterruptBench), SGR reaches full recovery within budget=3 where whole-trajectory replay exhausts (100\% vs.\ 55\%), and is roughly 10$\times$ faster than an adapted Sherlock rollback that also recovers. It matches ReAct-serial accuracy within noise on linear workloads while adding recovery and parallelism (up to 12.7$\times$ speedup) where structure permits. Ablation isolates SGR: removing it collapses success to 39.4\%.

</details>


### [299] [Reading, Writing and Repairing Game-Theoretic Policies in Weight Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31979)
*Ancil Crayton*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文研究语言模型能否在重复博弈策略网络的权重空间上工作，用四个可精确验证的问题测试中型开放模型对1218权重循环网络的理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索LLM是否能直接处理策略网络的权重而非仅文本，并以可精确检验的答案衡量其程序理解与操纵能力。

Method: 在含1218个权重的循环网络上设计四类任务：根据英文描述的对手群体写出最优策略（价值为有限计算，可精确计算差距）；给定权重报告15个对手历史后的动作；在深度10的全部对手序列上恢复并评判其实现的状态机；以及在输出被单点篡改时修复网络并指出首次出错的轮次。

Result: 程序恢复成功66次中62次；15项行为条目全部正确36次中34次；当模型给出可编译策略时20次全部达到最优。修复表现最差：18次中4次修复成功、5次诊断正确，中位补丁仅覆盖所需两项条目之一。

Conclusion: 模型在权重空间中进行程序恢复与行为预测接近完美，但定位与修复单点故障的外部干预能力明显不足。

Abstract: Can a language model work in the weight space of a policy network for a repeated game? We put four questions to a mid-size open model, on recurrent networks of 1{,}218 weights with exactly checkable answers. Given a population of opponents described in English, write a policy that is optimal: its value is a finite computation over the agent's information state, so a submitted network has an exact gap from the optimum. Given a network's weights, report its action after each of fifteen opponent histories; recover the state machine it implements, judged on every opponent sequence to depth ten; or repair a network whose output was altered in one place and say which round first goes wrong. The model recovers the program in 62 of 66 replies, reports all fifteen behavioral entries correctly in 34 of 36, and attains the optimum in 20 of 20 when it states a policy the evaluator compiles. Repair is the exception: 4 of 18 repaired, 5 of 18 diagnosed, with a median patch covering one of the two entries needed.

</details>


### [300] [Evaluating Large Language Models on Iranian Doctoral Entrance Exams in Electrical and Computer Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31263)
*Sima Akbari Neisiyani,Hossein Taghizad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究用波斯语原题与英译两种版本，零样本评测 GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.5 与 Grok 4 在 2024/2025 年伊朗电气与计算机工程博士入学考试 433 道选择题上的表现，发现模型可分为两档，语言差异不显著，含图题目显著更难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 评测多集中于英语与通用学科，缺乏针对非英语（波斯语）、高难度专业（电气/计算机工程博士入学考）且严格控制题目与模型配对的系统评测，尤其缺少对图形依赖题与语言版本的量化比较。

Method: 从四本官方题册共 440 题中剔除 7 道题干或图形歧义题，保留 433 题（EE 186、CE 247，其中 39.5% 依赖图形）；每题提供波斯语原文与英译，共产生 3,464 条计分响应。2025 年 10 月通过单一商业网页接口 Perplexity、以自动化脚本对四个模型进行零样本、开启推理的查询。因所有模型作答同一批题目，统计推断全部采用配对检验或题目聚类模型，并报告 Holm 校正、精确 McNemar 检验与优势比。

Result: 准确率呈两档：GPT-5（79.9%，95% CI 76.6–83.1）与 Gemini 2.5 Pro（78.4%，74.8–81.9）无显著差异，二者均比 Grok 4（71.7%）和 Claude Sonnet 4.5（71.3%）高 6.7–8.7 个百分点（Holm 校正 p < 0.001）。英波准确率差异极小（−0.2 至 +2.5 点，精确 McNemar p ≥ 0.28），三个模型的 90% CI 落在 ±5 点内。含图题显著更难，校正学科后优势比为 0.30（95% CI 0.21–0.43）；两个模型表面上的 EE 劣势在控制含图题比例后消失。

Conclusion: 该基准显示顶尖 LLM 在高难度专业非英语考试上已达约 80% 准确率，语言迁移几乎无损，图形推理是主要瓶颈而非学科差异；作者公开题目级响应与分析代码，并指出网页接口的检索与解码设置不可控等局限。

Abstract: We evaluate four large language models (LLMs) on multiple-choice questions from the 2024 and 2025 Iranian national Ph.D. entrance examinations in Electrical Engineering (EE) and Computer Engineering (CE). Of the 440 questions in the four official booklets, 7 were excluded because the question statement or its figure was ambiguous, leaving 433 questions (186 EE, 247 CE), of which 171 (39.5\%) depend on a figure. Each question was presented in the original Persian and in an English translation, giving 3,464 scored responses. GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Grok 4 were queried zero-shot, with reasoning enabled, through a single commercial web interface (Perplexity) in October 2025, using an automated script. Because every model answers the same items, all inferences use paired tests or question-clustered models. Accuracy separates into two tiers: GPT-5 (79.9\%, 95\% CI 76.6--83.1) and Gemini 2.5 Pro (78.4\%, 74.8--81.9) are statistically indistinguishable, and both outperform Grok 4 (71.7\%) and Claude Sonnet 4.5 (71.3\%) by 6.7--8.7 percentage points (Holm-adjusted $p < 0.001$). The English--Persian accuracy difference is small for every model ($-0.2$ to $+2.5$ points; exact McNemar $p \ge 0.28$). For three models the 90\% confidence interval lies within $\pm 5$ points, so differences larger than this can be excluded. Questions with figures are much harder: the odds ratio is 0.30 (95\% CI 0.21--0.43) after adjusting for discipline. The apparent EE deficit of two models disappears once the larger share of figure-based EE items is accounted for. We describe the dataset, the protocol and its limitations, including the uncontrolled web-retrieval and decoding settings of the interface, and release item-level responses and analysis code.

</details>


### [301] [RegioZH: Unveiling Comprehension Disparities across Regional Chinese Varieties in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31262)
*Weihua Zheng,Wu Kui,Thong T. Doan,Lin Jingxia,AiTi Aw,Nancy F. Chen,Roy Ka-Wei Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RegioZH 是一个覆盖中国大陆、台湾、香港、新加坡、马来西亚的中文区域变体词汇推理基准（2,607 题多项选择），揭示 LLM 在中文内部各变体间的显著能力不均。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测将“中文”视为单一整体，掩盖了模型对区域用户（不同地区语言变体）的失效情况，缺乏对“语言内部”变体鲁棒性的评估。

Method: 由各地区母语标注者构建并经专家验证，聚焦本地化习语、俚语、语码混用、礼貌规范与社会文化表达；对 11 个 LLM 做零样本测试，并在 5 个模型上测试 persona 与结构化思维链提示；辅以表征、注意力、校准与表层特征分析及定性分析。

Result: 零样本下模型间差异明显，台湾与新加坡平均准确率相差 29.4 个百分点；persona 与结构化 CoT 仅带来选择性提升，说明部分错误源于检索或提示框架而非知识缺失；发现“标记注意力”与语义 grounding 的分离、强制选择下的过度自信错误，以及本地化词汇密度是稳定的难度预测因子。

Conclusion: 表面的中文流利度可能掩盖区域变体理解的不均衡，呼吁在跨语言泛化评估之外，同步开展语言内部（intra-language）鲁棒性评测。

Abstract: Current evaluations often treat Chinese varieties as monolithic, obscuring failures for regional users. We introduce RegioZH, a 2,607-item multiple-choice benchmark for regional lexical reasoning across Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Malaysia. Built by region-specific annotators and expert-validated, it targets localized idioms, slang, code-mixing, politeness conventions, and sociocultural expressions. Zero-shot results on eleven LLMs show large disparities, including a 29.4-point average accuracy gap between Taiwan and Singapore. Persona and structured chain-of-thought prompts for five models yield selective gains, suggesting that some errors stem from retrieval or framing rather than only missing knowledge. Representation, attention, calibration, and surface-feature analyses show a dissociation between marker attention and semantic grounding, overconfident forced-choice errors, and localized lexical density as a consistent difficulty predictor. Qualitative analysis finds terminology misunderstandings, sociocultural inference gaps, and cross-regional semantic divergence. RegioZH demonstrates that apparent Chinese proficiency can mask uneven understanding across regional varieties, motivating intra-language robustness evaluation alongside multilingual generalization.

</details>


### [302] [RecipeADQA: A User-aware Question-Answering Dataset for Multi-Constraint Recipe Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31259)
*Haotian Li,Shuai Jiang,Sayaka Kamei,Yasuhiko Morimoto*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出基于真实用户行为、结合LLM偏好抽取与知识图谱标签映射的基准式自然语言食谱推荐QA数据集构建方法，生成RecipeADQA（128,465条），并设计噪声增强检索重排模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有QA食谱推荐任务缺乏带真值标签的数据集，常用方法通过配料或标签约束的简单组合生成数据，导致表达不自然、约束不合理，难以反映用户真实偏好。

Method: 由真实用户行为驱动，融合外部用户查询与评论数据，用LLM抽取细粒度偏好信号并映射到基于知识图谱的标签体系，构建含偏好约束与配料约束的QA数据；采用贪心策略选择约束以控制答案规模，并用基于标签的重排提升数据质量。

Result: 数据集含自然语言问题、结构化约束与答案集共128,465条；在数据质量与检索推荐性能两方面与基线对比：在同一食谱知识图谱上覆盖更广、问题自然度与约束合理性更优、可查询性更强；在RecipeADQA上训练的噪声增强检索重排模型（轻量parser召回+小语言模型在噪声候选池中筛选排序）优于在基线数据集上训练的同一模型。

Conclusion: 真实行为驱动+LLM偏好抽取+知识图谱标签映射的数据构建范式可显著提升QA食谱推荐数据集质量与下游模型性能，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Question-answering recipe recommendation tasks lack datasets with ground-truth labels. Existing methods often generate datasets from simple combinations of ingredient or tag constraints, leading to unnatural expressions and unreasonable constraints that are hard to reflect users' real preferences. This paper proposes a construction method for a benchmark-style QA dataset for natural-language recipe recommendation. Driven by real user behavior, our method integrates external user query and review data to extract fine-grained preference signals by LLMs and maps them onto a knowledge-graph-based tag schema, thereby constructing QA data consisting of preference and ingredient constraints. Besides, a greedy strategy for constraint selection is also used to control the answer size, while tag-based re-ranking is applied to improve data quality. The generated dataset RecipeADQA contains natural-language questions, structured constraints, and answer sets, resulting in 128,465 instances. Experiments compare RecipeADQA with baseline datasets from two perspectives: data quality and retrieval-recommendation performance. The results show that ours outperforms existing methods on the same recipe knowledge graph in coverage, higher question quality in naturalness and constraint rationality, and better queryability. Moreover, we design a noise-augmented retrieve-and-rerank model, in which a lightweight parser first retrieves candidate recipes, and a small language model then selects and ranks relevant recipes from a noisy candidate pool. The model trained on RecipeADQA outperforms the same model trained on the baseline datasets. The relevant construction code and data have been open-sourced at a GitHub repository https://github.com/MorimoLab/RecipeADQA.

</details>


### [303] [Directly Maximizing On-policy Expected Accepted Length for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31256)
*Ziying Zhang,Yaqing Wang,Yong Liu,Quanming Yao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FreDraft 是一种 on-policy 草稿模型训练方法，直接最大化草稿的期望接受前缀长度，通过解析边缘化与梯度重分配提升接受长度与解码加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码中草稿训练通常只优化 token 级分布对齐，而解码收益取决于被接受前缀长度；一旦某草稿 token 被拒绝，其后所有草稿 token 均被丢弃，故 token 级对齐并非直接优化目标。

Method: 提出 FreDraft：以当前草稿模型采样、直接最大化期望接受长度；目标函数显式建模"首次拒绝截断"，导出前缀感知的信用分配，将每个 token 按其对本 token 及后续 token 接受性的贡献加权；利用目标模型词表分布对 token 级接受率进行解析边缘化以降低梯度方差；并将部分分布级梯度重分配为对草稿概率高估 token 的显式惩罚，同时保持期望梯度不变。

Result: 在多个基准与多个目标模型上，FreDraft 相比强基线提升接受长度与解码加速比，且 on-policy 训练收敛更快。

Conclusion: 直接优化接受前缀长度是优于 token 级分布对齐的草稿训练范式，配合解析边缘化与梯度重分配可在不引入偏差的前提下兼顾效果与训练效率。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a lightweight draft model to propose tokens for verification by a target model. Draft training commonly optimizes token-level distribution alignment, but this does not directly optimize the length of the accepted prefix: once a draft token is rejected, all subsequent draft tokens are discarded. We propose FreDraft, an on-policy training method that directly maximizes the expected accepted length of drafts sampled from the current draft model. This objective accounts for first-rejection truncation and induces prefix-aware credit assignment, weighting each token by its contribution to the acceptance of the current and subsequent tokens. To optimize the objective efficiently, we analytically marginalize token-level acceptance rate, using the target model's vocabulary distribution to reduce gradient variance. We further redistribute part of this distribution-level gradient into an explicit penalty for sampled tokens whose probabilities are overestimated by the draft model, while preserving the expected gradient. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and target models show that FreDraft improves accepted length and decoding speedup over strong baselines, achieving faster on-policy training convergence.

</details>


### [304] [INCLUDE-2.0: Disentangling Knowledge Gaps in Multilingual LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31255)
*Angelika Romanou,Maria Grandury,Clara Meister,Negar Foroutan,Jabez Magomere,Anna Sotnikova,Hitesh Laxmichand Patel,Akshay Kumar Dubey,Alfonso Amayuelas,Amit Agarwal,Arion Das,Carlos Arriaga,Cheng Yu,Dalia Ali,David Quispe-Castillo,Fenal Ashokbhai Ilasariya,Francisco-Javier Rodrigo-Gines,Gonzalo Martinez,Gouthami Vadithya,Guido Ivetta,Javier Conde,Jorge Vallego,Juan J. Calderon G.,Karan Gupta,Marcos J Gomez,Marvin M. Agüero-Torales,Mithil Bangera,Naira Paola Arnez Jordan,Oscar M. Cumbicus-Pineda,Priyaranjan Pattnayak,Reewos Erwin Talla Chumpitaz,Sahil Aggarwal,Sahil Raj,Shruti Jalan,Srikant Panda,Susana Zhou,Yeshil Bangera,Orestis Papakyriakopoulos,Scott A. Hale,Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad,Antoine Bosselut*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 INCLUDE-2.0 区域感知多语言事实性评测基准，覆盖91种语言、86个国家（127个语言-国家对），超22万条来自本土来源的样本，区分四类区域知识，并揭示前沿模型在本地嵌入式知识上显著劣于广泛记载事实（约降14.5分）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 multilingual benchmark 覆盖语言远少于预训练语料所含语言，且常将语言熟练度与回答特定区域/社区问题的能力混为一谈，把语言当作区域的代理，无法细粒度刻画区域知识的类型差异。

Method: 构建 INCLUDE-2.0 大规模基准，涵盖91种语言、86个国家（127个语言-国家对）、超220K条来自本土区域来源的精选样本；按区域知识类型划分四类（与语境无关、因国家而异、关于某地的广泛记载事实、主要依赖本地语言文化来源的知识），每项标注知识类型与领域并配英文翻译，以支持语言熟练度与区域知识持有度的受控对比分析；在前沿与开源权重模型上评测。

Result: 聚合多语言准确率掩盖了区域知识类型、语言与区域间的显著差异；前沿模型在本地嵌入式知识上较广泛记载事实平均下降约14.5分；开源权重模型随规模提升准确率，但并未可靠地使性能对"用英语提问还是用原语言提问"保持不变。

Conclusion: INCLUDE-2.0 表明多语言总体准确率不足以衡量区域知识能力，需按区域知识类型分别评测；本地嵌入式知识仍是模型短板，规模扩展不等同于语言不变性，基准已公开。

Abstract: Current multilingual benchmarks cover only a fraction of the languages represented in modern pretraining corpora and often conflate language proficiency with the ability to answer questions grounded in specific regions and communities. We introduce INCLUDE-2.0, a large-scale benchmark for region-aware multilingual factual evaluation, which covers 91 languages from 86 countries (127 total language--country pairs), comprising over 220K curated samples drawn from native regional sources. Unlike existing benchmarks that often treat language as a proxy for region, IINCLUDE-2.0 distinguishes between questions whose answers are independent of context, vary by country, concern widely documented facts about a place, or depend on knowledge primarily expressed through local linguistic and cultural sources. Each item is annotated with its regional knowledge type and domain, and paired with an English translation, enabling controlled analysis of the relationship between language proficiency and possession of regional knowledge.
  Evaluating frontier and open-weight models on IINCLUDE-2.0, we find that aggregate multilingual accuracy masks substantial variation across regional knowledge types, languages, and regions. We find that frontier models perform worse on locally embedded knowledge than on widely documented facts about regions, with an average drop of ~14.5 points. We also show that for open-weight models, scale improves accuracy but does not reliably make performance invariant to whether a question is asked in English or its original language. INCLUDE-2.0 is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/epfl-nlp/include-2.0

</details>


### [305] [CoT-Proxy: Cross-Format Transfer for Distilling Long-Horizon Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33148)
*Dawid J. Kopiczko,Tijmen Blankevoort,Yuki M. Asano*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 仅用教师模型的动作（无可见思维链）即可将长程策略蒸馏给学生模型，且蒸馏所得策略可迁移至开启思考的推理模式（"格式迁移"）；引入CoT-proxies进一步显著提升，并可无缝应用于闭源教师。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程推理智能体通常依赖RL或对强教师轨迹的微调，但标准做法同时模仿教师的思维链与动作；然而最强教师为闭源模型，其思维链被API隐藏，无法获取。因此需要一种不依赖隐藏CoT的蒸馏方法。

Method: 在仅含教师动作的轨迹上训练学生，推理块留空（empty reasoning block）；同时对其自身生成的replay buffer施加KL损失以限制相对初始模型的漂移。进一步提出CoT-proxies：在空推理块后放置教师推理的简短摘要。该配方对闭源教师同样适用，可直接使用API返回的可见输出与推理摘要。

Result: 蒸馏Qwen3.6-27B的动作使Qwen3-4B在AppWorld上成功率从7%升至18%，Qwen3-32B从12%升至25%；加入CoT-proxies后Qwen3-4B进一步提升至35%。蒸馏闭源GPT-5.6 Luna的可见输出与推理摘要，使Qwen3-4B在AppWorld上从7%升至48%，在SWE-bench Verified上从3%升至28%。

Conclusion: 空推理块下学到的长程策略可迁移到开启思考的推理阶段：学生以自身风格推理、以教师风格行动（cross-format transfer）。由于动作与CoT-proxies均不依赖隐藏思维链，该范式可原样用于闭源教师，实现强闭源模型到开源智能体的高效蒸馏。

Abstract: Reasoning models become long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning or, more cheaply, through fine-tuning on a stronger teacher's trajectories, which contain the teacher's chain-of-thought as well as its actions. The standard fine-tuning approach imitates both, yet the strongest teachers are closed models whose chain-of-thought is hidden behind an API. We show that the chain-of-thought can be left out altogether and that the long-horizon policy can be distilled from the teacher's actions alone. The student is trained on these trajectories with its reasoning block left empty, while a KL loss on a replay buffer of its own generations limits drift from its initial model. Surprisingly, the policy learned from these trajectories with an empty reasoning block carries over to inference with thinking enabled, where the student reasons in its own style while acting like the teacher, an effect we call cross-format transfer. Distilling the actions of Qwen3.6-27B raises the task success of Qwen3-4B on AppWorld from 7% to 18% and that of Qwen3-32B from 12% to 25%. We further introduce CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher's reasoning placed after the empty reasoning block, which raise Qwen3-4B further, to 35%. Since neither actions nor CoT-proxies need the hidden chain-of-thought, the recipe applies unchanged to closed teachers. Distilling GPT-5.6 Luna from its visible outputs and the reasoning summaries its API returns raises Qwen3-4B from 7% to 48% on AppWorld and from 3% to 28% on SWE-bench Verified.

</details>


### [306] [AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33093)
*Guangyuan Wang,Chengran Li,Minchen Luo,Jichen Feng,Mengdi Wang,Yifan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AIChipBench 提出用可综合 RTL 实现量化 LLM 解码器（Qwen3.5、Gemma 3、Gemma 4、Llama 3.2）的 agent 基准，核心发现是困难在于跨解码步的存储状态，指向首个状态失配的反馈比仅输出反馈提升 25.0–46.9 个百分点且减半人时，69 个通过设计中 45 个在新序列/条件下 32 步内失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 解码器在硬件中携带跨步状态，错误的状�态更新可能让当前 token 正确却在若干步后污染输出，使设计"通过测试但仍然错误"。现有代码基准缺少对硬件 RTL 实现、状态正确性及隐藏测试泛化的刻画，因此需要一个能揭示 agent 在状态推理与调试能力短板上限的基准。

Method: 构建 AIChipBench：(1) 任务为按可执行整数参考模型实现量化 Qwen3.5/Gemma 3/Gemma 4/Llama 3.2 解码器的可综合 RTL，参考模型规定每步输出与存储状态；(2) 固定预算下用公开测试调试，冻结设计在留出 token 序列、复位、存储停顿与综合上评分；(3) 第二赛道要求在近似固定面积下加速正确设计；(4) 匹配研究对比"指向首个状态失配的反馈"与"仅输出反馈"；(5) 统计 9,136 次尝试、四个 agent，并用 200 次随机划分检验排名稳定性。

Result: 匹配研究全部 12 个 agent–任务单元中，状态失配反馈使接受率提升 25.0–46.9 个百分点，接受设计的 agent 小时数减半。新序列与新条件下重评，69 个被接受设计中有 45 个在其测试所覆盖的 32 步内失败。超过三分之一的加速尝试未能产出正确且合规的更快设计。综合得分排名 Sol 5.6、Fable 5.1 高于 Astra 6 与 Opus 5.5，且两个半边实例在全部 200 次随机划分中给出同一顺序。

Conclusion: 硬件 agent 需要能暴露存储状态的调试反馈，其评测基准也必须使用远超开发用例的最终测试，否则"通过测试"无法代表设计正确。

Abstract: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. They debug against public tests under fixed budgets; their frozen designs are graded on held-out token sequences, resets, memory stalls, and synthesis, and a second track asks them to speed up a correct design at nearly fixed area. Across 9,136 attempts by four coding agents, the difficulty lies in stored state. Feedback that points to the first state mismatch raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent--task cells of a matched study, by 25.0 to 46.9 percentage points, and halves the agent-hours per accepted design. Regraded on new sequences and conditions, 45 of 69 accepted designs fail within the 32 steps their tests required. More than a third of attempts to speed up a correct design end without one. An overall score ranks Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5, and both halves of the instances give this order in all 200 random splits. Hardware agents therefore need debugging feedback that exposes stored state, and their benchmarks need final tests well beyond the development cases.

</details>


### [307] [FOL-Proof: Verifying LLM Text-to-Logic Translations via Deterministic Semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33078)
*Yisrael Clark,Guy Katz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出FOL-Proof语义防火墙：用ERG/MRS确定性生成候选译文、以SMT求解器检验LLM生成一阶逻辑公式的逻辑等价性，实现近完美的选择性准确率并支持拒答与可选修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被广泛用于将自然语言陈述翻译为一阶逻辑以增强推理，但LLM易出错，语义不忠实的FOL公式会污染下游推理，因此需要一种可靠机制来校验翻译的语义忠实性。

Method: FOL-Proof流程：(1) 借助English Resource Grammar与Minimal Recursion Semantics等语义分析工具确定性地获取候选译文池；(2) 将每个派生读法与LLM生成的公式交由SMT求解器检验逻辑等价性；(3) 忠实则接受，否则拒绝，或通过多次调用LLM尝试修复。整体设计保守：搜索不完备、构造不支持或检验不确定时选择弃权而非误拒。

Result: 在ProofWriter、RuleTaker、PrOntoQA等既有基准及新建对抗性基准LongFaithCheck上评估，FOL-Proof达到近乎完美的选择性准确率（selective accuracy），而直接LLM评判器与往返（round-trip）基线表现明显更差。

Conclusion: 以独立语言学解释为参照、用SMT做逻辑等价检验的语义防火墙，能在保守弃权机制下有效识别LLM生成FOL的不忠实翻译，显著优于LLM自评与往返校验等替代方案。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate natural-language statements into first-order logic (FOL) to improve reasoning. However, LLMs are prone to errors, and so a semantically unfaithful FOL formula could corrupt downstream reasoning. We present FOL-Proof, a semantic firewall pipeline that validates LLM-generated FOL translations against independently derived linguistic interpretations. FOL-Proof operates by deterministically obtaining a pool of candidate translations via semantic analysis tools, such as the English Resource Grammar and Minimal Recursion Semantics; then applying an SMT solver to check each derived reading for logical equivalence to the LLM-generated formula. If the translation is faithful it is accepted; otherwise, it is rejected, or optionally repaired via repeated invocations to the LLM. The procedure is conservative: incomplete search, unsupported constructions, or inconclusive checks yield abstention rather than false rejection. We evaluated FOL-Proof on established benchmarks (ProofWriter, RuleTaker and PrOntoQA), and also on a new adversarial benchmark (LongFaithCheck). Our experiments show that FOL-Proof attains near perfect selective accuracy, while direct LLM judges and round-trip baselines show substantially worse performance.

</details>


### [308] [Modelling Billingual Learning Through LLM Training: A Critical-Period Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32997)
*Uriel Benymon,Tristan Whipps,Armita Ghobadi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该探索性计算研究用小规模两层GPT-2，先学英语再学德语（较近）或芬兰语（较远），比较顺序训练与EWC，考察嵌入层和两个Transformer层中英/二语表征的余弦相似度变化，作为关键期效应的表征层面检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关键期假说认为二语习得能力可能取决于已获一语知识被修改的难易程度；既有研究多停留在行为层面，本文尝试从神经语言模型的内部表征切入。

Method: 小规模两层GPT-2先训练英语，再以顺序训练或EWC（约束对英语重要的参数）训练德语或芬兰语；每种语言取20个留出探测句，取平均池化隐状态，在嵌入层和两个Transformer层，于1个与2个二语epoch后与纯英语模型做余弦相似度比较。

Result: 英语相似度在Transformer层保持较高、在嵌入层转为负值；二语相似度在Transformer层上升；德语与芬兰语在第二Transformer层的差异大于第一层；EWC使Fisher加权参数漂移降低约6%，但Transformer层相似度变化小于.001。

Conclusion: 表征层面可观察到与关键期相关的层级分化模式，但EWC对表征相似度影响极小；每条件仅一次训练，结论属初步，需多次运行与更多验证。

Abstract: Critical-period accounts of second-language (L2) acquisition suggest that the ability to learn a new language may depend on how easily previously acquired first-language (L1) knowledge can be modified. This exploratory computational study extends a neural language-model approach to critical period effects by examining internal representations rather than behavior. A small two-layer GPT-2 model was trained on English and then on German (a relatively related L2) or Finnish (a relatively distant L2) through either Sequential training or Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which limits change in parameters important for English. Mean-pooled hidden states for 20 held-out probe sentences per language were compared with those of the English-only model using cosine similarity at the embedding layer and two transformer layers after one and two L2 epochs. English similarity remained high in the transformer layers but became negative in the embedding layer. L2 similarity increased in the transformer layers, and German and Finnish differed more in the second transformer layer than in the first. EWC reduced Fisher-weighted parameter drift by about 6% but changed transformer-layer similarity by less than .001. With one training run per condition, these findings are preliminary.

</details>


### [309] [Social Bias Neurons in Multilingual Language Models: A Mechanistic Interpretability Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32685)
*Lance Calvin Lim Gamboa,Yue Feng,Mark Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文用机制可解释性方法（激活概率熵 vs. 积分差距梯度）定位多语言指令微调模型中的社会偏见神经元，覆盖3个模型、4种语言、7个偏见维度；发现积分差距梯度更有效，所识别神经元集中于最深层，抑制后显著降低偏见，且高/低资源语言的神经元分布不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言模型在处理涉及社会刻板印象的输入时存在社会偏见，但模型内部哪些组件编码这些偏见尚不清楚，需要定位并刻画偏见相关的内部表征。

Method: 将新兴的机制可解释性方法适配到多语言偏见分析：基于多语言偏见基准，采用两种偏见神经元识别方法——激活概率熵与积分差距梯度（integrated gap gradients）；在3个指令微调模型、4种语言、7个偏见维度上开展分析，并通过抑制所识别神经元来验证其因果作用。

Result: 积分差距梯度方法更有效：其隔离出的神经元（主要集中于模型最深层）被抑制时，模型偏见下降更明显；神经元分布在高资源与低资源语言间存在差异，说明语言在预训练数据中的表征影响偏见在模型内部的表示方式；性别、国籍、社会阶层三类偏见神经元与其他偏见维度的神经元重叠最多。

Conclusion: 社会偏见在多语言模型内部可由特定神经元刻画，深层神经元起关键作用；预训练资源水平影响偏见的内部表征；性别、国籍、社会阶层是模型学习与处理偏见时的枢纽维度。该工作为多语言偏见的多维度机制分析与后续去偏干预提供了依据。

Abstract: Multilingual models exhibit social bias when processing inputs pertaining to societal stereotypes. We adapt emerging mechanistic interpretability methods to pinpoint and characterize model components that encode this bias. We conduct our analysis across three instruction-tuned models, four languages, and seven bias dimensions. Specifically, we leverage multilingual bias benchmarks in implementing two methods for identifying social bias neurons: activation probability entropy and integrated gap gradients. We find the latter method to be more effective, as the neurons it isolates (which are largely concentrated at the model's deepest layers) lead to sharper decreases in model bias when suppressed. Further analysis reveals neuron distribution patterns differ between high- and low-resourced languages, suggesting that a language's representation in pretraining data influences how its biases are represented within model internals. Our results also indicate that neurons linked to gender, nationality, and social class biases overlap the most with neurons related to other bias dimensions, pointing to the pivotal role these three dimensions play in how models learn and handle bias.

</details>


### [310] [Generating Schema-Aligned Synthetic Dialogues and Measuring Their Diversity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32631)
*Konrad Stolte,Toni Fetzer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"先采样结构记录、再生成对话"的反向合成流程，并加入变化配置、人设与主题计划以提升多样性；嵌入空间参与比达23.3（基线9.2），下游8B抽取模型字段准确率64.8%（基线57.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话转结构化记录的模型需要成对数据（转写文本+精确记录），但标注成本高，敏感领域更难获取，故需无需标注的合成方案。

Method: 以相反顺序构建数据：先采样schema合法的记录，再由记录生成对话，可选由对话合成语音，使标签先于文本存在；针对朴素提示仅产生单一对话的小幅变体，引入采样变化配置、人设（personas）与按记录字段排序的主题计划作为显式变化机制；以嵌入空间度量输出多样性（参与比），并在两个医学对话语料上验证。

Result: 完整配置下嵌入方差分布在约2.5倍的独立方向上（参与比23.3 vs 9.2）；两个医学对话语料给出同量级数值，样本量、文本长度与语言为额外影响因素；下游测试中8B抽取模型在本文方法数据上微调达64.8%字段准确率，朴素生成数据为57.5%。

Conclusion: 反向合成加显式变化机制可在无标注条件下生成高多样性、记录对齐的对话数据，并显著提升下游结构化抽取性能；作者开源生成库与含对齐记录的德语临床对话语料。

Abstract: Training or evaluating a model that turns a conversation into a structured record requires paired data, meaning a transcript together with the exact record it should be converted into. Such pairs are expensive to annotate, and in sensitive domains they are also difficult to obtain at all. We therefore build them in the opposite order by sampling a schema-valid record first, then writing a dialogue from it, and optionally synthesizing speech from the dialogue, so the label exists before the text and we need no annotation step. Naively prompting a language model for such dialogues yields small variations of a single conversation, so we add a sampled variation configuration, personas, and a topic plan that orders the fields of the record as explicit mechanisms for variation. We measure the variation that reaches the output through embedding space, where the embedding variance spreads over about two and a half times as many independent directions with our full configuration compared to without (participation ratio 23.3 against 9.2). Two corpora of medical dialogue give values of the same order, with sample size, text length and language being additional factors there. We also show the positive effect of our method in a downstream test, where an 8B extraction model reaches 64.8% field accuracy when fine-tuned on dialogues from our method, against 57.5% from naive generation. We release the generation library and the generated corpus of German clinical dialogues with aligned records.

</details>


### [311] [MargEmbed-Akan: Bridging Twi Questions and English Knowledge through Cross-Lingual Score Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32630)
*Prince N. Y. Annan,Ali A. A. Aziz,Stephen E. Moore*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出跨语言查询编码器MargEmbed-Akan，通过跨语言得分蒸馏将Twi查询映射到英文段落检索空间，在AfriQA上以71.5 nDCG@10超越gemini-embedding-001等模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Twi（Akan）使用者在线检索的信息多为英文，跨语言检索（Twi查询→英文文档）至关重要；而现有开放/商用嵌入模型在低资源语言上的跨语言检索能力缺乏评测与改进方案。

Method: 构建两个Twi-English评测任务（AfriQA：1,221条原生Asante Twi问题检索英文维基段落；圣经翻译检索：Twi段落检索英文译文，6,195候选）。评测8个系统（BM25、5个开放嵌入模型、gemini-embedding-001与OpenAI text-embedding-3-large）。提出MargEmbed-Akan：以AfriE5-Large-instruct为基座的560M参数查询编码器，采用跨语言得分蒸馏——冻结基座对英文训练问题与其答案段落及7个难负例打分，学生模型分别从通过回译校验的NLLB-200 Twi译文和原英文问题复现这些分数以保持英文行为；训练时段落由冻结基座编码，评测时由MargEmbed-Akan编码。

Result: AfriQA：基座AfriE5与gemini-embedding-001均为66.6 nDCG@10，EmbeddingGemma 2、Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B、OpenAI text-embedding-3-large分别为56.6、51.3、53.4；MargEmbed-Akan达71.5，分别领先gemini 4.9、基座5.0、OpenAI 18.1；在无E/O标记的Twi上增益最大（+7.5）；英文检索与基座无显著差异，但两个商用模型高1.5-2.2分。圣经检索：标准Twi上与gemini统计持平（97.2 vs 96.5），无变音符Twi上更优（92.7 vs 84.9）。训练与模型选择未使用AfriQA数据。

Conclusion: 跨语言得分蒸馏可在不损害英文检索能力的前提下显著提升低资源语言（Twi）跨语言检索性能，尤其对非规范拼写（无变音符/Twi正字法缺失）更鲁棒，说明以强基座蒸馏构建轻量查询编码器是低资源跨语言检索的有效路径。

Abstract: Most information sought online by Twi (Akan) speakers is written in English, making cross-lingual retrieval essential. We evaluate eight systems: BM25, five open embedding models, and two proprietary models (gemini-embedding-001 and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large) on two Twi-English tasks. AfriQA contains 1,221 natively written Asante Twi questions that must retrieve their answering English Wikipedia passages. Bible translation retrieval requires a Twi passage to retrieve its English translation from 6,195 candidates.
  We introduce MargEmbed-Akan, a 560M-parameter open query encoder trained from AfriE5-Large-instruct using cross-lingual score distillation. The frozen base model scores each English training question against its answer passage and seven hard negatives. The student learns to reproduce these scores from both an NLLB-200 Twi translation that passes a round-trip translation check and the original English question, preserving English behaviour. During training, passages are encoded by the frozen base model; at evaluation, MargEmbed-Akan encodes questions and passages.
  On AfriQA, base AfriE5 and gemini-embedding-001 both achieve 66.6 nDCG@10; EmbeddingGemma 2, Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large achieve 56.6, 51.3, and 53.4, respectively. MargEmbed-Akan achieves 71.5, outperforming gemini-embedding-001 by 4.9 points, its base model by 5.0, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large by 18.1. Its largest gain is on Twi typed without E and O (+7.5 over gemini-embedding-001). English retrieval does not differ significantly from the base model, although both proprietary models score 1.5-2.2 points higher. On Bible translation retrieval, MargEmbed-Akan and gemini-embedding-001 are statistically tied on standard Twi (97.2 vs. 96.5 nDCG@10); MargEmbed-Akan performs better on diacritic-free Twi (92.7 vs. 84.9). No AfriQA data was used for training or model selection.

</details>


### [312] [ASCENT: A Benchmark for Evaluating and Advancing Stepwise Diagnostic Reasoning in Large Language Models on Common Clinical Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32734)
*Yera Choi,Yeong Hwa Kim,Jaedeok Lee,Taekang Kim,Sangdoo Yun,Seong-Eun Moon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ASCENT：基于MedQA-USMLE构建的3,078道临床标注式分步推理基准与训练资源，将病例拆解为与EMR对齐的Findings、Impression、Rationale步骤，用于在信息不完整条件下评估LLM的中介推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在医学问答上表现优异，但真实临床工作流的核心是"随信息累积不断修正印象"的分步诊断推理，现有评测几乎不覆盖该能力。

Method: 将每道MedQA-USMLE病例分解为EMR对齐的Findings—Impression—Rationale分步结构，由临床医生标注；在ASCENT上评测现有LLM，并对Qwen2.5-7B/32B进行微调；辅以反事实扰动、格式—内容对照、评判一致性及rollout等稳健性分析。

Result: 强推理模型在MedQA-USMLE上表现良好但在ASCENT上仍有明显提升空间，通用前沿模型差距更大，凸显"全信息诊断"与"分步诊断"之间的持续鸿沟；ASCENT微调相较预训练基线与HuatuoGPT-o1 CoT训练基线取得可测的F1提升，增益主要来自precision；微调模型依赖先前印象的诊断内容而非模仿其输出格式。

Conclusion: ASCENT揭示了LLM分步诊断推理的能力缺口，并证明针对性监督微调有效；但rollout下的误差传播仍是临床部署的关键挑战。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at medical question answering yet are rarely evaluated on the stepwise diagnostic reasoning that defines real clinical workflows, where impressions are revised as information accumulates. We build Annotated Stepwise Clinical rEasoning for NaturalisTic Diagnosis (ASCENT), a clinician-annotated benchmark and training resource of 3,078 stepwise problems derived from MedQA-USMLE that decomposes each vignette into EMR-aligned steps (Findings, Impression, supporting Rationale), enabling evaluation of intermediate reasoning under incomplete information.
  Experiments and training with ASCENT revealed insights into how current LLMs handle stepwise diagnostic reasoning. Even strong reasoning models that perform well on MedQA-USMLE leave substantial headroom on ASCENT, and general-purpose frontier models trail further, exposing a persistent gap between fully informed and stepwise diagnosis. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B and 32B on ASCENT yields measurable F1 gains over both pre-trained and HuatuoGPT-o1 CoT-trained baselines, with gains driven primarily by precision. Complementary robustness analyses (counterfactual perturbation, format-vs-content control, judge agreement, and rollout) further show that ASCENT-fine-tuned models rely on the diagnostic content of prior impressions rather than imitating their output format, while error propagation under rollout remains a key challenge for clinical deployment.

</details>


### [313] [Exploring Multi-Player Social Games as Verifiable Training Grounds for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31821)
*Keyu He,Michael Li,Jiarui Liu,Mingqian Zheng,Koichi Onoue,Tongshuang Wu,Maarten Sap*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用三种多人社交游戏的可验证胜负作为奖励，通过SFT与RLVR训练Qwen3模型，显著提升其社交智能，且效果可泛化到未见游戏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练社交智能语言模型通常依赖LLM裁判，成本高、噪声大且易被reward hacking；社交游戏的规则本身提供客观可验证的结果，可作为训练奖励的天然替代方案。

Method: 在三种多人社交游戏上，对Qwen3（1.7B、4B、32B）进行监督微调（SFT）和带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），并以更强的Gemma-3-27B作为对手评估胜率，同时对比提示等上下文策略。

Result: Qwen3-4B对Gemma-3-27B的胜率在三种训练游戏上从33%升至81%，在三种额外留出游戏上从39%升至54%；相比之下，上下文提示策略在同一组游戏上仅提升约6个百分点；增益在1.7B、4B、32B各规模上均成立。

Conclusion: 在社交游戏的可验证结果上训练LLM可培养可泛化的社交行为（更开放的信息分享、依据公开证据核验他人主张、协调投票），为构建社交智能体提供可扩展路径。

Abstract: The training of socially intelligent language models often relies on large language model (LLM) judges, which are expensive, noisy, and vulnerable to reward hacking. Multi-player social games offer a natural alternative: they require open-ended communication to coordinate with teammates and infer hidden roles, while their rules provide an objective outcome which can serve as a verifiable reward for training. Using three social games, we explore how much social intelligence Qwen3 models can acquire through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Results show that against a much stronger Gemma-3-27B model, SFT and RLVR raise the win rate of Qwen3-4B from 33% to 81% on the three trained games, and from 39% to 54% on three additional held-out games. In contrast, in-context strategies such as prompting improve the win rate of Qwen3-4B by only about 6 pp across the same games we train and evaluate on. Furthermore, we show that the gains from SFT and RLVR hold across the model sizes 1.7B, 4B, and 32B. Qualitative analyses of agent behavior show signs of stronger social intelligence; for example, trained agents tend to share information more openly, check each other's claims against public evidence, and coordinate their votes. More broadly, our results demonstrate that training LLMs on verifiable outcomes in social games can cultivate generalizable social behaviors, which offers a scalable path for building socially intelligent agents.

</details>


### [314] [SPARQL-Planned Single-Hop Traversal over a Live Knowledge Graph for Multi-Hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31771)
*Priyesh Vakharia,Masud Moshtaghi,Pratyay Banerjee,Nicholas Jedema,Amita Misra,Ankit Chadha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出将稠密检索与知识图谱遍历**交错（interleave）**的方法解决多跳问答，用LLM以SPARQL形式规划遍历路径但**只解析不执行**，在三个多跳基准上取得最优EM/F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
